title: 第一類對位法
text: 各聲部的獨立性
en: Independence of the Lines

title: 第一類對位法
text: 與定旋律一樣，對位聲部也應只有一個高潮。為了保持各聲部的獨立性，以及整個樂段的流暢，兩者的高潮不應同時出現，避免雙重高潮使某一瞬間受到過度強調。〔原文段末另有孤立的術語連結：倒數第二個（penultimate）。〕
en: Like the cantus firmus, the counterpoint line should have a single climax. To maintain the independence of the lines and the smoothness of the entire passage (so no one moment is hyper-emphasized by a double climax), these climaxes should not coincide.penultimate

title: 第一類對位法
text: 對位聲部容許有一次同音重複或延音線連結，但仍應盡量完全避免重複。練習原本就只有少數音符，這樣才能增加變化。
en: A single repeat/tie in the counterpoint is allowed, but try to avoid repeating at all. This promotes variety in the exercise, since there are so few notes to begin with.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 避免聲部交叉。交叉會削弱各聲部的獨立性，讓聽者更難分辨它們。
en: Avoid voice crossing. Voice crossings diminish the independence of the lines and make them more difficult to distinguish by ear.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 避免聲部超越，也就是某聲部越過另一聲部前一個音的音高。例如，若上聲部唱 E4，下聲部就不能在下一小節唱 F4。這也有助於保持各聲部的獨立性。
en: Avoid voice overlap, where one voice leaps past the previous note of the other voice. For example, if the upper part sings an E4, the lower part cannot sing an F4 in the following bar. This also helps maintain the independence of the lines.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 音程與聲部進行
en: Intervals and Motion

title: 第一類對位法
text: 在任何時刻，定旋律與對位聲部之間的音程都不應超過完全十二度，也就是八度加五度。大致而言，盡可能讓兩條旋律保持在八度以內；只有在不得已時才超過十度，而且只能維持一、兩個音。兩個聲部相距太遠，會減弱音響的融合，也可能降低演出的可行性。演奏是否方便雖然不是人類認知的基本原理，卻是作曲家必須考量的事，並且會直接影響聽者在演出中感受到的流暢度、旋律完整性與音響融合程度。
en: The interval between the cantus firmus and counterpoint at any moment should not exceed a perfect twelfth (octave plus fifth). In general, try to keep the two lines within an octave where possible, and only exceed a tenth in “emergencies” and only briefly (one or two notes). When the voices are too far apart, tonal fusion is diminished. Further, it can diminish performability, which, though not an essential principle of human cognition, is an important consideration for composers, and it has a direct effect on the smoothness, melodic integrity, and tonal fusion of what listeners hear during a performance.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 原則上，所有和聲協和音程都可以使用。不過，同度只能用在第一個和最後一個音程。同度非常穩定，較適合當作抵達的目標，而非途中的停留點；它也會削弱各聲部的獨立性。
en: In general, all harmonic consonances are allowed. However, unisons should only be used for the first and last intervals. Unisons are very stable and serve best as goals rather than midpoints. They also diminish the independence of the lines.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 除了開頭與結尾的兩音組合，其餘位置應優先採用不完全協和音程，少用完全協和音程，以加強結尾的抵達感，以及朝向結尾推進的感覺。無論如何，整道練習中的和聲音程都應有變化。
en: Imperfect consonances are preferable to perfect consonances for all intervals other than the first and last dyads, in order to heighten the sense of arrival at the end and to promote a sense of motion toward that arrival. In all cases, aim for a variety of harmonic intervals over the course of the exercise.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 絕不可連續使用兩個同類的完全協和音程，例如 P5–P5 或 P8–P8。這項限制涵蓋單音程及其複音程；例如 P5–P12 視同 P5–P5。連續使用兩個不同類的完全協和音程，例如 P8–P5，則可以，但仍應盡可能在每個完全協和音程之後接上不完全協和音程。平行五度與八度雖會加強音響融合，卻犧牲了旋律的獨立性；連續的穩定音響也會限制練習的變化與動態。因此，它們並不理想，在類種對位法中應予避免。
en: Never use two perfect consonances of the same size in a row: P5–P5 or P8–P8. This includes both simple and compound intervals; for example, P5–P12 is considered the same as P5–P5. (Two different perfect consonances in a row, such as P8–P5, are allowed, but try to follow every perfect consonance with an imperfect consonance if possible.) Parallel fifths and octaves promote tonal fusion at the expense of melodic independence, and these consecutive stable sonorities also limit variety and motion in the exercise. Thus, they are far from ideal, and are to be avoided in species counterpoint.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 相鄰音程之間的聲部進行應有所變化，盡量用到各種類型，或許只有斜向進行可以例外。反向進行最能增加變化並保持各聲部的獨立性，因此應盡可能優先採用。
en: Vary the types of motion between successive intervals, aiming to use each type (except perhaps oblique motion). Contrary motion is best for variety and preserving the independence of the lines, so it should be preferred where possible.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 同向進行與平行進行會減少變化及旋律的獨立性，使用時應兼顧以下限制：
en: Because similar and parallel motion diminish variety and melodic independence, their use should be mediated by other factors:

title: 第一類對位法
text: 同一類不完全協和音程最多只能連續使用三次，例如連續三個三度。絕不以同向進行到達完全協和音程；這種進行稱為直接五度／八度。它會使原本就已突出的音程受到過多關注。避免把同向進行與跳進結合，尤其應避免大跳。
en: Do not use more than three of the same imperfect consonance type in a row (e.g., three thirds in a row). Never move into a perfect consonance by similar motion (this is called direct fifths/octaves. This draws too much attention to an interval that already stands out of the texture. Avoid combining similar motion with leaps, especially large ones.

title: 第一類對位法
text: 作業
en: Assignments

title: 第一類對位法
text: 第一類對位法 A（PDF、MuseScore 檔 .mscz）：找出一道第一類對位法範例中的錯誤，並自行寫作一道練習。第一類對位法 B（PDF、MuseScore 檔 .mscz）：找出一道第一類對位法範例中的錯誤，並自行寫作一道練習。Fux 的完整練習集，請見〈《Gradus ad Parnassum》〉一章。
en: First-Species Counterpoint A (.pdf, .mscz). Asks students to do error detection on one first-species example and compose one of their own. First-Species Counterpoint B (.pdf, .mscz). Asks students to do error detection on one first-species example and compose one of their own. For the complete set of Fux exercises, see the Gradus ad Parnassum chapter.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 重點整理在類種對位法的第二類中，對位聲部的進行速率是定旋律的兩倍，由此引入強拍與弱拍的區別。強拍一律協和；弱拍可以協和，也可以不協和。弱拍上的不協和音程可以由經過式的級進產生。協和弱拍連接兩個協和強拍，形成連續三個協和音程，可採用下列多種型態：協和經過音：同方向級進兩次，勾勒出三度。替代音：先跳進四度，再反方向級進。跳進經過音：同方向進行一個三度及一個二度，勾勒出四度。音程分割：用兩次同方向跳進，分割較大的旋律音程，例如以兩個三度組成五度。音域轉換：由強拍到弱拍作協和的大跳，例如完全五度、六度或八度，再反方向級進。旋律進行的延遲：先跳進三度，再反方向級進。協和鄰音：先向一個方向級進，再級進回到原音。
en: Key Takeaways The second species of species counterpoint sees the counterpoint line move twice as fast as the cantus firmus. This introduces the ideas of strong versus weak beats. Strong beats are always consonant. Weak beats may be consonant or dissonant. Dissonance may occur on weak beats may arise through passing motion. Consonant weak beats connect two consonant strong beats to create a succession of 3 consonances. These can be of many types: consonant passing tone: two steps in the same direction to outline a third. substitution: leap a fourth, then step in the opposite direction. skipped passing tone: a third and a step in the same direction to outline a fourth. interval subdivision: two leaps in the same direction to divide a larger melodic interval, for example, with two thirds to make a fifth. change of register: a large, consonant leap (perfect fifth, sixth, or octave) from strong beat to weak beat, followed by a step in the opposite direction. delay of melodic progression: leap a third, then step in the opposite direction. consonant neighbor tone: step in one direction, then step back to the original tone.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 在第二類對位法中，對位聲部以二分音符進行，搭配全音符的定旋律。這個 2:1 的節奏比例帶來兩項新的基本音樂課題：一項關於拍節，即強拍與弱拍的區分；另一項關於和聲，即以經過音引入不協和音程。和聲上的不協和增加了音樂織度的變化，卻也帶來張力，必須以協和音程平衡，才能維持音響融合；進入與離開不協和音時，也須細心處理，以保持流暢。
en: In second-species counterpoint, the counterpoint line moves in half notes against a cantus firmus in whole notes. This 2:1 rhythmic ratio leads to two new “fundamental musical problems”—one metric and one harmonic: the differentiation between strong beats and weak beats, and the introduction of the passing-tone dissonance. The introduction of harmonic dissonance into second species adds to the variety of the musical texture. However, it brings a tension that must be balanced with consonance to promote tonal fusion, and it requires careful attention in order to maintain smoothness in and out of the dissonance.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 以下收錄《Gradus ad Parnassum》第一部分的全部第二類對位法範例，並和先前一樣，標出對位聲部與定旋律之間的音程。《Gradus ad Parnassum》完整的練習、解答與註解，請見〈《Gradus ad Parnassum》練習〉。
en: Here are the complete examples of second-species counterpoint from Part I of Gradus ad Parnassum, annotated (as before) with the interval that the counterpoint line makes with the cantus firmus. For the complete examples from Gradus ad Parnassum as exercises, solutions, and annotations, see Gradus ad Parnassum Exercises.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 第二類對位法完整練習譜例靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 範例 1。《Gradus ad Parnassum》中的全部第二類對位法練習。
en: Example 1. All second-species exercises from Gradus ad Parnassum.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 對位聲部的旋律
en: The Counterpoint Line

title: 第二類對位法
text: 與第一類一樣，對位聲部應容易歌唱、輪廓良好，具有單一高潮，並以級進為主，穿插一些小跳，偶爾以大跳增加變化。不過，第一類對位法的音符很少，為了兼顧練習其他方面的流暢，旋律常需要小跳。到了第二類，音符數增加，又有使用不協和音程的自由，便更容易在不引發其他音樂問題的情況下採用級進。因此，第二類的級進比例比第一類更高。若非跳進不可，應利用拍節安排來降低跳進的顯著程度：盡可能在小節內從強拍跳到弱拍，避免跨小節線從弱拍跳到強拍。此外，第二類旋律的音符較多，通常還應有一、兩個次要高潮：這些音低於全曲的最高點，作為局部片段的高潮。這能讓旋律有連貫的形狀，而非漫無目的地遊走，從而加強旋律的完整性。
en: As in first species, the counterpoint line should be singable and have a good shape, with a single climax and primarily stepwise motion (with some small leaps and an occasional large leap for variety). However, because a first-species counterpoint had so few notes, in order to maintain smoothness in other aspects of the exercise, the melody frequently employed small leaps. In second species, the increase in notes and the added freedom involving the use of dissonance makes it easier to move by step without causing other musical problems. Thus, a second-species counterpoint is even more dominated by stepwise motion than in first species. If the counterpoint must leap, take advantage of the metrical arrangement to diminish the attention drawn to the leap: leap from strong beat to weak beat (within the bar) rather than from weak beat to strong beat (across the bar line) when possible. Also, because there are more notes in a second-species line, there should usually be one or two secondary climaxes—notes lower than the overall climax that serve as “local” climaxes for portions of the line. This will help the integrity of the line by ensuring that it has a coherent shape and does not simply wander around.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 起始與結束
en: Beginning and Ending

title: 第二類對位法
text: 第二類對位法的起始
en: Beginning a second-species counterpoint

title: 第二類對位法
text: 與第一類一樣，若第二類對位聲部位於定旋律上方，應以 do [latex](\hat1)[/latex] 或 sol [latex](\hat5)[/latex] 開始；若位於定旋律下方，則以 do [latex](\hat1)[/latex] 開始。
en: As in first species, begin a second-species counterpoint above the cantus firmus with do [latex](\hat1)[/latex] or sol [latex](\hat5)[/latex]. Begin a second-species counterpoint below the cantus firmus with do [latex](\hat1)[/latex].

title: 第二類對位法
text: 第二類對位聲部的第一小節可以寫兩個二分音符，也可以先寫二分休止符，再接二分音符。休止符起頭能更快建立節奏輪廓，讓聽者更容易辨識，因此通常較好，也比較容易寫作。不論選哪種節奏，對位聲部的第一個實際音高都應遵守上述起始音程規則。
en: A second-species line can begin with two half notes in the first bar, or a half rest followed by a half note. Beginning with a half rest establishes the rhythmic profile more readily, making it easier for the listener to parse, so it is often preferable. It is also easier to compose. Regardless of rhythm, the first pitch in the counterpoint should follow the intervallic rules above.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 第二類對位法的結束
en: Ending a second-species counterpoint

title: 第二類對位法
text: 與第一類一樣，應以 clausula vera 終止式結束：對位聲部的最後一個音為 do [latex](\hat1)[/latex]。它的倒數第二個音，若對應的定旋律是 re [latex](\hat2)[/latex]，便應為 ti [latex](\hat7)[/latex]；若定旋律是 ti [latex](\hat7)[/latex]，便應為 re [latex](\hat2)[/latex]。
en: As in first species, you should end with a clausula vera: the final pitch of the counterpoint should be do [latex](\hat1)[/latex]; the penultimate note of the counterpoint should be ti [latex](\hat7)[/latex] if the cantus is re [latex](\hat2)[/latex], and re [latex](\hat2)[/latex] if the cantus is ti [latex](\hat7)[/latex].

title: 第二類對位法
text: 對位聲部的倒數第二小節可以使用一個全音符，讓最後兩小節與第一類相同；也可以使用兩個二分音符。因此，clausula vera 終止式可以從倒數第二小節的強拍或弱拍開始。
en: The penultimate bar of the counterpoint can either be a whole note (making the last two bars identical to first species) or two half notes. This allows you to begin your clausula vera on either the strong beat or the weak beat of the penultimate measure.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 強拍
en: Strong Beats

title: 第二類對位法
text: 在音樂織度中加入不協和音程，會帶來新的音樂課題。類種對位法的教學理念是，每進入新的一類，只增加少數難題，因此第二類只在非常有限的範圍內引入不協和音程。
en: The inclusion of dissonance in a musical texture creates new musical problems that need to be addressed. Because the philosophy of species counterpoint is to present only a small number of new musical difficulties with each successive species, second-species counterpoint introduces dissonance in a very limited way.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 第二類的強拍，即小節第一拍，一律協和。與第一類相同，應優先使用不完全協和音程（三度、六度），少用完全協和音程（五度、八度），並避免同度。
en: Strong beats (downbeats) in second species are always consonant. As in first species, prefer imperfect consonances (thirds and sixths) to perfect consonances (fifths and octaves), and avoid unisons.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 跨越小節線，也就是從弱拍到強拍時，兩聲部會同時移動，與第一類的聲部進行相同，因此應遵守第一類對位法的原則。例如，若弱拍是完全五度，下一個小節第一拍就不能也是完全五度。
en: Because motion across bar lines (from weak beat to strong beat) involves the same kind of voice motion as first species (two voices moving simultaneously), follow the same principles as first-species counterpoint. For instance, if a weak beat is a perfect fifth, the following downbeat cannot also be a perfect fifth.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 同樣地，從一個小節第一拍到下一個小節第一拍的進行，也須遵循前一章的第一類對位法原則，例如：
en: Likewise, progressions from downbeat to downbeat must follow the principles of first-species counterpoint described in the previous chapter, such as:

title: 第二類對位法
text: 不要讓連續兩小節以同類完全音程開始。相鄰兩小節第一拍之間，不應勾勒出不協和的旋律音程。例外是：若對位聲部從強拍到弱拍跳進八度，接著應反方向級進，因此與前一個小節第一拍構成七度。這種情況可以接受，因為它來自流暢的聲部進行。同一類不完全協和音程，最多只能連續出現在三個小節的開頭。
en: Do not begin two consecutive bars with the same perfect interval. Do not outline a dissonant melodic interval between consecutive downbeats. (Exception: if the counterpoint leaps an octave from the strong beat to the weak beat, the leap should be followed by step in the opposite direction, making a seventh with the preceding downbeat. This is okay, since it is the result of smooth voice motion.) Do not begin more than three bars in a row with the same imperfect consonance.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 相鄰兩個小節第一拍之間出現隱伏五度／八度，也稱直接五度／八度，是可以的，因為其效果較弱，又有對位聲部中間插入的音符加以減輕。
en: Hidden or direct fifths/octaves between successive downbeats are fine, as the effect is weak, and diminished by the intervening note in the counterpoint.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 弱拍
en: Weak Beats

title: 第二類對位法
text: 弱拍可以出現和聲上的不協和音程，因此在弱拍混合使用協和與不協和音程，最能增加變化。
en: Since harmonic dissonances can appear on weak beats, a mixture of consonant and dissonant intervals on weak beats is the best way to promote variety.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 第一類的同度會削弱各聲部的獨立性，因此造成問題。不過，若同度出現在第二類的弱拍，而且前後的聲部進行流暢，兩條旋律的節奏差異就足以維持獨立性。因此，為了寫出良好的聲部配合，必要時容許在弱拍使用同度。
en: Unisons were problematic in first species because they diminished the independence of the lines. However, when they occur on the weak beats of second species and are the result of otherwise smooth voice leading, the rhythmic difference in the two lines is sufficient to maintain that independence. Thus, unisons are permitted on weak beats when necessary to make good counterpoint between the lines.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 任何弱拍不協和音都必須符合下文說明的不協和經過音型態。下文也列出幾種協和弱拍的標準型態。如果你的弱拍不符合以下任何一種型態，對位很可能有問題。因此，可以用它們來引導寫作，也用來檢查成果。
en: Any weak-beat dissonance must follow the pattern of the dissonant passing tone, explained below. Also explained below are a number of standard patterns for consonant weak beats. Chances are high that if your weak beats do not fit into one of the following patterns, there is a problem with the counterpoint, so use them as a guide both for composing the counterpoint and for evaluating it.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 這些原則有助於安排第二類對位聲部的弱拍音。一個實用的方法是，先決定一個小節第一拍的音，再決定下一個小節第一拍的音，最後從下列型態中選一種，妥善填入兩者之間的弱拍。
en: These principles should help guide your use of weak-beat notes in a second-species counterpoint line. A good general practice is to start with a downbeat note, then choose the following downbeat note, and finally choose a pattern below that will allow you to fill in the space between downbeats well.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 本頁下方的示範影片會舉例說明這些原則中的大部分。
en: Most of these principles are used as examples in the demonstration video at the bottom of the page.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 不協和經過音：僅限弱拍
en: Dissonant passing tones (weak beats only)

title: 第二類對位法
text: 第二類中，弱拍上的所有不協和音都是不協和經過音。之所以這樣稱呼，是因為對位聲部以級進從一個協和的小節第一拍通往下一個協和的小節第一拍。此時，對位聲部兩個小節第一拍之間的旋律音程必為三度，經過音位於中間，以連續級進填滿這個三度。
en: All dissonant weak beats in second species are dissonant passing tones, so called because the counterpoint line passes from one consonant downbeat to another consonant downbeat by stepwise motion. The melodic interval from downbeat to downbeat in the counterpoint will always be a third, and the passing tone will come in the middle in order to fill that third with passing motion.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 第二類的所有不協和音都是經過音，所以不能跳進到達或離開不協和音，不能在不協和音上改變旋律方向，也不能在小節第一拍寫不協和音。
en: Since all dissonances in second species are passing tones, you will not leap into or out of a dissonant tone, change directions on a dissonant tone, nor write a dissonance on a downbeat.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 協和弱拍
en: Consonant weak beats

title: 第二類對位法
text: 不協和弱拍只有一種型態；協和弱拍則有好幾種可以使用（範例 2）：[1]
en: Unlike dissonant weak beats (of which there is only one type), there are several types of consonant weak beats available (Example 2):[1]

title: 第二類對位法
text: 範例 2。協和弱拍的各種型態，分別示範對位聲部位於定旋律上方與下方的情況。
en: Example 2. Examples of consonant weak beat types, above and below a cantus firmus.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 協和經過音（consonant passing tone）在相鄰兩個小節第一拍之間勾勒出三度。型態與不協和經過音相同，但三個音——第一拍、經過音、下一小節第一拍——都與當下的定旋律協和。協和經過音必定在定旋律上方或下方構成六度或完全五度。替代音（substitution）同樣在相鄰兩個小節第一拍之間勾勒出三度，但不以級進填入中間，而是先跳進四度，再反方向級進。若旋律需要多一次跳進或轉向以增加變化，就可以用它替代經過音，名稱也由此而來。與協和經過音一樣，對位聲部的三個音都必須與當下的定旋律協和。跳進經過音（skipped passing tone）在相鄰兩個小節第一拍之間勾勒出四度，弱拍音將這個四度分為一個三度與一個二度。同樣地，三個位置——第一拍、跳進經過音、下一小節第一拍——都與當下的定旋律構成協和音程。音程分割（interval subdivision）在相鄰兩個小節第一拍之間勾勒出五度或六度，將這個協和的大旋律音程分成兩次較小的協和跳進。五度分為兩個三度；六度則分為三度加四度，或四度加三度。不僅三個旋律音程——相鄰音符之間的兩個音程，以及兩個小節第一拍之間的音程——都必須協和，對位聲部的每個音也都必須與當下的定旋律協和。音域轉換（change of register）是從強拍到弱拍作協和的大跳，例如完全五度、六度或八度，再反方向級進。它可以在長時間級進後增加旋律變化，避免平行或其他問題，也可以讓對位聲部避開定旋律，以維持獨立性。這種型態不宜常用，而且每個音仍須與當下的定旋律協和。旋律進行的延遲（delay of melodic progression）在相鄰兩個小節第一拍之間勾勒出二度。先從強拍到弱拍跳進三度，再反方向級進到下一個小節第一拍。稱為「延遲」，是因為它裝飾了原本較慢的第一類進行，也就是兩個小節第一拍之間的一次級進。協和鄰音（consonant neighbor tone）是對位聲部從小節第一拍級進到弱拍，再於下一個小節第一拍回到原音。若第一個小節第一拍與定旋律構成五度，協和鄰音便構成六度；反之亦然。
en: A consonant passing tone outlines a third from downbeat to downbeat, and it has the same pattern as the dissonant passing tone, except that all three tones (downbeat, passing tone, downbeat) are consonant with the cantus firmus. A consonant passing tone will always be a sixth or perfect fifth above/below the cantus. A substitution also outlines a third from downbeat to downbeat. However, instead of filling it in with stepwise motion, the counterpoint leaps a fourth and then steps in the opposite direction. It is called a substitution because it can substitute for a passing tone in a line that needs an extra leap or change of direction to provide variety. Like the consonant passing tone, all three notes in the counterpoint must be consonant with the cantus. A skipped passing tone outlines a fourth from downbeat to downbeat. The weak-beat note divides that fourth into a third and a step. Again, all three intervals (downbeat, skipped passing tone, downbeat) are consonant with the cantus. An interval subdivision outlines a fifth or sixth between successive downbeats. The large, consonant melodic interval between downbeats is divided into two smaller consonant leaps. A melodic fifth between downbeats would be divided into two thirds. A melodic sixth between downbeats would be divided into a third and a fourth, or a fourth and a third. Not only must all three melodic intervals be consonant (both note-to-note intervals and the downbeat-to-downbeat interval), but each note in the counterpoint must be consonant with the cantus. A change of register occurs when a large, consonant leap (perfect fifth, sixth, or octave) from strong beat to weak beat is followed by a step in the opposite direction. It is used to achieve melodic variety after a long stretch of stepwise motion, to avoid parallels or other problems, or to get out of the way of the cantus to maintain independence. It should be used infrequently. And as always, each note must be consonant with the cantus. A delay of melodic progression outlines a step from downbeat to downbeat. It involves a leap of a third from strong beat to weak beat, followed by a step in the opposite direction into the following downbeat. It is called a “delay” because it is used to embellish what otherwise is a slower first-species progression (motion by step from downbeat to downbeat). A consonant neighbor tone occurs when the counterpoint moves by step from downbeat to weak beat, and then returns to the original pitch on the following downbeat. If the first downbeat makes a fifth with the cantus, the consonant neighbor will make a sixth, and vice versa.

title: 第二類對位法
text: 此處的術語有些是通用術語，其餘採自 Salzer 與 Schachter 的《Counterpoint in Composition》。↵
en: The terms used here are either standard or taken from Salzer & Schachter’s Counterpoint in Composition. ↵

title: 第三類對位法
text: 重點整理在類種對位法的第三類中，對位聲部的進行速率是定旋律的四倍，由此引入：更細的拍節層次：強、弱、次強、弱。鄰音及其他新的不協和音型態，使可用的型態包含：不協和經過音：以級進填入旋律三度的中間。不協和鄰音：從協和音級進離開，再級進回到同一個協和音。雙鄰音：結合上方與下方鄰音，例如 C–D–B–C 或 C–B–D–C。轉換音（nota cambiata；changing tone）：一種特殊的五音型態，罕見地容許從不協和音跳進離開。
en: Key Takeaways The third species of species counterpoint sees the counterpoint line move four times as fast as the cantus firmus. This introduces: a further metrical level (strong, weak, medium, weak) a neighbor tone and other new dissonance types so that the total includes: The dissonant passing tone: fills in the space of a melodic third via stepwise motion. The dissonant neighbor tone: a step away from and back to the same consonant tone. The double neighbor: both the higher and lower neighbour tones together (e.g., C–D–B–C or C–B–D–C). The nota cambiata (changing tone) is special five-note figure that highly unusually includes a leap from a dissonance.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 在第三類對位法中，對位聲部以四分音符進行，搭配全音符的定旋律。這個 4:1 的節奏比例，讓拍子的強弱區別比第二類更細：強拍是小節第一拍，次強拍是每小節第三個四分音符，弱拍是每小節第二、第四個四分音符。第三類也引入不協和鄰音，以及兩種容許不協和音參與跳進的相關型態。
en: In third-species counterpoint, the counterpoint line moves in quarter notes against a cantus firmus in whole notes. This 4:1 rhythmic ratio creates a still greater differentiation between beats than in second species: strong beats (downbeats), moderately strong beats (the third quarter note of each bar), and weak beats (the second and fourth quarter notes of each bar). Third species also introduces the neighbor-tone dissonance and two related figures in which dissonances can participate in leaps.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 範例 1 收錄《Gradus ad Parnassum》第一部分的第三類對位法範例，並和先前一樣，標出對位聲部與定旋律之間的音程。《Gradus ad Parnassum》完整的練習、解答與註解，請見〈《Gradus ad Parnassum》練習〉。
en: Example 1 provides the examples of third-species counterpoint from Part I of Gradus ad Parnassum, annotated (as before) with the interval that the counterpoint line makes with the cantus firmus. For the complete examples from Gradus ad Parnassum as exercises, solutions, and annotations, see Gradus ad Parnassum Exercises.

en: Example 1. All third-species exercises from Gradus ad Parnassum.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 對位聲部的旋律
en: The Counterpoint Line

title: 第三類對位法
text: 與第一、第二類相同，對位聲部應容易歌唱、輪廓良好，只有一個主要高潮，而且不與定旋律的高潮同時出現。旋律以級進為主，穿插一些小跳，偶爾以大跳增加變化。第三類和第二類一樣，比第一類更以級進為主，因為較少遇到非用跳進不可的棘手情況。若必須跳進，最好在小節內進行，避免跨越小節線。也與第二類一樣，通常應有一、兩個次要高潮：這些音低於整條旋律的最高點，作為局部片段的高潮。
en: As in first and second species, the counterpoint line should be singable and have a good shape, with a single climax that does not coincide with the climax of the cantus firmus, and primarily stepwise motion (with some small leaps and an occasional large leap for variety). Like second species, a third-species counterpoint should be dominated by stepwise motion, more so than in first species, because there are fewer sticky situations that would require a leap. If the counterpoint must leap, it is preferable to do so within the bar rather than across the bar line. Also like second species, there should usually be one or two secondary climaxes—notes lower than the overall climax that serve as “local” climaxes for portions of the line.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 起始與結束
en: Beginning and Ending

title: 第三類對位法
text: 第三類對位法的起始
en: Beginning a third-species counterpoint

title: 第三類對位法
text: 若第三類對位聲部位於定旋律上方，應以 do（[latex]\hat1[/latex]）或 sol（[latex]\hat5[/latex]）開始；若位於定旋律下方，則以 do（[latex]\hat1[/latex]）開始。
en: Begin a third-species counterpoint above the cantus firmus with do ([latex]\hat1[/latex]) or sol ([latex]\hat5[/latex]). Begin a third-species counterpoint below the cantus firmus with do ([latex]\hat1[/latex]).

title: 第三類對位法
text: 第三類對位聲部的第一小節可以寫四個四分音符，也可以先寫四分休止符，再接三個四分音符。不論選哪種節奏，對位聲部的第一個實際音高都應遵守上述起始音程規則。
en: A third-species line can begin with four quarter notes in the first bar, or a quarter rest followed by three quarter notes. Regardless of rhythm, the first pitch in the counterpoint should follow the intervallic rules above.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 第三類對位法的結束
en: Ending a third-species counterpoint

title: 第三類對位法
text: 與其他類相同，應以 clausula vera 終止式結束。對位聲部的最後一個音必須是 do（[latex]\hat1[/latex]），而且必須寫成全音符。
en: As in other species, end with a clausula vera. The final pitch of the counterpoint must always be do ([latex]\hat1[/latex]), and it must be a whole note.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 對位聲部的倒數第二個音，也就是倒數第二小節的最後一個四分音符，若對應的定旋律是 re（[latex]\hat2[/latex]），便應為 ti（[latex]\hat7[/latex]）；若定旋律是 ti（[latex]\hat7[/latex]），便應為 re（[latex]\hat2[/latex]）。
en: The penultimate note of the counterpoint (the last quarter note of the penultimate bar) should be ti ([latex]\hat7[/latex]) if the cantus is re ([latex]\hat2[/latex]), and re ([latex]\hat2[/latex]) if the cantus is ti ([latex]\hat7[/latex]).

title: 第三類對位法
text: 強拍
en: Strong Beats

title: 第三類對位法
text: 強拍，也就是小節第一拍的原則，大致與第二類相同：
en: Principles for strong beats (downbeats) are generally the same as in second species:

title: 第三類對位法
text: 強拍一律協和，而且不使用同度。優先使用不完全協和音程（三度、六度），少用完全協和音程（五度、八度）。
en: Strong beats are always consonant, and not unisons. Prefer imperfect consonances (thirds and sixths) to perfect consonances (fifths and octaves).

title: 第三類對位法
text: 跨越小節線，即從第四拍到下一個小節第一拍的進行，遵循第一類對位法的規則。
en: Motion across bar lines (from beat 4 to downbeat) follows the same rules as first-species counterpoint.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 從一個小節第一拍到下一個小節第一拍的進行，遵循第二類對位法的原則，但相鄰兩個小節第一拍之間容許出現直接五度／八度。以下複習第二類中幾項最重要、也適用於第三類的原則：
en: Progressions from downbeat to downbeat follow principles of second-species counterpoint (except that direct fifths/octaves between successive downbeats are allowed). The following is a review of some of the most important principles from second species that apply in third species as well:

title: 第三類對位法
text: 同類完全音程不能連續出現在三個小節的開頭；連續兩小節則可以。同一類不完全協和音程，最多只能連續出現在三個小節的開頭。相鄰兩個小節第一拍的音高，不可構成不協和的旋律音程。
en: No three consecutive bars can begin with the same perfect interval (two in a row are fine). No more than three bars in a row should begin with the same imperfect consonance. The pitches that begin consecutive downbeats must not make a dissonant melodic interval.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 若某小節第一拍是完全五度，前一小節的第三、第四拍都不能是五度。若某小節第一拍是八度，前一小節的第二、第三、第四拍都不能是八度。與第二類一樣，多插入一、兩個音，並不能消除平行五度與八度的不利效果。
en: If a downbeat contains a perfect fifth, neither beat 3 nor 4 of the previous bar can be a fifth. If a downbeat contains an octave, neither beat 2, 3, nor 4 of the previous bar can be an octave. Like in second species, the negative effects of parallel fifths and octaves are not mitigated by the addition of a note or two.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 其他拍位
en: Other Beats

title: 第三類對位法
text: 第二至第四拍應混合使用協和與不協和音程，以增加變化。在協和音程中，若為了寫出良好的聲部配合而有需要，可以在弱拍使用同度。任何不協和音都須遵循下文說明的不協和經過音或不協和鄰音型態。
en: Beats 2–4 should exhibit a mixture of consonant and dissonant intervals to promote variety. Among consonances, unisons are permitted on weak beats when necessary to make good counterpoint between the lines. Any dissonance must follow the pattern of the dissonant passing tone or the dissonant neighbor tone, explained below.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 協和音程
en: Consonance

title: 第三類對位法
text: 對位聲部可以用級進自由地到達或離開協和音，也可以從另一個協和音跳進到達，但須注意：
en: The counterpoint can move in and out of consonant tones freely by step, as well as by leap from another consonance, with the following considerations:

title: 第三類對位法
text: 所有旋律跳進都必須是旋律上容許的協和音程。大跳之後應反方向級進。從第四拍到下一個小節第一拍，應遵守上文對進入強拍的限制。
en: All melodic leaps, of course, must be melodic consonances. A large leap should be followed by a step in the opposite direction. Motion from the fourth beat into the following downbeat should follow the constraints above for motion into strong beats.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 不協和音程
en: Dissonance

title: 第三類對位法
text: 第三類的不協和音可以出現在第二、第三或第四拍，應以級進到達，再級進離開；下文的雙鄰音與 nota cambiata 是例外。這樣既讓不協和音避開小節最強的拍位，又以最流暢的旋律進行搭配它們，因而能維持流暢。第三類對位法的不協和處理，主要採用範例 2 所示、並於下文說明的型態：
en: Dissonances in third species can occur on beat 2, 3, or 4, and should be preceded and followed by stepwise motion (with the exception of the double neighbor and the nota cambiata, explained below). This promotes smoothness, both by keeping the dissonances away from the strongest beat of the bar and by coupling them with the smoothest melodic motion. Dissonance handling in third-species counterpointcentered on the types illustrated in Example 2 and described below:

title: 第三類對位法
text: 範例 2。第三類對位法的不協和音型態。
en: Example 2. Third-species dissonance types.

title: 第三類對位法
text: 不協和經過音以級進填入旋律三度的中間。經過音之前與之後的音，都必須與定旋律協和。不過，也可以連續出現兩個不協和經過音，例如 P4–d5 或 d5–P4。只要這些不協和音不落在小節第一拍，而且對位聲部沿同一方向級進，就不會造成不利效果。不協和鄰音從協和音級進離開，再級進回到原來的協和音，以此裝飾它；例如在定旋律上方形成 6–7–6。它的旋律型態與第二類的協和鄰音相同，差別在於和聲上的不協和。把它放在弱拍，也就是第二或第四拍，最為流暢。雙鄰音讓對位聲部第一拍與第四拍採用同一個音，而第二、第三拍分別採用比原音高一級與低一級的音，例如 C–D–B–C 或 C–B–D–C。第二、第三拍都不協和，但兩者都是以相距一級的音來裝飾原音，因此它們之間的跳進不會明顯削弱旋律的流暢。使用雙鄰音時，第三拍到第四拍的方向，應與第四拍到下一小節第一拍的方向相同；跨小節線的進行也應為級進。這能進一步保持流暢，緩和不協和音的效果。轉換音（nota cambiata；changing tone）是一種五音型態，在相鄰兩個小節第一拍之間勾勒出一次級進，可採用範例 3 的兩種型態之一。要使 nota cambiata 奏效，第一、第三、第五個音必須與當下的定旋律協和。第二個音不協和，並跳進到第三個音。不過，與雙鄰音一樣，整體型態會降低從不協和音跳進離開的不利效果：這次跳進前後由級進環繞，整體只推進一級，而且不協和音與下一個小節第一拍是同一音高。
en: The dissonant passing tone fills in the space of a melodic third via stepwise motion. The notes before and after the passing tone must be consonant with the cantus firmus. However, it is possible to have two dissonant passing tones in a row (P4–d5 or d5–P4). As long as these dissonances do not fall on downbeats and the counterpoint moves in stepwise motion in a single direction, there is no negative effect. The dissonant neighbor tone ornaments a consonant tone by stepping away and stepping back to the original consonance (6–7–6 over the cantus, for example). It is melodically identical to the consonant neighbor tone of second species, with the difference being the harmonic dissonance. Employing it on a weak beat (2 or 4) ensures the greatest smoothness. The double neighbor occurs when beats 1 and 4 in the counterpoint are the same tone, and beats 2 and 3 include the notes a step higher and a step lower than the original tone: for example, C–D–B–C or C–B–D–C. Both beats 2 and 3 are dissonant, but since both are embellishing the original tone by step, the leap between them does not significantly diminish the smoothness of the line. When using a double neighbor, the direction between beats 3 and 4 should be the same as between beat 4 and the following downbeat. That motion across the bar line should also be stepwise. This further maintains smoothness to temper the effect of the dissonances. The nota cambiata (changing tone) is a five-note figure that outlines a step progression from downbeat to downbeat. It follows one of two patterns shown in Example 3). For a nota cambiata to be effective, the first, third, and fifth notes must be consonant with the cantus. The second note will be dissonant and will leap to the third tone. However, like the double neighbor, the overall pattern minimizes the negative effect of the leap away from the dissonance. It is surrounded by stepwise motion, the overall progression is a single step, and the dissonant tone and the following downbeat are the same pitch.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 重點整理類種對位法的第四類以掛留音為特色，並依下列步驟妥善處理：「協和預備」：掛留之前先構成協和音程。「不協和掛留」：一個聲部停留，另一個聲部移動，形成不協和音程。「協和解決」：先前停留的聲部開始移動，將不協和音程解決為協和音程。
en: Key Takeaways The fourth species of species counterpoint is characterized by use of the suspension and its proper handling with: "consonant preparation": a consonance interval before the suspension; "dissonant suspension": one part stay while the other part moves to create a dissonant interval; "consonant resolution": the part that stayed before now moves to resolve the dissonance to a consonance.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 在第四類對位法中，對位聲部與定旋律每小節各移動一次，但兩者在節奏上錯開一個二分音符的時值，可以想成小節層次的切分音。對位聲部以二分音符記譜，每個弱拍二分音符都用延音線跨越小節線，連到下一個強拍。這種安排使純粹的第四類對位法一律採用斜向進行，並引入一種新的不協和音：掛留音。
en: In fourth-species counterpoint, the counterpoint line and cantus firmus both move once per bar, but they are rhythmically offset from each other by a half note. (Think syncopation on the bar level.) The counterpoint line will be notated in half notes, with each weak-beat half note tied across the bar line to the following strong beat. This arrangement means that in pure fourth-species counterpoint, the two lines always move in oblique motion. It also introduces a new kind of dissonance: the suspension.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 範例 1 收錄《Gradus ad Parnassum》第一部分的全部第四類對位法範例，並和先前一樣，標出對位聲部與定旋律之間的音程。《Gradus ad Parnassum》完整的練習、解答與註解，請見〈《Gradus ad Parnassum》練習〉。

For the complete examples from Gradus ad Parnassum as exercises, solutions, and annotations, see Gradus ad Parnassum Exercises.

text: 範例 1。《Gradus ad Parnassum》中的全部第四類對位法練習。

title: 第四類對位法
text: 掛留音
en: The Suspension

title: 第四類對位法
text: 掛留音是帶重音的不協和音，亦即它一律出現在強拍。由於受到更多強調，必須更細心地維持流暢與整體連貫。因此，與不協和經過音、鄰音一樣，掛留音的前後都由和聲上的協和音程包圍。掛留型態分為三個階段：
en: The suspension is an accented dissonance, meaning it always occurs on strong beats. Because of the increased emphasis, even greater care must be taken to promote smoothness and overall coherence. Thus, like the passing-tone and neighbor-tone dissonances, the suspension is always preceded and followed by harmonic consonances. A suspension figure has three parts:

title: 第四類對位法
text: 預備：對位聲部的弱拍音，與定旋律協和。它用延音線連到掛留音，兩者音高相同。掛留：對位聲部的強拍音，從預備音延續而來，此時與定旋律不協和。解決：對位聲部的弱拍音，比預備與掛留的音高低一級，並與定旋律協和。
en: Preparation: a weak-beat note in the counterpoint that is consonant with the cantus. This note is tied to the suspension, and the two are the same pitch. Suspension: a strong-beat note in the counterpoint, tied from the preparation, that is dissonant with the cantus. Resolution: a weak-beat note in the counterpoint that is one step below the preparation-suspension pitch and consonant with the cantus.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 第四類對位法應盡可能使用不協和掛留，因為練習的主要目的正是學習如何處理它。
en: Use dissonant suspensions as much as possible in fourth-species counterpoint. The primary purpose of the exercise is to practice handling dissonant suspension.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 掛留的類型
en: Types of suspensions

title: 第四類對位法
text: 掛留依據掛留音與解決音在定旋律上方或下方所形成的音程分類（範例 2）。例如，7–6 掛留的強拍掛留音與定旋律構成七度，再向下級進，解決到弱拍與定旋律構成六度的音。
en: Suspensions are categorized according to the intervals of the suspension and resolution tones above or below the cantus firmus (Example 2). A 7–6 suspension, for example, includes a strong-beat suspension that forms a seventh with the cantus, which resolves down by step to a weak-beat tone that forms a sixth with the cantus.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 定旋律上方可用的不協和掛留有 7–6、4–3 及 9–8（2–1）。只有這幾種型態能從不協和音程向下級進，解決到容許的協和音程。7–6 與 4–3 解決到不完全協和音程，因此較佳。定旋律下方主要使用的不協和掛留是 2–3。也可以使用 5–6 等其他進行，但保留的音並不造成不協和，因此不屬於不協和掛留。
en: Possible dissonant suspensions above the cantus firmus are 7–6, 4–3, and 9–8 (2–1). These are the only options that start on a dissonance and resolve down by step to an allowable consonance. 7–6 and 4–3 are preferable due to the resolution to imperfect consonances. The main dissonant suspension to use below the cantus firmus is 2–3. Other motions like 5–6 can be used, but they do not constitute dissonant suspensions, as the suspended note is not dissonant.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 第四類對位法的掛留類型譜例靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 範例 2。第四類對位法的掛留類型。
en: Example 2. Fourth-species suspension types.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 如何使用掛留
en: Using suspensions

title: 第四類對位法
text: 第四類旋律建立的型態，會引導聽者把弱拍聽成主要的協和位置。因此，處理第四類掛留時，應依它解決後的音程，套用第一類的原則。可以多用定旋律上方的 7–6、4–3，或下方的 2–3、5–6，但同一型態最多連續三次，就像第一類中的三度與六度一樣。第一類不能連續使用兩個八度或兩個五度，所以也不要連續使用兩次 9–8、6–5 或 4–5 掛留。實際上，任何會在相鄰弱拍形成兩個五度或兩個八度的安排，都應避免；這稱為弱拍五度或八度（after-beat fifths or octaves）。
en: The pattern set forward by a fourth-species line invites listeners to interpret the weak beats as the main consonances, so treat suspensions in fourth species the same way you would treat their intervals of resolution in first species. Use 7–6 and 4–3 (above) or 2–3 and 5–6 (below) liberally, but no more than three times in a row (like thirds and sixths in first species). Since you cannot use two octaves or two fifths in a row in first species, do not use two 9–8, 6–5, or 4–5 suspensions in a row. In fact, avoid any configuration that would create two fifths or two octaves on consecutive weak beats in fourth species (after-beat fifths or octaves).

title: 第四類對位法
text: 第四類對位聲部的旋律
en: The Fourth-Species Counterpoint Line

title: 第四類對位法
text: 只要可能，就使用不協和掛留。這會使旋律大多向下級進，也不容易朝向高潮發展，但沒有關係。只要旋律流暢、容易歌唱，而且掛留都有妥善預備與解決，就不必過度在意旋律形狀。第四類很難寫出與定旋律相同的輪廓品質，而它的主要目標是掛留處理，因此我們優先關注掛留，而非旋律形狀。
en: Use dissonant suspensions whenever possible. This will create a line consisting mostly of downward stepwise motion, and it will also make it hard to direct motion toward a climax, but this is fine. Do not worry about the shape of the line as long as it is smooth and singable and the suspensions are properly prepared and resolved. (It is difficult to create a fourth-species counterpoint with the same shape as a cantus firmus, and the main goal of fourth species is the treatment of the suspensions, so we focus on that over melodic shape.)

title: 第四類對位法
text: 若無法使用不協和掛留，仍應嘗試用延音線從弱拍連到強拍。這可以形成「協和掛留」；你也可以從小節第一拍的協和音向上跳進到弱拍的協和音。至少需要一、兩次向上跳進，抵銷向下解決所造成的音域下移，讓旋律保持在容易歌唱的音域內。
en: If a dissonant suspension is not possible, try to use a tie from weak beat to strong beat. This can be a “consonant suspension,” or you can leap up from downbeat consonance to weak-beat consonance. At least one or two upward leaps will be necessary to counteract the downward resolutions in order to keep the line in a singable range.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 如果不協和掛留與協和的延音型態都行不通，可以暫時中斷本類型態，見下方示範影片。這時改依第二類對位法的原則寫作，並儘快恢復第四類的延音線。每道練習盡量只中斷一次，而且只維持一、兩小節。
en: If neither a dissonant suspension nor a consonant tied figure is possible, it is permissible to break species (see video demo below). When you break species, follow the principles of second-species counterpoint and resume fourth-species ties as soon as possible. Try not to break species more than once per exercise, and do so for just a bar or two.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 起始與結束
en: Beginning and Ending

title: 第四類對位法
text: 第四類對位法的起始
en: Beginning a fourth-species counterpoint

title: 第四類對位法
text: 若第四類對位聲部位於定旋律上方，應以 do [latex](\hat1)[/latex] 或 sol [latex](\hat5)[/latex] 開始；若位於定旋律下方，則以 do [latex](\hat1)[/latex] 開始。
en: Begin a fourth-species counterpoint above the cantus firmus with do [latex](\hat1)[/latex] or sol [latex](\hat5)[/latex]. Begin a fourth-species counterpoint below the cantus firmus with do [latex](\hat1)[/latex].

title: 第四類對位法
text: 一律以二分休止符起頭。
en: Always begin with a half rest.

title: 第四類對位法
text: 第四類對位法的結束
en: Ending a fourth-species counterpoint

title: 第四類對位法
text: 第四類只有一種結尾方式：定旋律必須以 re–do [latex](\hat2-\hat1)[/latex] 結束。不要使用以 ti–do [latex](\hat7-\hat1)[/latex] 結束的定旋律。
en: There is only one option for ending fourth species. The cantus firmus must end with re–do [latex](\hat2-\hat1)[/latex]. Do not use a cantus that ends with ti–do [latex](\hat7-\hat1)[/latex].

title: 第四類對位法
text: 對位聲部以不協和掛留導向結尾。倒數第二小節為 do–ti [latex](\hat1-\hat7)[/latex]，最後一小節則為全音符的 do [latex](\hat1)[/latex]。這個 do–ti [latex](\hat1-\hat7)[/latex] 若位於定旋律的 re [latex](\hat2)[/latex] 上方，便形成 7–6 掛留；若位於定旋律的 re [latex](\hat2)[/latex] 下方，則形成 2–3 掛留。作為不協和掛留的 do [latex](\hat1)[/latex]，一律由前一小節用延音線連過來。
en: The counterpoint will end with a dissonant suspension. The penultimate bar will contain do–ti [latex](\hat1-\hat7)[/latex], and the final bar will contain a whole note do [latex](\hat1)[/latex]. The do–ti [latex](\hat1-\hat7)[/latex] will form a 7–6 suspension above the re [latex](\hat2)[/latex] in the cantus, or a 2–3 suspension below the re [latex](\hat2)[/latex] in the cantus. As a dissonant suspension, that do [latex](\hat1)[/latex] will always be tied over from the previous bar.

en: Examples 3 and 4 are video lessons by Kris Shaffer illustrate the process of composing a fourth-species counterpoint above and below a cantus firmus. These videos provide new information about the compositional process, as well as concrete examples of the above rules and principles.

Asks students to do error detection on one fourth-species example and compose one of their own. For the complete set of Fux exercises, see the Gradus ad Parnassum chapter.

title: 第五類對位法
text: 重點整理類種對位法的第五類，主要是把前面學過的手法結合起來，再加上一點裝飾，讓練習開始像一首真正的樂曲！具體而言：前面各類的元素可以結合使用，讓對位聲部包含全音符進行（第一類）、二分音符進行（第二類）、四分音符進行（第三類）與掛留（第四類），組合與順序幾乎不受限制。第五類新加入的內容包括：某些裝飾手法，例如先現音；這些手法……可以首次包含八分音符進行，這在第一至第四類中尚未出現。
en: Key Takeaways The fifth species of species counterpoint primarily involves combining the tricks we’ve learned so far along with a little decoration into something that starts to resemble real music! Specifically: Elements from all previous species combine such that the counterpoint line may include motion in whole notes (1st species), half notes (2nd), quarter notes (3rd), and suspensions (4th) in almost any combination and order. New to the 5th species are: certain embellishments such as notes of anticipation which … may include 8th note motion for the first time (not seen in species 1–4).

title: 第五類對位法
text: 在第五類對位法中，我們結合第一至第四類發展出的手法，只另外增加少數內容。因此，第五類開始比先前各類更接近真正的樂曲。挑戰也不再只是平衡不同的協和音程，還須兼顧不同對位類型之間的平衡。
en: In fifth-species counterpoint, we combine the tricks developed in species 1–4 with only a few additions. As such, the fifth species starts to resemble real music in a way that none of the previous species did, and the challenge is to balance not only types of consonance but also types of counterpoint.

title: 第五類對位法
text: 起始與結束
en: Beginning and Ending

title: 第五類對位法
text: 第五類仍遵循已熟悉的做法，在第一與最後一小節妥善處理完全協和音程，並減少音符的移動。以完全協和音程開始，以 clausula vera 終止式結束。
en: Once again, fifth-species counterpoint observes the now-familiar practice of handling of perfect consonances and reduced motion in the first and last measures. Begin with a perfect consonance and end with a clausula vera.

title: 第五類對位法
text: 裝飾掛留
en: Embellishing Suspensions

title: 第五類對位法
text: 掛留是第四類的課題；到了第五類，我們可以再以幾種常見的裝飾手法加以修飾。範例 1 在一串連續的 7–6 掛留上，示範主要的裝飾類型。
en: While suspensions are a fourth-species consideration, in fifth-species counterpoint we add the option of decorating those suspensions with some common embellishments. Example 1 illustrates the main types, set out on a single chain of 7-6 suspensions.

title: 第五類對位法
text: 連續掛留與常見裝飾手法譜例靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。範例 1。一串採用常見裝飾手法的連續掛留。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example. Example 1. A chain of suspensions with common embellishments.

title: 第五類對位法
text: 請注意，若把每小節的第一個音延長為二分音符，藉此簡化旋律，就會回到沒有裝飾的第四類掛留。
en: Note that if you simplify the line by sustaining the first note of the measure for a half note, you get right back to unembellished fourth-species suspensions.

title: 第五類對位法
text: 八分音符
en: Eighth notes

title: 第五類對位法
text: 也請注意，範例 1 最後一種掛留裝飾，首次引入八分音符進行。Fux 在第四與第五類「之間」介紹裝飾掛留及八分音符進行。除了這種「帶有迴音的先現音」掛留裝飾，Fux 也介紹一對經過八分音符的用法。所有這些八分音符都成對出現，並位於弱拍，填入每小節第二或第四個四分音符的位置。
en: Note too that the last of the suspension embellishments in Example 1 introduces eighth-note motion for the first time. Fux introduces embellished suspensions and eighth-note motion “in between” fourth and fifth species. Apart from this “anticipation with turn” embellishment of a suspension, Fux also introduces the possibility of a pair of passing eighth notes. In all cases, these eighth notes come in pairs, and they occur on weak beats (filling the second or fourth quarter note of the measure).

title: 第五類對位法
text: 《Gradus ad Parnassum》範例
