title: 主音化
text: 主音化（tonicization）是讓非主和弦暫時聽起來像主和弦的過程，藉由副屬和弦或副導音和弦達成；英文除了 secondary dominant、secondary leading-tone，也稱 applied dominant、applied leading-tone。我們會先學習如何主音化屬和弦，再看其他和弦的主音化。
en: Tonicization is the process of making a non-tonic chord temporarily sound like tonic. It's accomplished using secondary dominant or secondary leading-tone chords (sometimes called applied dominant and applied leading-tone chords). First, we'll learn how to tonicize the dominant, and then we’ll see tonicizations of non-dominant chords.

title: 主音化
text: 例 1 分析一段暫時讓 V 聽起來像主和弦的音樂，例 2 則抽出例 1 中參與主音化的兩個和弦。這裡是 C7 接到 F 和弦；如果不考慮調號，以及例 1 所提供的上下文，我們會把這兩個和弦分析為 F 大調的 [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5-I}[/latex]（例 2a）。
en: Example 1 analyzes a passage that temporarily makes V sound like the tonic chord. Example 2 extracts the two chords from Example 1 that participate in the tonicization. We have a C7 chord moving to an F chord, so if we were to analyze these chords without considering the key signature or the context that Example 1 provides, we'd say the two chords represent the progression [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5-I}[/latex] in F major (Example 2a).

title: 主音化

title: 主音化
text: 現在回到例 1 的上下文，可以看到 F 大和弦在片段的原調 B♭ 大調中，功能是 V（例 2b）。它正是結束第一個樂句的半終止和弦。我們知道這裡並未轉調，因為不僅半終止在 B♭ 大調，第二個樂句也從 B♭ 大調開始，重複第一個樂句的開頭。然而，C7 顯然不屬於 B♭ 大調；低音的 E♮ 臨時記號就告訴我們這一點。如例 2 的分析，C7 是 F 大和弦的 [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5}[/latex]。要在例 1 的上下文中表示這個關係，我們會說 C7 是「V 的 [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5}[/latex]」，寫成「[latex]\mathrm{V^6_5/V}[/latex]」。換句話說，F 大和弦是 V，C7 則是這個 V 和弦的 [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5}[/latex]。我們剛剛標出了第一個副屬和弦！
en: If we now reconsider the context that Example 1 provides, we can see that the F major chord functions as V in the excerpt's home key of B♭ major (Example 2b). Indeed, it's the chord that creates the half cadence that ends the first phrase. We know that we haven't changed keys here because, in addition to the half cadence being in B♭ major, the second phrase also begins in B♭ major (it repeats the beginning of the first phrase). The C7 chord, however, clearly doesn't belong to B♭ major—that's what the E♮ accidental in the bass tells us. As we determined in Example 2, the C7 chord is [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5}[/latex] of the F major chord. To represent that in the context of Example 1, we say that the C7 chord is “[latex]\mathrm{V^6_5}[/latex] of V,” and we write “[latex]\mathrm{V^6_5/V}[/latex].” In other words, the F major chord is V, and the C7 chord is the [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5}[/latex] of that V chord. We've just labeled our first secondary dominant chord!

title: 主音化
text: 如果在 G 大調，我們會將這兩個和弦分析為 viio7–I。回想學習導音七和弦時，我們發現大調中常將和弦七音降低，使它成為全減七和弦。這裡也是如此，請留意 E♭！例 3 的片段在 C 大調，因此 G 大和弦應分析為 V，而非 I。這表示 F♯o7 是 V 和弦的 viio7。寫作「viio7/V」，英文讀作「seven diminished seven of five」，即「V 的導音減七和弦」。例 3 加入 [latex]\mathrm{cad.^6_4}[/latex] 來裝飾屬和弦，因此 viio7/V 並未直接解決到 V。[latex]\mathrm{cad.^6_4}[/latex] 解決到 V7 而非 V 三和弦。到這一步，就得到例 3 中的實際片段。
en: If we were in G major, we would analyze these chords as viio7–I. Recall that when we learned about the leading-tone seventh chord, we discovered that it's common to lower the chordal seventh in major to create a fully diminished seventh chord. That's still true here (notice the E♭!). The passage in Example 3 is in C major, so we would analyze the G major chord as V, rather than I. That means the F♯o7 chord is viio7 of the V chord. We write “viio7/V” and say “seven diminished seven of five.” The passage in Example 3 adds a [latex]\mathrm{cad.^6_4}[/latex] to embellish the dominant. That's why the viio7/V doesn't resolve directly to V. The [latex]\mathrm{cad.^6_4}[/latex] resolves to V7 rather than the V triad. Now we've arrived at the passage in Example 3.

title: 主音化
text: 彙整：分析主音化的步驟
en: Summary: Steps for analyzing tonicization

title: 主音化
text: 注意：古典音樂偶爾會以半減七和弦作為副和弦，雖然少見，但確實可能出現。在爵士樂中，這種用法更少見；遇到這類和弦，幾乎可以確定它是暫時調性中的 ii∅7。
en: Note: It's rare but possible in classical music to have a half-diminished seventh chord act as an applied chord. It's even less common in jazz, where it's almost certainly an applied ii∅7.

title: 主音化
text: 半音化是可能出現主音化的線索。由於只有 V(7) 與 viio7，或少見的 vii∅7（見旁註），能形成主音化，因此判斷標記時，最有幫助的問題之一是：「這個半音變化和弦的性質是什麼？」和弦性質決定標記：若是大三和弦或屬七和弦，就標為 V(7)；若是減三和弦或減七和弦，就標為 viio(7)。
en: Chromaticism is an indication that tonicization may be present. Since only V(7) and viio7 (or, rarely, vii∅7—see note in sidebar) can create tonicization, one of the most helpful things for determining the label is to ask “what is the quality of the chromatic chord?” The quality determines the label: if the chord is a major triad or dominant seventh chord, it gets the label V(7). If the chord is a diminished triad or diminished seventh chord, it gets the label viio(7).

title: 主音化
text: 遇到半音變化音時，先停下來問自己以下問題：
en: When you come across a chromatic note, stop and ask the following questions:

title: 主音化
text: 這個半音變化音是和弦音，還是裝飾性和弦外音？若是和弦音：繼續看問題 2。若是裝飾性和弦外音：依其類型加以標示。和弦的性質是什麼？大三和弦或屬七和弦：副屬和弦，標為 V(7)/x。減三和弦或減七和弦：副導音和弦，標為 viio7/x。要判斷上面的 x，先問：這個半音變化和弦在哪個調中是 V 或 viio？再判斷那個調的主三和弦，在此片段原調中應標哪個羅馬數字。這個羅馬數字就是 x。
en: Is the chromatic note part of the chord, or is it an embellishing tone? Part of the chord: move on to question 2 Embellishing tone: label appropriately What's the quality of the chord? Major triad or dominant seventh chord: secondary V chord; label is V(7)/x Diminished triad or diminished seventh: secondary viio chord; label is viio7/x To determine x above, ask: In what key is the chromatic chord V or viio? Then, determine what Roman numeral the tonic triad of that key would get in the home key of your passage. That Roman numeral is x.

text: 解決和弦
en: Resolving

title: 主音化
text: 副和弦的導音稱為副導音（secondary leading tone），和弦七音則稱為副七音（secondary seventh）。這些不協和音的解決方式，與它們在各自所屬調性中的一般解決方式相同。
en: The leading tone of the applied chord is referred to as the secondary leading tone; the chordal seventh is referred to as the secondary seventh. These dissonances resolve just as they normally would in their own key.

title: 主音化
text: 例 6。若副和弦接到另一個七和弦，副導音可以向下解決，成為下一個和弦的七音，而非像一般導音那樣向上解決。
en: Example 6. If the applied chord is proceeding to another seventh chord, the secondary leading tone may resolve downward, instead of upward like a leading tone normally would, into the seventh of the next chord.

title: 主音化
text: 有一種例外：當被主音化的和弦本身也是七和弦，例如 D7–G7–C，副導音可以下行半音，成為下一個和弦的七音。在這個例子中，就會形成流暢的半音線條 F♯–F♮–E（例 6）。
en: One exception is that when the tonicized chord is itself a seventh chord (as in the progression D7–G7–C), the secondary leading tone may resolve down by semitone into the seventh of the following chord. In the example progression, this would create a nice chromatic line: F♯–F♮–E (Example 6).

title: 主音化
text: 主音化 V 以外的和弦
en: Tonicizing chords other than V

title: 主音化
text: 概述
en: Overview

title: 主音化
text: 任何大三和弦或小三和弦都能被主音化，不限於 V。減三和弦與增三和弦不能被主音化，因為不存在減調或增調。因此，除了 viio 與 iio 之外，各級和弦都可以被主音化。
en: Any major or minor triad can be tonicized, not just V. Diminished and augmented triads can’t be tonicized, since there are no diminished or augmented keys. This means that every Roman numeral can be tonicized except viio and iio.

title: 主音化
text: 分析各種主音化
en: Analyzing various tonicizations

title: 主音化
text: 主音化 V 以外的和弦時，分析仍遵循前面學過的相同步驟；唯一的不同，是現在可以被主音化的和弦有更多種。請留意半音變化音，它們是可能出現主音化的線索！
en: When chords other than V are tonicized, we follow the same steps for analysis that we learned earlier; the only difference is that there are now more possibilities for which chords can be tonicized. Be on the lookout for chromatic notes: these are signals that tonicization may be present!

title: 主音化
text: 不難想像，一個和弦被主音化的頻率，與它本身一般出現的頻率有關。例如，屬和弦與強屬前和弦很常見，因此它們也相當常被主音化。vi 雖然比 ii、IV、V 少見，仍經常被主音化。iii 與 VII（僅小調）的和聲較少見，也較少被主音化。
en: As you might imagine, the frequency with which a given chord is tonicized is related to the frequency with which that chord generally appears. For instance, the dominant and strong predominant chords are quite common, so we also see those chords tonicized with some frequency. The vi chord, while less common than ii, IV, and V, also frequently gets tonicized. The iii and VII (minor only) chords are uncommon harmonies, and we tend not to see them tonicized frequently.

title: 主音化
text: 主音化強屬前和弦
en: Tonicizing strong predominants

title: 主音化
text: 主音化強屬前和弦時，通常會對主三和弦的成員作半音變化。例如，只要在主三和弦加入 te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex]，就很容易將它變成 V7/IV（例 8）。同樣地，將主三和弦的 do（[latex]\hat{1}[/latex]）升高，再加入 te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex]，便能將它變成 viio7/ii（例 9）。
en: Tonicizing strong pre-dominants usually involves chromatic inflection of members of the tonic triad. For example, a tonic triad can easily be turned into a V7/IV chord by adding te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex] to the triad (Example 8). Similarly, a tonic triad can be turned into viio7/ii by raising do ([latex]\hat{1}[/latex]) and adding te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex] (Example 9).

title: 主音化
text: 將副屬和弦視為自然音和弦的變音形式
en: Secondary dominants as altered diatonic chords

title: 主音化
text: 另一種理解副和弦的方法，是把它想成同根音自然音和弦經過變音的版本。
en: Another way of thinking about secondary chords is to imagine them as altered versions of the diatonic chord with which it shares a root.

title: 主音化
text: 最直接的例子，是將 ii 的 fa（[latex]\hat{4}[/latex]）變成 fi（[latex]\uparrow\hat{4}[/latex]），再像平常一樣接到屬和弦。這個由 fa 到 fi [latex](\hat4-\uparrow\hat4)[/latex] 的變化，將一般的下屬和弦，變成一個在屬調中具有屬功能的和弦。
en: The most straightforward example is when a ii chord is chromatically altered by changing fa ([latex]\hat{4}[/latex]) to fi ([latex]\uparrow\hat{4}[/latex]) and then progresses, like usual, to the dominant chord. This alteration of fa to fi [latex](\hat4-\uparrow\hat4)[/latex] turns a regular subdominant chord into a chord that has a dominant function in the key of the dominant.

title: 主音化
text: 以 C 大調的 Dmi7–G–C 為例，其羅馬數字是 ii7–V–I。若把第一個和弦中的 fa 改成 fi（[latex]\hat4[/latex] 變成 [latex]\uparrow\hat4[/latex]，也就是 F 變成 F♯），就得到 D7–G–C。在 C 調中，可以將它分析為 II♯7–V–I；請注意，羅馬數字改成大寫，表示和弦性質改變，後方的升記號則進一步說明和弦三音被升高。不過，也可以注意到 D 大和弦屬於 G 大調，在 G 調中具有屬功能（V），而 G 調的主和弦正是下一個和弦。換句話說，我們從 G 調借用屬和弦，再將它運用於 G 大三和弦。因此，這個進行也能重新解讀為 V7/V–V–I。
en: Take the chord progression Dmi7–G–C in C major, which we would label with Roman numerals as ii7–V–I. If we change fa to fi ([latex]\hat4[/latex] to [latex]\uparrow\hat4[/latex], F to F♯) in the first chord, we get D7–G–C. In the key of C, we might analyze this progression as II♯7–V–I(note the uppercase Roman numeral, indicating the change of quality; the sharp sign afterward further clarifies the raised third of the chord). However, we can also note that D major belongs to G major; it is a dominant-functioning chord (V) in the key of G—the key in which the following chord is tonic. In other words, we are borrowing the dominant chord from the key of G and applying it to the G-major triad. Thus, we can re-interpret the progression as V7/V–V–I.

title: 主音化

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 重點整理轉調（modulation，有時稱 key change）是較長時間的主音改變。作曲家引入新調，基本上有兩種方式：突然的直接轉調（例 1）。較不著痕跡的共同和弦轉調（例 2）。有時，作曲家會使主音化與轉調的分界變得模糊；我們將這類情況稱為「延伸主音化」。
en: Key Takeaways Modulation (sometimes called a "key change") involves a longer-term change of tonic. There are two basic ways a composer can introduce a new key: A direct, abrupt modulation (Example 1) A pivot chord modulation, which is more subtle (Example 2) Sometimes, a composer will blur the lines between a tonicization and a modulation. We refer to such cases as "extended tonicizations."

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 本章播放清單
en: Chapter Playlist

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 我們已看過，主音化是讓非主和弦暫時聽起來像主和弦。本章討論轉調；相較於主音化的暫時性，轉調使主音改變的時間較長。有時人們也將 modulation 稱為「change of key」，也就是調性的改變。
en: We've seen that tonicization involves making a non-tonic chord sound like a temporary tonic. In this chapter, we discuss modulation, which, in contrast to the temporary nature of tonicization, involves a longer-term change of tonic. Sometimes people refer to modulation as a “change of key.”

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 分析轉調
en: Analyzing Modulations

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 作曲家引入新調，基本上有兩種方式：可以讓調性突然改變（例 1），也可以處理得較不著痕跡（例 2）。辨認轉調時，以下兩項建議很有幫助：
en: There are two basic ways a composer can introduce a new key: they can make the key change abrupt (Example 1), or they can be more subtle about it (Example 2). Two pieces of advice are helpful for identifying modulations:

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 記得，終止式能確立調性。因此，若在分析前先找出終止式，就能知道哪些地方出現了新調。同樣的臨時記號在片段中反覆出現，可能是轉調的線索。如果某個臨時記號持續出現，試著找出能確立新調的終止式，並確認這個新調是否與臨時記號的改變相符。
en: Remember that cadences establish keys, so if you can identify cadences before you start your analysis, you'll know where new keys occur. The presence of the same accidentals over and over again in a passage is an indication of potential modulation. If you start seeing a consistent accidental, see if you can identify a cadence that establishes the new key corresponding to the change in accidentals.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 直接轉調：突然改變調性
en: Direct modulations (these are abrupt)

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 突然的轉調常稱為「直接轉調」（direct modulation），因為作曲家直接進入新調。它有時也稱為「樂句轉調」（phrase modulation），因為經常出現在樂句交界。分析時若辨認出直接轉調，只須標示新調，再繼續進行和聲分析，如例 1。
en: Abrupt modulations are often called “direct modulations” because the composer goes directly to the new key. These are also sometimes called “phrase modulations” because they tend to occur at phrase boundaries. To recognize a direct modulation in analysis, simply label the new key, then continue with your harmonic analysis as in Example 1.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 例 1。Joseph Bologne 第4號弦樂四重奏，第一樂章第 15–29 小節中的直接轉調（0:27–0:56）。
en: Example 1. Direct modulation in Joseph Bologne, String Quartet no. 4, I, mm. 15–29 (0:27-0:56).

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 共同和弦轉調：較不著痕跡的轉調
en: Pivot chord modulations (these are subtle)

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 作曲家可以使用各種技巧，讓轉調更不著痕跡，其中較常見的方法之一，是使用共同和弦（pivot chord）。共同和弦是同時屬於原調與新調的自然音和弦。例 2 顯示，分析共同和弦時，會用一種特殊的上下排列標記：上方的羅馬數字表示和弦在舊調中的身分，下方則表示它在新調中的身分。在例 2 第 6 小節，我們會說「iv7 變成 ii7」。沒有任何單一方法能保證找出共同和弦，但有一種策略很有幫助：先一直用舊調分析，直到分析不再合理，再退回前一個和弦，試著將它當成共同和弦。若這個和弦也不適合，再往前退一個和弦。
en: A composer can use a variety of techniques to make a modulation more subtle, but one of the more common ways to do it is through the use of a pivot chord. A pivot chord is a single chord that is diatonic in (i.e., that belongs to) both the home key and the new key. Example 2 shows that we analyze a pivot chord using a special symbol where the upper Roman numeral labels the chord in the old key and the lower Roman numeral labels the chord in the new key. In measure 6 of Example 2, we would say “iv7 becomes ii7.” There's no single method that always works to find a pivot, but one strategy that's helpful is to analyze in the old key until it stops making sense, then back up a chord and try analyzing that as your pivot. If that chord doesn't work as a pivot either, try backing up one more chord.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: Josephine Lang〈Der Winter〉中的共同和弦轉調靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 例 2。Josephine Lang〈Der Winter〉第 1–12 小節中的共同和弦轉調。
en: Example 2. Pivot chord modulation in Josephine Lang, "Der Winter," mm. 1–12.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 有時不只一個和弦可以充當共同和弦。這時，最好的選擇是上下兩個羅馬數字都具有屬前功能的和弦。因為共同和弦之後通常很快就會出現 V；如果共同和弦在兩調中都標為屬前和弦，就表示無論從舊調或新調來看，都正在走向 V。次佳選擇，是讓舊調的主和弦成為新調的屬前和弦，例如 I 變成 IV。由於主和弦可以直接接到 V，這樣分析在功能上仍然合理。較不理想的共同和弦分析，通常牽涉屬和弦。例如「V 變成 I」，就暗示同一個和弦既不安定（V），又十分安定（I）；我們通常不會這樣聽到它。
en: Sometimes multiple chords could serve as pivots. In such cases, the best chords are ones where the upper and lower Roman numerals are both predominant chords. That's because V will usually appear shortly after the pivot, and having a predominant in both positions for your pivot chord label suggests that we’re on the way to V in both the old and new keys. Your second best option would be a tonic chord in the old key becoming a predominant in the new key (I becomes IV). Since a tonic chord can go directly to V, the analysis here still makes functional sense. Poor pivot chord analyses are usually ones that involve the dominant. An analysis such as "V becomes I," for example, suggests that the same chord is simultaneously unstable (V) and very stable (I), which isn’t how we’re likely to hear it.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 近系調
en: Closely related keys

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 雖然作曲家可以轉到任何調，但由於不同調之間共享的和弦數量不同，某些轉調比其他轉調更常見。調號相差不超過一個升降記號的調，例如 C 大調與 G 大調，視為近系調（closely related keys），它們有許多共同和弦。要找出某個原調的所有近系調，可以依下列步驟進行；參考五度循環圖（例 3）可能會有幫助。
en: While a composer may modulate anywhere, some modulations are more common than others because of the number of chords the two keys share. Key signatures within one accidental of one another (e.g., C major and G major) are considered closely related keys, sharing many common chords. To find all of the closely related keys for a given home key, do the following. You may find it useful to reference the circle of fifths (Example 3).

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 例 3。五度循環圖。點擊可放大。
en: Example 3. The circle of fifths. Click to enlarge.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 畫出三欄、兩列的格子。將原調放在上列中央。在原調的調號中增加一個升記號，或減少一個降記號（相當於往升號方向前進），將得到的調寫在右邊。在原調的調號中增加一個降記號，或減少一個升記號，將得到的調寫在左邊。在下列，分別寫出上列各調的關係大調或關係小調。
en: Create a grid with three columns and two rows. Place the home key in the center of the upper row. Add a sharp (or subtract a flat—the equivalent of adding a sharp) to the home key’s signature and list that key to the right. Add a flat to (or subtract a sharp from) the home key’s signature and list that key to the left. In the lower row, list the relative major or minor keys for each key in the upper row.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 若從 F 大調開始，結果應該類似例 4。請注意，這組調（包含原調）一定對應到原調各級和弦中的所有大、小三和弦；大調中是 I、ii、iii、IV、V、vi，小調中則是 i、III、iv、v、VI、VII。這是檢查結果的好方法。
en: If you were to do this with F major as a starting point, you should end up with something like Example 4. Notice that the keys will always correspond to every major or minor triad in the home key’s universe of Roman numerals (so, in major: I, ii, iii, IV, V, and vi; in minor: i, III, iv, v, VI, and VII). This is a good way to check your work.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 往降號方向一格原調調號往升號方向一格起始的調B♭FC關係調GmiDmiAmi
en: One step flatwise Starting key signature One step sharpwise starting key B♭ F C relative key Gmi Dmi Ami

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 例 4。找出 F 大調的近系調。
en: Example 4. Identifying closely related keys of F major.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 雖然可以轉到任何調，但有些轉調特別常見：
en: While it's possible to modulate to any key, certain keys are much more common than others:

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 大調：I→V 與 I→vi，例如 C→G、C→Am。小調：i→III 與 i→v，例如 Cm→E♭、Cm→Gm。
en: In major: I→V and I→vi (e.g., C→G and C→Am) In minor: i→III and i→v (e.g., Cm→E♭ and Cm→Gm)

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 使用共同和弦寫出轉調
en: Writing modulations with pivot chords

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 若要寫出使用共同和弦的轉調樂句，需要先選擇共同和弦，再安排適合的和聲進行。
en: If you're writing a modulating phrase that uses pivot chords, you'll need to choose a pivot chord, then determine an appropriate progression.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 找出可能的共同和弦
en: Identifying potential pivots

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 要找出兩調之間可能的共同和弦，可依下列步驟進行（例 5）：
en: To identify potential pivot chords between two keys (Example 5):

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 畫出兩欄的表格。左欄列出舊調的所有三和弦。右欄列出新調的所有三和弦。將兩欄中相同的三和弦配對。
en: Create a table with two columns. List all triads in the old key on the left. List all triads in the new key on the right. Match triads that appear in both columns.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 記得，最佳的共同和弦是在兩調中都具有屬前功能的和弦。
en: Remember that the best pivots are ones that are predominants in both keys.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 例 5。找出由 D 小調轉到 F 大調的共同和弦。
en: Example 5. Identifying pivots to modulate from Dm to F.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 選擇和聲進行
en: Choosing a progression

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 我們的耳朵通常需要一點時間，才能適應新調。因此，若希望新調聽起來已穩固確立，最好不要在共同和弦之後太快結束於終止式。一個好策略，是先用阻礙進行避開新調的終止式，再重新嘗試，成功抵達終止式（例 6）。請注意，例 6 一開始先用標準的主和聲延長進行確立原調。
en: Our ears tend to need time to adjust to hearing a new key. If you want your new key to sound firmly established, it's therefore best not to cadence too quickly after your pivot. A good strategy can be to use deceptive motion to avoid a cadence in the new key, and then to retry and successfully achieve a cadence afterward (Example 6). Notice that Example 6 begins by establishing the home key with a standard tonic expansion progression.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 使用共同和弦寫出轉調樂句靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 例 6。轉調樂句的寫作。
en: Example 6. Writing a modulating phrase.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 主音化與轉調
en: Tonicization versus modulation

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 依片段的長度，以及新調被確立的程度，主音化與轉調可以視為同一個連續範圍的兩端（例 7）。轉調比主音化更長，新調的確立也更強。這裡的「更強」是什麼意思？最明確的轉調，是先以終止式確立新調，之後音樂還繼續留在新調。較弱的轉調，可能只在終止式確立新調，隨即返回原調。有時，不同的人就是會把同一段音樂聽成不同情況；有些人的耳朵似乎比其他人更容易接受調性已經改變。你的分析應能呈現自己如何聽到這段音樂，並說明原因；同時也應理解，為什麼別人可能聽出不同的結果。
en: Tonicization and modulation can be viewed as two poles on a spectrum based on the length of the passage in question and the strength with which a new key is established (Example 7). Modulations are longer and stronger than tonicization. What does “stronger” mean here? The clearest modulations are those in which the new key is established with the cadence, and then the passage continues in the new key after the cadence. Weaker modulations might only establish the new key with the cadence, then go right back to the home key. Sometimes people will simply hear a passage differently: some people's ears seem to more willingly accept key changes than others. In your analysis, you should be able to represent your hearing of a given passage and explain why you hear it that way, and you should also be able to understand why someone else might hear it differently.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 例 7。主音化與轉調之間的連續範圍。
en: Example 7. Spectrum between tonicization and modulation.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 明確的主音化與轉調之間，有一個灰色地帶，稱為「延伸主音化」（extended tonicization）。像例 8 這樣的片段，比兩個和弦更長，例如比 [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5/V}[/latex] 接到 V 更長，但還沒有長到能藉由終止式確立真正的轉調。這時，我們會暫時用新調分析，並在整段延伸主音化下方畫出括線，再於括線下標示新調的羅馬數字。例 8 由 E♭ 大調開始，接著主音化 F 小調，所以括線下標示 ii。在例 8 中，這段延伸主音化也幫助音樂從 E♭ 大調過渡到 C 小調；換句話說，延伸主音化本身就成了銜接兩調的和聲區域。
en: In between clear tonicizations and modulations is a gray area that we call “extended tonicization.” These are passages like the one in Example 8 where the passage is longer than two chords (longer than, for instance, [latex]\mathrm{V^6_5/V}[/latex] to V), but not so long that it leads to a cadence to establish true modulation. In such cases, we temporarily analyze in a new key, and we show it by placing the Roman numeral of the new key underneath a bracket that underlies the entirety of the extended tonicization. Example 8 begins in E♭ major, then tonicizes F minor, so we put Roman numeral ii under the bracket. In the case of Example 8, the extended tonicization also helps us transition from E♭ major to C minor—in other words, the extended tonicization itself serves as a pivot area.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 分析者常在遇到下列兩種情況之一時，察覺這裡正在進行延伸主音化：
en: Often, analysts realize an extended tonicization is taking place when one of two things happens:

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: 發現自己在很短的篇幅內，不斷寫出 x/ii、y/ii、z/ii。羅馬數字在原調中已無法作出合理的功能解釋，但即將到來的終止式仍在原調。
en: The analyst realizes they have been writing x/ii, y/ii, z/ii over and over again in a short space. The Roman numerals stop making functional sense in the home key, but the upcoming cadence is still in the home key.

title: 延伸主音化與近系調轉調
text: Joseph Bologne 弦樂四重奏中的延伸主音化靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。

It may be best to leave composition-level form until after tonicization and modulation have been studied.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 重點整理本章介紹音樂曲式的層級、動機與分組分析。曲式可以理解為不同單位依層級組合而成的結構。其中最小的分組是動機，也就是經常再現、通常小於一個樂思的音樂單位。分析時，將作品中反覆出現並經過變化的動機圈起來，加上標記。不要把很長的旋律或旋律片段都當成動機，動機是短小的！分組分析是呈現一段音樂或整首作品如何分組的方法。先找出樂句結尾，這些位置常以終止式為標誌；再將樂句劃分成較小的單位，用譜面上方的方括線標出樂思層次。
en: Key Takeaways This chapter describes the hierarchy of musical form, motives, and segmentation analysis. Musical form can be understood as a hierarchical grouping of units. The smallest of these groupings is a motive, which is a regularly recurring unit of music that’s typically smaller than an idea. In an analysis, we circle and label motives that recur and are transformed across a work. Avoid identifying large melodies or portions of melodies as motives—motives are short! A segmentation analysis is a way to show the grouping units of a passage or whole piece. To do a segmentation analysis, we begin by identifying phrase endings, which are often marked by cadences. Then, we divide phrases into smaller units using square brackets above the score to show the idea level.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 例 1。古典音樂的曲式層級。
en: Example 1. Hierarchy of form in classical music.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 理解曲式的一種方式，是將它視為不同單位依層級組合而成的結構。例 1 說明，一首作品包含樂章、樂章包含段落、段落包含主題、主題包含樂句，依此類推。
en: One way to understand musical form is as a hierarchical grouping of units. Example 1 shows that a piece contains movements, movements contain sections, sections contain themes, themes contain phrases, and so on.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 例 1 看起來很簡單，但實際的層級關係更複雜。例如，有時兩個層級會合而為一：一個樂句就可能構成作品中的整個段落，因此不一定每次都有必要區分各個層級。最好把例 1 當成參考，而不是嚴格界定曲式層級的規則。
en: Although the diagram in Example 1 looks quite simple, the relationships between the levels are a little more complicated in reality. For instance, sometimes two levels are collapsed into one: a single phrase may comprise an entire section of a work, so it may not always be worthwhile to distinguish between each level. It’s best to think of Example 1 as a guide and not as something that strictly defines formal levels.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 本章與接下來三章著重於樂句層次的形式，也就是動機、樂思，有時還有次樂句，如何以不同方式構成樂句；次樂句將在後續章節討論。
en: This chapter, along with the three that follow it, are focused on phrase-level form, or the various ways in which a phrase may be constructed of motives, ideas, and sometimes subphrases (which will be discussed in later chapters).

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 動機
en: Motives

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 動機（motive）像是一小段旋律，是經常再現、通常小於一個樂思的音樂單位；樂思是本章下一節的重點。例 2–4 的影片各自討論不同作品的動機，基本內容相同。你可以選擇最感興趣的一支，也可以三支都看。
en: A motive is like a little snippet of a melody. It’s a regularly recurring unit of music that’s typically smaller than an idea (the focus of the next section of this chapter). Each video in Examples 2–4 discusses a motive from a different work. They all contain the same basic information, so you might choose to watch the one that interests you the most, or you might watch all three.

en: Example 4. Motivic analysis: Lin-Manuel Miranda, “Aaron Burr, Sir” from Hamilton (0:12–0:16).

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 動機不一定非要重複，但會重複的動機通常最值得討論，因此我們往往著重於在一段音樂中反覆出現的動機。
en: While a motive does not necessarily have to repeat, those that do are usually the most interesting ones to talk about, so we tend to focus on motives that recur throughout a passage.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 動機有許多類型，例如節奏、音高、輪廓或音色動機；不過，單獨使用「動機」一詞時，通常是指以音高為基礎的動機。若一個動機主要靠節奏設計讓人辨認，就會明確稱為「節奏動機」。
en: There are many kinds of motives (e.g., rhythmic, pitch, contour, timbre), but the word “motive” by itself most often refers to a pitch-based motive. A motive that’s primarily recognizable from its rhythmic design, for example, would be spoken of as a “rhythmic motive.”

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 動機在作品中再現時，往往會有所改變。常見的變化方式包括：
en: As a motive recurs throughout a work, it tends to change. Some common transformations are:

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 時值延長（enlargement）：讓動機的音符時值比原來更長。時值縮短（contraction）：讓動機的音符時值比原來更短。倒影（inversion）：改變動機的進行方向，例如原本上行改為下行。節拍位移（displacement）：相較於最初的呈現，改變動機在拍節中的位置。逆行（retrograde）：將動機最初的音符次序倒過來呈現。音程變化：改變構成動機的音程大小，例如小二度（mi2）變成大二度（ma2）。裝飾：在動機原有的基本形狀上加入裝飾音。
en: Enlargement: making the durations of a motive longer than the original Contraction: making the durations of a motive shorter than the original Inversion: changing the direction of the motive (e.g., instead of going up, it goes down) Displacement: changing the metric position of the motive relative to its original statement Retrograde: stating the motive backward in comparison to the initial statement Intervallic manipulation: changing the size of the intervals that comprise the motive (e.g., mi2 becomes ma2) Embellishment: adding embellishing tones to the underlying basic shape of the motive

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 初次被要求辨認作品中的動機時，人們往往會選擇過大的片段，例如整個主題。例 5 展示分析貝多芬第五號交響曲開頭時常見的錯誤：把一段過長、不適合視為動機的音樂當成動機。更有用的分析方式，可參考例 3 的影片。
en: Often when people are first asked to identify motives in a work, they tend to choose something too large, like an entire theme, for instance. Example 5 shows a common mistake in a motivic analysis of the opening of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony: identifying a passage that is too long to be considered a motive. For a more useful approach, see the video in Example 3.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 例 5。貝多芬第五號交響曲，第一樂章第 1–13 小節（0:00–0:17）。框出的片段過長，不適合視為一個動機。
en: Example 5. Beethoven, Symphony 5, I, mm. 1–13 (0:00–0:17). The boxed measures indicate something that is too long to be considered a motive.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 樂思層次、樂句與分組分析
en: The Idea Level, the Phrase, and Segmentation Analysis

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 樂句是一個相對完整的樂思，展現朝向目標的方向，並抵達某種結束感。下一章會更詳細討論樂句；這裡先說明兩個重點：
en: A phrase is a relatively complete thought that exhibits trajectory toward a goal, arriving at a sense of closure. While phrases are examined in more detail in the following chapter, here are two important points:

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 「相對完整」是指樂句具有開始、中段與結尾的感覺。在許多調性音樂中，結束感最常由終止式標示；下一章也會討論其他產生結束感的方式。演奏時，了解樂句以結束感收尾，有助於塑造音樂朝向目標的方向。[1]
en: “Relatively complete” means that the phrase has a sense of beginning, middle, and end. In much tonal music, closure is most often signaled by a cadence (though other ways of achieving closure will be examined in the following chapter). In performance, knowing that phrases end with closure can help us to shape passages with a sense of trajectory toward their goal.[1]

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 分析樂句時，我們常從分組分析（segmentation analysis）開始，用五線譜上方的方括線標示樂句的各個組成部分。
en: When we analyze a phrase, we often begin with a segmentation analysis, which uses square brackets above the staff to identify the phrase’s component parts.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 分組分析的最小層次，稱為樂思層次（idea level）。若需要，可回顧例 1，確認樂思在曲式層級中的位置。樂思是包含作品動機材料的短小分組，通常長兩小節，但也可能更長或更短。數個樂思可以組成次樂句或樂句，下一章將進一步討論。
en: The smallest level of a segmentation analysis is called the idea level. (If needed, see Example 1 for a reminder of where the idea level fits in the hierarchy of form.) Ideas are short grouping units that contain the motivic material for the work. They are often two measures long, but they may be longer or shorter. Ideas may group together to create subphrases or phrases, something that is discussed in more detail in the next chapter.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 進行分組分析時，可依以下步驟：
en: To perform a segmentation analysis, do the following:

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 找出可能產生結束感的位置。記得樂句需要有開始、中段與結尾的感覺，因此判斷樂句結尾時，不要把範圍看得太小。在調性音樂中，終止式常會告訴我們樂句在哪裡結束。將每個樂句劃分成較小的單位。辨認這些單位時，可以想想：若你要指導別人練習這個樂句，會如何劃分，讓對方分成小段練習？在五線譜上方，用方括線標示這些小單位。確認並標示出現的終止式。
en: Identify potential points of closure. Consider that phrases need a sense of beginning, middle, and end, so be careful that you’re not thinking too small to determine where a phrase ends. In tonal music, very often cadences tell us where the ends of phrases are. Divide each phrase into smaller units. (To identify these units, consider: if you were to coach someone to prepare this phrase, how would you divide it so they could practice it in smaller chunks?) Use square brackets above the staff to indicate those small units. Verify and label any cadences that are present.

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 例 6 與例 7 的影片，各自示範一個分組分析。兩支影片的說明相近，可以都看，也可以選擇較感興趣的一支。

title: 樂句層次曲式的基礎概念
text: 有時人們會混淆 phrase（樂句）與 phrasing（樂句處理）。一般說到 phrasing，是指如何塑造一段音樂，例如在哪裡推進或拉緩時間、在哪裡以及如何改變力度；它不一定指一個實際的樂句，也就是以終止式結束的完整樂思。 ↵
en: Sometimes people confuse the terms "phrase" and "phrasing." Usually when people say "phrasing," they are referring to the way a passage might be shaped (where to push and pull time, where and how to change dynamic levels, etc.), and they may or may not be referring to an actual phrase (a complete thought that ends with a cadence). ↵

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 重點整理本章介紹樂句、樂句型、樂段、重複樂句、複合形式，以及獨特的樂句層次形式。樂句（phrase）是一個相對完整、朝向某個目標推進的樂思。在調性古典音樂中，這個目標幾乎總是某一種傳統終止式；在其他音樂中，目標則可能不同。樂句型（sentence）是一種特殊的樂句，由呈示部與延續部構成。樂句有時會結合成較大的形式，其中兩種組合是：樂段（period）：由前句與後句構成的樂句層次形式。重複樂句：由兩個樂句構成，第二句是把第一句的重複完整寫出來。有時，兩個樂句型會以前句與後句的關係排列，形成複合樂段。本章討論的形式都相當常見，但作曲家創作出不明顯呼應這些結構的獨特樂句層次形式，也同樣常見。
en: Key Takeaways This chapter introduces the phrase, the sentence, the period, the repeated phrase, compound forms, and unique phrase-level forms. A phrase is a relatively complete thought that exhibits trajectory toward a goal. In tonal classical music, that goal is almost always one of the traditional cadence types, but in other kinds of music, that goal may be something else. A sentence is a special kind of phrase that contains a presentation and a continuation. Sometimes phrases are combined to form larger forms. Two such combinations of phrases are: The period: a phrase-level form consisting of an antecedent and a consequent. The repeated phrase: two phrases where the second is a written-out repeat of the first. Sometimes two sentences are arranged in an antecedent-consequent relationship to create a compound period. Although the forms discussed in this chapter are all quite common, it's equally common for a composer to write a unique phrase-level form that isn't in dialogue with the ones discussed here.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 本章播放清單
en: Chapter Playlist

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 1。舒伯特〈你是安寧〉（0:21–0:32）中，一個常見長度樂句的分組分析。
en: Example 1. A segmentation analysis of a phrase of common length in Schubert, "Du bist die Ruh" (0:21–0:32).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 2。范妮・韓賽爾〈暮景〉（0:00–0:40）中，一個長度特殊的樂句之分組分析。
en: Example 2. A segmentation analysis of a phrase of unique length in Fanny Hensel, "Abendbild" (0:00–0:40).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 樂句是一個相對完整的樂思，朝向某個目標推進，並在抵達時形成結束感。在調性古典音樂中，樂句的目標幾乎總是〈和聲、終止式與樂句結尾入門〉所述的某種終止式：完全正格終止（PAC）、不完全正格終止（IAC），或半終止（HC）。[1]
en: A phrase is a relatively complete thought that exhibits trajectory toward a goal, arriving at a sense of closure. In tonal classical music, the goal of a phrase is almost always one of the kinds of cadences described in the Introduction to Harmony, Cadences, and Phrase Endings chapter: perfect authentic cadences (PACs), imperfect authentic cadences (IACs), and half cadences (HCs).[1]

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 樂句可以有任何長度，但 4、8 或 16 小節特別常見。例 1分析的是 4 小節樂句的分組，屬於常見長度；例 2則分析 13 小節的樂句，長度較不尋常。
en: A phrase can be any length, but phrases of 4, 8, or 16 measures are particularly common. Example 1 shows a segmentation analysis for a phrase of 4 measures (a common length), while Example 2 shows a segmentation analysis for a phrase of 13 measures (an unusual length).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 樂句可以直接由樂思構成，也可以同時包含次樂句與樂思。例 3的圖示呈現這兩種情形。繪製樂句分析圖時，我們遵循兩個一般原則：
en: Phrases can comprise either ideas or both subphrases and ideas. The diagrams in Example 3 depict both of these scenarios. When we diagram phrases, we follow two general principles:

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 用方括線標示樂思與次樂句，也就是基本上不一定要以終止式結束的分組。用弧線標示樂句層次及其以上的分組，也就是基本上必須以終止式結束的分組。[2]
en: Square brackets are used for ideas and subphrases (essentially anything that doesn't have to end with a cadence). Arcs are used for anything at the phrase level or above (essentially anything that must end with a cadence).[2]

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 3。樂句的兩種劃分：（a）只劃分為樂思；（b）劃分為次樂句，再劃分為樂思。
en: Example 3. A phrase divided into (a) ideas only, and (b) subphrases and ideas.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 結束感對辨認樂句十分重要，因此正確辨識終止式至關重要。並非每個停頓或 V–I 進行都是終止式！例 4討論的段落中，有好幾處容易被誤認為終止式。
en: Because closure is so important for phrase identification, it's crucial to correctly identify cadences. Not every pause or V–I motion is a cadence! Example 4 discusses a passage with multiple locations someone might mistakenly label as cadences.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 海頓鋼琴三重奏 H. 3，第一樂章的終止式分析
en: Analysis of cadences in Haydn, Piano Trio, H. 3, I (requires internet)

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 4。海頓 F 大調鋼琴三重奏 Hob. XV:6，第一樂章（0:00–0:24）中，有多處可能被誤標為終止式的段落。
en: Example 4. A passage with multiple locations someone might mistakenly label as cadences in Haydn's Piano Trio in F Major, Hob. XV:6, I (0:00–0:24).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 兩種類別：典型結構與獨特形式
en: Two Categories: Archetypes vs. Unique Forms

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 以下將探討樂句層次形式的兩種主要組織方式：
en: Below, we'll explore two main ways that phrase-level forms might be organized:

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 它們可能運用我們所稱的典型結構（archetype）。這是組織樂句的特定方式；本章將介紹樂句型與樂段兩種。它們也可能與典型結構毫無關聯；這時我們稱之為獨特形式，意即其組織方式既非樂句型，也非樂段。
en: They might play with what we'll call an archetype. These are special ways of organizing phrases, and you'll read about two kinds: sentences and periods. They might not relate to an archetype at all, in which case we'll say they're unique forms, meaning they are not organized as sentences or periods.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 這並不表示典型結構比獨特形式更常見。在共通實踐時期的音樂中，兩類樂句層次形式都經常出現。此外，這兩類最好視為同一光譜的兩端（例 5）：某種樂句層次形式可能比較接近其中一端，卻不明確屬於任一類。
en: Note that this doesn’t mean that archetypes are more common than unique forms. Phrase-level forms belonging to both categories appear frequently in common-practice music. Moreover, these categories might best be viewed as two ends of a spectrum (Example 5) in which a phrase-level form can be understood as “closer” to one category or the other without clearly belonging to either one.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 5。樂句層次形式類別的光譜。
en: Example 5. A spectrum of phrase-level formal categories.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 典型結構一：樂句型（特殊的一種樂句）
en: Archetype 1: The Sentence (A Special Kind of Phrase)

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 基本概念
en: The Basics

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 6。露易絲・法朗克《大提琴奏鳴曲》第二樂章（0:00–0:28）開頭的一個樂句型。
en: EXAMPLE 6. A sentence at the beginning of Louise Farrenc, Cello Sonata, II (0:00–0:28).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 6呈現一種常見的樂句建構方式，稱為樂句型。樂句型由兩個次樂句組成：呈示部與延續部。呈示部通常長 4 小節，包含一個基本樂思（b.i.）及其重複。延續部通常與呈示部等長，形成比例上的平衡；它具有以下將討論的四項特徵。
en: Example 6 shows one common way to construct a phrase, called a sentence. A sentence consists of two subphrases: the presentation and the continuation. The presentation is often four measures long, and it consists of a basic idea (b.i.) and its repetition. The continuation is often the same length as the presentation, creating a sense of proportional balance. It's characterized by four traits that are discussed below.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 7。常見的樂句型長度。
en: Example 7. Common sentence lengths.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 8。一個假想的樂句型，其延續部比呈示部長。
en: Example 8. A hypothetical sentence with a continuation that's longer than the presentation.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 呈示部與延續部等長的情形很常見（例 7列出幾種常見長度），而延續部比呈示部長也同樣常見（例 8）。相較之下，延續部比呈示部短的情形並不常見。
en: Although it's common for the presentation and continuation to be the same length (several common lengths are shown in Example 7), just as often, the continuation is longer than the presentation (Example 8). However, it's not common for the continuation to be shorter than the presentation.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 進一步理解呈示部
en: More Detail: The Presentation

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 呈示部是一個次樂句，由基本樂思（b.i.）及其重複組成，如例 6的前半段。
en: The presentation is a subphrase comprised of a basic idea (b.i.) and its repetition (as in the first half of Example 6).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 基本樂思通常長 2 小節，但 1 小節或 4 小節的基本樂思也頗常出現。
en: Basic ideas are often two measures long, but one-measure or four-measure basic ideas also occur with some frequency.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 基本樂思的重複往往帶有變化，因此有時不容易判斷眼前是重複，還是全然不同的樂思。通常有助於釐清的一項特徵是旋律輪廓：若兩個樂思具有相同輪廓，我們往往會把第二個聽成第一個的變化重複；若輪廓不同，就較可能把後一部分聽成與前一部分形成對比。本章稍後討論樂段時，還會回到這個問題。
en: The repetition of the basic idea is often varied, which can sometimes make it challenging to determine whether one is dealing with repetition or with a completely different idea. One of the characteristics that usually helps to clarify is contour: if the two ideas share the same contour, often we hear the second as a varied repetition of the first. If the two ideas have different contours, then we’re more likely to hear the second section as contrasting with the first, something that will return in our discussion of the period later in this chapter.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 基本樂思常見的變化方式包括：
en: Some common transformations of the basic idea are:

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 節奏或旋律的裝飾。移調。改變配和聲。改變音程的性質或度數，或同時改變兩者。
en: Rhythmic or melodic embellishment Transposition Change of harmonization Change of interval quality or size (or both)

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 呈示部通常從主和聲開始，接著可能採取下列幾種走向：
en: Presentations typically begin on the tonic harmony, and they may do one of several things:

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 以 [latex]\mathrm{I–V–V–I}[/latex] 或 [latex]\mathrm{I–ii^4_2–V^6_5–I}[/latex] 等進行延長主和聲。從主和聲走向屬和聲：[latex]\mathrm{I––V––}[/latex]。從主和聲走向非屬和聲，最常見的是 ii(6) 這類強烈的屬前和聲。
en: Prolong tonic via a progression such as [latex]\mathrm{I–V–V–I}[/latex] or [latex]\mathrm{I–ii^4_2–V^6_5–I}[/latex] Move from tonic to dominant: [latex]\mathrm{I––V––}[/latex] Move from tonic to a non-dominant harmony, most often a strong pre-dominant such as ii(6)

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 進一步理解延續部
en: More Detail: The Continuation

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 延續部是一個次樂句，通常比呈示部更不穩定。
en: The continuation is a subphrase that typically feels less stable than the presentation.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 延續部具有四項特徵：
en: It's characterized by four traits:

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 片段化（f.）：單位的長度比先前建立的單位更短。例如，若每個基本樂思都是 2 小節，片段就可能只有 1 小節。請注意，片段化只涉及單位的長度，不涉及旋律內容；片段的旋律可能與基本樂思有關，也可能無關。節奏活動增加：使用比先前單位更短的音符時值。模進：單位被重複，並移至不同音高。和聲節奏加快：和弦更換比先前更頻繁。例如，若每個基本樂思長 2 小節，且各自只配一個和弦，延續部就可能每小節換一次和弦。
en: Fragmentation (f.): making unit sizes shorter than the previously established unit sizes (e.g., if the basic ideas are each two measures, fragments may be one measure long). Note that fragmentation refers only to the length of the units. It does not refer to their melodic content, which may or may not be related to the basic ideas. Increased rhythmic activity: the use of faster durations than in previous units. Sequences: units are repeated and transposed. Increased harmonic rhythm: chord changes occur more often than before. For example, if the basic ideas are each two measures long and each is harmonized with a single chord, the continuation might contain chord changes every measure.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 延續部包含上述特徵愈多，就愈容易辨認；但許多時候只會出現其中一部分。最明顯的特徵也許是片段化：即使其他特徵缺席，它通常仍能提示延續功能。不過，並非所有延續部都有片段化。
en: A continuation subphrase is easier to identify if it includes more of the traits listed above, but very often, only some of these traits are present. Perhaps the most obvious one is fragmentation, which usually signals continuation even in the absence of the other traits, but not all continuations exhibit fragmentation.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 延續部因此有兩種典型樣態：有片段化（如例 6）與沒有片段化（如例 9與例 10）。在例 9中，延續部並未再細分出較小的樂思層次。單位（u.）這個術語，指的是直接呈現其所屬上一層分組特徵的分組；在例 10中，它表示該 2 小節樂思展現延續功能，例如透過加快和聲節奏來表現。
en: Continuations may therefore take one of two typical forms: with fragmentation (as in Example 6) and without fragmentation (as in Examples 9 and 10). In Example 9, the continuation doesn’t divide into a smaller idea level. The term unit (u.) denotes a grouping that simply expresses the traits of the next higher grouping to which it belongs; in Example 10, it indicates that the two-measure idea expresses continuation (perhaps through increased harmonic rhythm, for example).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 9。貝多芬《軍樂隊波蘭舞曲》（0:00–0:06）中，一個沒有片段化的樂句型。
en: Example 9. A sentence without fragmentation in Beethoven, Polonaise for Military Band (0:00–0:06).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 10。貝多芬第四號鋼琴奏鳴曲，作品 7，第二樂章（0:00–0:45）中的樂句型，其延續部沒有片段化。
en: Example 10. A sentence whose continuation doesn't exhibit fragmentation in Beethoven, Piano Sonata no. 4, Op. 7, II (0:00–0:45).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 因此，延續部可以呈現兩種典型樣態：
en: Continuations may therefore take one of two typical forms:

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 前面的例 6呈現有片段化的典型延續部。例 8與例 9呈現沒有片段化的延續部。在例 9中，延續部沒有再細分出較小的樂思層次。例 10使用「單位」（u.）一詞，指直接呈現其所屬上一層分組特徵的分組。在此，這個單位意指該 2 小節樂思藉由加快和聲節奏，表現延續功能。
en: Example 6 above showed a typical continuation with fragmentation. Examples 8 and 9 show continuations without fragmentation. In Example 9, the continuation doesn't divide into a smaller idea level. The term "unit" (u.) is used in Example 10 to denote a grouping that simply expresses the traits of the next higher grouping to which it belongs. Here, unit would mean that the two-measure idea expresses continuation through its increased harmonic rhythm.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 延續部的開頭具有不穩定性，因此很難概括它會以何種和聲開始。不過，就結尾而言，延續部總是朝向終止式推進；在古典音樂中，可以是三種常見終止式中的任何一種：完全正格終止、半終止或不完全正格終止。
en: Since continuations are unstable at their beginnings, it's hard to generalize about how they might begin harmonically. In terms of their endings, however, continuations always drive toward a cadence, and in classical music, that cadence can be any of the three common kinds (perfect authentic, half, or imperfect authentic cadence).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 整理：典型樂句型及其變體
en: Summary: The Archetypal Sentence and Its Variants

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 樂句型有許多不同樣貌。最清楚、最容易辨識的樂句型，較接近理想化的典型結構；較不明確的樂句可能有很大的變化，卻仍展現某些樂句型特徵，我們稱這類樂句具有樂句型特質（sentential）。典型樂句型包含：
en: Sentences come in many forms: the clearest, most obvious sentences are closer to the idealized archetype, and phrases that are less clear may be highly varied while still exhibiting some traits of the sentence (we call such phrases sentential). The archetypal sentence consists of:

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 4 或 8 小節。一個呈示部。一個長度與呈示部平衡的延續部。延續部中的片段化。
en: 4 or 8 measures A presentation A continuation whose length balances that of the presentation Fragmentation in the continuation

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 必須說清楚，許多樂句型並不具備上述所有特徵。要具有樂句型特質，一個樂句至少必須有呈示部與延續部。
en: To be clear, many sentences do not have all of these traits. At a minimum, to be sentential, a phrase needs a presentation and a continuation.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 典型結構二：樂段（兩個樂句的組合）
en: Archetype 2: The Period (A Combination of Two Phrases)

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 基本概念
en: The Basics

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 11。莫札特《單簧管協奏曲》第三樂章（0:00–0:11）中的一個樂段。
en: Example 11. A period in Mozart's Clarinet Concerto, III (0:00–0:11).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 除了樂句型，另一種常見的樂句層次形式是樂段（例 11）。樂句型本身是一個樂句，樂段則由兩個樂句組成；每一句都包含一個基本樂思（b.i.），接著是一個對比樂思（c.i.）。兩句對這些樂思的處理有何不同，見下文。第一句稱為前句，通常長 4 小節，結束於較弱的終止式，最常見的是半終止（HC）。第二句稱為後句，其終止比前句更強，最常見的是完全正格終止（PAC）。後句可以與前句等長，也可以更長；較短的情形很少見。
en: In addition to the sentence, another common phrase-level form is the period (Example 11). Unlike the sentence, which is a single phrase, the period comprises two phrases, each consisting of a basic idea (b.i.) followed by a contrasting idea (c.i.) (see below on how the treatment of these ideas differs in each phrase). The first phrase, called the antecedent, is often four measures long, and it ends with a weaker cadence, most often a half cadence (HC). The second phrase is called the consequent. It ends with a stronger cadence than the antecedent, most often a perfect authentic cadence (PAC). It may be the same length as or longer than the antecedent; it’s rare for it to be shorter.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 進一步理解前句
en: More Detail: The Antecedent

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 前句有時被形容為「提出問題」，而後句則「給出答案」。也可以把前句理解為一個尚未完整的陳述，再由後句補足。這兩種說法都源於同一件事：前句的終止總是比後句弱。
en: Antecedents are sometimes characterized as "asking a question" to which the consequent "provides the answer." Another way to think of it is that the antecedent makes an incomplete statement and the consequent completes it. Both of these descriptions stem from the fact that the antecedent always ends with a weaker cadence than the consequent.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 前句通常從主和聲開始，並且最常以半終止結束。前句當然也可能轉調，但更常見的是整句都停留在主調。
en: Antecedents typically start on tonic harmony, and they most often end on a half cadence. While it's certainly possible for the antecedent to modulate, it’s more common for the it to be entirely in the tonic key.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 進一步理解後句
en: More Detail: The Consequent

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 和前句一樣，後句也由基本樂思與對比樂思組成。多數後句開頭的基本樂思與前句相似或相同，但也可能不同。[3]如果兩個基本樂思不同，可將前句的基本樂思標為「b.i.1」，後句的則標為「b.i.2」，以便區分。
en: Like the antecedent, the consequent also comprises a basic idea and a contrasting idea. Most consequents begin with a basic idea that is similar or identical to that of the antecedent, but it may also be different.[3] If the two basic ideas are different, it might be useful to label the antecedent's basic idea as "b.i.1" and the consequent's as "b.i.2."

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 後句必須以比前句更強的終止式結束，因此它的對比樂思幾乎總與前句不同。差異的程度可以很大：有時後句的 c.i. 開頭與前句相同，只在接近結尾時改變；有時則整個對比樂思都不同。
en: The consequent's contrasting idea is almost always different from the antecedent's due to the fact that it must end with a stronger cadence than the antecedent. The degree of difference varies widely: sometimes the consequent's c.i. begins like the antecedent's and only changes near the very end; other times, the c.i. is entirely different.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 後句最常從主和聲開始，並以完全正格終止（PAC）結束。
en: Consequents most often begin on tonic harmony and end with a PAC.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 樂段可以維持在單一調性，也可以轉調。如果樂段轉調，調性的改變通常發生在後句。
en: Periods may either stay in a single key or modulate (i.e., change keys). If the period modulates, the change of key usually happens during the consequent.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 重複樂句（結合兩個樂句的另一種方式）
en: The Repeated Phrase (Another Way to Combine Two Phrases)

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 另一種相當常見、而且有時會與樂段混淆的樂句層次形式，是重複樂句：一個樂句之後，接著把它的重複完整寫出來（例 12）。
en: Another relatively common phrase-level form—one that sometimes gets confused with the period—is the repeated phrase, which consists of a phrase followed by a written-out repeat (Example 12).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 12。舒伯特〈你是安寧〉（0:22–0:44）中的重複樂句。
en: Example 12. A repeated phrase in Schubert's "Du bist die Ruh" (0:22–0:44).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 通常不會把置於反覆記號之間的單一樂句稱為重複樂句。此術語指的是將重複實際寫出，因而在樂曲中增加小節數的形式。重複時往往會有變化，例如裝飾旋律；這也說明作曲家為什麼可能選擇把樂句再寫一次。
en: A phrase between two repeat signs would typically not be considered a repeated phrase—this term refers to a phrase with a written-out repeat that adds additional measures to the piece. The repetition is often varied (for example, the melody may be embellished during the repeat), which explains why a composer may choose to write out the phrase a second time.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 在重複樂句中，第一句可以用任何一種終止式結束，第二句則必須使用相同的終止式。這正是它與樂段的差別：樂段的後句以比前句更強的終止式結束。
en: In a repeated phrase, the first phrase can end with any kind of cadence, and the second phrase must therefore end with the same one. This distinguishes a repeated phrase from a period, in which the consequent ends with a stronger cadence than the antecedent.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 複合的樂句層次形式（結合典型結構）
en: Compound Phrase-Level Forms (Combining Archetypes)

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 13。克里斯蒂安・佩措爾德《G 大調小步舞曲》（0:00–0:25）中的複合樂段。
en: Example 13. A compound period in Christian Petzold's Minuet in G Major (0:00–0:25).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 樂句型本身是一個樂句，而樂段由兩個樂句組成，因此一個樂段也可以由兩個樂句型構成，如例 13。一種形式以這種方式包含另一種形式時，我們稱其為複合形式。
en: Since the sentence is a single phrase, and since the period is composed of two phrases, it's possible for a period to be made of two sentences, as in Example 13. When one form contains another kind of form in this way, we call the result a compound form.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 14。范妮・韓賽爾〈暮景〉（0:00–0:40）中，一種獨特的樂句層次形式。
en: Example 14. A unique phrase-level form in Fanny Hensel's "Abendbild" (0:00–0:40).

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 13有哪些樂段特徵？第一個樂句，也就是前句，以半終止結束；第二個樂句，也就是後句，以更強的完全正格終止結束。這種由弱至強的終止模式，使此例保有樂段特有的「問與答」，或「不完整樂思走向完整樂思」的感覺。
en: How is Example 13 like a period? The first phrase (the antecedent) ends with a half cadence, and the second phrase (the consequent) ends with a stronger cadence: a perfect authentic cadence. This weak-to-strong cadence pattern makes this example retain that sense of "question and answer" or "incomplete thought to completed thought" that is so characteristic of the period.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 例 13又如何運用樂句型？它的前句與後句各自都是一個樂句型：每句的前 4 小節是呈示部，後 4 小節是延續部。
en: How does Example 13 use sentences? The antecedent and the consequent are each a sentence: in each phrase, the first four measures are the presentation and the last four measure are the continuation.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 獨特的樂句層次形式
en: Unique Phrase-Level Forms

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 本章介紹的樂句層次形式都相當常見；但那些具有獨特形式、與這些典型結構沒有明顯呼應關係的樂句，也同樣常見。
en: The phrase-level forms we've looked at in this chapter are all quite common, but just as common are phrases that are unique—that aren't in dialogue with these archetypes in any obvious way.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 分析這類段落時，我們仍可進行分組分析。可以靈活使用各種標籤；若某個標籤無助於詮釋，也不必勉強套用。例 2已示範長度特殊的樂句如何分組；現在的例 14則呈現如何選擇適當的標籤，套用在那些分組上。
en: When we analyze such passages, we can still perform a segmentation analysis. We can choose to apply labels flexibly, but we can also feel free to abandon labels where they don't seem to support our interpretation. In Example 2, we showed a segmentation analysis of a phrase of unique length, and we now show how one might apply select labels to those segments in Example 14.

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式

en: Assignments

title: 樂句、典型結構與獨特形式
text: 在後調性音樂或流行音樂等其他音樂中，也可能以其他手法標示結束感。↵若要複習樂句以上有哪些層次，請參閱〈樂句層次形式的基礎概念〉中關於曲式層級的討論。↵有些分析者把後句開頭與前句相同的樂段稱為「平行樂段」，把後句開頭與前句不同的樂段稱為「對比樂段」。由於對比樂段非常少見，本書通常以「樂段」泛指平行樂段，只有在少數遇到對比樂段時，才特別註明類型。↵
en: In other kinds of music, such as post-tonal music or popular music, closure may be signaled by other kinds of devices. ↵See the discussion of formal hierarchy in Foundational Concepts for Phrase-Level Forms for a reminder of what is above the phrase level. ↵Some analysts use the term "parallel period" to describe a period in which the consequent begins the same way as the antecedent, and "contrasting period" to describe a period in which the consequent begins differently than the antecedent. Since contrasting periods are so rare, however, this book simply uses “period” to refer to a parallel period, specifying the type only in the rare instance of a contrasting period. ↵

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 重點整理混合形式將一種典型結構的開頭，與另一種典型結構的結尾組合。可能的開頭包括前句、呈示部或複合基本樂思。可能的結尾包括後句、延續部或終止型結尾。雖然任何開頭都可以搭配任何結尾，但有些配對比其他配對更常見，見例 7。
en: Key Takeaways A hybrid form combines the beginning of one archetype with the ending from another. Possible beginnings are antecedents, presentations, or compound basic ideas. Possible endings are consequents, continuations, or cadential endings. Although any beginning could be combined with any ending, some pairings are more common than others (see Example 7).

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 本章播放清單
en: Chapter Playlist

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 什麼是混合形式？
en: What's a hybrid form?

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 在〈樂句、典型結構與獨特形式〉中，我們探討過兩種樂句層次的典型結構：樂句型（sentence）與樂段（period）。
en: In The Phrase, Archetypes and Unique Forms, we looked at two phrase-level formal archetypes: the sentence and the period.

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 這些形式都分為兩個部分。樂句型分成兩個次樂句：呈示部與延續部。樂段則分成兩個樂句：前句與後句。
en: We found that these forms divide into two parts. A sentence divides into two subphrases: a presentation and a continuation. A period divides into two phrases: an antecedent and a consequent.

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 例 1。貝多芬鋼琴奏鳴曲 Op. 13，第二樂章第 1–8 小節的「前句＋延續部」（0:00–0:32）。
en: Example 1. An antecedent + continuation in Beethoven, Piano Sonata Op. 13, II, mm. 1–8 (0:00–0:32).

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 將一種典型結構的開頭，與另一種典型結構的結尾配對，就形成混合形式（hybrid form）。例 1 的前句之後接的是延續部。
en: A hybrid form occurs when the beginning of one archetype is paired with the ending from another archetype. In Example 1, an antecedent is followed by a continuation.

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 如何知道第一部分是前句，而不是呈示部？它以較弱的終止式結束，而呈示部不以終止式結束。它由基本樂思接上對比樂思；呈示部則是基本樂思接上同一基本樂思的重複。如何知道第二部分是延續部，而不是後句？它不像後句那樣從基本樂思開始，而是以延續部常見的片段化開始。半終止之後，屬和聲繼續維持，讓它一開始就帶有不安定感；這與後句開頭典型的安定感不同。
en: How do we know the first part is an antecedent rather than a presentation? It ends with a weaker cadence, whereas presentations don't end with cadences. It has a basic idea followed by a contrasting idea, whereas presentations have a basic idea followed by a repetition of the basic idea. How do we know the second part is a continuation rather than a consequent? Rather than beginning as consequents do with a basic idea, it begins with fragmentation, which is characteristic of continuations. It begins with a feeling of instability created by the dominant that continues after the half cadence, rather than the stability that's typical of a consequent's beginning.

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 目前我們已知道兩種開頭（呈示部與前句）和兩種結尾（延續部與後句），但其實還有另一種可能的開頭——複合基本樂思，以及另一種可能的結尾——終止型結尾。下文會介紹這些新類型，並提供區分它們的方法。
en: So far, we know two beginnings (presentation and antecedent) and two endings (continuation and consequent), but there's actually one more possible beginning (compound basic idea) and one more possible ending (cadential). Below, we'll outline these new beginnings and endings and provide ways to help distinguish between them.

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 開頭
en: Beginnings

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 新類型：複合基本樂思（c.b.i.）
en: New: The Compound Basic Idea (c.b.i.)

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 例 2。海頓 C 大調鋼琴奏鳴曲 Hob. XVI:35，第一樂章第 1–8 小節中的複合基本樂思（0:00–0:05）。
en: Example 2. A compound basic idea in Haydn's Piano Sonata in C, Hob. XVI:35, I, mm. 1–8 (0:00–0:05).

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 複合基本樂思（compound basic idea，c.b.i.）是沒有終止式的前句，如例 2。[1]
en: A compound basic idea (c.b.i.) is an antecedent without a cadence, as seen in Example 2.[1]

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 例 2 哪裡像前句？它包含一個基本樂思，接著是一個對比樂思。例 2 哪裡不同於前句？它沒有以終止式結束。請留意，低音在第 3–4 小節一直維持 G；雖然旋律暫時停歇，低音卻缺少和聲上的移動，因此避開了原本可能出現的半終止（HC）。
en: How is Example 2 like an antecedent? It contains a basic idea followed by a contrasting idea. How is Example 2 different from an antecedent? It doesn't end with a cadence. Notice how the bass sits on G across mm. 3–4: although the melody comes to a point of rest, the lack of harmonic motion in the bass evades the half cadence (HC) that might have appeared there.

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 彙整：三種開頭類型
en: Summary: The Three Beginning Types

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 混合的樂句層次形式有三種開頭：前句、複合基本樂思與呈示部。例 3 彙整了區分這些開頭的特徵。
en: The three beginnings that appear in hybrid phrase-level forms are antecedent, compound basic idea, and presentation. Example 3 provides a summary of the characteristics that differentiate each of these beginnings.

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 開頭以終止式結束？第一個樂思第二個樂思前句是b.i.c.i.複合基本樂思否b.i.c.i.呈示部否b.i.b.i.
en: Beginning Ends with cadence? First idea Second idea antecedent Yes b.i. c.i. compound basic idea No b.i. c.i. presentation No b.i. b.i.

title: 混合的樂句層次形式
text: 複合基本樂思的「複合」是什麼意思？它常充當大型樂句型的基本樂思：整個樂句型長16小節，呈示部長8小節，包含兩個c.b.i.單位。這些大型基本樂思本身又由兩個單位——一個b.i.與一個c.i.——組成，因此稱為「複合」。 ↵終止樂思與終止型結尾有什麼不同？終止樂思出現在延續部末尾；終止型結尾則大致像是把終止樂思擴展到4小節，取代整個延續部。因此，「cadential」可以出現在樂思與次樂句兩個曲式層次。 ↵當然，小調也可以使用，唱名為 me–fa–sol–do [latex](\downarrow\hat3-\hat4-\hat5-\hat1)[/latex]。 ↵
en: What is "compound" about the compound basic idea? It often functions as the basic idea of a large sentence, one that is sixteen measures in length, where the presentation is eight measures long and comprises two c.b.i. units. It's "compound" in the sense that these large basic ideas are themselves composed of two units: a b.i. and a c.i. ↵What is the difference between a cadential idea and cadential ending? The cadential idea comes at the end of a continuation, and essentially, the cadential ending is like the cadential idea being expanded to four measures and replacing the continuation. That means that "cadential" can occur at two formal levels: the idea level and the subphrase level. ↵This can also occur in minor, of course, as me–fa–sol–do [latex](\downarrow\hat3-\hat4-\hat5-\hat1)[/latex]. ↵

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 重點整理擴展使樂句比預期更長，可以發生在內部（樂句開始與結束之間），也可以發生在外部（開始之前或結束之後）。內部擴展的技巧包括重複、拉長、再來一次技巧與替代路徑。外部擴展分為兩類：前綴出現在開始之前，例如導奏。後綴出現在終止式之後，例如終止後延伸、小尾聲與尾聲。縮減使樂句比預期更短。
en: Key Takeaways Expansions make a phrase last longer than expected. They can be internal (between the beginning and ending of the phrase) or external (before the beginning or after the end). Internal expansion techniques include repetition, stretching, one-more-time technique, and alternative path. External expansions fall into two categories: Prefixes occur before the beginning, such as an introduction. Suffixes occur after the cadence, such as post-cadential extensions, codettas, and codas. Contractions make a phrase shorter than expected.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 本章播放清單
en: Chapter Playlist

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 擴展（expansion）與縮減（contraction）指的是作曲家改變樂句預期長度的方式。
en: The terms expansion and contraction refer to ways composers play with the expected length of a phrase.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 「預期長度」是什麼意思？
en: What does "expected length" mean?

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 當一個樂句讓人聯想到某種典型結構，卻沒有完全依照它進行時，我們往往能判斷：如果它更接近該典型結構，原本會有多長。有時，樂句朝向終止式的進行，會讓我們預期終止式可能出現在哪裡；樂句卻避開了這個預期中的終止式。有時，一首作品呈現同一樂句的兩種版本，一個沒有擴展，另一個有擴展，讓我們有原型可供比較。
en: When a phrase invokes one of the archetypes without following it exactly, we can often identify how long a closer representation of that archetype would have been. Sometimes the cadential motion of the phrase allows us to anticipate where a cadence might occur, but the phrase evades the expected cadence. Sometimes a piece states two versions of a phrase—one unexpanded and the other expanded—giving us a model to which we can compare the expanded version.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 擴展是使樂句比預期更長的過程，增加的長度可能在樂句內部，即「內部擴展」，也可能在樂句外部，即「外部擴展」。縮減則是使樂句比預期更短，而且一定發生在樂句內部。
en: Expansion refers to the process of making a phrase longer than we expect. This lengthening might occur within the phrase ("internal expansion") or outside of the phrase ("external expansion"). Contraction refers to the process of making a phrase shorter than we expect, and it always occurs within a phrase.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 本章概述幾種樂句擴展與縮減的技巧，雖未涵蓋所有可能，已包括數種較常見的做法。這些技巧的術語很容易多到令人難以掌握；最重要的是能辨認樂句何時比預期更長或更短，並說明長度差異如何產生。
en: In this chapter, we offer an overview of several techniques for phrase expansion and contraction. This isn't an exhaustive list, but it covers several of the more common techniques. The terminology concerning expansion and contraction techniques can quickly become overwhelming. What's most important is to be able to recognize when a phrase is longer or shorter than expected and to be able to describe what's creating the difference in length.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 內部擴展
en: Internal Expansions

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 以下四種技巧——重複、拉長、再來一次與替代路徑——都發生在樂句內部，也就是樂句開始之後、終止式之前。作曲家常結合使用這些技巧；事實上，只用單一技巧擴展樂句的情況反而較少見。
en: The four techniques we discuss below—repetition, stretching, one-more-time, and alternative path—all occur within a phrase: after the phrase's beginning, but before its cadence. Often, composers use these techniques in combination; in fact, it's relatively rare to find a phrase that's expanded using only one technique.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 重複
en: Repetition

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 1。Robert Sheldon 的 Bright Lights!，以完全相同的重複形成內部擴展（0:49–1:03）。
en: Example 1. Internal expansion via exact repetition in Robert Sheldon's Bright Lights! (0:49–1:03).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 作曲家重複材料時，有時會因重複而增加長度。
en: Sometimes when a composer repeats material, the repetition creates extra length.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 1 在一個單位內完全重複同一動機，因而增加長度：四小節的前句之後，接上擴展為五小節的後句。多出來的長度，來自單位內動機的重複。
en: Example 1 shows an exact repetition of a motive within a unit that creates extra length: a four-measure antecedent is followed by an expanded five-measure consequent. The extra length results from a repeated motive within a unit.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 2。莫札特法國號協奏曲 K. 447，第一樂章第 1–9 小節，以變化重複形成內部擴展（0:00–0:18）。
en: Example 2. Internal expansion via varied repetition in Mozart's Horn Concerto, K. 447, I, mm. 1–9 (0:00–0:18).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 2 呈現變化重複，將整個單位重複以增加長度：四小節的複合基本樂思（c.b.i.）之後，接上五小節的延續部。延續部以模進開始，使原本預期的四小節擴展成五小節。
en: Example 2 shows a varied repetition in which a whole unit is repeated to add extra length: a four-measure compound basic idea (c.b.i.) is followed by a five-measure continuation. The continuation begins with a sequence that expands it from the expected four measures to five.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 並不是所有重複都會形成擴展！請區分出乎預期、增加長度的重複，以及較可預期的重複，例如呈示部中的基本樂思重複。
en: Not all repetitions create expansion! Be careful to differentiate expansion-creating repetitions, which are unexpected, from more predictable repetitions, such as when the basic idea is repeated in a presentation.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 拉長
en: Stretching

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 3。舒伯特鋼琴奏鳴曲 D. 459，第一樂章第 1–9 小節，以拉長形成內部擴展（0:00–0:17）。
en: Example 3. Internal expansion via stretching in Schubert's Piano Sonata D. 459, I, mm. 1–9 (0:00–0:17).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 有時，作曲家會增加某個和聲或旋律的持續時間，讓它比預期更長。這時，我們說包含該和聲或旋律的單位被拉長（stretching）了。在例 3 中，四小節的呈示部之後，接上五小節的延續部。延續部的終止樂思被拉長：[latex]\mathrm{I}^6[/latex] 與終止屬和聲各自持續一整小節，而非原本共同出現在一個小節內；這個屬和聲又以 [latex]\mathrm{Ger}^6[/latex] 與終止 [latex]^6_4[/latex] 加以裝飾。
en: Sometimes composers will lengthen a harmony or melody by increasing its duration so that it lasts longer than expected. When that happens, we say that the unit that contains the harmony or melody has been stretched. In Example 3, a four-measure presentation is followed by a five-measure continuation. The continuation's cadential idea is stretched when a [latex]\mathrm{I}^6[/latex] chord and the cadential dominant (embellished by a [latex]\mathrm{Ger}^6[/latex] and a cadential [latex]^6_4[/latex]) each last for a full measure as opposed to both occurring within a single measure.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 再來一次技巧（o.m.t.）
en: One-More-Time Technique (o.m.t.)

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: Janet Schmalfeldt（1989）提出「再來一次技巧」（one-more-time technique），包含三個步驟：（1）音樂嘗試形成終止式；（2）這個終止式被迴避；（3）音樂再次嘗試終止。再次嘗試時常使用相同材料，讓人感到音樂像是「往回退了一步」；但也可能換用不同的終止材料。
en: Coined by Janet Schmalfeldt (1989), the one-more-time technique involves three steps: 1) the music tries to cadence, 2) the attempted cadence is evaded, and 3) the music retries the cadence. The re-tried cadence often uses the same material, such that it feels like the music is "backing up," but it may also retry the cadence with different cadential material.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 4。孟德爾頌 Op. 8 第5首〈Pilgerspruch〉中，以再來一次技巧形成內部擴展（0:00–0:37）。
en: Example 4. Internal expansion via the one-more-time technique in Mendelssohn, Op. 8, no. 5, "Pilgerspruch" (0:00–0:37).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 4 在第 10 小節提出一次終止，但它被迴避了，進行為 [latex]\mathrm{cad^6_4 – V^4_2 – I^6}[/latex]。接著，以再來一次技巧重複終止樂思。這個再來一次單位也被拉長：旋律 C–B♭–A–G 的下行花了兩小節，原本只需一小節；終止 [latex]\mathrm{^6_4}[/latex] 解決到 [latex]\mathrm{V}^7[/latex]，也花了一整小節，原本只需半小節。
en: In Example 4, a cadence is proposed in m. 10, but it's evaded ([latex]\mathrm{cad^6_4 – V^4_2 – I^6}[/latex]). A one-more-time repetition of the cadential idea ensues. The one-more-time unit is stretched: notice that it takes two measures (compared to one originally) for the melody to descend C–B♭–A–G, and it takes a full measure (compared to a half measure originally) for the cadential [latex]\mathrm{^6_4}[/latex] to resolve to [latex]\mathrm{V}^7[/latex].

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 替代路徑
en: Alternative Paths

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 當出乎預期的新材料，使樂句暫時或永久偏離原本走向終止式的路線，就形成替代路徑（alternative path）。暫時偏離稱為繞道（detour）：在真正抵達終止式之前，先返回該樂句先前的材料。永久偏離則稱為改道（reroute）：不返回樂句先前的材料，便走向終止式。
en: An alternative path occurs when unexpected new material either temporarily or permanently causes a phrase to deviate from its expected trajectory toward a cadence. A temporary deviation is called a detour. Detours return to previous material from within the phrase before the phrase achieves a cadence. A permanent deviation is called a reroute. Reroutes achieve cadences without returning to previous material from within the phrase.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 5。孟德爾頌《赫布里底群島》序曲第 9–26 小節，以替代路徑中的繞道形成內部擴展（0:20–0:58）。
en: Example 5. Internal expansion via alternative path (detour) in Mendelssohn, Hebrides Overture, mm. 9–26 (0:20–0:58).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 5 展示繞道：樂句型的延續部再次出現。當終止樂思的動機在第 19 小節出現後，又於第 20 小節重複，我們察覺這次重複開始「偏離路線」；因為先前對應的第 15 小節並沒有這樣做。接著，第 21–22 小節出現高度對比的兩小節片段，之後在第 23–26 小節返回類似第 19–20 小節終止樂思的材料，只是這次被拉長了。
en: Example 5 shows a detour: the sentence's continuation is repeated. We realize the repetition is getting "off track" when the motive in the cadential idea (m. 19) is repeated (m. 20), which did not happen in the analogous place before (m. 15). A highly contrasting two-measure passage emerges (mm. 21–22) that leads to a return of material (mm. 23–26) similar to the cadential idea in mm. 19–20, now stretched.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 6。Maria Theresia von Paradis〈Sicilienne〉第 1–10 小節，以替代路徑中的改道形成內部擴展（0:00–0:42）。
en: Example 6. Internal expansion via alternative path (reroute) in Maria Theresia von Paradis, Sicilienne, mm. 1–10 (0:00–0:42).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 6 展示改道：四小節的前句之後，接上擴展為六小節的後句。後句以和前句相同的基本樂思開始，但它的對比樂思卻朝顯著不同的方向前進，並未導向終止式。因此，需要新的終止樂思，才能將樂句帶向完全正格終止（PAC）。
en: Example 6 shows a reroute: a four-measure antecedent is followed by a six-measure expanded consequent. The consequent begins with the same basic idea as the antecedent, but its contrasting idea moves in a markedly different direction, one that doesn't lead to a cadence. A new cadential idea is needed to bring the phrase to a perfect authentic cadence (PAC).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 雖然再來一次技巧與替代路徑都與終止式有關，兩者卻是很不一樣的技巧，如下表所示：
en: Although one-more-time technique and alternative paths both involve cadences, they are very different techniques, as explained below:

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 再來一次技巧替代路徑片段已嘗試形成終止式，但沒有成功。感覺像是樂句往回退，重新嘗試剛才未成功的終止式。片段尚未嘗試形成終止式。感覺像是樂句偏離了原本路線。
en: One-more-time technique Alternative path Passage has tried and failed to achieve a cadence Feels as though the phrase backs up to try the failed cadence again Passage has not yet tried to cadence Feels as though the phrase has gone off course

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 外部擴展
en: External Expansions

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 作曲家在樂句外部增加長度時，可以在樂句開始前增加小節，稱為前綴；也可以在終止式之後增加，稱為後綴。分析圖用虛線弧線或方括線標示外部擴展。
en: When composers add length outside of a phrase, they may add measures before the beginning (prefixes) or after the cadence (suffixes). In diagrams, we indicate external expansions using dashed arcs or brackets.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 前綴
en: The Prefix

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 7。Cécile Chaminade〈L'amour captif〉第 1–10 小節，以短小前綴形成外部擴展（0:00–0:13）。
en: Example 7. External expansion via small prefix in Cécile Chaminade, "L'amour captif," mm. 1–10 (0:00–0:13).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 前綴（prefix）位於樂句開始之前，通常是導奏。前綴可以很短，也可以很長，例如交響曲開頭的慢速導奏。例 7 展示短小的前綴。如同許多歌曲，這首法國藝術歌曲（mélodie）在歌者進入前，先有一段器樂導奏，也就是在樂句開始前先出現的材料。請注意，這個樂句還使用典型核心低音終止型態的變體：Chaminade 不用 mi-fa-sol-do（[latex]\hat{3}-\hat{4}-\hat{5}-\hat{1}[/latex]），而寫成 di-re-sol-do（[latex]\uparrow\hat{1}-\hat{2}-\hat{5}-\hat{1}[/latex]），出現在第 8–11 小節。
en: A prefix occurs before the beginning of a phrase, usually taking the form of an introduction. A prefix can be small, but it may also be large, such as when a composer begins a symphony with a slow introduction. Example 7 shows a small prefix. As is very common with songs, this mélodie opens with an instrumental introduction before the singer enters—that is, before the phrase beginningg. Note also that this phrase includes a variant on the typical core bass cadential pattern. Instead of mi-fa-sol-do ([latex]\hat{3}-\hat{4}-\hat{5}-\hat{1}[/latex]), Chaminade writes di-re-sol-do ([latex]\uparrow\hat{1}-\hat{2}-\hat{5}-\hat{1}[/latex]) (mm. 8–11).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 後綴
en: The Suffix

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 後綴出現在樂句已形成終止之後。例 8 的術語，可彈性用來描述不同種類的後綴。雖然例 8 提供使用指引，有人稱為終止後延伸的片段，另一人可能稱為小尾聲。比起執著哪個術語最適切，更重要的是辨認這段後綴在樂句範圍之外增加了長度。
en: A suffix occurs after a phrase has cadenced. The terms in Example 8 are flexibly used to describe different types of suffix. While Example 8 provides guidelines for their use, what one person calls a post-cadential extension, another might choose to call a codetta. It's more important to recognize that a given suffix adds length outside the bounds of a phrase than to worry about which term is most appropriate.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 術語平均長度特徵典型位置範例終止後延伸（p.c.e.）短（1–2 小節）材料較少：旋律材料很少或沒有。常重複終止式的和弦，例如 V–I，或最後的主和弦。通常不會呈現完整樂句。段落內，一個樂句結束之後。例 9小尾聲（codetta）中等（4–8 小節）常使用短小的動機材料，並加以重複。可能完整走過一輪終止和聲進行。可能呈現完整樂句，也可能沒有。作品或樂章內，一個段落結束之後。例 10尾聲（coda）長（8 小節以上）材料較充實：可能呈現新主題，或先前主題的再現。常包含數個樂句。作品或樂章主體結束之後。例 11
en: Term Avg. Length Characteristics Typical Location Example Post-cadential extension (p.c.e.) Short (1-2 mm.) Insubstantial: little or no melodic material Often repeats the chords of the cadence (e.g. V–I) or the final tonic Atypical to state an entire phrase After the end of a phrase within a section Example 9 Codetta Medium (4-8 mm.) Often features short motivic material that gets repeated May cycle through an entire cadential progression May or may not state an entire phrase After the end of a section within a piece or movement Example 10 Coda Long (8+ mm.) Substantial: may feature a new theme or reprise of a previous theme Often contains multiple phrases After the end of a piece or movement Example 11

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 8。區分常見後綴類型的特徵。
en: Example 8. Characteristics that differentiate common suffix types.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 9 呈現一個長樂段的結尾。後句以完全正格終止結束後，接著兩小節的終止後延伸，藉由琶音延長最後的主和聲。[1]
en: Example 9 shows the end of a lengthy period. After the perfect authentic cadence that ends the consequent, a two-measure post-cadential extension prolongs the final tonic via arpeggiation.[1]

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 在例 10 中，一個長樂句於第 41 小節，以 A♭ 大調的完全正格終止結束這首鋼琴奏鳴曲的呈示部。終止式之後接著小尾聲；請留意其中重複的兩小節單位，其和聲配置使用終止低音線 fi-sol-do（[latex]\uparrow\hat{4}-\hat{5}-\hat{1}[/latex]）。
en: In Example 10, a lengthy phrase ends the exposition of the piano sonata with a PAC in A♭ major at m. 41. The cadence is followed by a codetta: notice that it features a repeated two-measure unit harmonized with the cadential bass line fi-sol-do ([latex]\uparrow\hat{4}-\hat{5}-\hat{1}[/latex]).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 11 展示最長的一類後綴：尾聲。導奏先返回（4:52），接著有所變化（5:03），然後在 5:32 以和後續開頭重疊的完全正格終止，結束作品本體。尾聲也從 5:32 開始，以充滿活力的音樂為作品的收束喝采；它將先前聽過的主題改為快速版本，並包含數個樂句。
en: Example 11 features the longest kind of suffix: a coda. After the introduction returns (4:52) and then is varied (5:03), an elided PAC ends the piece proper (5:32). The coda (also at 5:32) presents an energetic celebration of the piece's closure, featuring a fast version of a previously-heard theme with several phrases.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 9。Cécile Chaminade〈Les presents〉以後綴中的終止後延伸形成外部擴展（2:31–2:57）。例 10。貝多芬鋼琴奏鳴曲 Op. 2 第1號，第 36–48 小節，以後綴中的小尾聲形成外部擴展（0:45–0:58）。
en: Example 9. External expansion via suffix (post-cadential extension) in Cécile Chaminade, “Les presents” (2:31–2:57). Example 10. External expansion via suffix (codetta) in Beethoven, Piano Sonata Op. 2, no. 1, mm. 36–48 (0:45–0:58).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 時間音樂事件4:52導奏以變化形式返回。5:03導奏的第二次變化開始。5:32尾聲開始，材料取自 2:00 出現的第二主題。
en: Timestamp Event 4:52 Introduction returns in varied form 5:03 A second variation on the introduction begins 5:32 Coda begins; its material is drawn from the second theme (from 2:00)

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 11。蕭士塔高維契《慶典序曲》中，以後綴中的尾聲形成外部擴展。
en: Example 11. External expansion via suffix (coda) in Shostakovich, Festive Overture.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 縮減
en: Contraction

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 例 12。Stéphan Elmas 第1號鋼琴協奏曲，第三樂章第 15–21 小節中的縮減（32:21–32:28）。
en: Example 12. Contraction in Stéphan Elmas, Piano Concerto No. 1, III, mm. 15–21 (32:21–32:28).

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 縮減比擴展少見。當樂句比我們預期更短時，就產生縮減。
en: Contractions occur less frequently than expansions. A contraction occurs when a phrase is shorter than we might expect it to be.

title: 樂句層次的擴展與縮減
text: 在例 12中，四小節的複合基本樂思之後，接著三小節的延續部。依複合基本樂思的長度，我們可能原本期待延續部也有四小節，形成比例平衡。聆聽時，請留意終止式來得多麼突然；縮減通常會帶來這種感覺。
en: In Example 12, a four-measure compound basic idea is followed by a three-measure continuation. Given the length of the compound basic idea, we might have expected the continuation to be four measures long to create proportional balance. As you listen, notice how the cadence feels abrupt, a feeling that usually accompanies contraction.
