text: 例21。將五音降低的屬七和弦序列，作等音重新詮釋，讀成一連串法式增六和弦接屬七和弦的組合。
en: Example 21. A sequence of dominant-seventh chords with flattened fifths enharmonically reinterpreted as a succession of French augmented-sixth chords followed by dominant-seventh chords.

title: 半音模進
text: 再進一步，可以將法式增六和弦換成德式增六和弦，如例22。這樣就得到一串與逐半音下行屬七和弦等音的進行。同時，每兩個相鄰和弦之間也會產生平行五度；蕭邦在運用這個進行時，似乎並不介意，請聽例23。
en: Taking this sequence one step further, we can substitute German augmented-sixth chords for the French augmented-sixth chords, as shown in Example 22. Note that when we do this, we get what is enharmonically equivalent to a succession of dominant-seventh chords descending by semitone. We also produce parallel fifths between each successive chord, which Chopin did not seem to mind in his application of this sequence which you can listen to in Example 23.

en: Example 23. A sequence of German augmented-sixth chords followed by dominant-seventh chords in Chopin's Mazurka in C♯ Minor Op. 30 No. 4, mm. 124-39.

title: 半音模進
text: 半音模進當然還有無數種變化，本章只展示其中一些選擇。這些模進都會讓聽眾暫時遠離調性中心，可能只是短暫打破穩定，也可能轉入遠系調。十九世紀的作曲家廣泛使用這些手法；接近二十世紀之際，它們也成為把調性推向邊界的一股力量。
en: There are, of course, myriad ways in which we may vary a chromatic sequence. The examples listed throughout this chapter merely represent some of these options. Importantly, all of these chromatic sequences transport the listener away from the tonal center, for the purposes of either a temporary disruption of stability, or to modulate into a distantly-related key. These techniques were used by composers throughout the nineteenth century, and were part of what contributed to pushing tonality to its fringes as we moved closer to the turn of the twentieth century.

title: 半音模進
text: 半音模進作業：聲部寫作與分析。
en: Chromatic Sequences Assignment (Part-writing and analysis)

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 重點整理Omnibus 進行是一種以反向運動構成的半音聲部連接手法。兩個聲部參與聲部交換，其餘聲部保持不動。這種進行可以延長屬和聲。收斂型中，導音下行；從根音開始的低音則上行。發散型中，七音上行；從根音開始的低音則下行。兩種模式都可以在抵達另一個原位屬七和弦時，重新設定起點，繼續多輪進行。
en: KEY TAKEAWAYS The omnibus progression is a chromatic voice-leading technique that moves in contrary motion. The progression includes two voices that move participate in a voice exchange, while the other voices remain static This progression prolongs dominant harmony In the converging omnibus progression, the leading tone descends while the bass (which starts on the root) ascends In the diverging omnibus progression, the seventh ascends while the bass (which starts on the root) descends Both patterns can go through multiple iterations by “resetting” the progression when you reach another root-position dominant-seventh chord

title: Omnibus 進行
text: Omnibus 進行是一種特殊的半音模進，低音與另一個聲部作反向運動。它最常用來延長屬和聲，也可以作為轉入遠系調的手段。
en: The omnibus progression is a special type of chromatic sequence in which the bass and another voice in the texture move in contrary motion. The omnibus progression is most commonly used to prolong dominant harmony, but it can also be used as a means of modulating into distant keys.

title: Omnibus 進行
text: Omnibus 進行有兩種寫法：低音與上方聲部逐漸靠攏的收斂型，以及彼此遠離的發散型。
en: There are two ways of writing an omnibus progression: with the bass and upper voices converging, or with the bass and upper voices diverging.

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 收斂型 Omnibus 進行
en: The converging omnibus progression

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 收斂型 Omnibus 進行從原位屬七和弦開始。低音逐半音上行，含導音的聲部則逐半音下行，形成聲部交換。聲部連接應盡量平順：只有參與交換的兩個聲部移動，其餘聲部都作為共同音保持不動。
en: The converging omnibus progression begins on a root-position dominant-seventh chord. The bass moves upward by semitone, while the voice with the leading tone moves downward by semitone, creating a voice exchange. The voice leading in this progression should be as smooth as possible: The only voices that are moving are the ones involved in the voice exchange. The other voices remain static as common tones.

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 例1透過女高音聲部的導音與低音聲部的根音交換，延長屬七和弦。這樣移動三個半音，會抵達另一個原位屬七和弦，也可等音解讀為德式增六和弦。繼續到總共移動四個半音，則回到最初的同一個屬七和弦，但改為第一轉位。整個模式包含五個和弦位置，在下方譜例中標為1至5。
en: Example 1 shows the prolongation of a dominant-seventh chord via a voice exchange between the leading tone (in the soprano) and the root of the chord (in the bass). Moving three semitones in this fashion brings you to another root-position dominant-seventh chord/German augmented-sixth chord (recall that these are enharmonically equivalent!). Moving four semitones in this fashion brings you to the same dominant-seventh chord on which you began the progression, but this time, in first inversion. The pattern yields five different chords, labelled 1-5 in the example below.

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 有些作曲家會把模式中的第二個和弦，從屬七和弦改成減七和弦。在這個變體中，第一與第二和弦之間保留三個共同音，如例2。
en: One variation of the omnibus progression that some composers use is to change the second chord in the pattern from a dominant-seventh chord to a diminished-seventh chord. In this version, there are three common tones held between the first and second chord. You can see this variation in Example 2.

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 第二和弦改用減七和弦的 Omnibus 變體靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。例2。以減七和弦取代模式中第二和弦的 Omnibus 變體。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example.Example 2. A variation on the omnibus progression that substitutes a diminished-seventh chord for the second chord of the pattern.

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 布拉姆斯提供了一個很好的收斂型用例。例3中，第38–41小節透過 Omnibus 進行，延長 B 大調的屬和弦。有趣的是，第46–48小節再次使用這個進行，這回延長的是新調 C♯ 的屬和弦；這個 C♯ 調性，正是第38–41小節原進行內部和弦所「暗示」的調。
en: Brahms provides us with a good example of a converging omnibus progression. In Example 3, we can see that the dominant chord in the key of B major is prolonged by way of an omnibus progression in mm. 38-41. Interestingly, he uses the progression again in mm. 46-48, this time to prolong the dominant of the new key of C♯, which is the key “implied” by the internal chords of the original progression in mm. 38-41.

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 布拉姆斯詼諧曲中的兩次 Omnibus 進行靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 例3。布拉姆斯《詼諧曲》Op. 4，第31–49小節中的兩次 Omnibus 進行。
en: Example 3. Two omnibus progressions in Brahms, Scherzo Op. 4, mm. 31-49

title: Omnibus 進行
text: Omnibus 進行可以轉入遠系調，甚至最終走完整個八度，雖然實際作品很少如此延伸。當進行到第四個和弦、抵達新的原位屬七和弦時，找出新的導音，就能重新開始。下方例4每到模式的第四個和弦便重新設定起點，將它解讀為新的屬七和弦，使新的導音與根音低音作反向運動。例如，模式中的第四個和弦是 B♭7。在例1中，它被解讀為德式增六和弦，聲部交換再繼續一個半音，抵達 C 調屬和弦的第一轉位，也就是前例的和弦5。這一次，則把 B♭7 當作新的原位屬七和弦，重新啟動模式，使新的導音與低音作半音聲部交換。因此，它被重新標為和弦1，新的導音以藍色標示。下方譜例用不同顏色呈現各次和弦的重新詮釋，以及低音與不同導音之間的交換。
en: The omnibus progression can be used to move into distant keys, and eventually traverse the entire octave (though in practice it is rare to go through the entire octave). Once you reach the new root-position dominant-seventh chord (that you arrived at after four chords), find the new leading tone and begin the process again. In Example 4 below, the sequence “resets” with every fourth chord, reinterpreting that as a new dominant-seventh chord and thus moving a new leading tone in contrary motion with the bass (which is on the root of the chord). For example, the fourth chord in the pattern is B♭7. In Example 1, this chord was interpreted as a German augmented-sixth chord, and the chromatic voice exchange continued one more semitone to reach the dominant of C in first inversion (Chord 5 in the example above). This time, we are starting the pattern over by interpreting the B♭7 as a new root-position dominant-seventh chord, and moving the new leading tone in a chromatic voice exchange with the bass. This chord has been re-labeled as Chord 1, with the new leading tone highlighted in blue. The colours throughout the example below show the the reinterpretations of this chord throughout the pattern, and the voice exchanges between the bass and the various leading tones.

text: 延伸至整個八度的 Omnibus 進行靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。

text: 例4。走完整個八度的 Omnibus 進行。

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 下方例5中，蕭邦連續使用兩輪 Omnibus 進行，可透過紅、藍音符頭與五線譜上方的數字追蹤。這裡採用第二和弦為減七和弦的變體，從 C♯ 小調的原位屬七和弦，走到 G 大調的原位屬七和弦。接著，原文說蕭邦將這個 D7 的根音與五音「都下移半音」，成為 A♭7 的根音與五音（音程方向的疑誤見譯註）。A♭7 作為屬和弦，使樂句在 D♭ 大調結束；主音與起始的 C♯ 等音，但大小調式已不同！
en: In Example 5 below, Chopin uses the omnibus progression through two iterations, which you can follow by observing the red and blue noteheads and numbers listed above the staff. Chopin uses the variant with the diminished-seventh chord as Chord 2, and moves through the omnibus progression from a root-position dominant-seventh chord in C♯ minor to a root-position dominant-seventh chord in G major. Interestingly, though, Chopin then takes this D7 chord and moves both the root and fifth down by semitone to become the root and fifth of the A♭7 chord which serves as the dominant to close the phrase in D♭ major, the same tonic (but not mode) that we started on!

title: Omnibus 進行

en: Example 5. Two successive iterations of the omnibus progression in Chopin Nocturne in D-Flat Major, Op. 27, No. 2

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 發散型 Omnibus 進行
en: The diverging omnibus progression

title: Omnibus 進行
text: 發散型的運作幾乎相同，只是與低音反向移動的，改為七音而非導音，如例6。要繼續轉入遠系調，只需找出新原位屬七和弦的七音，再重複這個過程。譜例以不同顏色標出七音與低音的每次交換，便於追蹤。例如，第一小節從 G7 開始，女低音聲部的 F 與低音 G 作半音聲部交換；兩者逐半音反向遠離，到同小節第四拍抵達 E7。此時，新和弦的七音 D 又與低音 E 展開交換。另一種理解方式，是把這個版本視為從原模式的和弦4開始。若想將例1完整倒過來，只要在下方譜例每個標為和弦4的位置之前，插入和弦5即可。舒伯特鋼琴奏鳴曲的下方片段，就是這種倒轉的例子，見例7。
en: The diverging omnibus progression works almost identically, but instead of moving the leading tone in contrary motion to the bass, you move the seventh. This is shown in Example 6. To move into distant keys, find the new seventh in the root-position dominant-seventh chord and repeat the process. Again, this is made more clear by following the colours in the example, which represent each voice exchange between seventh and bass. For instance, starting on G7 in measure 1, the chromatic voice exchange occurs between F in the alto voice, and G in the bass. Moving apart in contrary motion by semitone, we eventually reach E7 on beat 4 of the same measure. At this point, we have a new seventh of the chord, D, which participates in the voice exchange with the bass, which is now on E. Another way to think of this version of the omnibus progression is to consider it starting on Chord 4 of the pattern. If you wanted to completely reverse the original omnibus progression from Example 1, you would simply insert Chord 5 before any of the Chord 4s listed in the example below. This kind of reversal can be found in the excerpt from Schubert’s Piano Sonata, reproduced below in Example 7.

en: Much like the converging version of this technique, the diverging omnibus progression is rarely used to traverse the entire octave, but we do find many examples in which the technique is used to achieve modulations into distant keys. In Example 8, Mussorgsky uses the omnibus progression to modulate to E major by way of two iterations through the pattern.

title: Omnibus 進行
text: Omnibus 進行的聲部寫作與分析（.docx、.pdf）。
en: Part-writing and analyzing omnibus progressions (.docx, .pdf)

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 重點整理屬和弦的五音可以升高或降低，形成增五度或減五度。分析時，在羅馬數字旁加上「+」表示增五度，或「o」表示減五度。增五度的屬和弦，通常讓升高的五音向上解決到下一和弦的三音，因此最常解決到大三和弦。降低的五音通常向下半音，解決到下一和弦的根音。九音取代重複的根音，向下級進解決。十一音取代三音，透過保持共同音而解決。十三音取代五音，向下三度解決。延伸和弦幾乎都採原位。
en: KEY TAKEAWAYS Dominant chords may feature an augmented or diminished fifth, indicated in analysis by “+” (for augmented) or “o” (for diminished) beside the Roman numeral. Augmented dominant chords typically have the augmented fifth resolving up to the third of the following chord. These are most commonly found resolving to major triads. Diminished fifths typically resolve down by semitone to the root of the following chord A 9th replaces a doubled root, and resolves downward by step An 11th replaces a third, and resolves via common-tone A 13th replaces a fifth, and resolves downward by third Extended chords are almost exclusively found in root position

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 變化和弦
en: Altered Chords

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 到目前為止，我們探討的許多半音和聲，都可以用副功能或調式借用來說明。原文指出，這些和聲尚未涉及改變和弦的完全五度；接下來就要詳細討論這種做法。把三和弦的五音升高或降低，會使這個五度變成增五度或減五度。我們雖然見過含減五度的減三和弦與七和弦，卻還需要討論另一種可能：和弦保留大三度，同時包含增五度或減五度。這些和弦通常稱為「變化和弦」（altered chords）。分析符號並無統一標準，但常在羅馬數字旁加「+」標示增五度，加「o」標示減五度；本章也採用這種方式。
en: To this point, many of the chromatic harmonies we have explored have been explained in terms of either secondary function or modal borrowing. None of these harmonies include alterations to the perfect fifth of the chord; a practice we will now discuss in some detail. When the fifth of a triad is raised or lowered, it becomes either augmented or diminished. While we have seen diminished triads and seventh chords that feature diminished fifths, we have yet to discuss the possibility of a chord with a major third and either an augmented or diminished fifth. These chords are commonly referred to as “altered chords.” Although there is no standard analytical notation, augmented fifths are often indicated in analysis by “+” beside the Roman numeral. Diminished fifths are indicated by a “o” beside the Roman numeral. We will adopt this practice here.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 含增五度的屬和弦

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 把大三和弦的五音升高，就會形成增三和弦。升高的五音通常向上級進，解決到目標和弦的三音。例1中，法朗克透過含增五度的屬七和弦，突然從 F♯ 小調轉入 D 大調。請注意，變化音向上解決到目標和弦的三音；此處目標是 D 大調的主和弦。這是這個半音變化音最常見的解決方式。
en: If you raise the fifth of a major triad, it will become an augmented triad. Typically, raised fifths resolve upward by step to the third of its target chord. In Example 1, Franck abruptly modulates from f-sharp minor to D major by way of a dominant seventh chord with an augmented fifth. Note the resolution moves upward to the third of the target chord (in this case, tonic in D major). This is the most common resolution of this chromatic pitch.

en: Importantly, these chords do not resolve easily to minor triads, since the augmented fifth would not be able to resolve upward by step. In Example 3, the dominant chord with an augmented fifth is used in first inversion, with the chromaticized fifth resolving upward again.

text: 例3。布拉姆斯，《第二號鋼琴協奏曲》，第四樂章。

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 增三和弦具有對稱性，可以作多種解讀；若沒有足夠的上下文，很難辨認根音。例3中，布拉姆斯清楚呈現它是 B♭ 的屬和弦，但也很容易把低音重新解讀為 A 增三和弦的根音。與減七和弦相似，增三和弦也可以成為半音轉調、進入遠系調的途徑。例4展示 C 增三和弦的三種等音解讀與解決。
en: Note that the augmented triad is a symmetrical chord than can be interpreted in multiple ways, making it difficult to identify its root without proper surrounding context. In Example 3 Brahms makes it clear that chord is functioning as the dominant of B♭, but one could easily re-interpret the bass note as the root of an A augmented triad. Like the diminished-seventh chord, the augmented triad can be a pathway to distant, chromatic modulations. Example 4 shows the three possible enharmonic interpretations and resolutions of the C augmented triad.

text: 含減五度的屬和弦
en: The Dominant with Diminished Fifth

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 把大三和弦的五音降低，會形成一種不同於先前所學的特殊和弦性質。根音上方因此出現減五度，而這個音傾向向下級進，解決到目標和弦的根音。雖然可以只使用這個三音和弦，更常見的做法，卻是在屬七和弦中降低五音。例5出自理查・史特勞斯的歌劇《莎樂美》（Salome），終止處的屬和弦包含減五度，帶著鮮明的不協和感導向主和弦。這裡對降低五音的解決較自由，並沒有把它解決到主和弦的根音。
en: Flattening the fifth of a major triad results in a strange chord quality that we have not encountered thus far. This alteration makes a diminished fifth above the root, and this tone tends to resolve downward by step to the root of its target chord. Although it is possible to use this triad, it is far more common to use the diminished fifth in a dominant-seventh chord. In Example 5, an excerpt from the opera Salome by Richard Strauss, the cadential dominant includes a diminished fifth, which provides a delightful dissonance leading to the tonic. In this example, Strauss is more liberal with the resolution of the flattened fifth, and doesn’t bother resolving the pitch to the root of the tonic chord.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 《莎樂美》中含減五度的屬和弦靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 例5。理查・史特勞斯，《莎樂美》，排練記號117。
en: Example 5. Richard Strauss, Salome, rehearsal 117

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 如同增三和弦與減七和弦，含減五度的屬七和弦也具有對稱性，並且與法式增六和弦等音。把 V°7 改用第二轉位，讓降低的五音位於低音、向下級進解決時，這種關係更清楚。例如，C 大調中的 V°4/3，與 F 大調的法式增六和弦相同；V°4/3/V 則與原調 C 大調的法式增六和弦等音。嚴格來說，原位的降五音屬七和弦也能等音解讀為法式增六和弦，只是必須重新拼寫，才能看清楚。例6列出這些關係。
en: Like the augmented triads and diminished-seventh chords, the dominant seventh with a diminished fifth is symmetrical. Moreover, the chord is equivalent to a French augmented-sixth chord. This equivalence becomes even clearer when you use the Vo7 chord in second inversion, leaving the lowered fifth in the bass voice to resolve downward by step. For example, in C major, the Vo4/3 chord is identical to the French augmented-sixth chord in F major. Similarly, the Vo4/3/V is equivalent to the French augmented-sixth chord in the home key of C major. Technically, the root-position dominant seventh chord with a diminished fifth is also equivalent to a French augmented-sixth chord, though this requires some enharmonic respelling to become clear. Example 6 shows all of these equivalences.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 最後，以柴可夫斯基《第五號交響曲》第二樂章的例7，結束變化屬和弦的討論。片段先在半減七與全減七和弦之間半音游移，接著出乎意料地出現自然音 ii7。這個和弦透過級進，經過另一個半減七和弦，抵達終止處的屬和弦 V°4/3。一般而言，終止屬和弦通常以原位才能有效發揮作用；此處卻以不同方式呈現，正好體現十九世紀的半音化與模糊感。低音中的降五音向下級進，像增六和弦一樣，解決到 D 大調的主和弦。
en: To finish off our discussion of altered dominants, consider Example 7, from the second movement of Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5. In this excerpt, emerging from a chromatic quagmire of half-diminished and fully-diminished seventh chords is a relatively surprising diatonic ii7 chord. This chord resolves via stepwise motion, through another half-diminished seventh chord, to the cadential dominant of the passage: a Vo4/3 chord. Typically, cadential dominants are only effective in root position, however this chord is emblematic of nineteenth-century chromaticism and ambiguity. The lowered fifth resolves downward by step, much like an augmented-sixth chord, to the D major tonic.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 延伸和弦
en: Extended Chords

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 到目前為止，我們主要使用三和弦與七和弦。不過，三度疊置可以超過根音上方的七度；許多浪漫時期及之後的作曲家確實這麼做。只是繼續疊到一定程度，就會再次回到根音，如例8a。爵士理論把七音以上的和弦音稱為延伸音（extensions），本章也採用這個稱呼。延伸音的意義取決於聲部配置。例8b與8c是同樣四個音高的兩種配置：例8b可以清楚地在 C 大調中解讀為 V13/7；例8c卻不那麼明確，既可能是8b和弦的某種轉位，也可能是延伸的 iii 和弦。無論採哪種解讀，聲部配置都使和聲脈絡變得模糊。因此，延伸和弦通常採原位，因為延伸音的身分實際上由和弦根音決定。
en: To this point, we have only used harmonies that form triads or seventh chords. It is possible, and indeed, many Romantic-era composers and beyond did this, to continue to superimpose thirds beyond the seventh above the root of a chord. You can do this only so far, though, before you reach the root of the chord again, as you can see in Example 8a. In jazz theory, chord members beyond the seventh are referred to as extensions, and we will adopt this practice here. Importantly, extensions rely on their voicing to determine their meaning. In Example 8b and 8c, two different voicings of the same four pitches are given. In Example 8b, the chord can clearly be contextualized as V13/7 in the key of C major. Example 8c is much less clear; it could be some kind of inversion of the chord in 8b, or we could consider it to be an extended iii chord. In either case, the context is made unclear by the chord’s voicing. Because of this, we tend to only use extended chords in root position (as the extensions are truly defined by the chord root).

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 延伸音的堆疊與不同聲部配置靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 例8。延伸音的種類。
en: Example 8. Types of Extensions

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 五、六或七聲部的織度，雖然能容納所有和弦音與延伸音，卻未必需要這麼密集的和弦。寫作四聲部時，就必須決定省略哪些音。把延伸和弦理解為聲部線條的產物——由延伸音取代原本的和弦音——會很有幫助。本章寫作這些和弦時，始終保留根音與七音，因為它們對辨認和弦性質十分重要。
en: While you could include all chord members and extensions in textures with 5, 6, or 7 voices, it is often undesirable to use such dense chords. When composing these chords in a four-voice texture, you will need to decide which notes to leave out. It’s useful to consider these chords as being linearly derived, with the extension displacing a regular chord member. Importantly, when we write these chords, we will always include the root and the chordal seventh, as these are essential for identifying the chord’s quality.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 例9展示在屬七和弦上，各種延伸音的由來。
en: Example 9 shows all of the derivations of these extensions as applied to a dominant-seventh chord.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 例9a中，九音取代了低音上方八度處、原本重複的根音。九音可以與低音中的根音同時出現，但要確認兩者相距九度，不能把九音壓到根音旁邊，成為二度。這裡省略了五音；若是五聲部織度，就可以保留。九音應向下級進解決。
en: In example Example 9a, the 9th displaces the root, doubled an octave above the bass. The 9th may appear together with the root (found in the bass), but make sure that it sounds in the octave above the root; this is a 9th, and not a 2nd. Here, the 5th is omitted, but could well be present in a five-voice texture. The ninth should resolve down by step.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 例9b中，十一音取代十音，也就是三音。由於三音在屬和弦中是導音，通常不重複，因此十一音與三音不應同時出現。看似矛盾的是，十一音會「透過共同音解決」：原本導音通常朝主音解決，取代它的十一音也導向主音，只是音高保持不變。這個和弦有時同時包含九音與十一音，聽來類似低音為第五級音的 IV 和弦。
en: Example 9b shows the 11th displacing the 10th (3rd). Since the 3rd (the leading tone) is not normally doubled, the 11th and the 3rd should not sound together. Paradoxically, the 11th “resolves by common-tone. Since the leading tone would typically resolve to the tonic, so should the 11th. This chord sometimes includes both the ninth and the eleventh, and resembles a IV chord with scale-degree 5 in the bass.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 例9c中，十三音取代十二音，也就是五音。屬七和弦很少重複五音，因此十三音與五音通常不會同時出現。原本的五音，也就是第二級音，常向下級進至主音；因此，取代它的十三音有時會向下跳進三度，「解決」到第一級音。十三音也可以保持為共同音，成為主和弦的三音。
en: Example 9c shows the 13th displacing the 12th (5th). It is uncommon to double the 5th in a dominant-seventh chord, so the 13th and the 5th don’t normally sound together. Since the 5th (scale-degree 2) would often resolve down by step to the tonic, the 13th sometimes “resolves” by leaping down by third to scale-degree 1. It is also possible for the 13th to be held as a common tone, becoming the 3rd of the tonic chord.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 最後，例9d展示如何結合延伸音與變化音，產生很有特色的屬和聲。
en: Lastly, Example 9d shows that you can combine extensions and alterations to make some truly interesting dominant sonorities.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 「假」延伸音與「真」延伸音
en: “Fake” Extensions vs. “Real” Extensions

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 請注意，前述各例的前半部分，延伸音都在和弦改變之前，就先解決到一般的和弦音；因此，更適合將它解釋為重拍上的不協和音，而非真正的和弦延伸音。只有延伸音持續到和弦結束，並隨著和弦改變一起解決，本章才把它視為「真正的」延伸音。
en: It is important to note that in the first part of each of the above examples, the extension resolves to a regular chord member before the chord changes. This makes it much more explainable as an instance of accented dissonance, rather than an extension. Only when the extension lasts for the duration of the chord, resolving with the chord change, do we consider it a “real” extension.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 例10中，舒曼在歌曲開頭使用屬九和弦。九音被當作和弦成員，而非裝飾音：它在和弦持續時以跳進進入，直到和弦改變才解決。請與例11比較：舒伯特在第五小節以 F♭ 形成屬和弦上方的九音，但這個九音在和弦改變之前，就先向下級進解決。因此，這是「假的」九音，較適合解釋為重拍不協和音，而非真正的和弦延伸音。
en: In Example 10, we can see that Schumann uses a dominant ninth chord in the opening of this song. The 9th is treated like a chord member, rather than as an embellishment; notice that it is approached by leap, within the chord, and does not resolve until the chord changes. Compare this with Example 11, in which Schubert uses an F♭ to create a 9th above the dominant in measure 5. This 9th resolves down by step before the chord changes. This is an example of a “fake” 9th that is better explained as an accented dissonance, rather than a “real” chord extension.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 同樣地，請聽下方例12的舒伯特《高貴圓舞曲》（Valse noble）。十三音雖然在旋律中很突出，卻總是在和弦改變之前先向下級進解決，因此更適合解釋為倚音，而非真正的和弦成員。再與例13的《感傷圓舞曲》（Valse sentimentale）比較：片段除了多次使用真正的九音，第七小節終止處的屬和弦還包含低音上方的十三音；這個音以跳進進入，也以跳進離開，是真正的和弦延伸音。
en: Similarly, listen to Schubert’s Valse noble in Example 12, below. Notice that the 13th, while prominent in the melody, always resolves down by step before the chord changes. This 13th is best explained as appoggiatura rather than a “real” member of the chord. Compare this with Schubert’s Valse sentimentale in Example 13. Along with several “real” 9ths used throughout the passage, The cadential dominant in m. 7 includes a 13th above the bass that is approached and left by leap–a true chord extension.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 與九音、十三音相比，十一音在西歐藝術音樂中少見得多。可能的原因，是十一音取代了三音，而三音正是決定和弦性質的重要成員；在屬和弦中，它也標示屬功能。請看佛瑞的例14：片段中的屬和弦都缺少三音，多半改以四音或十一音取代。整體屬到主的功能感相當薄弱，而貫穿片段的主音持續音，又使這份功能感更弱。
en: Unlike 9ths and 13ths, 11ths are considerably more rare in the Western European Art Music repertoire. This is likely because the 11th displaces the 3rd of a chord, which is the chord member that indicates a chord’s quality (and in the case of a dominant chord, its function as well). Consider Example 14, below, by Fauré. Throughout the passage, the dominant chords lack 3rds, and in most cases, use a 4th (or 11th) in its place. The overall sense of function from dominant to tonic is particularly weak, a sense which is further weakened by the tonic pedal heard throughout the passage.

text: 延伸音有時也可用在非屬功能和弦上，如例15。這裡的 ii 和弦除了七音，還包含九音與十一音。十一音以真正的高位十一音呈現，位於七音與九音之上；不同於前面佛瑞的例子，那裡把十一音寫成四音，聽來更像尚未解決的掛留。這類配置在流行音樂中常見得多，例如 The Emotions 的例16 。這裡的屬和聲是一個真正的十一和弦；許多流行樂手會稱它為「IV over V」，也就是在 G 低音上奏出 F 大三和弦。
en: Sometimes, chord extensions can be applied to non-dominant chords, as is the case in Example 15. Here, the ii chord has a 7th, along with a 9th and an 11th. The 11th is presented as a “true” 11th, voiced above the 7th and 9th, unlike in the Fauré example above, where the 11th is written as a 4th (and sounds more like an unresolved suspension). Voicings like this are far more common in popular music, such as in Example 16 by The Emotions. Here, the dominant is presented as a “real” 11th chord, or, as many practicing pop musicians would put it, a “IV over V” chord in which F major is sounded above a G bass.

title: 變化與延伸和弦
text: 最後這兩個例子再次說明，延伸音的身分取決於聲部配置與線條脈絡；它們甚至讓我們重新思考三度疊置和聲中的功能觀念。究竟是低音決定功能，還是和弦包含哪些音？最後來看法朗克《A 大調小提琴奏鳴曲》優美的開頭，見例17。樂章一開始調性模糊，在兩個功能感似乎受到抑制的和弦之間交替。起始的 V9「逆向」接到一個看似包含十一音的 ii13，使 V9 失去鮮明的屬功能；也可以把後者解釋為第一小節同一個 V9 的某種「轉位」。小提琴進入後，以 B 小三和弦的琶音，提供更多將第二小節和弦聽成 ii 的依據。最後，主和弦的抵達使調性落定於 A 大調。不過，F♯ 的存在仍稍微削弱了主和聲的穩定；它雖向下級進解決，卻又懸留在小提琴旋律中。
en: Examples like the last two reinforce the fact that extensions are defined by voicing and linear context, and indeed, begin to call into question the entire notion of function in tertian harmony. Is it the bass that determines function, or is it the chord’s content? For our last example, we will consider the beautiful opening to César Franck’s Violin Sonata in A major, found in Example 17. This movement begins in tonal obscurity, alternating between two chords whose function seems completely suppressed. The opening V9 chord loses its sense of dominant function when it progresses “backwards” to what appears to be a ii13 chord that also includes an 11th. Alternatively, one could interpret this chord as an “inversion” of the same V9 chord heard in the first measure. When the violin enters, more evidence is given for hearing the chord in m.2 as ii, this time supported by an arpeggiated b minor triad in the violin. Eventually, the tonality settles in A major with a tonic arrival. Of course, the tonic is weakened somewhat by the presence of an F sharp, which resolves downward by step, but is left dangling in the violin’s melody.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 重點整理新黎曼理論以音樂理論家 Hugo Riemann 命名，藉由共同音關係解釋三和弦進行，重點在於和弦如何銜接，而不必始終留在同一調內。本章每一種具名的新黎曼變換，都在一個大三和弦與一個小三和弦之間切換。最基本的變換只移動一個音，保留兩個共同音：關係變換（R，Relative）連接大三和弦與根音低小三度的小三和弦，例如 C 與 Am。同主音變換（P，Parallel）連接同根音的大、小三和弦，例如 C 與 Cm。導音交換變換（L，Leading-tone exchange）連接大三和弦與根音高大三度的小三和弦，例如 C 與 Em。另一些重要變換保留一個共同音，移動兩個音：滑移變換（S，Slide）連接大三和弦與根音高半音的小三和弦，例如 C 與 C♯m。鄰接關係變換（N，Nebenverwandt）連接大三和弦與根音低五度的小三和弦，例如 C 與 Fm。六音極點變換（H，Hexpole）連接大三和弦與根音低大三度的小三和弦，例如 C 與 A♭m。它不保留共同音，而讓每個音各移動半音，抵達新和弦。各種變換以單一字母縮寫：R、P、L、S、N、H。理論家也建立了可視化這些關係的網路，例如音網（Tonnetz）、Weitzmann 區域，以及立方體舞（Cube Dance）。另有一頁式變換摘要，可開啟互動樂譜或PDF。以下譜例採用原章提供的一頁式 PDF 摘要。 原章所附 PDF原章所附〈變換與共同音〉，完整第1／1頁。Transformations and Common Tones＝變換與共同音；副標為「大、小三和弦中的變換，附共同音與大小性質改變的細節」。P、L、R：兩個共同音，大小性質改變。Slide與Nebenverwandt：一個共同音，大小性質改變；原譜把後者印為Neberverwandt。Chromatic Mediants＝半音中音關係：一個共同音，大小性質保持。UFM／USM／LFM／LSM分別為上方降型／上方升型／下方降型／下方升型中音關係：上、下指新根音相對原根音的位置，升、降區分三度根音的變化形式；原譜各列PR、LP、PL、RP等操作順序保留。Disjunct or Doubly-Chromatic Mediants＝分離型或雙重半音中音關係：沒有共同音，大小性質改變；Upper／Lower＝上方／下方。Major third cycle (Hexatonic)＝大三度循環（六音系統），PL做三輪；Minor third cycle＝小三度循環，PR做四輪。Major／Minor＝大三和弦／小三和弦起始。譜中圓弧顯示共同音的保持，所有音符與組合代號保留。頁底授權：CC0 1.0通用（公眾領域），Mark Gotham與FourScoreAndMore.org放棄對本文件的所有權利。
en: Key Takeaways Neo-Riemannian theory, named after music theorist Hugo Riemann, provides a means of rationalizing triadic progressions that involve sharing common tones, more so than staying within one key. Every Neo-Riemannian transformation toggles between one major and one minor triad. The most basic Neo-Riemannian transformations shift one note and keep two common tones. Relative relates a major triad and the minor triad a minor third lower, such as C and Ami. Parallel relates a major triad and the minor triad sharing the same root, such as C and Cmi. Leading-tone exchange relates a major triad and the minor triad a major third higher, such as C and Emi. Other important Neo-Riemannian transformations keep one common tone and shift two notes. Slide relates a major triad and the minor triad one semitone higher, such as C and C♯mi. Nebenverwandt relates a major triad and the minor triad a fifth below, such as C and Fmi. Hexpole relates a major triad and the minor triad a major third below, such as C and A♭mi. This transformation is unique because it does not keep any common tones; instead, each note is shifted by a half step to get to the new chord. Neo-Riemannian transformations are abbreviated to one letter each: R, P, L, S, N, and H. Theorists have come up with several networks of transformations that help visualize these relationships, such as the Tonnetz, the Weitzmann regions, and the Cube Dance. A one-page summary of transformations is available as an interactive score and as a PDF.

text: 上方片段的和弦縮譜見例2。進行連接兩個 A♭ 大三和弦；但中間的和弦，既難以有效地歸入 A♭ 大調，也不遵循功能和聲的慣例。
en: A reduction of the chord progression in the excerpt above can be found in Example 2. The passage connects two A♭ major triads; however, the chords in between those triads do not belong to A♭ major in any useful way, nor do they follow any of the conventions of functional harmony.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 你或許會直接將這段音樂歸為「非功能和聲」，但實際聽來，它仍有自己的邏輯。Richard Cohn 問道：「如果這類音樂——以三和弦為材料，功能卻不明確——不能完全依自然音調性的原則取得連貫性，那麼，還有哪些原則能使它連貫？」（1998，第169頁）
en: One might dismiss the passage altogether as “non-functional harmony,” but when you listen to it, it follows a certain kind of logic. As Richard Cohn writes, “if this music [music that is triadic but functionally indeterminate] is not fully coherent according to the principles of diatonic tonality, by what other principles might it cohere?” (1998, 169).

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 新黎曼變換
en: Neo-Riemannian Transformations

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 新黎曼理論描述一種不必依賴調性脈絡，也能連接大、小三和弦的方法。例3展示三種基本操作。每種操作都保留兩個共同音，並改變三和弦的大小性質。
en: Neo-Riemannian theory describes a way of connecting major and minor triads without a tonal context. Example 3 shows the three basic Neo-Riemannian operations. Notice that each operation preserves two common tones in a triad and changes its mode.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 關係變換（R，Relative）保留三和弦中的大三度，讓剩餘的一音移動全音。同主音變換（P，Parallel）保留三和弦中的完全五度，讓剩餘的一音移動半音。導音交換變換（L，Leading-Tone Exchange）保留三和弦中的小三度，讓剩餘的一音移動半音。
en: The Relative transformation (R) preserves the major third in the triad and moves the remaining note by whole tone. The Parallel transformation (P) preserves the perfect fifth in the triad and moves the remaining note by semitone. The Leading-Tone Exchange transformation (L) preserves the minor third in the triad and moves the remaining note by semitone.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例3。三種基本新黎曼操作：R 關係變換、P 同主音變換、L 導音交換。
en: Example 3. The three basic Neo-Riemannian operations: Relative, Parallel, and Leading-Tone Exchange.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 每種變換都是在兩個和弦之間切換。可以想像鍵盤的 Caps Lock：原本輸入小寫字母，按一下就改輸入大寫；再按一下，就回到小寫，而不會跑到第三種字母形態。
en: It’s important to note that each transformation is a toggle between two chords. As an analogy, think of the caps lock key on your keyboard, which toggles between two cases of letters. If you are typing with lowercase letters and then press caps lock, this tells your keyboard to begin typing in uppercase letters. But if you press caps lock again, it toggles back to lowercase—it doesn’t go to some third case.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 同樣地，對 C 大三和弦作 L 變換，得到 E 小三和弦；對 E 小三和弦再作 L，就回到 C 大三和弦。因此，連續重複同一種變換，只會在兩個和弦之間交替，如例4。
en: Similarly, if you do the L transformation on a C major triad, you get an E minor triad. If you do the L transformation on an E minor triad, you return to a C major triad. Put another way, successive repetitions of the same transformation alternate between two chords, as shown in Example 4.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例4。在 C 大三和弦與 E 小三和弦之間，連續施作 L 變換。
en: Example 4. Successive L transformations on C major and E minor triads.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 多數十九世紀作曲家不會一直重複同一種變換，但二十世紀的作品中可以找到這種手法。例如 Laurie Anderson 的〈O Superman〉，全曲持續使用 L 變換。
en: While most 19th-century composers didn’t write progressions using the same transformation over and over again, you will find this technique used in twentieth-century works like “O Superman” by Laurie Anderson, which uses successive L transformations throughout.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 音網（Tonnetz）
en: The Tonnetz

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例5是一張音網。音網將音高排列成特定的圖形：由左至右是完全五度，由左上至右下是大三度，由左下至右上是小三度。每個基本三角形的三個頂點，構成一個大三和弦或小三和弦。圖上雖然只畫出有限的平面區域，理論上若不把等音視為相同，音網可以無限延伸；若將等音視為相同，就會形成環面形狀，動畫見此。
en: Example 5 shows a Tonnetz. A Tonnetz is a visual representation of pitches arranged such that perfect fifths are read from left to right, major thirds are read diagonally from the top left to the bottom right, and minor thirds are read diagonally from the bottom left to the top right. Any three pitches in a triangle form a major or minor triad. Although it’s pictured here as a flat, confined plane, theoretically, without enharmonic equivalence, the Tonnetz continues on infinitely; with enharmonic equivalence, the Tonnetz forms a torus shape.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 新黎曼變換可以想像成：沿三角形的其中一條邊，把三角形翻到另一側。
en: Neo-Riemannian transformations can be visualized by flipping a triangle along one of its three edges.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例5。音網（Tonnetz）。
en: Example 5. The Tonnetz.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: P 同主音變換，沿完全五度的橫向邊翻轉。R 關係變換，沿大三度的左上至右下斜邊翻轉。L 導音交換變換，沿小三度的右上至左下斜邊翻轉。
en: The (P)arallel transformation flips the triangle along the edge belonging to the line of perfect fifths (left to right). The (R)elative transformation flips the triangle along the edge belonging to the line of major thirds (top left to bottom right). The (L)eading-tone transformation flips the triangle along the edge belonging to the line of minor thirds (top right to bottom left).

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例6。在音網上，對 C 大三和弦與 G 小三和弦施作 P、L、R。
en: Example 6. Tonnetz showing the three Neo-Riemannian operations (P, L, and R) performed on a C major triad and a G minor triad.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例6展示各種變換在音網上的樣貌。以紅邊標出的 C 大三和弦為例，P 沿 C–G 邊翻轉，得到 C 小三和弦；L 沿 G–E 邊翻轉，得到 E 小三和弦；R 則沿 C–E 邊翻轉，得到 A 小三和弦。若從小三和弦開始，例如綠邊的 G 小三和弦，翻轉方向就都相反。回到布拉姆斯小提琴與大提琴協奏曲，現在便有辦法理解這串和弦如何連貫。原文在此稱為例7的分析圖，展示兩個 A♭ 大三和弦之間，是由一連串 P 與 L 變換連接。
en: Example 6 shows each of the transformations on the Tonnetz. If you perform a P transformation on the C major triad, highlighted with red edges, it will flip along the C–G side to become C minor. Similarly, L will flip the triad along the G–E edge to become E minor, and R will flip the triad along the C–E edge to become A minor. Note that if you start on a minor triad, such as the G minor triad highlighted with green edges, all of the flips will be in the opposite directions. Returning to the example from Brahms’s concerto for violin and cello, we now have a means of understanding how this chord progression works. Example 7 shows that the two A♭ major triads are connected by a series of P and L transformations between chords.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例8。布拉姆斯雙協奏曲第270–276小節在音網上的路徑。
en: Example 8. Brahms’s concerto for violin and cello, mm. 270–76 on the Tonnetz.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 布拉姆斯這段進行，從音網右下方沿一列三角形向上移動，見例8。起點圖上寫作 G♯ 大三和弦，需要將它等音解讀為 A♭ 大三和弦。
en: The excerpt from the Brahms concerto navigates a column of triangles moving upward from the bottom right of the Tonnetz, shown in Example 8. Note that you need to enharmonically re-interpret the G♯ major triad as an A♭ major triad at the starting point.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 音網有助於呈現大、小三和弦之間的接近程度：同一調內的三和弦大多聚在相近位置，調性差異大的和弦則相隔較遠。反過來，音網也能幫助我們想出有趣的和弦進行，超越只依共通實踐和聲語法時容易想到的選擇。
en: The Tonnetz is useful for visualizing the proximity of major and minor triads; notice that all of the triads in a given key are close together, while tonally disparate keys are also far apart on the Tonnetz. Conversely, the Tonnetz is helpful for imagining interesting chord progressions that you might not think of if you’re limiting yourself to typical common-practice syntax.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 變換鏈與循環
en: Chains or Cycles of Transformations

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 雖然新黎曼理論幾乎可以用來建立或分析任何大、小三和弦進行，作曲家卻經常偏好能形成封閉循環的操作鏈。循環從同一和弦出發，最後也回到它，途中依循固定的變換模式，與模進有些相似。前面的布拉姆斯進行就是 PL 循環：它交替採用 P 與 L，並在同一和弦上開始與結束。
en: While you can use Neo-Riemannian theory to create or analyze just about any chord progression, composers have often focused on chains of operations that create closed cycles of triads. Cycles begin and end on the same chord, and they follow a specific pattern of transformations (much like a sequence). The progression from the Brahms example above is a PL cycle because it alternates P and L transformations and begins and ends on the same chord.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 交替使用兩種基本變換，可以形成三種循環：PL、RP、RL。如例9所示，PL 與 RP 不必經過太多次變換就能回到起點：PL 需要六次，RP 需要八次。
en: There are three possible cycles that use two transformations: the PL cycle, the RP cycle, and the RL cycle. As you can see in Example 9, the PL and RP cycles “close the loop” after relatively few transformations: six for the PL cycle, and eight for the RP cycle.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例9。PL 與 RP 循環。
en: Example 9. PL and RP cycles.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 相較之下，RL 循環（例10）很長，會經過全部二十四個大、小三和弦。由於回到起點需要很久，這個循環常被略過，或只呈現其中一段。
en: Conversely, the RL cycle (Example 10) is is quite long: it passes through all 24 major and minor triads. Since this cycle takes so long to “close the loop,” it is often ignored or presented in truncated form.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例10。RL 循環。
en: Example 10. The RL cycle.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 還有一種值得注意、使用三種基本變換的循環：PLR。如例11所示，把 P–L–R 的組合做兩輪，就會回到起始和弦。
en: There is one three-transformation cycle that is noteworthy: the PLR cycle. As Example 11 shows, it takes two cycles of the PLR transformations to return to the starting chord.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例11。PLR 循環。
en: Example 11. The PLR cycle.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例12。PL、RP、PLR 循環，以及各自的母音階或共同音。
en: Example 12. PL, RP, and PLR cycles related to their parent scales/common tones.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 上述循環中，PL 與 RP 都能將其所有三和弦用到的音，匯集成一個母音階。PL 產生六音音階，由半音與小三度交替構成；RP 產生八音音階，由半音與大二度交替構成。兩者都具有對稱性，可以視為整個循環的整體聲響。每個 PLR 循環則圍繞一個共同音：循環中的每個三和弦都包含這個音。
en: Of the cycles mentioned above, both the PL and RP cycles generate a parent scale made up of all of the notes used by its constituent triads. The PL cycle generates the hexatonic scale, a symmetrical scale made up of alternating semitones and minor thirds. The RP cycle generates an octatonic scale, another symmetrical scale made up of alternating semitones and major seconds. You might consider these scales to represent the “overall sound” of the cycle. Each PLR cycle is centered around a single pitch, which is contained in each of the triads within the cycle.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例12將這些循環畫成圖。
en: Each of these cycles is illustrated in Example 12.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 其他變換
en: Other Transformations

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 還有三種變換，在作品中出現得夠頻繁，值得在此介紹。
en: There are three other types of Neo-Riemannian transformations that occur frequently enough in the repertoire that they are worth mentioning here.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 滑移變換（S，Slide）的名稱來自「滑動」。它的做法恰好與 P 相反：將三和弦中構成完全五度的兩音，各移動半音，改變和弦的大小性質。[1]鄰接關係變換（N，Nebenverwandt）將三和弦中構成小三度的兩音，各移動半音，同樣改變和弦的大小性質。Nebenverwandt 在德文中意為「鄰接相關」，形容這組三度如鄰音般的移動。[2]六音極點變換（H，Hexpole）讓每個聲部各移動半音，連接根音相距三度、大小性質相反的三和弦；兩和弦就是前述六音 PL 循環中的兩個極點，見例12。[3]
en: The Slide transformation (S) (short for “slide”) is effectively the opposite of the P transformation: it moves the two pitches that form the perfect fifth in a triad by semitone and changes the mode of the triad.[1] The Nebenverwandt transformation (N) moves both members of the minor third in a triad by semitone and again changes the mode. Nebenverwandt means “neighbor-related” in German, and it describes the neighbor-tone-like motion of this third. [2] The Hexpole (H) transformation connects a triad to its modal opposite a third away by moving each voice by a single semitone, generating the hexatonic poles in the hexatonic PL cycle discussed above and shown in Example 12.[3]

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 這三種變換見例13。
en: These three transformations are shown in Example 13.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例13。S、N、H 變換。
en: Example 13. S, N, and H transformations.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 這些變換都可以視為基本 P、L、R 的組合。例如，H 可以寫成 PLP。事實上，任意兩個大三和弦或小三和弦之間，都能以這些變換的組合連接；五步以內，就能從任何一個三和弦走到另一個。其中特別有意思的是採用節約式聲部連接的進行，也就是每個聲部的移動都不超過級進。還有許多組合值得自己試試！
en: Of course, all of the above transformations can be considered combinations of the staple P, L, and R transformations. For example, you could describe H as “PLP.” Indeed, you can describe the connection between any two major and/or minor triads as combinations of transformations: you can get from one triad to any other in five steps or less. The most interesting are those that use parsimonious voice leading: voice leading in which no single voice moves more than a step. There are numerous other combinations you could come up with—try some on your own!

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 更多新黎曼變換網路
en: More Networks of Neo-Riemannian Transformations

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 增三和弦
en: Augmented triads

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 基本的新黎曼變換只處理大、小三和弦，不包含增三和弦；但增三和弦能在大、小三和弦之間搭起橋梁，尤其是透過 R 相連的和弦。仔細看前面的例子會發現，R 與 P、L 不完全一樣：R 唯一移動的音要走兩個半音，其他兩者只走一個半音。若以移動半音數衡量，R 的工作量就是 P、L 的兩倍。把兩個 R 相關和弦之間的全音空隙補上，便會出現增三和弦，如例14。
en: Although it is not part of the staple Neo-Riemannian transformations, which only deal with major and minor triads, the augmented triad provides a useful link between major and minor triads, specifically those that are connected by R transformations. Upon scrutinizing the above examples, you may have noticed that the R transformation isn’t quite the same as the P and L transformations, because it moves its non-preserved note by two semitones, while the others move their non-preserved note by one semitone. In a sense, the R transformation is twice as much “work” as the P and L transformations. If we fill in the gap between two R-related triads, an augmented triad emerges, as shown in Example 14.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例14。在 R 變換中插入增三和弦。
en: Example 14. The R transformation with an intervening augmented triad.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 增三和弦本身的模糊性，讓這件事更有趣。它與減七和弦一樣具有對稱性，透過等音重新拼寫，每個和弦音都能成為根音。例如，例14的 C 增三和弦，也能拼成 E 增三和弦 E–G♯–B♯，或 A♭ 增三和弦 A♭–C–E。因此，依根音的不同解讀，只移動一個聲部半音，就能接到三個不同的小三和弦。例15展示 C+ 的三種可能解決。
en: Things get interesting when you consider the augmented triad’s ambiguity. Because it is a symmetrical chord (like the diminished seventh chord), you can enharmonically respell the augmented triad such that any of its chord members can act as the root. For example, the C augmented triad in Example 14 could also be spelled as an E augmented triad (E–G♯–B♯), or an A♭ augmented triad (A♭–C–E). As a result, you can resolve the augmented triad to three different minor triads by moving a single voice by semitone, depending on how its root is interpreted. Example 15 shows the three possible resolutions of the C+ triad.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例15。同一增三和弦的三種拼寫，分別解決到三個小三和弦。
en: Example 15. Three different spellings of the augmented triad resolving to three different minor triads.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 同樣地，只移動一個聲部半音，也能將同一個增三和弦與三個不同的大三和弦相連，如例16。
en: Likewise, the same augmented triad can connect to three different major triads by moving a single voice by semitone, as shown in Example 16.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例16。三個大三和弦，連接到同一個增三和弦。
en: Example 16. Three different major triads connect to the same augmented triad.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例17。四個 Weitzmann 區域。
en: Example 17. The four Weitzmann regions.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例17畫出四個增三和弦，以及各自只需移動一個聲部半音，就能抵達的大、小三和弦。由於對稱性，將等音視為相同後，增三和弦確實只有四種不同音集合。每個增三和弦與周圍六個三和弦，合稱一個 Weitzmann 區域；這個名稱紀念 Carl Friedrich Weitzmann，他在十九世紀多部著作中詳細討論增三和弦及其靈活運用。區域中的每條線，都代表一個音移動一個半音。從左側大三和弦，經中央增三和弦走到右側小三和弦時，就能找到先前談過的幾種變換：R、S、N 的總移動量各為兩個半音，在每個 Weitzmann 區域中都能追蹤這些路徑。
en: Example 17 illustrates the four augmented triads (yes, there are only four, due to the symmetry of the chord) and the major and minor triads they can resolve to by moving only one voice by semitone. Each augmented triad and its six associated triads are referred to as Weitzmann regions, named after the theorist Carl Friedrich Weitzmann, who wrote at length about the augmented triad and its versatility in several 19th-century treatises. Each line in a Weitzmann region represents moving one note in a triad by a single semitone. When you trace a path from a triad on the left to a triad on the right, you’ll find several of the transformations discussed previously. R, S, and N each require a total move of two semitones, and each of these can be traced through any given Weitzmann region.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 立方體舞（Cube Dance）
en: The Cube Dance

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 回想一下，LP、RP、PLR 都是封閉循環。這些反覆模式雖然有趣，久了也可能變得單調。如果能在循環之間「轉調」呢？增三和弦就在這裡派上用場。
en: Recall that the LP, RP, and PLR cycles are “closed loops.” These recurring patterns are interesting, but could grow stale after a while. What if there were a way to “modulate” between cycles? Enter the augmented triad.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例18。加入增三和弦的 PL 循環。
en: Example 18. PL cycles with added augmented triads.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 再看 C+ 的 Weitzmann 區域，其中的大三和弦是 C、E、A♭；它們正好也是例12中，從 C 開始的 PL 循環所包含的大三和弦。同一 PL 循環中的小三和弦，則屬於另一個區域：E♭+。把這兩個增三和弦加入 PL 循環，和弦數就從六個增加到八個。因此，可以把原本的六邊形改畫成立方體，如例18。
en: Take another look at the major triads connected to the C+ Weitzmann region: C, E, and A♭. Notice that these three major triads are the same as those found in the PL cycle that started on C, found in Example 12. The minor triads in that PL cycle can be found in a different Weitzmann region: the E♭+ region. If we add augmented triads into our PL cycles, we grow the group of possible chords within a cycle from six to eight. Instead of representing these cycles on a hexagon, let’s illustrate them using a cube, as shown in Example 18.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例18右上方，是包含 C 大三和弦的 PL 循環。立方體的每條邊，都代表一個音移動半音；大、小三和弦之間的邊，便是 P 或 L。與它們相接的兩個增三和弦，位在立方體相對的頂點；增三和弦與鄰接三和弦之間，也各只差一音移動半音。
en: The PL cycle that starts on C can be found in the top right of Example 18. Each side of the cube represents the motion of one note in the triad moving by semitone. When the triads move from major to minor, these are either P or L transformations. The augmented triads that connect to the major and minor triads are on opposite corners of the cube, and, of course, these connect to each adjoining triad by a one-semitone move as well.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 例19。立方體舞，原構想由 Douthett 與 Steinbach 提出。
en: Example 19. The Cube Dance (originally conceived by Douthett and Steinbach).

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 那麼，要如何從一個 PL 循環「轉調」到另一個？注意，同一個增三和弦會出現在兩個不同立方體中。在某個 PL 循環裡寫作和弦進行時，只要走到其中一個增三和弦，就能跳到相鄰的 PL 循環，繼續前進。每個立方體分別透過兩個增三和弦，與另兩個立方體相連。把這些連接合在一起，就能畫出以單一半音移動連通所有大、小三和弦的地圖。Jack Douthett 與 Peter Steinbach 在1998年首次說明這個圖，稱它為「立方體舞」，見例19。
en: Now, how might we “modulate” from one PL cycle to another? Notice that the same augmented triad can be found in two different cubes. If we wrote a chord progression within one PL cycle, we could “jump” to an adjacent PL cycle by navigating to one of the two augmented triads and continue in the new cycle. In a sense, each cube is connected to two other cubes via an augmented triad. We can use these connections to create a single illustration that provides us a map of all major and minor triads connected by a single semitone. This was first explained by Jack Douthett and Peter Steinbach (1998), who referred to this diagram as a “cube dance.” The cube dance has been reproduced in Example 19.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 利用立方體舞，可以從包含 C 的 PL 循環開始，經 C+ 或 E♭+ 進入另一個 PL 循環。若想從 C 走到 D，必須跨越兩次循環：可以經 C+、D♭+，也可以經 E♭+、D+。雖然立方體舞沒有清楚畫出其他種類的循環，也能利用增三和弦，在 RP、PLR，或任何包含 R 的變換組合之間切換。
en: Using the cube dance model, you could create a chord progression starting in the PL cycle that includes C, and modulate to a new PL cycle via either the C+ or E♭+ triads. If you wanted to get from C to, say, D, you would have to modulate twice: either through C+ and D♭+, or E♭+ and D+. Though the other cycles are not depicted clearly on the cube dance model, you can also use augmented triads to modulate between RP cycles, or PLR cycles, or indeed any group of Neo-Riemannian transformations that include R transformations.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 立方體舞或許比音網更能呈現大、小三和弦的接近程度。如果用聲部從一個三和弦移到另一個所需的半音總數衡量距離，直覺上相近的和弦，在圖上也靠近；感覺較遠的和弦，在圖上也較遠。更重要的是，立方體舞與音網都不必依賴一個調性中心。對於十九、二十，甚至二十一世紀那些使用三和弦、卻避開功能調性的音樂，這些圖能幫助我們理解和弦進行；無論分析作品或自己創作，都很有用。
en: Perhaps even better than the Tonnetz, the cube dance illustrates the proximity of major and minor triads. If we equate proximity with the total number of semitones needed to move from one triad to another, the cube dance diagram puts chords together that we would intuitively consider to be “close” to one another, while those that we might consider “distant” are relatively far apart. Moreover, the cube dance (and even the Tonnetz) does this without reference to a tonal center, making it useful for rationalizing chord progressions from music of the 19th and 20th (and even 21st) centuries that is triadic but shies away from functional tonality. This can be incredibly helpful when analyzing this kind of music, or even when writing your own.

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 作業
en: Assignments

title: 新黎曼三和弦進行
text: 新黎曼變換學習單（.pdf、.mscz）：對個別三和弦施作 P、L、R、S 滑移、N、H，實現變換鏈，並找出連接兩個和弦的變換路徑。以新黎曼變換作曲（.pdf、.mscz）：運用立方體舞與其他循環，創作一首簡短的極簡風格鋼琴獨奏曲。
en: Worksheet on Neo-Riemannian Transformations (.pdf, .mscz). Asks students to perform P, L, R, SLIDE, N, and H on individual triads, to realize chains of transformations, and find a transformation chain to connect two chords. text: 這個名稱由 David Lewin 提出。↵這個變換由 Richard Cohn 引入。↵將它稱作 H 變換的用法，歸功於 Robert Cook。↵
en: This term was coined by David Lewin. ↵This transformation was introduced by Richard Cohn. ↵Robert Cook is attributed with referring to this as the H transformation. ↵

title: 中音關係
text: 重點整理中音關係描述兩個根音相距大三度或小三度的和弦。中音關係可以分成三類：自然音型（第1級）：兩個共同音，和弦性質在大、小三和弦之間改變；兩和弦可同屬一個自然音調性。半音型（第2級）：一個共同音，大小性質相同，也就是兩者皆為大三和弦，或皆為小三和弦；兩和弦無法同屬一個自然音調性。雙重半音型，又稱分離型（第3級）：沒有共同音，大小性質在大、小三和弦之間改變。
en: Key Takeaways The mediant relationship describes chords whose roots are separated by third (major or minor). Mediants can be grouped into three categories: Diatonic (Grade 1): two common tones; chord quality changes (major→minor or vice-versa). Both chords fit into a diatonic key. Chromatic (Grade 2): one common tone; chord quality remains the same (both are major or both are minor). Both chords do not fit in a diatonic key. Doubly-chromatic or disjunct (Grade 3): no common tones; chord quality changes (major→minor or vice-versa).

title: 中音關係
text: 前一章〈新黎曼三和弦進行〉的一個重點，是根音相距三度的三和弦如何銜接。例如，L 連接 C 大三和弦與 E 小三和弦。這些三度關係，也可以用中音關係來理解。回想〈大調音階〉，[latex]\hat3[/latex] 與建立在它上面的三和弦 iii／III，有時稱為「中音」；[latex]\hat6[/latex] 與其三和弦 vi／VI，則是「下中音」。不過，mediant 還有更廣的意思：任何兩個根音相距三度的和弦。依這個廣義用法，iii 與 vi，或小調中的 III 與 VI，都分別與主和弦構成中音關係。
en: One main focus in the previous chapter on Neo-Riemannian Triadic Progressions is the connection between triads with roots a third apart. For instance, L connects C with Emi. Another way of looking at these third-related chords is in terms of mediants. Recall from the Major Scales chapter that [latex]\hat3[/latex] and the triad built upon it (iii/III) is sometimes called the "mediant," and [latex]\hat6[/latex] and its triad (vi/VI) is the "submediant." But "mediant" has another, more general meaning: any two chords whose roots are related by third. In this sense, both the iii and the vi chord (or III and VI in minor) are mediants.

title: 中音關係
text: 中音關係並不必然限於自然音。所有可能的中音關係，可以分成以下三類：[1]
en: But these mediant relationships do not have to be diatonic. The combined collection of possible mediants can be divided into three categories:[1]

title: 中音關係
text: 自然音型（第1級）：兩個共同音，和弦性質在大、小三和弦之間改變；兩和弦可同屬一個自然音調性。半音型（第2級）：一個共同音，大小性質相同；兩者皆為大三和弦或皆為小三和弦，但無法同屬一個自然音調性。雙重半音型，又稱分離型（第3級）：沒有共同音，大小性質在大、小三和弦之間改變。
en: Diatonic (Grade 1): two common tones; chord quality changes (major→minor or vice-versa). Both chords fit into a diatonic key. Chromatic (Grade 2): one common tone; chord quality remains the same (both are major or both are minor). Both chords do not fit in a diatonic key. Doubly-chromatic or disjunct (Grade 3): no common tones; chord quality changes (major→minor or vice-versa).

title: 中音關係
text: 例1展示這些類別，後面各節再分別討論。
en: These categories are demonstrated in Example 1 and discussed in the sections below.

title: 中音關係
text: 自然音中音關係（第1級）
en: Diatonic Mediants (Grade 1)

title: 中音關係
text: 自然音中音關係保留兩個共同音，並改變三和弦的大小性質，例如 C 與 Am，或 C 與 Em。以新黎曼理論來說，就是 L 或 R 關係。[2]
en: Diatonic mediants share two common tones and involve a change of triad quality (between major and minor), such as C and Ami or C and Emi. Diatonic mediants can be understood in neo-Riemannian terms as forming L or R relationships.[2]

title: 中音關係
text: 半音中音關係（第2級）
en: Chromatic Mediants (Grade 2)

title: 中音關係
text: 半音中音關係更疏遠一層：兩和弦只保留一個共同音，但大小性質相同。相對於 C 大三和弦，四個半音中音和弦就是 E、E♭、A、A♭ 大三和弦。每一對都能用兩次新黎曼操作連接，也就是 L 或 R 與 P 的不同組合。
en: Chromatic mediants are a step more remote: the pair of chords now has one common tone, and the triad quality is kept the same in both chords. For instance, in relation to the C triad, the chromatic mediants would be the major triads of E, E♭, A, and A♭. These triads would be related with two neo-Riemannian transformations: the various combinations of L/R and P.

title: 中音關係
text: 有些英語文獻進一步把這四種中音關係標為「上方降型」「上方升型」「下方降型」「下方升型」（upper flat、upper sharp、lower flat、lower sharp）。上、下指新和弦根音在原根音上方或下方；升、降用來區分半音中音和弦所建立的音階級。德語理論則使用結合功能與變換的名稱，例如 Tonikavariantparallel：先改變主和弦的大小性質，再從那裡作德語意義的 Parallel 變換，也就是取關係調和弦。
en: Some English-language sources give extra labels of "upper flat," "upper sharp," "lower flat," and "lower sharp" to these four mediant types. Upper/lower refers to whether the root of the mediant is above or below the original chord, and flat/sharp clarifies the scale degree upon which the chromatic mediant chord is built. German-speaking theory accounts for these with function-transformational terms like Tonikavariantparallel: i.e., change the mode of the tonic chord (from major to minor or vice versa) and then take the (German) parallel transformation from there.

title: 中音關係
text: 雙重半音中音關係（第3級）
en: Doubly-Chromatic Mediants (Grade 3)

title: 中音關係
text: 第三類也是最後一類：兩和弦沒有共同音，大小性質也改變。從 C 大三和弦出發，雙重半音中音和弦是 E♭m 與 A♭m。這些和弦之間，聽來尤其疏遠。
en: In the third and last type, the mediant chords do not share any common tones, and the triad quality also changes. From C major, the doubly-chromatic mediants are E♭mi and A♭mi. These chords sound especially remote from one another.

title: 中音關係
text: 如前所述，這裡的功能、術語與標記必須稍加留意，因為不同慣例並存。最容易混淆的是 parallel：英語傳統用它連接同根音的大小調，例如 C 大調與 C 小調；德語傳統卻用它表示英語所稱的 relative，例如 C 大調與 A 小調。處理歷史文獻或跨語言資料時，尤其要分清楚。下表並列德語功能標記，以及〈前一章〉所介紹、在英語新黎曼理論中使用的變換組合；功能名稱以主和弦為起點。德語欄的 n/a，表示沒有慣用的名稱或縮寫。
en: As mentioned above, we need a bit of caution in regards to functions, terms and labels here, as there are some different conventions running in parallel (pun intended!). The main headache is the use of that term "parallel" which in English-speaking traditions connects two modes on the same root (C and Cmi, for instance), while the German tradition uses it for what English-speaking theory calls "relative" (such as C and Ami). Confusing, right? Watch out, especially if you're working with historical and/or multi-lingual sources. The following table is an overview of both functional labels (in German, taking the example of a tonic starting point) and combined neo-Riemannian transformations as discussed in the previous chapter (English). On the German side, "n/a" indicates that there is no commonly used term or abbreviation.

title: 中音關係
text: 以第1、2、3級區分中音關係的方式，在德語音樂理論中較常見；自然音、半音、雙重半音中音關係等名稱，則在英語音樂理論中較常見。兩套說法都有用。↵新黎曼術語雖然源自德語理論，當代德語音樂理論卻通常以 Gegenklang（G）與 Parallel（P）討論這些關係，容易造成混淆。詳見本章後段的「功能與變換」。本章前面的 L、P、R，仍沿用前一章所確立的新黎曼意義。↵
en: The notion of "grades" (1, 2, 3) is more common in German-speaking music theory; the other terms (diatonic/chromatic/doubly-chromatic mediants) are more common in English-speaking music theory. Both are useful. ↵Despite the German roots of these neo-Riemannian terms, contemporary German music theory would typically discuss these relations with the terms Gegenklang (G) and Parallel (P). This gets confusing, so please see the section on "Function and Transformations" at the end of this chapter. For now, the LPR terms are used here in the neo-Riemannian sense established in the previous chapter. ↵

title: VI. 爵士樂
text: 本部分介紹傳統爵士與藍調中的和聲、節奏及即興基礎。爵士樂與其他同樣廣大的音樂類型一樣，所包含的音樂語言遠比這裡呈現的更多；不過，讀者將能熟悉搖擺樂、咆勃等子類型的重要慣用語法。
en: This section introduces students to the basics of harmony, rhythm, and improvisation within traditional jazz and blues. Like any other equally broad genre, jazz encompasses more musical languages than are represented here, of course, but students will gain familiarity with idioms that structure subgenres such as swing and bebop.

text: 第一章〈搖擺節奏〉介紹搖擺樂及其衍生類型中，常見且具有風格特色的節奏。
en: The first chapter, Swing Rhythms, introduces students to common and stylistic rhythms that are often found in swing music and subgenres that grew out of it.

title: VI. 爵士樂
text: 接著學習簡單與複雜的和弦代號，以及如何在爵士語境中，以合乎風格的方式配置這些和弦。
en: Next, students learn about simple and complex chord symbols and how those symbols are idiomatically voiced in a jazz context.

title: VI. 爵士樂
text: 隨後幾章探討爵士曲目常見的和聲模式：ii–V–I；各種裝飾和弦，例如副和弦與共同音減七和弦；以及和弦替代，例如三全音替代、調式混合與副和弦的替代運用。
en: The next few chapters discuss common harmonic formulas encountered in jazz repertories: ii–V–I; embellishing chords such as applied chords and common tone diminished seventh chords; and substitutions such as the tritone substitution, mode mixture, and substituting applied chords.

title: VI. 爵士樂
text: 〈和弦—音階理論〉討論即興，也介紹爵士樂手如何運用調式即興。
en: Improvisation is discussed in the Chord-Scale Theory chapter, which also introduces students to how jazz musicians use modes to improvise.

title: VI. 爵士樂
text: 最後幾章分別探討傳統藍調的曲式與和聲，以及旋律。這也銜接到下一部分的流行音樂，因為流行音樂大量借鑑了藍調。
en: The final chapters of this section cover the formal/harmonic and melodic aspects of traditional blues music. This also serves as a transition into the following section on popular music, a genre that borrows heavily from the blues.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 重點整理搖擺八分音符通常寫成一般的均分八分音符，演奏時卻不等長：可以近似理解為三連音節奏，前一音約為後一音的兩倍長。反拍重音（backbeat）是在四拍子中強調第二、第四拍所形成的切分，在爵士樂中很常見。當拍節原有的層級感受到擾動，就會出現切分。
en: Key Takeaways Swing eighths are notated as regular straight eighths but performed unevenly, in a quasi-triplet rhythm where the first note is twice as long as the second. Backbeat, a syncopation created through accent on beats 2 and 4 of a quadruple meter, is common in jazz. Syncopation occurs when the hierarchy of the meter is obscured.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 爵士樂有許多鮮明的節奏慣用法，構成它的風格特色。本章介紹特別重要的搖擺八分音符與反拍重音，並進一步討論切分。
en: Jazz has many characteristic uses of rhythm that define it as a genre. This chapter introduces two especially signficant rhythms—swing eighths and the backbeat—and discusses syncopation generally.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 基本的搖擺律動
en: The Basic Swing Groove

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 搖擺八分音符
en: Swing eighths

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 例1。演奏搖擺八分音符時，前一音大約是後一音的兩倍長。
en: Example 1. Swing eighths are performed so that the first eighth is roughly twice as long as the second.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 搖擺節奏最容易辨認的特色之一，就是搖擺八分音符。搖擺八分音符演奏成不等長、近似三連音的節奏，將原本1:1的比例改成約2:1，也就是前一個八分音符約為後一個的兩倍長。例1以記譜示意。
en: One of the most recognizable features of swing rhythms is swung eighth notes. Swing eighths are performed as uneven eighth notes in a quasi-triplet rhythm, shifting the proportion from 1:1 to, roughly, 2:1—that is, the first eighth note is about twice as long as the second eighth note. This is illustrated with notation in Example 1.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 在某種意義上，將爵士曲的八分音符寫成例1的三連音形式，或許更接近實際演奏；但整份樂譜會因此變得多麼擁擠！所以爵士譜通常把搖擺八分音符仍寫成均分八分音符，讓演奏者依風格理解並奏出搖擺感。
en: While in some sense it may be more accurate to notate the eighth notes of a jazz tune as a triplet rhythm as notated in Example 1, imagine how cluttered that would be! Instead, swing eighth notes in jazz are always written as straight eighth notes, and performers are expected to know to swing them.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: Spotify：《Anything Goes》序曲錄音
en: Spotify Embed: Overture (requires internet)

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 例2。《Anything Goes》序曲錄音0:36處，全體樂團一起演奏圖示節奏。
en: Example 2. The entire ensemble plays the notated rhythm at 0:36 of the overture to Anything Goes.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 例3。《Anything Goes》序曲第二部分的鼓聲部，持續出現這個採均分八分音符的節奏。
en: Example 3. This rhythm, with straight eighths, occurs in a drum part throughout the second part of the Anything Goes overture.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 音樂劇《Anything Goes》的序曲，同時包含均分與搖擺八分音符的段落。開頭幾分鐘採搖擺節奏；0:36處，全體樂器一起奏出搖擺八分音符，最容易聽出來，見例2。聆聽時，試著跟著搖擺八分音符打拍；速度很快，因此手也得打得相當快。
en: The overture from the musical Anything Goes contains passages with both straight and swing eighths. The first few minutes are swung; this is easiest to hear at 0:36 when all the instruments in the ensemble play swing eighths together (Example 2).While listening, tap along to the swing eighths—and note that the tempo is very brisk, so you'll be tapping quite quickly.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 再與0:52開始的中段比較，見例3。這裡改成均分八分音符，律動感明顯不同。聆聽時跟著均分八分音符打拍；這一段的速度，比開頭搖擺段落慢得多。
en: Contrast this with the straight eighths in the middle section of the overture, which begins at 0:52 (Example 3). The feel changes dramatically during this straight section. As you listen, tap along to the straight eighths, which are at a considerably slower tempo than the first part's swing eighths.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 小號短暫過渡後，1:39開始的第三部分又回到搖擺八分音符；可以從爵士鼓的腳踏鈸聲部聽出這個節奏。
en: After a quick transition in the trumpets, swing eighths return for the third part of the overture, which begins at 1:39. The swing eighths are audible in the hi-hat cymbal of the drumset.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 例1的三連音記法，是常見的搖擺節奏說明方式；但實際上，八分音符的精確比例，會隨作品與演奏者而不同。一般而言，快速演奏傾向比較接近均分，慢速演奏則往往採用更明顯的長短差。比較 Dizzy Gillespie 的〈Eternal Triangle〉與 Count Basie 的〈Duet〉：前者的搖擺比例較均勻，後者則較不平均。
en: The triplet rhythm notated in Example 1 is a common way to explain swing, but in reality, the exact ratio of swing eighths varies from piece to piece and from performer to performer. Generally speaking, faster tempos tend to be more straight and slower tempos tend to employ a more dramatic swing. Compare the swing of "Eternal Triangle" by Dizzy Gillespie and "Duet" by Count Basie—the former has a more even swing rhythm, while the latter has a more uneven swing.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 反拍重音（Backbeat）
en: Backbeat

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 另一個重要的爵士節奏特色是反拍重音，也就是在四拍子中強調第二、第四拍。這與古典音樂常強調第一、第三拍的方式相反。不過，第一拍在爵士樂中仍然重要：和弦常在這裡改變，根音也常在這裡出現；只是它不一定是最響的一拍。
en: The next most significant rhythmic feature of jazz is the backbeat. The backbeat is an accent on beats 2 and 4 of a quadruple meter. This is the opposite of the typical accent structure of classical music, where beats 1 and 3 are usually the most accented. (Beat 1 is still important in jazz, though—that's still usually where chord changes occur and roots of chords are sounded. It just may not be the loudest beat.)

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 反拍重音與搖擺八分音符，是標準搖擺鼓型的重要成分，見例4。閉合的腳踏鈸強調反拍，節奏鈸（ride cymbal）則奏出搖擺八分音符。鼓型變化很多，而且通常即興演奏，但多數爵士鼓型都能找到這兩個成分。
en: The backbeat and the swing eighth together make up an important part of a standard swing drum beat (Example 4). The backbeat is accented with the closed hi-hat cymbal, while the swing eighths are played on the ride cymbal. Drum beats vary widely and are typically improvised, but these are two components you will find in most jazz drum patterns.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 搖擺八分音符與反拍重音的標準鼓型靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 例4。包含搖擺八分音符與反拍重音的標準搖擺鼓型。
en: Example 4. Standard swing drum beat with swing eighths and a backbeat.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 跟著爵士曲打拍時，可以試著打在第二、第四拍的反拍重音，而不只打在每小節第一拍。
en: When tapping along with jazz tunes, try tapping along to the backbeat, rather than the downbeat.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 切分
en: Syncopation

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 理解切分之前，要先掌握拍節的基本概念，可參閱〈單拍子〉與〈複拍子〉。當等距的拍點暗示出層級感時，就形成拍節。例如，多數爵士樂所採的 [latex]\mathbf{^4_4}[/latex] 拍，是由四個等距四分音符拍點構成：第一拍最重要，第三拍次之，第二與第四拍相對較次要。這裡的「重要」，指和弦變換、轉調等重要事件常發生在第一拍；第三拍也可能出現，但較少；第二或第四拍出現和弦變換，則相對不常見。
en: Before understanding syncopation, it is important to understand meter more generally (refer to the chapters on simple and compound meter). Meter emerges when a series of equally spaced pulses imply a sense of hierarchy. For example, [latex]\mathbf{^4_4}[/latex] time, which most jazz is in, is a series of four quarter notes (equally distant beats) in which beat 1 is most important, beat 3 less important, and beats 2 and 4 least important of all. "Importance" here means that important things happen on beat 1: things like chord changes, key changes, and so on. These important things might also happen on beat 3, but it is less common, and it's relatively unusual to see chord changes on beat 2 or 4.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 當這份層級感受到某種方式的擾動，就會產生切分。做法很多，反拍重音就是其中一種：在第二、第四拍發聲，而不在第一、第三拍發聲，強調 [latex]\mathbf{^4_4}[/latex] 拍中原本相對較弱的位置。爵士樂另一種常見切分，是強調一對八分音符中位於拍子後半的第二個音，如前面的例2。
en: Syncopation occurs when this sense of hierarchy is subverted in some way. There are many ways to achieve this subversion, and the backbeat is actually one such example. By sounding on beats 2 and 4, but not on beats 1 and 3, the backbeat creates syncopation by accenting the less important beats of the [latex]\mathbf{^4_4}[/latex] meter. Another common jazz syncopation is accenting the second offbeat eighth of an eighth-note pair, as in Example 2 above.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: 除了以重音擾動拍點感，也能用休止與延音線製造切分，例如讓旋律避開小節第一拍才開始。例5就是透過休止與延音線形成切分的例子。
en: In addition to accents that obscure the beat, syncopation can also be created through rests and ties: for example, avoiding downbeats when beginning melodic lines. An example of syncopation created with rests and ties is in Example 5.

title: 搖擺節奏
text: Carla Bley〈Donkey〉中的休止與延音線切分靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原始資源含有本章必要的音樂範例。

en: Example 5. Syncopation in Carla Bley, "Donkey" (1976).
