title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 重點整理功能層是依樂器在整體織體中扮演的角色，將它們分組的方法。流行歌曲中的功能層包括：明示拍節層：顧名思義，清楚呈現歌曲的拍節與各脈動層次。多數打擊樂屬於這一層。功能低音層：為歌曲提供和聲基礎。低音域樂器很可能屬於這一層。和聲填充層：增加織體厚度，提供更多和聲脈絡。通常由鍵盤、合成器與吉他構成，不同曲風的配置可能相差很大。旋律層：通常由人聲及其他旋律樂器演奏。特色是音色變化靈活，且相較周圍織體，樂器音色較明亮。新奇層：透過呼應或插入式音型，與旋律層形成對照。這一層常使用音色不容易與其他樂器融合的樂器。
en: Key Takeaways A functional layer is a way of grouping instruments together according to the role the instruments play within the larger texture. Some functional layers in pop songs include: The explicit beat layer, which (as the name suggests) clearly articulates the meter and pulse levels within the song. Most percussion is part of this layer. The functional bass layer, which provides a harmonic foundation for the track. Bass-register instruments likely belong to in this layer. The harmonic filler layer, which thickens the texture and provides more harmonic context to the song. This layer typically comprises keyboards, synthesizers, and guitars, and varies widely depending on genre. The melodic layer, which is typically performed by the voice and other melodic instruments. The melodic layer is notable for involving high timbral flexibility, as well as instruments that are bright relative to the surrounding texture. The novelty layer, which works in opposition to the melodic layer through call-and-response gestures or interjections. This layer often uses instruments whose timbral features resist blending with the rest of the ensemble.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 本章播放清單
en: Chapter Playlist

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 尤其在音序器與數位音訊工作站出現以後，以分層方式構思、寫作的流行音樂，所占比例越來越高。這種分層作曲方式是流行音樂的重要結構特徵，值得仔細分析。Allan Moore（2012）指出，傳統描述織體的術語，例如主調織度、異音織度、複調織度與單音織度，原本是為描述古典音樂而發展，套用在流行音樂上，能提供的洞見有限。[1]他因此提出功能層的概念，作為更有解釋力的流行音樂織體分析工具。一個功能層可以只對應一件樂器，也可以由一組樂器共同構成。
en: Especially since the advent of sequencers and digital audio workstations, an ever-increasing majority of popular music is conceptualized and written in layers. This layered approach to composition is an important structural feature of pop music, deserving of close analytical attention. Allan Moore (2012) observes that traditional terms for describing texture (homophony, heterophony, polyphony, monophony) were developed to describe classical music, and do not offer much insight when applied to pop music.[1] He developed the concept of functional layers as a more powerful tool for describing pop textures. Functional layers may be equivalent to a single instrument, or a group of instruments may constitute a single functional layer.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: Moore（2012）提出流行音樂常見的四個功能層：
en: Moore (2012) identifies four functional layers common in pop music:

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 明示拍節層功能低音層和聲填充層旋律層
en: The explicit beat layer The functional bass layer The harmonic filler layer The melodic layer

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: Lavengood（2020）加入第五層：
en: Lavengood (2020) adds a fifth layer:

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 新奇層
en: The novelty layer

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 辨識這些功能層看似不複雜，但分析各層如何構成，是拆解歌曲、加深理解的一種方式。功能層分析也能顯示歌曲中，與特定曲風或文化相關的常見做法。
en: While identifying these layers may not seem like a complex task, analyzing the way they are constituted is one way of breaking down a song to understand it better. Analyzing functional layers may furthermore illuminate common practices in the song associated with specific genres and/or cultures.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 本章以Vulfpeck的〈3 on E〉（2020）說明這些概念。例1列出各功能層的樂器，例2則用分層圖，呈現這些樂器在全曲中的使用情形。每件樂器的顏色，都對應它所屬的功能層。
en: The concepts in this chapter will be illustrated with the song "3 on E" by Vulfpeck (2020). A list of the instruments that constitute each functional layer is given in Example 1, and the use of the instruments throughout the song is diagrammed in a layer graph in Example 2. Colors assigned to the instruments reflect their functional layer.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 功能層樂器新奇層（黃色）陶笛旋律層（紅色）人聲、銅管音色的FM合成器和聲填充層（綠色）吉他、高音正弦波合成器功能低音層（藍色）貝斯明示拍節層（紫色）鼓組、輔助打擊樂器
en: Functional Layer Instruments Novelty (yellow) Ocarina Melody (red) Vocals, brassy FM synth Harmonic filler (green) Guitars, high sine synth Functional bass (blue) Bass Explicit beat (purple) Drum kit, auxiliary percussion

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 例1。Vulfpeck〈3 on E〉（2020）各功能層的樂器。
en: Example 1. List of instruments in functional layers in "3 on E" by Vulfpeck (2020).

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 〈3 on E〉樂器分層互動圖與影音依原章公開互動圖重繪，保留樂器列、色塊與時間刻度，附中文圖例供離線閱讀。時間標記沿用原圖。 原章Auralayer分層圖至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例2，〈3 on E〉樂器分層圖的離線重繪版。由上至下：Ocarina＝陶笛（黃色，新奇層）；Brassy FM synth＝銅管音色FM合成器、Vocals＝人聲（紅色，旋律層）；Guitars＝吉他、High sine synth＝高音正弦波合成器（綠色，和聲填充層）；Bass＝貝斯（藍色，功能低音層）；Aux percussion＝輔助打擊樂器、Drum kit＝鼓組（紫色，明示拍節層）。橫軸依原圖每30秒標一刻度，從0:00至3:00。色塊的高低與斜邊依原圖保留；原章未在此提供其定量單位，不宜直接讀為分貝。圖下英文：依原章Auralayer圖重繪供離線閱讀；時間標記沿用原圖，未獨立核對錄音。

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 例2。Vulfpeck〈3 on E〉（2020）的樂器分層圖。顏色對應樂器的功能層：新奇層為黃色，旋律層為紅色，和聲填充層為綠色，功能低音層為藍色，明示拍節層為紫色。
en: Example 2. Layer graph of instruments in "3 on E" by Vulfpeck (2020). Color corresponds to the instrument's functional layer: novelty (yellow), melody (red), harmonic filler (green), functional bass (blue), and explicit beat (purple).

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: Spotify：〈3 on E〉
en: Spotify Embed: 3 on E (requires internet)

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 明示拍節層
en: Explicit Beat Layer

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 這一層明確呈現拍點的規律模式（Moore 2012，20）。它也是歌曲律動的重要部分，負責建立、維持拍節與特色節奏。這一層常由無固定音高的打擊樂器構成；許多流行音樂主要以鼓組呈現明示拍節層，當然也能加入其他打擊樂器。由於許多流行音樂是為跳舞而作，這一層的節奏通常規律、反覆。因此，它為歌曲其他部分提供基礎，而其他部分在節奏上可以更自由。
en: This layer "articulates an explicit pattern of beats" (Moore 2012, 20). It is also a key component to the song's groove, as it establishes and maintains the song's meter and characteristic rhythms. Instruments in this layer are often unpitched percussion instruments; in much pop music, the drum kit is the instrument that primarily articulates the explicit beat layer, though of course other percussion may be added. The rhythms performed in the explicit beat layer also tend to be regular and repetitive, since so much pop music is meant to be danced to. The explicit beat layer thus provides a foundation for the rest of the track, which is more flexible in this regard.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 這些基本特性，讓明示拍節層在流行歌曲中特別容易辨認。〈3 on E〉幾乎全曲都有這一層，由鼓組演奏。最後一次副歌（2:20）又加入輔助打擊樂器。上方例2以紫色呈現明示拍節層。
en: These fundamental properties of the explicit beat layer render it particularly easy to recognize in pop songs. In "3 on E," the explicit beat layer is present throughout almost the entire track and is played by the drum kit. In the final chorus (2:20), additional auxiliary percussion in the form is added to the explicit beat layer. Example 2 above shows the explicit beat layer with purple colors.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 功能低音層
en: Functional Bass Layer

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 和明示拍節層一樣，功能低音層也是歌曲律動的重要部分，共同構成歌曲的基礎。注意上方例2的藍色功能低音層，也和明示拍節層一樣，幾乎貫穿全曲。不同之處是，功能低音層還肩負音域與調性上的重要角色：提供低頻，並界定歌曲的和聲脈絡。絕大多數流行歌曲中，功能低音層在每次換和弦時的第1拍演奏和弦根音，同時滿足這兩個角色（例3）。
en: Like the explicit beat layer, the functional bass layer is an important component of the song's groove, and forms part of the foundation of a track. Note that in Example 2 above, the functional bass (shown in blue) is present throughout almost the entire song, like the explicit beat layer. Unlike the explicit beat layer, the functional bass layer also serves an important registral and tonal role: to provide the bass frequency and define the harmonic context of a song. In the vast majority of pop songs, the functional bass layer fills these two roles at once by playing the chord roots on beat 1 of each chord change (Example 3).

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 〈3 on E〉低音譜例靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原資源包含本章使用的譜例。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 例3。〈3 on E〉中，貝斯擔任功能低音層，既為律動提供重要節奏，也清楚呈現和聲。原書經許可使用。
en: Example 3. The bass guitar, acting as the functional bass layer, both provides important rhythms to the groove and clarifies the harmony in "3 on E." Used with permission.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 旋律層
en: Melodic layer

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 歌曲的主要旋律線構成旋律層。人聲自然是其中最典型的樂器，也最不需要額外的理論說明。其他非人聲樂器之所以歸入旋律層，是因為它們承擔旋律線，與人聲一起演奏，或取代人聲。上方例2以紅色呈現旋律層；人聲是典型例子，偶爾也有銅管音色的FM合成器加入。就像這個合成器，旋律層的樂器通常比織體其他部分具有更明亮的音色，而且可能有高度的音色變化能力，模仿歌唱人聲的變化。Moore也指出，旋律層的配器，是辨認歌曲曲風的重要線索。
en: The principal melodic line(s) of a song form the melodic layer. Of course, the voice is the most typical instrument in the melodic layer, and requires the least theorizing. When other, non-vocal instruments belong to the melodic layer, it is because they carry the melodic line, either alongside or instead of the voice. In Example 2 above, the vocals are a paradigmatic example of the melodic layer (shown in red), and occasionally a brassy FM synth joins the vocals in the melodic layer. As with this brassy synth, instruments in the melodic layer tend to have brighter timbres than those of instruments in other parts of the texture, and moreover, may have a high degree of timbral flexibility that mimics similar changes in the singing voice. Moore also points out that the instrumentation of the melodic layer is a strong indicator of the genre the song belongs to.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 和聲填充層
en: Harmonic filler layer

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: Moore說，和聲填充層填補低音層與旋律層之間的「音域」空間（2012，21）。雖然其中確實可能包含中頻樂器，但定義中的引號提示，這裡談的是概念上的音域空間，而不是嚴格按頻率劃分的音域。吉他、鍵盤與合成器最常出現在和聲填充層，〈3 on E〉就是如此，見上方例2；不過，配置會隨曲風大幅改變，合唱團、管弦樂團或流行樂管樂組，也可能擔任這個功能。[2]
en: Moore says that the harmonic filler layer "fill[s] the 'registral' space between the bass and [melodic] layers" (2012, 21). While harmonic filler layers may indeed include mid-range instruments, the presence of scare quotes in Moore's definition indicates that this is about conceptual registral space, rather than strict frequency-based register. Guitars, keyboards, and synthesizers are most common in the harmonic filler layer (as in "3 on E," as shown in Example 2 above), but this can vary greatly depending on genre—choirs, orchestras, and horn sections could also be appropriate.[2]

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 新奇層
en: Novelty layer

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 新奇層與旋律層形成對照，特色是呼應或插入式音型，以及不尋常的音色。它是本章功能層中最不具必要性的一層，不見得每首歌都有。搖滾樂標準配置以外的樂器，也就是吉他、鼓和鍵盤以外的樂器，以及吸引注意的合成器音色，常被用來構成新奇層。[3]〈3 on E〉第二次主歌（0:59）中的陶笛，同時符合這個定義在音型與音色上的條件，形成典型、但出現時間很短的新奇層；上方例2以黃色標示。其他明顯的新奇層例子，還有Jason Derulo〈Talk Dirty〉（2013，0:39）中的薩克斯風，以及Celine Dion〈My Heart Will Go On〉（1997，0:00）中的錫笛。
en: The novelty layer functions in opposition to the melodic layer, and is characterized by call-and-response or interjectory gestures and unusual timbres. It is the least essential of all the functional layers discussed in this chapter, and may not be present in every song. Non-standard rock instruments (that is, instruments beyond guitars, drums, and keyboards) and attention-grabbing synthesizer sounds often are used to create a novelty layer.[3] The ocarinas in the second verse of "3 on E" (0:59) fulfill both the gestural and timbral parameters of this definition, creating a paradigmatic (albeit minimally present) novelty layer (shown in blue in Example 2 above). Other examples with prominent novelty layers are the saxophone in "Talk Dirty" by Jason Derulo (2013, 0:39) or the tin whistle in "My Heart Will Go On" by Celine Dion (1997, 0:00).

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 分析時可以提出的問題
en: Questions to ask while analyzing

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 如同其他音樂分析，貼上標籤只是形成有說服力之分析的起點。以下問題，可以幫助你從辨識功能層，進一步發展成以織體為基礎的歌曲詮釋：
en: As always with music analysis, applying labels is only the beginning of creating a compelling analysis. Below are some ideas for questions to ask yourself to develop your labelling of functional layers into an interpretation of the song based on texture:

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 各層由哪些樂器構成？各層何時進入、何時退出？這與曲式有什麼關係？是否有某個功能層完全缺席？省略它會產生什麼效果？新奇層的配器，暗示了哪些跨作品、跨文本的聯想？各層的節奏輪廓有何差異？是否有樂器參與不只一個功能層？角色改變會產生什麼效果？上述答案如何與曲風或文化脈絡相連？
en: What instruments make up each layer? When do layers enter and exit, and how does that relate to the form? Are any functional layers missing altogether? What is the effect of omitting that layer from the song? What intertextual associations are implied by the instrumentation of the novelty layer? How do the rhythmic profiles of the layers differ? Do any instruments participate in multiple functional layers? What is the effect of their change of role? How do any of the answers to the questions above relate to genre or cultural context?

text: 延伸閱讀

Auralayer is a free web app for creating visualizations of texture and instrumentation.

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: 作業

title: 流行音樂的織體

title: 流行音樂的織體
text: Moore特別指出，明示拍節層幾乎無所不在，是流行音樂與古典音樂的一項區別（2012，20），也是傳統術語不完全適合描述流行音樂的部分原因。相較之下，功能低音層在古典音樂中，和在流行音樂中一樣容易辨認。↵Moore（2012，21）也指出，有些曲風可能完全不使用和聲填充層，並以金屬樂為例。↵非西方或民俗樂器，也就是所謂「世界音樂」樂器，常被侷限在新奇層的角色，這種做法有時會造成問題；詳見Lavengood（2020）。↵
en: Moore notes in particular that the ubiquity of the explicit beat layer is something that distinguishes pop music from classical music (2012, 20). This is part of what makes traditional terms inapt for describing pop music. By contrast, the functional bass layer is one that could be recognized as easily in classical music as it is in pop music. ↵Moore (2012, 21) also notes that some genres might not use a harmonic filler layer at all, and gives metal as an example of such a genre. ↵Non-western or folk instruments ("world" instruments) are often relegated to the novelty layer, to sometimes problematic effect, as described in Lavengood (2020). ↵

title: 流行音樂和聲圖式入門
text: 重點整理可以透過和聲圖式，也就是特別常見的和弦進行，理解流行音樂和聲。這些圖式可以有所變化，同時仍保留與典型原型的相似性。
en: Key Takeaways Pop harmony can be understood through harmonic schemas—particularly common chord progressions. These schemas can be altered while still maintaining their resemblance to the prototype.

title: 流行音樂和聲圖式入門
text: 許多流行／搖滾歌曲會反覆出現一些常用和弦進行。這些固定模式，也就是圖式，常在歌曲中循環出現：同一進行連續重複多次。這在主歌—副歌形式歌曲的副歌中特別常見，但也會出現在主歌、歌節與橋段中。熟悉流行和聲圖式，有助於用耳朵辨識和聲；除了聽低音的音階級數、判斷和弦是原位或第一轉位，還能辨認曾在其他歌曲中聽過的常見模式。例1簡要整理各圖式最常見的形式。
en: There are a number of common stock chord progressions that recur in many pop/rock songs. These stock progressions, or schemas, will often occur in cyclical patterns in a song; that is, the same progression will repeat multiple times in a row. This is particularly common in choruses of verse-chorus songs, but it also happens in verses, strophes, and bridges. Knowledge of pop schemas is helpful for identifying harmonies by ear, since in addition to listening for bass scale degrees and considering whether the harmonies are in root position or first inversion, you can listen for common patterns that you have heard in other songs. Example 1 succinctly summarizes the most common forms of each schema.

title: 流行音樂和聲圖式入門
text: 圖式的一個關鍵特徵，是可以有所變化，卻仍能被辨認為同一圖式的實例。想想「鳥」這個詞：如果沒有其他提示，有人請你想像一隻鳥，你或許不會想到特定鳥種，但大概會想到類似麻雀或美洲知更鳥的形象。這隻想像中的鳥，就是你心中「鳥」這個圖式的典型原型。即使外觀與它不同，你仍能認出各種鳥類：鴕鳥、企鵝、紅鶴與天鵝，在外觀、行為與棲地上差異很大，卻顯然都是鳥。同樣地，即使和聲圖式經過某些變化，你仍可以，也應該，辨認出它們是此處所列圖式的實例。常見變化包括半音變化或和弦轉位，整理於例1的最後一欄。
en: A crucial feature of schemas is that they can be altered while still remaining recognizable as a manifestation of that schema. Think of the term "bird." If someone asks you to imagine a bird without any extra context, you may not imagine a specific species of bird, but you would probably imagine a bird that looks something like a sparrow or robin. Your imaginary bird is your mental prototype for the schema "bird." You can recognize all kinds of birds as being birds even if they do not look exactly like your imaginary bird—ostriches, penguins, flamingos, and swans are all clearly birds, despite their significant differences in appearance, behavior, and habitat. In the same way, you can and should recognize harmonic schemas as manifestations of the schemas listed here, even when they undergo some form of variation. Common variations include chromatic inflection or chord inversion, and are summarized in the final column of Example 1.

title: 流行音樂和聲圖式入門
text: 接下來幾章，會把具有共同特徵的圖式歸在一起，詳細介紹每種圖式與它最常見的變化。
en: The following chapters group together certain schemas that share several qualities, and go into detail about each individual schema and its most common variations.

title: 以藍調為基礎的圖式
text: 重點整理以藍調為基礎的圖式，都包含某種變格進行。許多歌曲只反覆使用I–IV這兩個和弦，這在節奏藍調與靈魂樂中特別常見。「變格嘆息」圖式IV–iv–I，包含la–le–sol [latex](\hat{6}-\downarrow\hat{6}-\hat{5})[/latex]的聲部連接，常出現在樂句結尾。可以運用「副IV」和弦，形成雙重變格圖式：♭VII–IV–I。這些副IV和弦也能形成延伸變格進行，例如♭VI–♭III–♭VII–IV–I。
en: Key Takeaways Blues-based schemas all include some kind of plagal motion. Many songs simply use the two-chord vamp I–IV (very common in R&B and soul music). The "plagal sigh" schema, IV–iv–I, includes the scale-degree voice-leading la–le–sol [latex](\hat{6}-\downarrow\hat{6}-\hat{5})[/latex] and can often be found at phrase endings. "Applied" IV chords can be used to create a double-plagal schema: ♭VII–IV–I. These applied IV chords can be used to create extended plagal progressions such as ♭VI–♭III–♭VII–IV–I.

title: 以藍調為基礎的圖式

title: 以藍調為基礎的圖式
text: 以藍調為基礎的圖式，也稱「降號側」圖式，主要使用五度圈降號方向上的和聲。之所以把它們與藍調聯繫起來，是因為藍調偏好IV和弦，也就是沿五度圈往降號方向遇到的第一個和弦，而且降第七級音在藍調中非常普遍。
en: Blues-based schemas, or "flat-side" schemas, are those that mostly employ harmonies found on the "flat side" of the circle of fifths. We draw the connection to the blues here because of its propensity for using the IV chord (the first chord found in the flat-wise direction on the circle of fifths), and for the general ubiquity of the flattened seventh scale degree in blues music.

title: 以藍調為基礎的圖式

title: 以藍調為基礎的圖式
text: IV在共通寫作時期的作品中，已是極常見的前屬／下屬和弦，在流行／搖滾音樂中的地位卻更突出。I與IV交替，可能源於shuffle藍調吉他伴奏中的5–6鄰音進行（例1）；許多曲風都常見這種和弦交替（例2）。
en: The IV chord, while certainly an extremely frequent predominant/subdominant chord in common-practice repertoire, has an even more prominent place in pop/rock music. Perhaps borne out of the 5–6 neighboring motion found in shuffle-blues guitar accompaniment patterns (Example 1), an alternation between I and IV is a common occurrence in numerous genres (Example 2).

title: 以藍調為基礎的圖式
text: 搖滾與流行音樂中，一種很常見的變格圖式，是用小iv和弦形成類似終止的手勢。它最常出現在IV–iv–I這個三和弦圖式中，通常伴隨下行旋律la–le–sol [latex](\hat{6}-\downarrow\hat{6}-\hat{5})[/latex]，例如例6的吉他聲部。半音下行，對主和弦產生特別強的趨向。
en: A very common plagal schema in rock and popular music is the use of the minor iv chord as a kind of cadential gesture. It is most commonly found as part of the three-chord schema IV–iv–I. The schema is typically accompanied by the descending melody la–le–sol [latex](\hat{6}-\downarrow\hat{6}-\hat{5})[/latex], which is found in the guitar part in Example 6. The semitone descent creates an especially strong pull to the tonic.

title: 以藍調為基礎的圖式
text: J. Kent Williams與Frank Lehman分別討論美國流行歌曲黃金年代及古典好萊塢電影配樂中的這種下行，稱之為「變格嘆息」。[1]兩位作者都認為，這種手勢會喚起懷舊與感傷。在流行音樂中，音樂人也常把這個進行，搭配帶有感傷意味的歌詞。
en: This descent has been referred to by J. Kent Williams and Frank Lehman as a "plagal sigh" in Golden Era American popular song and Classic Hollywood film scores, respectively.[1] Both authors consider this gesture to invoke a sense of nostalgia and sentimentality. Indeed, even in pop music, musicians typically use this progression in conjunction with lyrics that suggest sentimentality.

en: "Wake Me Up When September Ends" by Green Day (Example 6) exhibits both of the tendencies discussed above: motion from IV–iv–I and a sense of nostalgia and sentimentality in the lyrics.

title: 以藍調為基礎的圖式
text: 「雙重變格」是Walter Everett使用的術語：在前述變格進行中，於IV之前再加入IV/IV和弦，形成擴展。[2]更簡單的寫法是♭VII–IV–I。最有名的例子，可能就是披頭四〈Hey Jude〉的尾聲（例7）。
en: The “double-plagal” progression (Walter Everett’s term) is an expansion of the plagal progression discussed above to include the IV/IV chord prior to the IV chord.[2] This is perhaps more simply explained as ♭VII–IV–I. The most famous instance of the double-plagal progression is likely the coda from “Hey Jude” by the Beatles (Example 7).

In the version of “Hey Joe” by Jimi Hendrix (1966), the verse consists of three iterations of the plagal motion in a descending-fourths pattern, which results in the progression ♭VI–♭III–♭VII–IV–I, in the key of E major.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 重點整理I、IV、V與vi是流行音樂最常見的和聲，可以排列成幾種聲響各異的圖式。每種圖式都能透過和弦替代或輪換起點等方式變化，仍讓人辨認出原圖式。Doo-wop圖式為I–vi–IV–V，常見於1960年代流行音樂。常見變化：I–vi–ii–V：以ii取代IV。IV–V–I–vi：輪換起點。創作歌手圖式為vi–IV–I–V或I–V–vi–IV，常見於1990年代創作歌手的音樂。也能以關係小調理解為i–VI–III–VII。常見變化是輪換為IV–I–V–vi。跳格子圖式為IV–V–vi–I，常見於2010年以來的流行音樂。也能以關係小調理解為VI–VII–i–III。常見變化為VI–V–i–III，也就是在小調中以V取代VII。
en: Key Takeaways I, IV, V, and vi are the most common harmonies in pop music, and they can be arranged into several schemas, each with a distinct sound. Each schema can have variations, such as chord substitution or rotation, while still remaining recognizable as that schema. The doo-wop schema is I–vi–IV–V, and it was common in 1960s pop music. Common variations: I–vi–ii–V (ii substitutes for IV) IV–V–I–vi (rotation) The singer/songwriter schema is vi–IV–I–V or I–V–vi–IV, and it was common in 1990s singer/songwriter music. It can also be understood in its relative minor: i–VI–III–VII. A common variation is IV–I–V–vi (rotation). The hopscotch schema is IV–V–vi–I, and it is common in recent pop music (since 2010). It can also be understood in its relative minor: VI–VII–i–III. A common variation is VI–V–i–III (V substitutes for VII in minor).

title: 四和弦圖式

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 本章討論的進行，都有一個共同點：使用I、IV、V與vi這四個和弦，它們可能是整個流行音樂中最常用的和弦。因此，這些圖式聽起來有些相似；差別在和弦排列順序。
en: The progressions discussed in this chapter all have something in common. They use the same four chords: I, IV, V, and vi, which are probably the most common chords in all of pop music. Because of this, they all sound somewhat similar; the difference is in the order of the chords.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 這個循環和弦進行的名稱，來自它常見於1950年代及1960年代初期的搖滾抒情歌曲，例如Gene Chandler〈Duke of Earl〉（1962）。此後它也持續被廣泛使用，例如Rebecca Black〈Friday〉（2011）的主歌與副歌，以及Bonnie Tyler〈Total Eclipse of the Heart〉（1983）的副歌，後者從0:49開始。
en: The name for this cyclical chord progression comes from its common use in rock ballads from the 1950s and early 1960s, such as “Duke of Earl” by Gene Chandler (1962). However, it has continued to be used frequently ever since: examples include the verse and chorus of “Friday” by Rebecca Black (2011) and the chorus of “Total Eclipse of the Heart” by Bonnie Tyler (1983) (starts at 0:49).

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 以ii取代IV
en: Substituting ii for IV

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 由於ii與IV在這個和弦進行中具有相同功能，兩者可以互相替代，例如Bruce Springsteen〈Hungry Heart〉（1980）。
en: Because ii and IV share the same function in this chord progression, ii can be swapped out for IV, as in Bruce Springsteen's "Hungry Heart" (1980).

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 輪換起點
en: Rotation

title: 四和弦圖式
text: Doo-wop圖式通常循環使用，因此也能由循環中的另一個和弦開始，仍按原來的順序前進，稱為輪換起點。例如Coldplay〈Viva la Vida〉（2008）反覆使用同一串和弦，但樂句由IV而非I開始（例2）。
en: Because the doo-wop schema is typically employed in cycles, it can also start on a different chord in the cycle and then proceed through the same succession of chords (rotation). For example, “Viva la Vida” by Coldplay (2008) works through a cyclical repetition of the same succession of chords, but the phrases begin on IV rather than I (Example 2).

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 創作歌手圖式
en: Singer/Songwriter

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 創作歌手圖式可能是最廣為人知的四和弦圖式。常見的羅馬數字分析是vi–IV–I–V，在C大調即Ami–F–C–G；但從I開始的輪換版本，也極為常見。此外，這兩種輪換，都可能被理解為以大調主和弦或關係小調主和弦為中心。例3最能說明這點。
en: The singer/songwriter schema may be the best known of all the four-chord schemas. A common Roman numeral analysis for this schema is vi–IV–I–V, or Ami–F–C–G in C major, but the rotation starting with I is also exceedingly common. On top of that, either rotation may be understood as having either the major tonic or the relative minor tonic. This is best understood through Example 3.

text: 例3。創作歌手圖式的兩種常見輪換。

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 和1950年代的Doo-wop一樣，這也是四和弦的循環進行。它存在已久，可見於多種音樂風格；但從1990年代中期開始，在Sarah McLachlan、Jewel與Joan Osborne等創作歌手的作品中，變得越來越常見。
en: Like the 1950s doo-wop, this is a four-chord cyclical progression. It has been around for some time and can be found in a variety of musical styles, but it became increasingly common beginning in the mid-1990s with singer/songwriters such as Sarah McLachlan, Jewel, and Joan Osborne,

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 調性模糊
en: Tonal ambiguity

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 這個進行的重要特徵，是單靠它本身，無法清楚確立唯一的主和弦，稱為調性模糊。例如Luis Fonsi與Daddy Yankee的〈Despacito〉（2017），和弦進行Bmi–G–D–A，對不同聽者而言，可能是D大調的vi–IV–I–V，也可能是B小調的i–VI–III–VII（例4）。創作歌手圖式之所以模糊，部分原因是沒有正格終止：兩種可能的收束進行，分別是變格IV–I或級進VII–i。缺乏強烈的和聲終止時，聽者可能只能依前後的和弦進行、循環由哪些和弦開始與結束，以及旋律中的重要音，判斷主和弦；也可能始終無法確定。
en: One important feature of this progression is that it does not, on its own, clearly communicate a definitive tonic chord. This property is known as tonal ambiguity. An example is "Despacito" by Luis Fonsi and Daddy Yankee (2017). The chord progression, Bmi–G–D–A, can sound like vi–IV–I–V in D major or like i–VI–III–VII in B minor to different listeners (Example 4). One reason the singer/songwriter schema is ambiguous is because there is no authentic cadence: the two potential cadential motions are either plagal (IV–I) or stepwise (VII–i). Without a strong harmonic cadence, listeners might only be able to determine the tonic chord—if at all—by the progressions before and after the singer/songwriter schema, which chords in the cycle begin and end it, and the important pitches of the melody.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 例4。〈Despacito〉使用調性模糊的創作歌手圖式，因此D大和弦與B小和弦，都可能被聽成主和弦。
en: Example 4. Both D major and B minor are plausible tonic chords for "Despacito" because of its use of the tonally ambiguous singer/songwriter schema.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 有些創作者會利用這種雙重性，讓歌曲在關係大小調之間往返轉調，或讓音樂呼應歌詞中的雙重意義；這也解釋了它為何適合上述1990年代中期的創作歌手。Heart的〈What About Love〉（1985）就是例子：前奏明確在D小調；主歌由0:23開始，使用創作歌手進行，在D小調與F大調之間模糊；1:10開始的副歌則明確在F大調。聆聽時請對照下表（例5）。
en: In fact, some songwriters take advantage of this duality in songs that modulate back and forth between relative major and minor keys, as well as in songs with some parallel ambiguity in the text (hence its usefulness for those mid-1990s songwriters). An example is “What About Love” by Heart (1982), which has an obvious D minor intro, a D minor/F major verse (begins at 0:23) using the singer/songwriter progression, and a chorus obviously in F major (begins at 1:10)—listen while following along with the chart below (Example 5).

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 例5。Heart〈What About Love〉利用創作歌手圖式的調性模糊，銜接小調前奏與大調副歌。
en: Example 5. "What about Love" by Heart exploits the singer/songwriter schema's tonal ambiguity to link between a minor-mode intro and a major-mode chorus.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 輪換起點
en: Rotations

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 如前文所述，這個圖式從I或vi開始的兩種輪換，同樣常見。有時也從IV開始，形成IV–I–V–vi，以V–vi的假終止作結，因而成為帶有假解決的變體。Lady Gaga〈Alejandro〉（2009）的副歌，從1:11開始，就使用這種輪換。
en: As discussed above, this schema has two equally common rotations that start the progression on I and vi. From time to time, the singer/songwriter progression might also begin on the IV chord, resulting in a “deceptive” variant of this progression that ends with V–vi—a deceptive cadence (IV–I–V–vi). The chorus (starts at 1:11) of "Alejandro" by Lady Gaga (2009) uses this rotation of the singer/songwriter schema.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 跳格子圖式
en: Hopscotch

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 約2010年以來，另一種四和弦圖式越來越常見：IV–V–vi–I，在小調中則為VI–VII–i–III。例子包括Sam Smith〈Dancing with a Stranger〉（2019），以及DJ Khaled、Justin Bieber與Quavo的〈No Brainer〉（2018）。我們稱它為跳格子圖式，因為它的根音進行是級進、級進、三度小跳。
en: In recent years (since about 2010), another type of four-chord schema has become increasingly common: IV–V–vi–I, or VI–VII–i–III in minor. Examples include "Dancing with a Stranger" by Sam Smith (2019) and "No Brainer" by DJ Khaled, Justin Bieber, and Quavo (2018). We will refer to this as the hopscotch schema because of its root motion: step, step, skip.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 和創作歌手圖式一樣，跳格子圖式也可能具有調性模糊。換句話說，在F–G–Ami–C中，A小和弦或C大和弦，都可能被聽成主和弦（例6）。這個進行通常缺乏明確的終止動作，尤其是進入C和弦的時候。
en: Like the singer/songwriter schema, the hopscotch schema can be tonally ambiguous. In other words, in the progression F–G–Ami–C, either Ami or C might sound like tonic (Example 6). There is often no definitive cadential motion, especially moving into the C chord.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 跳格子圖式譜例靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原資源包含本章使用的譜例。例6。跳格子圖式，以標註呈現「級進—級進—三度小跳」模式。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example. Example 6. The hopscotch schema, with annotations showing the “step-step-skip” pattern.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 在小調中以V取代VII
en: Replacing VII in minor with V

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 一種特別常見的和弦替代，可以強化跳格子圖式的小調理解：用大和弦V取代下主音和弦VII，讓VI–VII–i–III變成VI–V–i–III。BLACKPINK〈Love to Hate Me〉（2020）就這樣做。兩個和弦雖有相同的和聲功能，色彩卻相差很大：小調中的大V使用ti [latex](\hat7)[/latex]，VII則使用te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex]。有些歌曲，例如YNW Melly〈Mixed Personalities〉，將V轉位，讓低音仍保持跳格子的「級進—級進—三度小跳」，即使根音進行已經改變（例7）。
en: An especially common harmonic substitution that encourages a minor-mode interpretation of the hopscotch schema is to replace the subtonic VII chord with the major V chord, so that VI–VII–i–III becomes VI–V–i–III. One song that does this is "Love to Hate Me" by BLACKPINK (2020). Although these chords have the same harmonic function, the two chords have quite distinct colors, since the major V chord in minor uses ti [latex](\hat7)[/latex] while VII uses te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex]. Some songs, like "Mixed Personalities" by YNW Melly, invert this V chord, which allows the bass motion of the hopscotch schema to stay the same (step-step-skip) even though the root motion has changed (Example 7).

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 以V取代VII的跳格子圖式譜例靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原資源包含本章使用的譜例。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 例7。跳格子圖式以V取代VII，將VII中的G換成V中的G♯。
en: Example 7. The hopscotch schema with V replacing VII, meaning the G of the VII is replaced with the G♯ of the V chord.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 用耳朵辨認
en: Recognizing by Ear

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 這些四和弦圖式都使用I、IV、V與vi，因此聽起來相似。而且每種圖式都可以輪換，不能只看進行由哪個和弦開始、在哪個和弦結束！請改聽大調主和弦如何被接近（例8）。
en: All of these four-chord schemas sound similar to one another, since they all use I, IV, V, and vi. All the schemas can be rotated, so it's not simply a matter of seeing where the progression begins and ends! Instead, try listening to how the major tonic is approached (Example 8).

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 三種圖式接近大調主和弦的方式靜態樂譜尚待補齊；原資源包含本章使用的譜例。例8。每種圖式都從不同和弦接入大調主和弦。
en: Musical example (requires internet)Static score pending; the original resource contains a musical example. Example 8. Each schema approaches the major tonic from a different chord.

title: 四和弦圖式
text: Doo-wop圖式以十分傳統的正格進行接入主和弦，和古典音樂相似。創作歌手圖式以變格進行接入大調主和弦。跳格子圖式以三度小跳接入大調主和弦，與傳統終止類型沒有直接對應關係。
en: In the doo-wop schema, the tonic is approached with very traditional authentic motion, as in classical music. In the singer/songwriter schema, the major tonic is approached with plagal motion. In the hopscotch schema, the major tonic is approached by a skip (not related to any traditional cadence).

title: 四和弦圖式
text: 即使你認為真正的主和弦是小調主和弦，聽大調主和弦如何被接近，仍有助於區分這幾種四和弦圖式。只聽小調主和弦的接近方式，可能沒有那麼有用，因為創作歌手與跳格子圖式，都是以級進接入小調主和弦。
en: Even if you think the real tonic is the minor tonic, listening to the approach to the major tonic will help distinguish among these four-chord schema options. Listening to the approach to the minor tonic may not be helpful, since both the singer/songwriter and the hopscotch schemas approach the minor tonic by step.

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 重點整理本章圖式都以共通寫作時期音樂常見的模式為基礎。哀嘆圖式是四和弦圖式，低音沿小調四音列，從主音下行至屬音：do–te–le–sol [latex](\hat1-\downarrow\hat7-\downarrow\hat6-\hat5)[/latex]。典型配法是i–♭VII–♭VI–V，但te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex]可以用許多不同和弦配和聲。五度循環圖式至少有四個和弦，各和弦根音依序下行完全五度。它有許多變化，也不一定從主和弦開始。
en: Key Takeaways The schemas discussed in this chapter are all based on those often found in common-practice music. The lament schema is a four-chord schema that descends down the minor tetrachord from the tonic to the dominant: do-te-le-sol [latex](\hat1-\downarrow\hat7-\downarrow\hat6-\hat5)[/latex]. Most typically, this is harmonized by I–♭VII–♭VI–V, however, te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex] can be harmonized in numerous ways. The circle-of-fifths schema is at least four chords in length, and it consists of chords whose roots descend by perfect fifth. This schema has many possible variations and does not necessarily start on the tonic.

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 哀嘆
en: Lament

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 「哀嘆」進行得名於早期古典音樂：這個幾乎總在小調中的進行，常被用作哀嘆歌曲的固定低音。例如Henry Purcell歌劇《Dido and Aeneas》（《狄朵與埃涅阿斯》）中的〈狄朵的哀歌〉，以及J. S. Bach《B小調彌撒》中的〈被釘十字架〉。這些古典例子的詳情，請見〈固定低音〉章。
en: The “lament” progression is so named because in early classical music, this chord progression (almost always in minor) was used as the ground bass for songs of lament. Examples include “Dido’s Lament” by Henry Purcell, from the opera Dido and Aeneas, and J.S. Bach’s “Crucifixus,” from his Mass in B Minor. For more on those classical cases, see the Ground Bass chapter.

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: Dire Straits的〈Sultans of Swing〉，是流行／搖滾音樂中典型的哀嘆圖式例子（例1）。這個樂句的低音沿小調四音列do–te–le–sol [latex](\hat1-\downarrow\hat7-\downarrow\hat6-\hat5)[/latex]下行，以i–♭VII–♭VI–V三和弦配和聲。中間兩個和弦使用切分，而且時值較短，讓樂句末尾的屬和弦有空間再加入七音，形成銜接下一次和弦進行的回轉。
en: Dire Straits' "Sultans of Swing" provides a classic example of the lament in a pop/rock setting (Example 1). The phrase descends through the minor tetrachord do-te-le-sol [latex](\hat1-\downarrow\hat7-\downarrow\hat6-\hat5)[/latex] and is harmonized with diatonic triads: I–♭VII–♭VI–V. The middle two chords are syncopated and given less duration in order to make room for the seventh to be added to the dominant chord at the end of the phrase, which provides a turnaround to repeat the chord progression.

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 〈Sultans of Swing〉主歌開頭譜例原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例1，〈Sultans of Swing〉原章完整單頁譜。Dmi＝D小和弦；C、B♭、A為大和弦；A7為A屬七和弦。Dmi: i表示以D小調分析；♭VII、♭VI、V分別對應C、B♭、A。末尾A7加入七音形成回轉。歌詞片段的大意是黑暗中發抖、雨中的公園，以及時間上的轉折。

text: 例1。Dire Straits，〈Sultans of Swing〉（1978）。

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 例2呈現Muse〈Thoughts of a Dying Atheist〉的主歌開頭。注意，te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex]由第二轉位的B♭大和弦配和聲。它可以解讀為第二轉位的III，也可以像譜例的分析一樣，視為以兩個上鄰音修飾的VII和弦。
en: Example 2 shows the opening of the verse in Muse’s “Thoughts of a Dying Atheist.” Importantly, note that te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex] is harmonized by a B♭ major chord in second inversion. One may interpret this as a III chord in second inversion or, as is shown in the transcription, a VII chord embellished with two upper neighbor notes.

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 五度循環
en: Circle-of-Fifths

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 這個圖式中，每個和弦的根音都下行五度，接到下一個根音。它常出現在小調，從i開始，結束於關係大調。和創作歌手進行一樣，它也有些調性模糊：起始和弦容易被當成主和弦，但VII到III又很容易被聽成關係大調的V–I。因此，這個進行也能用來從關係小調移向關係大調。
en: In this schema, each chord’s root moves down by fifth to the next root. This progression often happens in minor, beginning on i and ending on the relative major. Like the “singer/songwriter” progression, there is some key ambiguity in this progression, as the starting chord is easily considered tonic, but the motion from VII to III can easily be heard as V–I in the relative major key. And indeed, it can be used to move from the relative minor to the relative major.

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: Aqua〈Barbie Girl〉的副歌，提供一個調性略為模糊的五度循環圖式例子（見例3）。
en: The chorus of Aqua's "Barbie Girl" provides a somewhat tonally ambiguous example of the circle-of-fifths schema (see Example 3).

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 〈Barbie Girl〉五度循環譜例原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例3，〈Barbie Girl〉原章完整單頁譜。Voice＝人聲；Electric Bass＝電貝斯。黑字E:以E大調分析為vi–ii–V–I；藍字C♯mi:以升C小調分析為i–iv–VII–III。C♯mi與F♯mi是小和弦，B與E是大和弦。圖中歌詞意為「我是芭比女孩，住在芭比的世界」。

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 例3。Aqua，〈Barbie Girl〉（1997）。
en: Example 3. Aqua, "Barbie Girl" (1997).

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: Muse〈Thoughts of a Dying Atheist〉的主歌，也在上述哀嘆圖式之後，緊接一個四和弦的五度循環圖式。這個進行立刻重複，回到起始小調；不過，第二次的「哀嘆—五度循環」組合，會導向關係大調的副歌，將III當成新的主和弦。
en: The verse of Muse’s “Thoughts of a Dying Atheist” also includes a four-chord circle-of-fifths schema, immediately following the lament discussed above. This progression immediately repeats, returning to the initial minor key. However, the second time through, this lament–circle-of-fifths pattern leads to a chorus in the relative major (taking the III chord as the new tonic).

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 流行／搖滾音樂中，也有更長的五度循環圖式。
en: Longer examples of the circle-of-fifths schema can be found in pop/rock music, too.

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: Radiohead〈You and Whose Army?〉（例5）的五度循環圖式稍微複雜一些。這裡使用帶半音變化的模進，每一對有五度關係的和弦，都在局部形成下一個和弦的副ii–V進行，很像爵士樂中的副ii–V進行。和〈Barbie Girl〉一樣，這首歌也有調性模糊：五度循環持續推動音樂，卻沒有強烈確立主音。E大調與C♯小調都能成立，因此下方分析同時列出兩種理解。
en: Radiohead's "You and Whose Army?" (Example 5) presents a slightly more complex instance of a circle-of-fifths schema. Here we get a chromatic sequence of the schema, in which each pair of fifth-related chords functions locally as an applied ii–V progression of the following chord, much like the applied ii–V progressions found in jazz. Like "Barbie Girl," "You and Whose Army?" is tonally ambiguous. The circle-of-fifths schema propels the music forward, without ever strongly confirming the tonic. Both E major and C♯ minor are viable interpretations, and thus have both been provided in the analysis below.

title: 流行音樂中的古典圖式
text: 〈You and Whose Army?〉半音化五度循環譜例原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例5，〈You and Whose Army?〉原章完整單頁譜。黑字C♯mi:以升C小調分析；藍字E:以E大調分析。of C♯、of B、of A分別表示括弧內的ii–V，以C♯、B、A為局部目標。mi表示小和弦；D♯mi–G♯、C♯mi–F♯、Bmi–E是三組副ii–V；後續A與C♯mi在兩個調性中分別具有不同級數。歌詞片段以反覆的挑戰語氣，質問對方及其同伴。

text: 重點整理Puff圖式以I–iii–IV進行為基礎。常見變化：I–III♯–IVi–III–iv
en: Key Takeaways Puff schemas are based on a I–iii–IV progression. Common variations: I–III♯–IV i–III–iv

title: Puff圖式
text: 本章播放清單
en: Chapter playlist

title: Puff圖式
text: 其他章節介紹的許多圖式，常作為反覆的和弦循環；但有些圖式更常充當具有明確方向、朝目標推進的樂句中的構成材料。使用中音三和弦iii的Puff圖式，就是其中之一。名稱來自Peter, Paul and Mary〈Puff, the Magic Dragon〉（1963）：這首歌的樂句開頭使用了此圖式。
en: While many of the schemas discussed in other chapters are commonly used as repeating chord loops, others are more often used as a building block within a goal-oriented phrase. Puff schemas, which use the mediant triad (iii), are one such schema. The name comes from its use at the outset of phrases in the song “Puff, the Magic Dragon” by Peter, Paul and Mary (1963).

title: Puff圖式
text: 和弦代號 A C♯mi D A 歌詞 Puff，那隻神奇的 龍， 住在 海邊。 羅馬數字 I iii IV I
en: Lead sheet A C♯mi D A Lyrics Puff, the magic dragon, lived by the sea. Roman numerals I iii IV I

title: Puff圖式
text: 例1。〈Puff, the Magic Dragon〉多數樂句都以Puff圖式開始。
en: Example 1. The puff schema begins most of the phrases in “Puff, the Magic Dragon.”

title: Puff圖式
text: Puff圖式通常出現在樂句開頭，就像例1。它通常不會直接循環反覆，因此IV之後的和弦可以改變。〈Puff〉的第四個和弦是I；Marvin Gaye〈Let’s Get It On〉則從IV接到V（例2）。The Animals〈House of the Rising Sun〉（1964）示範小調歌曲中的Puff圖式（例3）：這裡從大IV接到VI，顯示Puff圖式也能改變和弦性質。
en: The puff schema is typically found in the opening of phrases, as it is here (Example 1). Again, the puff schema is not typically looped, so the chords that come after the IV chord can vary. In “Puff,” the fourth chord is I. But in “Let’s Get It On” by Marvin Gaye, the IV chord progresses to V (Example 2). “House of the Rising Sun” by the Animals (1964) is an example of the puff schema in a minor-key song (Example 3); here, a major IV progresses to VI, demonstrating how the puff schema can involve varied chord quality.

title: Puff圖式
text: 和弦代號 E♭ Gmi7 A♭ A♭/B♭ 歌詞 ……我一直很努力 嘗試，寶貝 羅馬數字 I iii7 IV V11
en: Lead sheet E♭ Gmi7 A♭ A♭/B♭ Lyrics ………I’ve been really tryin, baby Roman numerals I iii7 IV V11

title: Puff圖式
text: 例2。〈Let’s Get It On〉的樂句先以Puff圖式開始，再以V–I進行收束。
en: Example 2. The phrases in “Let’s Get It On” begin with a puff schema before finishing with a V–I motion.

title: Puff圖式
text: 和弦代號 Ami C D F Ami C E 歌詞 有一幢房子 在紐奧良 人們叫它「升起的 太陽」 羅馬數字 i III IV VI i III V
en: Lead sheet Ami C D F Ami C E Lyrics There is a house in New Orleans they call the Rising Sun Roman numerals i III IV VI i III V

title: Puff圖式
text: 例3。〈House of the Rising Sun〉在小調中使用Puff圖式；IV也改用大和弦，而不是典型的小和弦。
en: Example 3. “House of the Rising Sun” uses the puff schema in minor. The IV chord is also major instead of the typical minor.

title: Puff圖式
text: I–III♯–IV
en: I–III♯–IV

title: Puff圖式
text: Puff圖式的一種常見半音變體，是將iii和弦的三音升高，變成大III♯和弦，形成I–III♯–IV。Radiohead的首支單曲〈Creep〉（原文標1993）明顯使用這個進行，將Puff圖式與帶有調式混合的變格圖式結合（例4）。
en: One particularly common chromatic variant of the puff schema raises the third of the iii chord to make it a major III♯ chord: I–III♯–IV. This progression is prominently featured in Radiohead’s debut single, “Creep” (1993). It combines the puff schema with a plagal schema with mode mixture (Example 4).

title: Puff圖式
text: 和弦代號 G B C Cmi 歌詞 當你先前在這裡 我無法直視你的 雙眼。你就像一位 天使，你的肌膚令我 落淚。 羅馬數字 I III♯ IV iv
en: Lead sheet G B C Cmi Lyrics When you were here before couldn’t look you in the eye. You’re just like an angel, your skin makes me cry. Roman numerals I III♯ IV iv

title: Puff圖式
text: 例4。Radiohead〈Creep〉使用帶大III♯和弦的Puff圖式；每個音樂內容欄相當於兩小節。
en: Example 4. "Creep” by Radiohead uses the puff schema with a major III♯ chord. (Each column = two measures.)

title: Puff圖式
text: 大III♯和弦中升高的三音，形成流暢的半音線sol–si–la [latex](\hat5-\sharp\hat5-\hat6)[/latex]，如例5。
en: The raised third in the major III♯ chord creates a nice chromatic line, sol–si–la [latex](\hat5-\sharp\hat5-\hat6)[/latex], as shown in Example 5.

title: Puff圖式
text: I–III♯–IV中的半音線譜例原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例5，〈Major III voice leading〉原章完整單頁譜。half-step＝半音，圖中兩處皆如此。C:表示C大調；C、E、F和弦分別是I、III♯、IV。藍色聲部G–G♯–A對應sol–si–la；升高的是E和弦的三音G♯。

title: Puff圖式
text: 例5。I–III♯–IV中的半音線。

title: Puff圖式
text: 將III♯–IV理解為假解決
en: III♯–IV as Deceptive Motion

title: Puff圖式
text: 許多情況下，III♯應解釋為副屬和弦V/vi。當III♯擔任V/vi，後面接vi就很自然。C–E–Ami–F這類進行，可以理解為創作歌手圖式的變化，以V/vi取代V。
en: In many cases, a III♯ chord should be interpreted as an applied chord: a V/vi. The III♯ chord, acting as V/vi, does sound good when followed by vi. A progression like C–E–Ami–F can be understood as a variation on the singer/songwriter schema, in which a V/vi replaces the V chord.

title: Puff圖式
text: 尤其當一首歌已使用C–E–Ami–F這類進行，另一處若由E直接接F，就可能被理解為III♯的假解決：
en: Especially in a song that uses a progression like C–E–Ami–F, moving from E straight to F in another progression could be understood as deceptively resolving the III♯ chord:

title: Puff圖式
text: 在A小調中，E–Ami是V–i。Ami是C大調的vi，因此在C大調中，E–Ami可以分析為V/vi–vi。在A小調中，E–F是V–VI，是V和弦的假解決。在C大調中，E–F仍可能聽起來像V/vi的假解決。
en: E–Ami is a V–i progression in the key of A minor. Ami is vi in the key of C major, so in C major, we can analyze E–Ami as V/vi–vi. E–F is a V–VI progression in the key of A minor, a deceptive resolution of the V chord. In C major, E–F may still sound like a deceptive resolution of the V/vi chord.

title: Puff圖式
text: MGMT〈Weekend Wars〉（2007）的一大特色，是在III♯作為V/vi時，交替運用假解決與正格解決。先用正格的V/vi–vi建立預期，便能讓聽者將後面的Puff進行感受為假解決（例6）。
en: The play between deceptive and authentic resolutions of III♯ as a V/vi chord is a remarkable feature of the progressions used in “Weekend Wars” by MGMT (2007). Setting up the puff schema with an authentic V/vi–vi progression prepares the listener to experience the puff progression as a deceptive resolution (Example 6).

title: Puff圖式
text: 正格解決 Puff圖式：假解決 和弦代號 A/C♯ Dmi C/E F A B♭ 歌詞 ……即刻擬出的作戰計畫 寫在人行道上 羅馬數字 V6/vi vi V6 I V/vi VI/vi（或III♯ IV）
en: authentic resolution puff schema: deceptive resolution Lead sheet A/C♯ Dmi C/E F A B♭ Lyrics … Instant battle plans written on the sidewalk Roman numerals V6/vi vi V6 I V/vi vi/vi (or III♯ IV)

text: Puff圖式（PDF、Word）：辨認多首使用Puff圖式的歌曲，其和弦進行為何。學習單播放清單。辨識圖式（PDF、Word）：從多種可能性中辨認流行歌曲圖式，包括以藍調為基礎的圖式、四和弦圖式、Puff圖式與古典圖式。學習單播放清單。
en: Puff schemas (.pdf, .docx). Asks students to identify the chord progressions of various songs that use the puff schema. Worksheet playlist Identifying schemas (.pdf, .docx). Asks students to identify schemas in pop songs from a wide pool of possibilities, including blues-based schemas, four-chord schemas, puff schemas, and classical schemas. Worksheet playlist

title: 調式圖式
text: 重點整理許多流行歌曲使用的和弦進行，會暗示大、小調以外的調式。使用某個調式圖式，不代表整首歌都嚴格維持在那個調式。可以將調式與大調、自然小調比較，找出構成其聲響特色的特徵音。混合利底安圖式：雙重變格：♭VII–IV–I。下主音往返：I–♭VII。愛奧利安圖式：下主音往返：i–♭VII，與混合利底安相同，但主和弦改為小和弦。愛奧利安往返：i–♭VII–♭VI–♭VII。愛奧利安終止：♭VI–♭VII–i，或以I結束。哀嘆：i–♭VII–♭VI–v。多利安圖式：多利安往返：i–IV。利底安圖式：利底安往返：I–II♯。利底安終止：II♯–IV–I。本書從不同角度討論調式。更多說明請見〈自然音調式入門（一般介紹）〉、〈和弦—音階理論（爵士）〉、〈自然音調式（二十／二十一世紀）〉與〈運用調式、音階與音集分析（二十／二十一世紀）〉。
en: Key Takeaways Many pop songs use harmonic progressions that imply modes other than major/minor. A modal schema may be used without the entire song being strictly within that mode. Modes may be compared to major and natural minor to understand what characterizes their sound (their color notes) Mixolydian schemas: Double plagal ♭VII–IV–I Subtonic shuttle I–♭VII Aeolian schemas: Subtonic shuttle i–♭VII (same as mixolydian, but with a minor tonic) Aeolian shuttle i–♭VII–♭VI–♭VII Aeolian cadence ♭VI–♭VII–i (or I) Lament i–♭VII–♭VI–v Dorian schemas: Dorian shuttle i–IV Lydian schemas: Lydian shuttle I–II♯ Lydian cadence II♯–IV–I This book covers modes from many different angles. For more information on modes, check Introduction to Diatonic Modes (general), Chord-Scale Theory (jazz), Diatonic Modes (20th/21st-c.), and Analyzing with Modes, Scales, and Collections (20th-/21st-c.).

title: 調式圖式
text: 本章播放清單
en: Chapter Playlist

title: 調式圖式
text: 「調式」是個十分複雜的術語。作為音樂學標準學術百科全書的《Grove Music Online》，其調式條目由九位作者共同撰寫，原文指出篇幅達238頁（Powers等人，2001）。因此，即使你認為自己已了解調式，學習它在流行音樂中的用法時，仍不妨暫時放下既有認識。
en: "Mode" is a really complicated term. The article on mode in Grove Music Online (Powers et al. 2001), which is the standard academic encyclopedia for musicology, is 238 pages long and has nine authors. This means that, even if you think you already know about modes, you may want to set that knowledge aside before learning how modes are used in pop music.

title: 調式圖式
text: 本章討論調式如何出現在流行與搖滾音樂的特定和弦圖式中，主要依據Nicole Biamonte（2010）與Philip Tagg（2011）的研究。先比較調式和聲與自然音和聲的功能，再依所借用的調式，分組介紹常見圖式。
en: This chapter discusses modes as they appear in certain schematic chord progressions in pop and rock music. Most of this information is based on the work of Nicole Biamonte (2010) and Philip Tagg (2011). After showing the function of modal harmonies as they compare to diatonic harmonies, common modal schemas will be introduced, grouped by the mode they borrow from.

title: 調式圖式
text: 依主和弦是大和弦還是小和弦，將調式分組，有助於聽辨調式片段，見例1。上排的第三級[latex]\hat3[/latex]與主音相距大三度，即mi，包括大調、混合利底安與利底安；下排的第三級[latex]\hat3[/latex]與主音相距小三度，即me，包括愛奧利安、多利安與弗里吉安。例1也顯示這些調式與大、小調的差異：以較淺顏色標出的音，相對於大調或自然小調有所改變，稱為該調式的特徵音。[1]虛線圓弧連接這些對應關係。
en: Grouping modes by whether the tonic is major or minor helps with aural identification of modal passages. This grouping is represented in Example 1. The top line shows modes whose [latex]\hat3[/latex] is a major third above tonic (mi): major, mixolydian, and lydian. The bottom line shows modes whose [latex]\hat3[/latex] is a minor third above tonic (me): aeolian, dorian, and phrygian. Example 1 also illustrates what differentiates certain modes from major or minor. Each mode has exactly one pitch shown in a lighter color; this pitch is inflected when compared to major/minor. These special pitches are referred to as the color note of each mode.[1] These relationships are shown with the dotted slurs.

title: 調式圖式
text: 依主和弦性質分組的調式比較譜原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例1，調式比較完整單頁原譜。C major＝C大調；C mixolydian＝C混合利底安；C lydian＝C利底安；C aeolian (natural minor)＝C愛奧利安（自然小調）；C dorian＝C多利安；C phrygian＝C弗里吉安。上排以大調比較B→B♭及F→F♯；下排以自然小調比較A♭→A及D→D♭。

title: 調式圖式
text: 例1。依大、小主和弦分組的調式；虛線連接各調式的特徵音與大調／自然小調中的對應音。
en: Example 1. Modes grouped by major vs. minor tonic, with dotted slurs connecting the distinctive color pitch of each mode with its major/minor counterpart.

title: 調式圖式
text: 調式和聲的功能
en: Function of Modal Harmonies

title: 調式圖式
text: 你可能已學過自然音和聲中的主功能、下屬功能與屬功能。調式和聲的功能，大致與其自然音對應和弦一致；不過，加入調式變音之後，這些功能之間會有更多重疊，整理於例2。
en: You may already have learned about tonic, subdominant, and dominant function in diatonic harmony. Modal harmonies basically align in function with their diatonic counterparts, although the additional modal inflections create greater overlap between these functions. This is summarized in Example 2.

title: 調式圖式
text: 例2。調式和聲讓同一和弦能採用更多不同色彩，同時仍保留其功能。
en: Example 2. Modal harmony allows many more "flavors" of the same chord to be implemented without changing the function of the chord.

title: 調式圖式
text: 這張和聲功能圖，有助於理解為什麼某些調式進行，和自然音進行一樣具有朝目標前進的感覺。
en: This illustration of harmonic function may help you to understand why certain modal progressions seem as goal-oriented as diatonic progressions.

title: 調式圖式
text: 混合利底安：♭VII
en: Mixolydian: ♭VII

title: 調式圖式
text: 混合利底安的特徵音是te（[latex]\downarrow\hat{7}[/latex]），見例3。大調流行歌曲中的♭VII，借自混合利底安調式。♭VII通常具有屬功能；在雙重變格與混合利底安終止圖式中，可以把它理解為傳統大調V和弦的替代（例4）。
en: Mixolydian's color note is te ([latex]\downarrow\hat{7}[/latex]), as shown in Example 3. In major-mode pop songs, the ♭VII chord is borrowed from the mixolydian mode. ♭VII typically has dominant function, and you might think of it as a substitute for the traditional major-mode V chord in both the double plagal and mixolydian cadence schemas (Example 4).

title: 調式圖式
text: 例3。[latex]\downarrow\hat{7}[/latex]（te）是混合利底安的特徵音。重要的混合利底安和弦v與♭VII都包含此音；iiio不在本章常用和弦之列。
en: Example 3. [latex]\downarrow\hat{7}[/latex] (te) is the color note of the mixolydian mode. Important mixolydian harmonies have that color note in them: v and ♭VII. (iiio is not used.)

title: 調式圖式
text: 混合利底安和弦圖式譜例原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例4，混合利底安圖式完整單頁原譜。Double plagal＝雙重變格；Subtonic shuttle＝下主音往返。左框：B♭（♭VII）相當於F調的IV，因此產生兩次連續變格進行，以圓弧連接。右框：往返圖式在兩個和弦之間不斷來回。原譜右側使用反覆記號和雙向箭頭，不另標終止。

title: 調式圖式
text: 例4。雙重變格與下主音往返，是兩種特別常見的混合利底安進行；原文在此將後者稱為「混合利底安終止」，名稱差異請見上方譯註。
en: Example 4. The double plagal schema and the mixolydian cadence schema are two especially common mixolydian chord progressions.

title: 調式圖式
text: 雙重變格
en: Double plagal

title: 調式圖式
text: 〈以藍調為基礎的圖式〉章詳細討論的雙重變格圖式♭VII–IV–I，也屬於混合利底安圖式，因為它使用大主和弦及[latex]\downarrow\hat{7}[/latex]，即te。
en: The double plagal schema, ♭VII–IV–I, which is discussed further in the blues-based schemas chapter, is also a mixolydian schema, due to the major tonic and the [latex]\downarrow\hat{7}[/latex] (te).

title: 調式圖式
text: 下主音往返
en: Subtonic shuttle

title: 調式圖式
text: 例5。The Kinks〈Tired of Waiting for You〉的前奏與主歌使用下主音往返。譜例從0:07開始。
en: Example 5. "Tired of Waiting for You" by the Kinks uses the subtonic shuttle in its intro and verses. Transcription begins at 0:07.

title: 調式圖式
text: 混合利底安最具代表性的進行是下主音往返：♭VII–I，在C調中即B♭–C，見上方例4。The Kinks〈Tired of Waiting for You〉（1965）的前奏與第一次主歌，持續使用這種往返：器樂聲部在I與♭VII之間來回，旋律則將[latex]\downarrow\hat{7}[/latex]，即te，用作裝飾音與旋律目標（例5）。
en: The most distinctive chord progression in mixolydian is the subtonic shuttle, ♭VII–I, or B♭–C in C major (Example 4 above). The subtonic shuttle is used continuously throughout the intro and first verse of "Tired of Waiting for You" by the Kinks (1965), where the instrumental parts shuttle between I and ♭VII throughout, while the melody emphasizes [latex]\downarrow\hat{7}[/latex] (te) as an embellishment and melodic goal (Example 5).

title: 調式圖式
text: 愛奧利安：♭VII與♭VI
en: Aeolian: ♭VII and ♭VI

title: 調式圖式
text: 愛奧利安可以看成與自然小音階具有相同音高材料；但作為調性或音集來理解時，本章將它與一般小調區分，因為流行音樂中的愛奧利安，會突出le與te [latex](\downarrow\hat6, \downarrow\hat7)[/latex]。這些特徵音形成♭VI與♭VII，是愛奧利安的代表和弦。雖然它們屬於小調／愛奧利安的自然音和弦，記號仍加上降號，以免與viio混淆。愛奧利安圖式使用其中一個或兩個和弦（例6）；♭VI具下屬功能，♭VII具屬功能。
en: You may think of aeolian as equivalent to the natural minor scale. As a key or collection, though, aeolian and minor are different, because aeolian (as used in pop music) will prominently feature le and te [latex](\downarrow\hat6, \downarrow\hat7)[/latex]. These color note scale degrees give us the ♭VI and ♭VII chords, which are the signature chords of the aeolian mode. (Note the use of flat signs in label of ♭VI and ♭VII, even though they are diatonic in minor/aeolian—this is to prevent confusion with viio.) Aeolian schemas use one or both of these harmonies (Example 6). The ♭VI chord has subdominant function, and the ♭VII chord has dominant function.

title: 調式圖式
text: 四種愛奧利安和弦圖式譜例原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例6，愛奧利安圖式完整單頁原譜。Subtonic shuttle＝下主音往返：小i使此往返呈愛奧利安；大I則是混合利底安。Aeolian shuttle＝愛奧利安往返：空心符頭表示核心i–♭VI，實心符頭的♭VII作經過和弦。Aeolian cadence＝愛奧利安終止：常用皮卡第三度，即大I；♭VI與♭VII仍使整體保有愛奧利安色彩。Lament＝哀嘆：圖式有多種變化，此版本持續使用降第六與降第七級，符合愛奧利安。圖中依序為Cmi–B♭、Cmi–B♭–A♭–B♭、A♭–B♭–C、Cmi–B♭–A♭–Gmi。

title: 調式圖式
text: 例6。下主音往返、愛奧利安往返、愛奧利安終止與哀嘆，是四種常見的愛奧利安進行。
en: Example 6. The subtonic shuttle, aeolian shuttle, aeolian cadence, and lament schemas are four common aeolian chord progressions.

title: 調式圖式
text: 例7。Gotye〈Somebody That I Used to Know〉的前奏與主歌使用下主音往返，副歌則使用愛奧利安往返。前奏譜例從0:04開始，副歌從1:32開始。
en: Example 7. "Somebody That I Used to Know" by Gotye features the subtonic shuttle in its intro/verses and the aeolian shuttle in its choruses. The Intro transcription begins at 0:04, and the Chorus transcription begins at 1:32.

title: 調式圖式
text: 下主音往返
en: Subtonic shuttle

title: 調式圖式
text: 前文把下主音往返介紹為混合利底安進行，但它也能用於愛奧利安，差別只在主和弦的性質。主和弦若為大和弦，暗示混合利底安；若為小和弦，則暗示愛奧利安。因此，♭VII–i，也就是C小調中的B♭–Cmi，是下主音往返的小調版本。Gotye〈Somebody That I Used to Know〉（2011，例7）的前奏與主歌使用這個圖式。
en: The subtonic shuttle was introduced as a mixolydian progression, but the same progression can be used in aeolian. The difference is only in the quality of the tonic chord. If it's major, then the subtonic shuttle implies mixolydian; if it's minor, then the subtonic shuttle implies aeolian. In other words, ♭VII–i, or B♭–Cmi in C minor, is the minor version of the subtonic shuttle. This subtonic shuttle is used in the intro and verses of "Somebody That I Used to Know" by Gotye (2011, Example 7).

title: 調式圖式
text: 愛奧利安往返
en: Aeolian shuttle

title: 調式圖式
text: 愛奧利安另一個常見往返是i–♭VII–♭VI–♭VII。它可理解為i與♭VI之間的往返，途中加入經過和弦♭VII。Gotye〈Somebody That I Used to Know〉（2011，例7）的副歌清楚使用這個進行。
en: Another common shuttle in aeolian is i–♭VII–♭VI–♭VII. This progression can be understood as a shuttle between i and ♭VI, with a passing ♭VII chord along the way. This progression is featured clearly in the chorus of "Somebody That I Used to Know" by Gotye (2011, Example 7).

title: 調式圖式
text: 例8。Howard Shore《魔戒》配樂的魔戒遠征隊主題，以愛奧利安終止結束樂句。譜例從0:27開始。
en: Example 8. The Fellowship Theme from the Lord of the Rings soundtrack by Howard Shore concludes its phrases with an aeolian cadence. Transcription begins at 0:27.

title: 調式圖式
text: 愛奧利安終止
en: Aeolian cadence

title: 調式圖式
text: 愛奧利安往返不斷在i與♭VI之間來回，很難暗示真正的終止：終止表示抵達目標，但這種循環進行似乎沒有固定終點。愛奧利安終止♭VI–♭VII–i，也就是A♭–B♭–Cmi，與往返圖式相似，卻具有明確方向：它在主和弦上終止，通常不作為循環。愛奧利安終止經常使用皮卡第三度，讓所有和弦都成為大和弦：♭VI–♭VII–I，也就是A♭–B♭–C。
en: In the aeolian shuttle schema, the consistent shuttling back and forth between I and ♭VI makes it difficult for a true cadence to be implied—a cadence means that a goal has been reached, but a circular progression like the aeolian shuttle doesn't seem to have a goal. The aeolian cadence ♭VI–♭VII–i, or A♭–B♭–Cmi, is similar to the aeolian shuttle, but it's goal-oriented: it cadences on the tonic chord, and it does not tend to be used as a loop. The aeolian cadence very frequently uses a picardy third, which means all the chords are major: ♭VI–♭VII–I, or A♭–B♭–C.

title: 調式圖式
text: 愛奧利安終止對許多人帶有文化聯想，常與成功、英雄氣概相關。《魔戒》的魔戒遠征隊主題，就在樂句結尾使用它（例8，0:27開始）。它也被稱為瑪利歐終止，因為《超級瑪利歐兄弟》每關結束時，那段著名號角音樂就採用此進行；其他遊戲，例如《Final Fantasy》，也常把它用作勝利號角。這些例子都以皮卡第三度收尾。
en: The aeolian cadence has a lot of cultural associations for many people and is typically associated with success and heroism. This cadence concludes the phrases of the Fellowship Theme from Lord of the Rings (Example 8, begins at 0:27). The aeolian cadence has also been called the Mario cadence, since the well-known fanfare at the end of each level of Super Mario Bros. uses this progression; the progression is often heard as a fanfare in other video games, such as Final Fantasy. In all of these examples, the cadence concludes with a picardy third.

title: 調式圖式
text: 例9。Eva Simons〈I Don’t Like You〉使用包含♭VII與小v的哀嘆圖式。
en: Example 9. "I Don't Like You" by Eva Simons uses a lament schema with ♭VII and minor v.

title: 調式圖式
text: 哀嘆
en: Lament

title: 調式圖式
text: 哀嘆圖式有許多變化，詳見介紹該圖式的章節。其中i–♭VII–♭VI–v特別帶有愛奧利安色彩：它不用會暗示功能性小調的導音，而使用愛奧利安的特徵音te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex]。Eva Simons〈I Don’t Like You〉（2012，例9）就能聽到這個版本。
en: The lament schema has many variations, as discussed in the chapter addressing that schema. One particular flavor, i–♭VII–♭VI–v, strongly implies the aeolian mode due to the absence of a leading tone, which would imply a minor tonality, in favor of te [latex](\downarrow\hat7)[/latex], a color note of aeolian. This variation of the lament schema is heard in "I Don't Like You" by Eva Simons (2012, Example 9).

title: 調式圖式
text: 多利安：小主和弦搭配大IV
en: Dorian: IV with a Minor Tonic

title: 調式圖式
text: 多利安聽起來接近小調，但以la取代le，即[latex](\hat6 \text{ instead of} \downarrow\hat6)[/latex]。這會改變和弦性質，例如產生大IV，而不是小調中的小iv，見例10。在以小和弦為主和弦的歌曲中使用大IV，是多利安的重要標誌；否則它可能聽起來像小調／愛奧利安。多利安的大IV通常具有下屬功能。
en: Dorian is a mode that sounds like minor, but with la instead of le [latex](\hat6 \text{ instead of} \downarrow\hat6)[/latex], which produces altered harmonies including a major IV chord (compared to the minor iv in minor), shown in Example 10. Using a major IV chord in songs with a minor tonic is the primary marker of a dorian song, which would otherwise sound like it was minor/aeolian. The major IV chord in dorian usually has a subdominant function.

title: 調式圖式
text: 例10。多利安與自然小音階的差別，在於相對自然小調升高的第六級[latex]\uparrow\hat{6}[/latex]（la），它改變IV與ii的和弦性質；vi°不在本章常用和弦之列。
en: Example 10. Dorian is distinguished from the natural minor scale by its [latex]\uparrow\hat{6}[/latex] (la), which alters the quality of the IV and ii chords. (vi° is not used.)

title: 調式圖式
text: 例11。〈Get Lucky〉在本例分析為B多利安，每四小節以具有代表性的IV–i進行強調Bmi主和弦，箭頭標出跨循環的回歸。
en: Example 11. "Get Lucky" is in B dorian and features a characteristic IV–i motion every four bars (shown here by the arrows) to emphasize Bmi as tonic.

title: 調式圖式
text: 多利安特別常與放克、迪斯可及其衍生曲風相聯繫，多利安往返在這些曲風中尤其普遍。CHIC〈Dance, Dance, Dance〉（原文標1979）是眾多例子之一。較少聽這些曲風的人，可能不易辨認多利安往返，反而聽成ii–V。多聽放克與迪斯可，有助於把那個看似ii的和弦聽成i，即使是Daft Punk〈Get Lucky〉（2013，例11）這類多利安色彩較有歧義的歌曲，也能如此理解。
en: The dorian mode is especially associated with funk, disco, and its derivative genres, where the dorian shuttle is especially pervasive. One example of many is "Dance, Dance, Dance" by CHIC (1979). Some people who haven't listened to much music from these genres have trouble aurally recognizing the dorian shuttle and hear it instead as ii–V. Listening to a lot of funk and disco should help you learn to hear that "ii chord" as a i chord, even in more ambiguously dorian songs like Daft Punk's "Get Lucky" (2013, Example 11).

title: 調式圖式
text: 多利安往返
en: Dorian shuttle

title: 調式圖式
text: 多利安往返在大IV與小i之間交替（例12），整體形成主和聲延長。IV的上方聲部常呈鄰音進行，強調相對自然小調升高的la [latex](\uparrow\hat6)[/latex]。常見變化是擴成i–IV–i7–IV，進一步延伸上方聲部的鄰音效果。
en: The dorian shuttle alternates between a major IV chord and a minor i chord (Example 12). The overall effect of this progression is one of tonic prolongation. The upper notes of the IV harmony often form a neighboring motion that emphasizes la [latex](\uparrow\hat6)[/latex]. A common variation on the dorian shuttle is expanded to i–IV–i7–IV. This further expands the neighboring effect in the upper voices.

title: 調式圖式
text: 多利安往返及其擴展譜例原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例12，多利安往返完整單頁原譜。Dorian shuttle＝多利安往返。右框：多利安往返可以為拱形旋律配和聲，最高處落在i⁷和弦。Cm:表示C小調背景；i／i⁷為C小和弦／C小七和弦，IV為含A自然音的F大和弦。

title: 調式圖式
text: 例12。多利安往返使用小i與大IV，也能擴展出向上拱至i7的線條。
en: Example 12. The dorian shuttle uses minor i and major IV. It can be expanded to arch up to i7.

title: 調式圖式
text: 利底安：II♯
en: Lydian: II♯

title: 調式圖式
text: Fi [latex](\uparrow\hat4)[/latex]是利底安的特徵音，讓第二級和弦成為大II，而非大調中的小ii（例13）。為了清楚區分，本書將此和弦寫成II♯；升號表示和弦三音升高。
en: Fi [latex](\uparrow\hat4)[/latex] is the color note of the lydian mode, which results in a major II chord instead of the minor ii found in major (Example 13). This text refers to this chord as II♯ for clarity, with the sharp sign representing the raised third of the chord.

title: 調式圖式
text: 例13：利底安類似大調，但第四級升高，因此形成大II和弦。♯iv°與vii不在本章常用和弦之列。
en: Example 13: Lydian is like major with a raised scale-degree 4. This results in a major II chord. (ivº and vii are not used.)

title: 調式圖式
text: 例13。利底安類似大調，但使用[latex]\uparrow\hat{4}[/latex]（fi），因此形成大II和弦。♯iv°與vii不在本章常用和弦之列。
en: Example 13. Lydian is like major with [latex]\uparrow\hat{4}[/latex] (fi). This results in a major II chord. (iv° and vii are not used.)

title: 調式圖式
text: 如果II♯接到V，如古典音樂常見的情形，就應把它理解為副屬和弦V/V。流行歌曲中的II♯卻常接向其他和弦，因此本章使用II♯這個記號。
en: If II♯ goes to V, as it typically does in classical music, the chord should be understood as as a secondary dominant V/V instead. But in pop tunes, II♯ often leads elsewhere, necessitating the II♯ label.

title: 調式圖式
text: 很少有流行歌曲從頭到尾嚴格維持利底安，但許多大調歌曲會用大II♯代替通常的小ii，暫時帶出利底安色彩，同時在整體上仍維持大調。
en: Very few pop songs are truly in the lydian mode all the way through the song, but many major-mode pop songs use a major II♯ chord in place of the typical minor ii, giving a brief lydian flavor while remaining overall in the major mode.

title: 調式圖式
text: II♯可以有下屬功能或屬功能，以下兩種圖式分別展現這些用法（例14）。
en: II♯ can have either subdominant or dominant function, and each is used in the following two schemas (Example 14).

title: 調式圖式
text: 兩種利底安和弦圖式譜例原章嵌入譜的完整單頁原圖，已保存供離線閱讀，附中文圖例。 原章線上譜例至原來源查看譜例／圖片 ↗例14，利底安圖式完整單頁原譜。Lydian shuttle＝利底安往返；Lydian cadence＝利底安終止。左框：辨認時要小心，同樣的C–D也可能是G調IV–V，或D調♭VII–I等。右上框：下行半音線形成朝向主和弦的旋律趨勢。右下plagal cadence＝變格終止，指IV–I這一步。II♯–IV–I即D–F–C，上方半音線依序F♯–F–E。

title: 調式圖式
text: 例14。II♯是利底安的代表和弦，兩個圖式都使用它。
en: Example 14. The II♯ chord is the characteristic chord of lydian and is used in both of these schemas.

title: 調式圖式
text: 利底安往返
en: Lydian shuttle

title: 調式圖式
text: 最基本的利底安進行，是II♯與I之間的簡單往返。要正確辨認並不容易：由於很少有歌曲全程維持利底安，後面的IV或ii常會取消先前的調式變音，讓歌曲整體仍呈大調，只短暫使用II♯。Fleetwood Mac〈Sara〉（1979）的開頭，可以聽到這個進行的變化。它加入Ima7，為拱形旋律配和聲，並在II♯下方保留主音持續低音。歌曲後面使用Doo-wop圖式，消除II♯造成的利底安色彩。Mark Spicer提供了這個分析的圖例。
en: The most basic lydian chord progression is a simple shuttle between II♯ and I. Identifying this chord progression correctly can be tricky: because few pop songs are truly in lydian throughout, this II♯ chord is often neutralized later in the chord progression with a IV chord or a ii chord, which means the song is overall in major, but with a brief II♯ chord. This progression can be heard with some alterations in the opening of "Sara" by Fleetwood Mac (1979). "Sara" expands the lydian shuttle to include a Ima7 chord to harmonize an arching melody, and it also uses a tonic pedal underneath the II♯ chord. Later on in the song, the II♯ is neutralized by the use of a doo-wop schema. This is illustrated by Mark Spicer.

title: 調式圖式
text: 如果II♯的特徵音一直沒有被還原，也有可能實際進行根本不是I–II♯，而是另一種根音呈級進的往返。比如Taylor Swift〈Starlight〉（2012）的主歌，從0:26起在A與B大和弦間交替，但它們是E大調的IV–V，不是利底安往返。0:56進入副歌後，輪換的Doo-wop圖式讓這點更清楚。前文的下主音往返，也是兩個大和弦根音呈級進的例子。辨認時要留意，利底安在流行音樂中相對少見。
en: If the II♯ chord is never neutralized, it's possible that the chord progression isn't really I–II♯, but another shuttle that relates roots by step. For example, Taylor Swift's "Starlight" (2012) has verses that alternate between A and B major chords (begins at 0:26), but they are IV–V in E major, not a lydian shuttle. This becomes clear in the chorus (0:56), which is harmonized with a rotation of the doo-wop schema. The subtonic shuttle discussed earlier in this chapter is another chord progression that relates two major chords by step. Remember that lydian is rare in pop music, and be careful when identifying this progression!

title: 調式圖式
text: 在這個進行中，II♯具屬功能，利用fi到sol的半音[latex](\uparrow\hat4-\hat5)[/latex]，帶回主和弦。
en: In this progression, II♯ functions as a dominant chord, leading back into the tonic with the half step between fi and sol [latex](\uparrow\hat4-\hat5)[/latex].

title: 調式圖式
text: 例15：〈Forget You〉全曲循環使用利底安終止，伴唱持續呈現其特有的半音線。
en: Example 15: "Forget You" loops a lydian cadence throughout the song. The background vocals always have the characteristic chromatic line.

title: 調式圖式
text: 利底安終止
en: Lydian cadence

title: 調式圖式
text: 最流行的II♯進行，是利底安終止II♯–IV–I，在C調中即D–F–C。注意，利底安的fi [latex](\uparrow\hat{4})[/latex]隨即被一般IV和弦還原為fa [latex](\hat4)[/latex]。此圖式也有流暢的半音聲部連接，可能是它吸引人的部分原因。Cee Lo Green〈Forget You〉（2010，例15）是相當清楚的例子。[2]
en: The most popular progression using II♯ is the lydian cadence II♯–IV–I, or D–F–C in C major. Notice that the lydian fi [latex](\uparrow\hat{4})[/latex] is immediately neutralized by the regular IV chord, replacing it with fa [latex](\hat4)[/latex]. This schema also features smooth chromatic voice leading, which may partially explain the appeal of this progression. The clearest example of this schema may be Cee Lo Green's "Forget You" (2010, Example 15).[2]

title: 調式圖式
text: 用耳朵辨認調式
en: Identifying Modes by Ear

title: 調式圖式
text: 如果不習慣演奏或聆聽調式音樂，要用耳朵區分它們，可能會覺得困難。以下逐步流程可用來分辨本章主要討論的調式，例16將它畫成流程圖。
en: If you are not used to playing in and listening to modes, it can be daunting to identify and distinguish modes by ear. Here is a step-by-step process for aurally distinguishing all the modes discussed here, illustrated as a flowchart in Example 16.

title: 調式圖式
text: 1. 辨認主和弦的性質。
en: 1. Identify the quality of tonic.

title: 調式圖式
text: 例16。用耳朵辨認調式的流程圖。
en: EXAMPLE 16. Flowchart illustrating the process of identifying modes by ear.

title: 調式圖式
text: 先聽出主音，再聽完整的主和弦。主和弦的三音，與主音相距大三度還是小三度？這能區分偏大調的類型——大調、混合利底安、利底安，以及偏小調的類型——小調、愛奧利安、多利安。
en: Listen for the tonic pitch. Then, listen for the whole tonic chord. Is the third of that chord major or minor? This distinguishes the major-ish modes (major, mixolydian, lydian) from the minor-ish modes (minor, aeolian, dorian).

title: 調式圖式
text: 2. 聽第七級[latex]\hat{7}[/latex]：ti或te。
en: 2. Listen for [latex]\hat{7}[/latex] (ti or te).

title: 調式圖式
text: 把第七級[latex]\hat{7}[/latex]與平常大、小調歌曲中的導音ti比較，導音位於主音下方半音。如果第七級[latex]\hat{7}[/latex]在主音下方全音，即te，便屬降低的第七級，表示歌曲至少暫時帶有本章所說的調式性。
en: Compare the [latex]\hat{7}[/latex] to the leading tone (ti) a half step below tonic that we typically hear in minor and major songs. If [latex]\hat{7}[/latex] is a whole step below tonic (te), then it's lowered, which means that the song is (at least temporarily) in a mode.

title: 調式圖式
text: 如果聽到大主和弦，而且第七級[latex]\hat{7}[/latex]降低為te，就是混合利底安。
en: If you heard a major tonic and [latex]\hat{7}[/latex] is lowered (te), then you are in mixolydian.

title: 調式圖式
text: 如果聽到小主和弦，而且第七級[latex]\hat{7}[/latex]升高為導音ti，就是本章所區分的小調。
en: If you heard a minor tonic and [latex]\hat{7}[/latex] is raised (ti), then you are in minor.

title: 調式圖式
text: 若還不能確定調式，繼續第三步。
en: If your mode is not already identified, proceed to step 3.

title: 調式圖式
text: 3. 聽其他升高的特徵音：大調側的fi [latex](\uparrow\hat4)[/latex]，以及小調側的la [latex](\uparrow\hat6)[/latex]。
en: 3. Listen for other raised color notes—fi [latex](\uparrow\hat4)[/latex] in major, and la [latex](\uparrow\hat6)[/latex] in minor.

title: 調式圖式
text: 如果第七級[latex]\hat7[/latex]仍不足以辨認調式，就聽其他升高的特徵音。
en: If [latex]\hat7[/latex] did not identify the mode for you, listen for other raised color notes.

title: 調式圖式
text: 在大主和弦的調式中，若第四級[latex]\hat{4}[/latex]升高為fi，就是利底安；若沒有升高，則是大調。
en: If [latex]\hat{4}[/latex] is raised (fi) in a major-tonic mode, you are in lydian. If it is not, you are in major.

title: 調式圖式
text: 在小主和弦的調式中，若第六級[latex]\hat{6}[/latex]相對自然小調升高為la，就是多利安；若沒有，則是愛奧利安。
en: If [latex]\hat{6}[/latex] is raised (la) in a minor-tonic mode, you are in dorian. If not, you are in aeolian.
