text: decrescendo（漸弱）音量逐漸減弱；樂譜有時以髮夾形記號表示。
en: decrescendo Getting gradually softer; sometimes represented in notated scores with a hairpin symbol.

title: 詞彙表
text: 旋律進行的延遲在對位中，一種協和弱拍型態：先作三度跳進，再級進至下一強拍。
en: delay of melodic progression In counterpoint, a type of consonant weak beat that skips by third and then steps into the following downbeat.

title: 詞彙表
text: Dembow每一拍都打大鼓，小鼓演奏tresillo節奏後兩組起點的一種鼓型。
en: dembow A drumbeat in which the kick drum plays on every beat, while the snare plays the last two parts of a tresillo rhythm.

title: 詞彙表
text: 依附型過渡部重用主要主題動機素材的奏鳴曲式過渡部。
en: dependent transition A sonata-form transition that reuses motivic material from the primary theme.

title: 詞彙表
text: 衍生音列（derived row）由同一集合類的多個實例構成的十二音音列，例如三個同類四音組，或四個同類三音組。
en: derived row A 12-tone tonerow formed of the same pitch class set several time such as 3 tetrachords or 4 trichords.

title: 詞彙表
text: 繞道替代路徑的一種類型，使樂句暫時偏離原先預期通往終止式的路徑。先轉入繞道路線，最後再恢復樂句稍早的表達方式。
en: detour A type of alternative path. A detour creates a temporary deviation from a phrase's expected trajectory toward a cadence. Detours are initiated by a diversion onto the detour and they end with a resumption of rhetoric from earlier in the phrase.

title: 詞彙表
text: 發展部（development）奏鳴曲式中較不穩定的段落；它可能發展呈示部已建立的主題材料，也可能不以這些材料為重點。
en: development A section of a sonata form that is unstable, and that may or may not explore thematic material established in the exposition.

title: 詞彙表
text: 自然音的／調內的（diatonic）1. 音階、調式或音集依全、全、半、全、全、全、半排列，或採用這個模式的任一輪換。2. 屬於當下的調，與半音變化的（chromatic）相對。
en: diatonic 1. A scale, mode, or collection that follows the pattern of whole and half steps W–W–H–W–W–W–H, or any rotation of that pattern. 2. Belonging to the local key (as opposed to "chromatic").

title: 詞彙表
text: 自然音和聲（diatonic harmony）以自然音音階為基礎的和聲，例如鋼琴白鍵所形成的音階。分析時可用羅馬數字標記這些和弦。
en: diatonic harmony Harmony that is based in a diatonic scale, such as the white notes of the piano. In analysis, diatonic harmonies may be labeled with with Roman numerals.

title: 詞彙表
text: 自然音調式（diatonic mode）以自然音音集中的音所組成的音階。
en: diatonic mode A scale made up of the notes of the diatonic collection.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聽寫聽覺技能練習的一種，由學生把聽到的範例寫成五線譜。
en: dictation A type of aural skills exercise in which aural examples are written by the student in staff notation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 減音程比完全音程或小音程小半音的音程。
en: diminished intervals Intervals that are one half step smaller than a perfect or minor interval.

title: 詞彙表
text: 減七和弦全減七和弦的另一名稱，即由減三和弦加上根音上方減七度音構成的七和弦。
en: diminished seventh chord Another name for a fully diminished seventh chord, a seventh chord with a diminished triad and a diminished seventh.

title: 詞彙表
text: 減三和弦三音與根音形成小三度、五音與根音形成減五度的三和弦。
en: diminished triad A triad whose third is minor and fifth is diminished.

title: 詞彙表
text: diminuendo（漸弱）音量逐漸減弱，與decrescendo同義。
en: diminuendo Getting gradually softer; decrescendo.

title: 詞彙表
text: 直接五度或八度以同向進行進入五度或八度，也稱隱伏五度或八度。
en: direct fifths or octaves Similar motion into a fifth or octave. Also called hidden fifths or octaves.

title: 詞彙表
text: 不重疊的（discrete）彼此分開、沒有重疊。
en: discrete Non-overlapping; separate.

title: 詞彙表
text: 動機移位（拍節位置）改變動機相對於最初陳述時的拍節位置。
en: displacement (of a motive) Changing the metric position of the motive relative to its original statement.

title: 詞彙表
text: 位移不協和（displacement dissonance）拍節不協和的一種：兩個以上音樂層次暗示相同拍節，但其中一層相對另一層，固定錯開一段節奏時值，稱為位移量。
en: displacement dissonance A type of metrical dissonance in which two or more musical layers imply the same meter, but one is offset from the other by a consistent rhythmic value (the "displacement index").

title: 詞彙表
text: 位移量（displacement index）位移不協和中，兩個音樂層次彼此錯開的節奏時值。
en: displacement index The rhythmic value by which two musical layers are offset from one another in a displacement dissonance.

title: 詞彙表
text: 不協和在音程或和弦中感受到的一種聽覺粗糙感。
en: dissonance A perceived quality of auditory roughness in an interval or chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: 分拍單位將一拍分為二等分或三等分的音符時值，分別對應單拍子與複拍子。例如4/4拍或6/8拍中的八分音符。
en: division unit The note value that divides the beat into two or three parts (in simple or compound meters, respectively); for example, the eighth note in 4/4 or 6/8.

title: 詞彙表
text: 屬功能（dominant function）使人感到迫切需要解決到主和弦的一類和弦功能，包括V與vii°；小調同樣使用V與vii°。
en: dominant function A category of chords that provides a sense of urgency to resolve toward the tonic chord, including V and vii° (in minor: V and vii°).

title: 詞彙表
text: 屬和聲鎖定長時間延長V和弦，也稱「停留在屬和聲上」，常包含sol（5̂）上的持續低音。
en: dominant lock Extensive prolongation of the V chord. Also known as "standing on the dominant." Often involves a pedal point on sol (5̂).

title: 詞彙表
text: 屬七和弦（dominant seventh chord）由大三和弦加上根音上方的小七度音組成的七和弦。
en: dominant seventh chord A seventh chord in which the triad quality is major and the seventh quality is minor.

title: 詞彙表
text: Doo-wop圖式（doo-wop schema）𝄆 I–vi–IV–V 𝄇，在C大調為C–Ami–F–G。常見變化是以ii取代IV，或輪換循環的起點。
en: doo-wop schema 𝄆I – VI – IV – V 𝄇, or C – Ami – F – G in C major. Common alterations: substituting ii for IV; rotation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 多利安（dorian）依全音－半音－全音－全音－全音－半音－全音排列的自然音調式，類似把自然小調的第六音級升高。從D開始依序彈鋼琴白鍵，也會得到這種音階。
en: dorian A diatonic mode that follows the pattern W–H–W–W–W–H–W. This is like the natural minor scale, but with a raised scale degree 6. This scale can also be found by playing the white notes of the piano starting on D.

title: 詞彙表
text: 多利安往返（dorian shuttle）IV–i，在C小調背景中為F–Cmi，暗示多利安調式。不熟悉此調式的人，可能會把它聽成ii–V。
en: dorian shuttle IV–i, or F–Cmi in C minor. This shuttle implies the dorian mode. It can sound like ii–V to someone who is not used to the dorian mode.

title: 詞彙表
text: 拍點格用一串點表示拍與小節，是節奏聽寫的一種方法。
en: dot grid A series of dots that represent beats and measures, used as a strategy for rhythmic dictation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 重降記號將音降低兩個半音。
en: double flat Lowers a note by two half steps.

title: 詞彙表
text: 雙鄰音以上鄰音與下鄰音環繞某個音的裝飾，例如C–B–D–C。兩個鄰音之間也可再次奏出被裝飾的音，例如C–D–C–B–C。
en: double neighbor An embellishment that surrounds a note with its upper and lower neighbor (e.g., C–B–D–C). The note being embellished may be articulated between the two neighbor tones, as in C–D–C–B–C.

title: 詞彙表
text: 雙重變格圖式（double plagal schema）♭VII–IV–I，在C大調為B♭–F–C。名稱來自把IV–I的變格關係，再套用到IV本身：IV/IV–IV，也就是♭VII–IV。
en: double plagal schema ♭VII–IV–I, or B♭–F–C in C major. The term comes from duplicating the plagal relationship (IV–I) by applying it to IV as well (IV/IV–IV, or ♭VII–IV).

title: 詞彙表
text: 重升記號將音升高兩個半音。
en: double sharp Raises a note by two half steps.

title: 詞彙表
text: 雙高音譜號G譜號的一種，以捲曲部分環繞五線譜由下往上第二線，指定該線的音為G₃。
en: double treble clef As a "G" clef, the double treble clef designates the second-lowest line of a staff as G₃ by curling around it.

title: 詞彙表
text: 倍全音符時值等於兩個全音符的音符。
en: double whole note A note value that lasts the duration of two whole notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 倍速律動（double-time feel）反拍演奏速度是常規兩倍的鼓型：小鼓在每拍後半個八分音符，而不是只有第2、4拍。
en: double-time feel A drum pattern where the backbeat is played twice as fast as usual (that is, on the second eighth of each beat, rather than on beats two and four).

title: 詞彙表
text: 重複音（doubling）讓和弦中的某些音，同時出現在不只一個聲部。
en: doubling Duplicating some notes of a chord in multiple parts.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小節強拍（downbeat）小節第一拍，指揮時以向下的動作表示。
en: downbeat Beat 1 of a measure, which is conducted with a downward motion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 二拍子每小節有兩拍的拍節。
en: duple meter A meter with two beats per measure.

title: 詞彙表
text: 二連音將複拍子的一拍分成二等分的連音組。
en: duplet A tuplet that involves dividing a beat in compound meter into two parts.

title: 詞彙表
text: 先導聲部（dux）一對模仿聲部中先進入的聲部；可與後隨聲部comes比較。
en: dux The first part in a pair of imitative voices (compare to comes).

title: 詞彙表
text: 力度表示音量大小的音樂術語。
en: dynamics The musical term for loudness.

title: 詞彙表
text: 八分音符時值為四分音符的一半，或等於兩個十六分音符的音符。
en: eighth note A note value that lasts half the duration of a quarter note, or the duration of two sixteenth notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 八分休止符時值為四分休止符的一半，或等於兩個十六分休止符的休止符。
en: eighth rest A type of rest that lasts half the duration of a quarter rest, or the duration of two sixteenth rests.

title: 詞彙表
text: 裝飾和聲（embellishing harmony）功能在於延長另一個和聲，而非推動樂句走向終止目標的和聲。裝飾和聲常被描述為經過式或鄰音式。
en: embellishing harmony A harmony whose function is to prolong another harmony, rather than to advance the phrase toward its cadential goal. Embellishing harmonies are often said to be passing or neighboring.

title: 詞彙表
text: 裝飾音用來裝飾其他在結構上更重要音符的音，通常不屬於當下和弦。類型包括經過音、鄰音、倚音、逃音、持續音、掛留音與先現音。
en: embellishing tones Notes that decorate other, more structurally important notes. Embellishing tones are often not part of the prevailing chord. Types of embellishing tones include passing tones, neighbor tones, appoggiaturas, escape tones, pedal tones, suspensions, and anticipations.

title: 詞彙表
text: 浮現的主音（emergent tonic）歌曲最初幾個段落尚未出現主和弦，直到稍後，通常在副歌，主和弦才登場。常與歌詞中獲得勝利、自信或清晰認知的主題相連。
en: emergent tonic A tonic that is initially absent for the first sections of a song, but arrives later on (often in the chorus). Often tied to lyrical themes of attained triumph, self-confidence, or clarity.

title: 詞彙表
text: 能量增加（energy gain）讓人感到一段音樂能量升高的特性。可以透過更活躍的節奏、更快的和弦更替、更厚的織體、更寬的音域、漸強，或朝終止與目標推進來達成。
en: energy gain A quality in a passage of music that heightens the perceived energy of the passage. This can be through more active rhythmic activity, faster harmony changes, thicker texture, expanded range, crescendo, or drive toward a cadence or goal.

title: 詞彙表
text: 同音異名等價（enharmonic equivalence）音符、音程或和弦聽起來相同，但拼寫不同的關係。
en: enharmonic equivalence A relationship between notes, intervals, or chords that sound the same but are spelled differently.

title: 詞彙表
text: 插部用來描述輪旋曲式中主要主題以外樂段的術語；主要主題也稱A或反覆主題。插部透過多方面的變化與主要主題形成對比，主要包括調性及旋律、節奏、和聲素材的變化。
en: episode A term used when describing the sections of a rondo form that are not the main theme (a.k.a. A or refrain). Episodes provide contrast with the main theme through changes in multiple domains, primarily key and melodic/rhythmic/harmonic material.

title: 詞彙表
text: 逃音以級進進入，再朝反方向跳進離開的裝飾音。
en: escape tone An embellishing tone that is approached by step and left by leap in the opposite direction.

title: 詞彙表
text: 呈示部必要終止（EEC）副主題區（S）的目標。EEC是第一個令人滿意、且之後接上不以S為基礎之新素材的完全正格終止。
en: essential expositional cadence (EEC) The goal of the S area. The EEC is the first satisfactory PAC that is followed by new material (not based on S).

title: 詞彙表
text: 迴避終止作曲家先建立對終止式的期待，接著卻避開終止的任何情況。例如作欺騙進行，把終止處的屬和弦或主和弦改用轉位，或省略必要聲部，如主和弦的低音或女高音聲部的音。
en: evaded cadence Any situation where a composer sets up the expectation for a cadence, then avoids cadencing. Examples include deceptive motion, inversion of the cadential dominant or tonic, and/or omitting an essential voice (such as the bass note of the tonic chord or the soprano note of the tonic chord).

title: 詞彙表
text: 擴展使樂句比預期更長的過程。延長可發生在樂句內部，稱為內部擴展；也可發生在樂句外部，稱為外部擴展。
en: expansion The process of making a phrase longer than expected. This lengthening might occur within the phrase (internal expansion) or outside of the phrase (external expansion).

title: 詞彙表
text: 明示拍節層（explicit beat layer）流行音樂的一種功能層，清楚呈現歌曲中的拍節與各脈動層次。多數打擊樂屬於這一層。
en: explicit beat layer A type of functional layer within pop music that clearly articulates the meter and pulse levels within the song. Most percussion is part of this layer.

title: 詞彙表
text: 賦格呈示段（exposition）賦格的第一部分，各聲部在其中依次陳述主題或答題。
en: exposition (fugue) The first part of a fugue, in which each voice states the subject or answer.

title: 詞彙表
text: 呈示部（奏鳴曲式，exposition）奏鳴曲式作品的第一個大段，通常建立主要主題，並提出稍後才會解決的衝突。這種衝突常表現為不同的調性中心，例如主題部在主調，副題部則在屬調。
en: exposition (sonata form) The first large section in a sonata-form work. It usually establishes the main themes of a work and sets up a conflict that is later resolved in the work. This conflict often takes the form of differing key centers (such as when the primary theme of a sonata is in tonic and the secondary theme is in the dominant).

title: 詞彙表
text: 擴充的終止型結束以核心低音型mi–fa–sol–do（3̂–4̂–5̂–1̂）配置和聲的次樂句，功能類似延續部。
en: extended cadential ending A subphrase that harmonizes the core bass pattern mi–fa–sol–do (3̂–4̂–5̂–1̂). Functions similarly to a continuation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 延伸音（和聲）在三和弦上方繼續疊加三度，產生額外和弦音。通常指九音、十一音或十三音，而較少指七音；不過，七音也是一種延伸音。
en: extension (harmony) Adding additional thirds on top of the triad. Most commonly refers to ninths, elevenths, or thirteenths rather than sevenths, although sevenths are also extensions.

title: 詞彙表
text: 外部輔助樂段輔助樂段的一類，包括引入作品或樂段的前綴，以及接在作品或樂段一般結尾之後的後綴。
en: external auxiliary section A category of auxiliary sections including prefixes (which introduce a piece/section) and suffixes (which follow the generic conclusion of a piece/section).

title: 詞彙表
text: 外部擴展在樂句開始前加入額外素材（前綴），或在終止式之後加入額外素材（後綴），以延長樂句。
en: external expansion Lengthening a phrase by adding extra material to it either before it begins ("prefix") or after it cadences ("suffix").

title: 詞彙表
text: 扇形符槓（feathered beaming）同一組符槓內的音逐漸改變速度，表示漸快或漸慢。
en: feathered beaming A gradual change in the speed of notes within a single beam.

title: 詞彙表
text: 延長記號表示將音保持得比記譜時值更長的符號，記作𝄐。
en: fermata A symbol that indicates one should hold a note longer than its written duration. Notation: 𝄐

title: 詞彙表
text: 附加變化音（musica ficta）文藝復興音樂中，未記在譜上而由演奏者補加的變化記號。熟練的演奏者知道應在適當位置加入；現代出版的文藝復興音樂版本，常由編者標出這些變化音。
en: ficta Musica ficta are un-notated accidentals added to Renaissance music. Competent performers know to add ficta in appropriate places. In modern editions of Renaissance music, ficta are often provided by the editor.

title: 詞彙表
text: 數字低音以阿拉伯數字與符號表示低音上方音程的記法。音樂家據此實現出和弦與和弦外音。
en: figured bass Arabic numerals and symbols that indicate intervals above a bass note. These are realized into chords and non-chord tones by musicians.

title: 詞彙表
text: 終止音（final）在教會調式中，終止音作為旋律的目標，大致對應現代「主音」的概念；但它不一定像主音那樣受到強調。此名稱來自葛利果聖歌最後一音是該調式終止音的原則。
en: final In church modes, the final loosely corresponds to the modern notion of "tonic," in that it is a melodic goal. However, the final may not always be emphasized in the way a tonic is. Finals are named by the fact that the last note of a Gregorian chant will always be the final of the mode.

title: 詞彙表
text: 第一轉位以三音為低音的三和弦和聲。
en: first inversion A triadic harmony with the third in the bass.

title: 詞彙表
text: 固定唱名法無論使用哪個音階，do一律是音高類C、re一律是音高類D，其餘依此類推的唱名系統。
en: fixed do A system of solfège in which do is always the pitch class C, re the pitch class D, etc., regardless of scale.

title: 詞彙表
text: 符尾置於符桿末端的曲線。帶符桿的音符每增加一條符尾，時值就減半。例如八分音符的符號相當於四分音符加上一條符尾，其時值為四分音符的一半。
en: flag A curved line placed at the end of a stem. Each flag added to a stemmed note represents the reduction of the note value by half. For example, the symbol for an eighth note is like a quarter note plus a flag; the eighth note is one-half the value of the quarter note.

title: 詞彙表
text: 降記號將音降低半音。
en: flat Lowers a note by a half step.

title: 詞彙表
text: 曲式指樂段或作品的結構，可理解為具有層級的單位組合。常討論兩種層次：樂句層次的曲式，涉及動機、樂念、次樂句或樂句；作品層次的曲式，涉及樂段、樂章或整首作品。
en: form Refers to the structure of a passage or piece. Form can be understood as a hierarchical grouping of units, and we often speak of form at one of two levels: phrase-level form (referring to motives, ideas, subphrases, or phrases) or composition-level form (referring to sections, movements, or whole pieces).

title: 詞彙表
text: forte（強）強奏。
en: forte Loud.

title: 詞彙表
text: Forte編號（Forte number）Allen Forte為集合類建立的命名系統，每個集合類有獨立編號。第一個數表示基數；第二個數部分依編排約定，大致由緊密的集合排向較分散的集合。
en: Forte number A nomenclature for set classes developed by Allen Forte; each set class has a unique Forte number. The first number refers to the cardinality of the set, and the second number is semi-arbitrary, but generally proceeds from the most compact to the most expanded set.

title: 詞彙表
text: 每拍大鼓（four on the floor）每一拍都有大鼓擊點的鼓型。
en: four on the floor A drumbeat in which the kick drum is sounded on every beat.

title: 詞彙表
text: 不穩固的主音（fragile tonic）主和弦存在，但穩定感被削弱。通常是因為使用轉位，或把主和弦放在樂句中段、拍節上不穩定的位置；相較之下，較典型的主和弦會是穩定的出發點或到達點。
en: fragile tonic The tonic chord is present, but weakened. Usually, the weakening comes from using the tonic chord in inversion, or otherwise from placing the tonic chord in a metrically unstable mid-phrase position (versus a more typical usage where the tonic is a stable point of arrival or departure).

title: 詞彙表
text: 片段化（fragmentation）把音樂單位縮得比先前建立的長度更短。例如原先單位長2小節，片段化後可能只長1小節。
en: fragmentation Making unit sizes smaller than the previously established size. For example, if units had previously been two measures long, fragments might be one measure long.

title: 詞彙表
text: 自由無調性音樂（free atonal music）不採傳統音高中心與和聲階序，也不以序列方式組織的無調性音樂。
en: free atonal music Music that is atonal, avoiding a traditional pitch center and harmonic hierarchy, but is not serial.

title: 詞彙表
text: 自由對位（free counterpoint）不採特定主題材料的對位寫法。
en: free counterpoint Contrapuntal writing without any specific thematic content.

title: 詞彙表
text: 自由節奏沒有可辨識拍點或拍號的音樂，通常只有很少的節奏結構，或完全沒有。
en: Free Time Free time refers to music with no discernible beat or time signature. Music in free time often has very little (or no) rhythmic structure.

title: 詞彙表
text: 頻率（frequency）在聲學上，指聲波重複的快慢；它與聲音的音高相關。
en: frequency Acoustically, how often a sound wave repeats; the pitch of a sound.

title: 詞彙表
text: 全減七和弦三和弦部分為減三和弦，七音與根音形成減七度的七和弦。
en: fully diminished seventh chord A seventh chord whose triad is diminished and whose seventh is diminished.

title: 詞彙表
text: 功能（function）某個音樂元素在形成更大音樂單位時，所扮演的角色。
en: function The role that a musical element plays in the creation of a larger musical unit.

title: 詞彙表
text: 功能低音層（functional bass layer）流行歌曲織體中，提供和聲基礎的一層。低音域樂器很可能屬於這一層。
en: functional bass layer A layer within a pop song texture that provides a harmonic foundation for the track. Bass-register instruments likely belong to in this layer.

title: 詞彙表
text: 功能層（functional layer）在流行歌曲的織體中，執行特定角色的一件樂器或一組樂器。這些角色包括：• 明示拍節層• 功能低音層• 旋律層• 和聲填充層• 新奇層
en: functional layer An instrument or group of instruments that perform a specific role within a pop song texture. These roles are: • the explicit beat layer • the functional bass layer • the melodic layer • the harmonic filler layer • the novelty layer

title: 詞彙表
text: 空隙填補旋律寫作的一項原則：大跳若開啟新的音域，之後應以級進填補其間的空隙。
en: gap-fill A principle of melody writing suggesting that any large leaps that open up a new register ought to be filled in afterward with stepwise motion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音程度數（generic interval）依某音集或音階中的音級位置，計算兩音之間相隔的度數，不指定大小、增減等性質。
en: generic interval The number of scale steps between notes of a collection or scale.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大譜表上下排列、以大括線連接的兩行五線譜。上方使用高音譜號，下方使用低音譜號。
en: grand staff Two staves placed one above the other, connected by a brace. The top staff has a treble clef, while the bottom staff has a bass clef.

title: 詞彙表
text: 圖像記譜（graphic notation）以圖像、形狀、色彩及其他符號特徵表現音樂，取代傳統五線譜的記譜技法。
en: graphic notation A notational technique that uses images, shapes, colors, and/or various other symbolic features to represent music instead of traditional staff notation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 圖像樂譜以圖像、形狀、顏色或其他各種符號元素來表現音樂，取代傳統五線譜的一種樂譜。
en: Graphic Scores A type of musical score that uses images, shapes, colors, and/or various other symbolic features to represent music instead of traditional staff notation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 律動（groove）流行音樂中複雜而多面的現象，其構成包含歌曲的節奏輪廓、速度、拍子、打擊樂與低音線。律動也涵蓋較難言傳的面向，例如演奏者或聽者以身體感受規律音樂模式的經驗，以及投入、專注的狀態。
en: groove A complex and multidimensional phenomenon of popular music that in part is made up of a song's rhythmic profile, tempo, meter, percussion, and bass line. Groove also encompasses more ineffable aspects of music, such as the performer's or listener's sense of embodying a regular musical pattern and/or their concentration.

title: 詞彙表
text: 固定低音（ground bass）反覆出現的低音模式，作為一組變奏的基礎，與流行／搖滾歌曲的循環和弦進行有相似之處。
en: ground bass A repeated bass pattern that forms the foundation for a set of variations, not unlike the cyclical progressions of pop/rock songs.

title: 詞彙表
text: 分組不協和（grouping dissonance）拍節不協和的一種：兩個以上音樂層次，每組包含不同數量的拍或脈動，而且這些數量彼此不是整數倍或因數關係，例如複節奏的情形。
en: grouping dissonance A type of metrical dissonance in which two or more musical layers have a different number of beats/pulses which are not multiples/factors of one another, as in a polyrhythm.

title: 詞彙表
text: 髮夾形力度記號漸強或漸弱記號。
en: hairpins A crescendo or decrescendo symbol.

title: 詞彙表
text: 半終止（HC）樂句停在V和弦上的非結束性終止式。偶爾，尤其在浪漫時期音樂中，半終止的最後和弦會是V⁷。
en: half cadence (HC) A kind of inconclusive cadence that occurs when a phrase ends on V. Occasionally, particularly in Romantic music, the final chord of a half cadence will be V⁷.

title: 詞彙表
text: 二分音符時值為全音符的一半，或等於兩個四分音符的音符。
en: half note A note value that lasts half the duration of a whole note, or the duration of two quarter notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 二分休止符時值為全休止符的一半，或等於兩個四分休止符的休止符。
en: half rest A type of rest that lasts half the duration of a whole rest, or the duration of two quarter rests.

title: 詞彙表
text: 半音（half step／semitone）八度的十二分之一，通常視為傳統西方音樂記譜中的最小基本音程。
en: half step (semitone) One-twelfth of an octave; generally considered to be the smallest interval in Western musical notation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 半減七和弦（half-diminished seventh chord）由減三和弦加上根音上方的小七度音組成的七和弦。
en: half-diminished seventh chord A seventh chord in which the triad quality is diminished and the seventh quality is minor.

title: 詞彙表
text: 半速律動（half-time feel）反拍速度是常規一半的鼓型：小鼓只在每小節第3拍，而不是第2、4拍。
en: half-time feel A drum pattern in which the backbeat is twice as slow as usual (that is, the snare hits occur only on beat three of each measure, instead of beats two and four).

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲省略省去原先預期的和弦。有兩種類型：導音省略，以同根音的屬七和弦，或功能相當的減七和弦，取代預期的三和弦；升根音省略，將預期和弦的根音升高，使它成為導音或副導音。
en: harmonic elision The suppression of an expected chord. Two kinds of elision are a leading-tone elision, in which the expected triad is replaced by the dominant seventh chord with the same root or by a functionally equivalent diminished seventh chord, and raised-root elision, in which the root of the expected chord is raised to become a leading tone (or applied leading tone).

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲填充層（harmonic filler layer）流行歌曲中的功能層，增加織體厚度，提供更多和聲脈絡。通常由鍵盤、合成器與吉他構成，會隨曲風而有很大差異。
en: harmonic filler layer A functional layer within a pop song that thickens the texture and provides more harmonic context to the song. This layer typically comprises keyboards, synthesizers, and guitars, and varies widely depending on genre.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲功能（harmonic function）和弦可分為主功能、前屬功能、屬功能三類。這種分類說明和弦在西方古典調性和聲進行中的典型行為；例如主功能和弦較穩定，常代表解決或停歇的位置。
en: harmonic function Refers to three categories of chords: tonic, predominant, and dominant. A chord's membership within a category indicates something about how that chord typically behaves in tonal harmonic progressions in Western classical music. For example, tonic function chords are stable and tend to represent points of resolution or repose.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲音程兩音同時發聲的音程。
en: harmonic interval An interval whose notes sound together (simultaneously).

title: 詞彙表
text: 和弦轉位改變和聲的低音，例如以三音取代根音作為低音。
en: harmonic inversion Changing the bass note of a harmony so that, for example, the third is in the bass instead of the root.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲大調（harmonic major）把大調音階的la（6̂）改成le（↓6̂）：do–re–mi–fa–sol–le–ti–do（1̂–2̂–3̂–4̂–5̂–↓6̂–7̂–1̂）。
en: harmonic major A major scale with le (↓6̂) instead of la (6̂): do–re–mi–fa–sol–le–ti–do (1̂–2̂–3̂–4̂–5̂–↓6̂–7̂–1̂).

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲小音階依次排列半音與全音的音集合，上行順序為全—半—全—全—半—三個半音—半。類似自然小音階，但導音升高。
en: harmonic minor An ordered collection of half and whole steps with the ascending succession W–H–W–W–H–3Hs–H. Like natural minor, but with a raised leading tone.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲節奏（harmonic rhythm）和弦更換的速率，通常以每小節幾個和弦表示。例如十八世紀古典音樂中，常見每小節更換一次和弦。
en: harmonic rhythm The rate at which chords change, usually expressed in chords per measure. A common rate of chord change in 18th-century classical music is one chord per measure, for example.

title: 詞彙表
text: 泛音列（harmonic series）一系列音，其頻率是第一個頻率的整數倍：基頻與各分音的比依序為1:1、1:2、1:3、1:4、1:5等。若以C₂為基音，音高可近似記為C₂、C₃、G₃、C₄、E₄、G₄、B♭₄、C₅等。
en: harmonic series A series of notes whose frequencies are multiples of the first frequency: 1:1, 1:2, 1:3, 1:4, 1:5, etc. Starting with the pitch C₂, this would result in the series of pitches C₂, C₃, G₃, C₄, E₄, G₄, B♭₄, C₅, etc.

title: 詞彙表
text: 同時發聲地各音同時一起演奏或演唱。
en: harmonically Notes played or sung all together at the same time.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲封閉（harmonically closed）樂句或段落結束於主和聲，也就是原位I和弦。
en: harmonically closed A phrase or module is harmonically closed when it ends with tonic harmony (I in root position).

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲開放（harmonically open）樂句或段落結束於主和聲以外的和弦。
en: harmonically open A phrase or module is harmonically open when it ends on a harmony other than tonic.

title: 詞彙表
text: 泛音／諧波（harmonics）複合聲音中，頻率與基頻具有整數倍關係的上方分音。
en: harmonics An overtone of a complex sound that occurs at a whole-number ratio to the fundamental.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲縱向組合的音響。
en: harmony A vertical sonority.

title: 詞彙表
text: 開頭疊句（head refrain）出現在段落歌詞最前面一行左右的疊句。
en: head refrain A refrain that is the first line or so of the section's text.

title: 詞彙表
text: 赫米奧拉（hemiola）兩個一組與三個一組的層次之間，形成的分組不協和。常見於三拍子作品：把六拍，例如兩個3/4小節，改分為三組、每組兩拍，取代原先預期的兩組、每組三拍。
en: hemiola A grouping dissonance between a 2-layer and a 3-layer. Hemiolas commonly occur in triple-meter pieces by grouping six beats (e.g., two measures of 3/4) into three groups of two beats, rather than the expected two groups of three beats.

title: 詞彙表
text: 赫茲（Hertz）聲音頻率的計量單位；1赫茲表示每秒完成一次振動週期。
en: Hertz A unit of measurement for the frequency of a sound, equivalent to one cycle per second.

title: 詞彙表
text: 異音織度（heterophony）同一條旋律線的多個變體，同時發聲的音樂織度。
en: heterophony A musical texture with multiple simultaneous variants on a single melodic line.

title: 詞彙表
text: 六音組（hexachord）由六個音組成的音集。在序列音樂中，通常指十二音音列的前六音或後六音。
en: hexachord A six-note collection. In serial music, "hexachord" is typically used to refer to either the first or last six notes of a twelve-tone row.

title: 詞彙表
text: 六音組的互補組合性（hexachordal combinatoriality）某音列形式的一個六音組，與另一形式的一個六音組合併後，構成全部十二個音高類的特性。
en: hexachordal combinatoriality A property of a row in which combining one hexachord from a version of a row with a hexachord from another version of a row creates the chromatic collection.

title: 詞彙表
text: 六音音階（hexatonic scale）由半音與小三度交替構成的六音集合，例如 C–C♯–E–F–G♯–A。
en: hexatonic scale A six-note collection that alternates between half steps and minor thirds, such as C–C♯–E–F–G♯–A.

title: 詞彙表
text: 六音極點變換（H）一種新黎曼變換：讓每個聲部各移動半音，連接根音相距三度、大小性質相反的三和弦，例如 C 大三和弦與 A♭ 小三和弦。
en: Hexpole (H) transformation A Neo-Riemannian transformation that connects a triad to its modal opposite a third away by moving each voice by a single semitone (e.g., connecting C major and A♭ minor).

title: 詞彙表
text: 踩鈸（hi-hat cymbals）一對尺寸相同的小型鈸，直徑通常14英吋，裝在專用架上。下片反向放置並固定，上片由腳踏板控制。敲擊音色取決於開合程度：閉合時明亮短促，張開時有較猛烈的碰撞與沙響，也有多種中間音色。單用踏板，還能做出飛濺聲效果。
en: Hi-hat cymbals A pair of smaller cymbals, matched in size, typically 14” in diameter, mounted on a specially designed stand. The bottom cymbal sits upside down, unmoving, and the top cymbal is attached to the stand so that it can be controlled by a foot pedal. When struck, the hi-hats’ timbre depends on how open or closed the two cymbals are. The hi-hat is most often struck while closed, producing a characteristic, bright “tick tick tick”; the open sound has a more aggressive crashing or rattling quality; and a wide range of intermediate timbres are also available. When played with the foot pedal only, the cymbals make a splashing effect.

title: 詞彙表
text: 有層級的依層級排列的。
en: hierarchical Arranged according to rank.

title: 詞彙表
text: 本調描述作品整體主調的術語。例如某樂章為A大調，其本調就是A大調。這個詞用來與局部調性相區別。
en: home key A term used to describe a piece's overall tonic. If a movement is in the key of A major, then the home key is A major. The term is used to distinguish itself from local keys.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主調織度（homophony）由一個旋律聲部，通常是最高聲部，加上其他從屬伴奏聲部構成的織度。包括聖詠式織度與旋律加伴奏的織度。
en: homophony A musical texture consisting of one melodic part (usually the topmost) and other subordinate accompanying parts. This includes chorale texture and melody-and-accompaniment texture.

title: 詞彙表
text: 同節奏多個聲部採用相同節奏。
en: homorhythm Rhythmic unison among multiple parts.

title: 詞彙表
text: 跳格子圖式（hopscotch schema）IV–V–vi–I。這個四和弦圖式，自2010年以來在流行音樂中越來越常見。
en: hopscotch schema IV–V–vi–I. This four-chord schema has become increasingly common in pop music since 2010.

title: 詞彙表
text: 混合形式將樂句型與樂段的特徵結合成單一樂句層次曲式的形式。
en: hybrid form A phrase form that combines aspects of the sentence and the period into one phrase-level form.

title: 詞彙表
text: 混合樂譜同時具有顯著傳統記譜與圖像記譜元素的樂譜。
en: Hybrid Scores A score that contains prominent elements from both traditional and graphic notation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 超拍超小節拍節的基本拍點層次，一個超拍通常等於一個小節。
en: hyperbeat The basic pulse level in a hypermeter. A hyperbeat is usually equivalent to one measure of music.

title: 詞彙表
text: 超小節一組通常由四個超拍構成的單位；多個超小節形成超小節拍節。
en: hypermeasure A group of (usually four) hyperbeats. Multiple hypermeasures form a hypermeter.

title: 詞彙表
text: 超小節拍節（hypermeter）把多個小節組合成具有不同重音規律的群組，形成類似拍節的關係。一個超小節通常長四個小節。
en: hypermeter Groupings of measures into different patterns of accentuation akin to meter. A hypermeasure is typically four measures long.

title: 詞彙表
text: 超小節拍節的擾動在原本規律、通常為四拍的超小節拍節中，某個音樂事件使超小節變得較短或較長。
en: hypermetric disruption A musical event within an otherwise regular hypermeter (typically quadruple) that creates a hypermeasure of a different length (shorter or longer).

title: 詞彙表
text: 超小節拍節的重新解讀單一超拍同時具有兩種功能。幾乎總是發生在樂句重疊處：前一超小節的結尾，也就是第四超拍，同時成為新超小節的開頭，也就是第一超拍。
en: hypermetric reinterpretation A single hyperbeat simultaneously functioning in two ways. Almost always, this occurs at a phrase elision, in which the end of one hypermeasure (hyperbeat 4) is simultaneously the beginning of a new hypermeasure (hyperbeat 1).

title: 詞彙表
text: 超拍重複一種詮釋上的判斷，用來表示你認為超小節如何超出預期的小節數，例如從四小節增為五小節。採用這種解讀，表示你認為超小節內的一個或數個超拍立即重複。例如原本的1234可能變成12344，也可能將3與4一起重複，變成123434。當所分析的樂句是先前樂句的變體時，這類解讀通常最有說服力，因為可以比較兩者來支持論點。
en: Hypermetric Repetition This is an interpretational decision to represent how you think a hypermeasure has been expanded beyond its expected number of measures (from 4 to 5, for example). Applying this technique means you think a hyperbeat or hyperbeats within a hypermeasure has/have been immediately repeated. For example, instead of 1234, you could have 12344, or 3 and 4 could repeat together 123434. This type of assertion is usually most convincing when the phrase in question is a variant of a previously stated phrase because then you can compare the two to make the argument.

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂念分段分析所辨識的最小音樂單位。樂念不必以終止式結束，可以組成次樂句或樂句；例如基本樂念、對比樂念、單位、終止樂念與片段。
en: idea The smallest unit of music identified by a segmentation analysis. Ideas need not end with cadences, and they may combine to form subphrases or phrases. Examples include basic idea, contrasting idea, unit, cadential idea, and fragments.

title: 詞彙表
text: 表意符號代表某個想法或概念的圖像或符號。
en: ideogram A picture or symbol which represents an idea or concept.

title: 詞彙表
text: ii–V–I大調為ii⁷–V⁷–Imaj⁷，小調為iiø⁷–V⁷–i⁷；這是傳統爵士樂中極重要的基本進行。
en: ii–V–I ii⁷–V⁷–Imaj⁷ in major, or iiø⁷–V⁷–i⁷ in minor. A fundamentally important progression in traditional jazz.

title: 詞彙表
text: 模仿兩個以上聲部分別進入，使用相同旋律或其不同版本。
en: imitation Imitation sees two or more parts enter separately with (versions of) the same melody.

title: 詞彙表
text: 不完全正格終止（IAC）V–I終止式中，V、I或兩者使用轉位，或主三和弦上方的女高音聲部不是do（1̂），或同時符合上述情況。此外，不完全正格終止也常被用來迴避終止。
en: imperfect authentic cadence (IAC) A V–I cadence in which V, I, or both harmonies are inverted, and/or do (1̂) is not in the soprano over the tonic triad. Additionally, IACs are often used to evade a cadence.

title: 詞彙表
text: 不完全協和音程大、小三度，或大、小六度。
en: imperfect consonance Thirds or sixths with major or minor quality.

title: 詞彙表
text: 不完全鄰音以級進進入、跳進離開，或反過來以跳進進入、級進離開的裝飾音。名稱來自它只在裝飾型態的一側發揮鄰音功能。不完全鄰音也可稱為倚音或逃音。
en: incomplete neighbor A type of embellishing tone that is approached by step and left by leap or vice-versa. The name comes from the idea that it functions as a neighbor tone on only one side of its embellishment. Incomplete neighbors may be called appoggiaturas or escape tones.

title: 詞彙表
text: 獨立型過渡部引入新動機素材的奏鳴曲式過渡部，而非重用主要主題的素材。
en: independent transition A sonata-form transition that introduces new motivic material (as opposed to reusing material from the primary theme).

title: 詞彙表
text: 不確定性一種音樂哲學取向與作曲技巧，將音樂中的某些元素留而未定，交由演奏者裁量，或由機遇決定。
en: indeterminacy A philosophical approach and compositional technique in music that leaves elements within the music undetermined. These elements can be left up to the discretion of the performer or to chance.

title: 詞彙表
text: 索引數（index number）變換Tₙ或Iₙ中的n。Tₙ以n表示移位的半音數；Iₙ則表示先做基本倒影I₀，再移位n個半音。
en: index number In a transformation (Tₙ or Iₙ), n is the index number, representing the interval of transposition in semitones.

title: 詞彙表
text: 經過升降變化的（inflected）相對於通常形式，作了半音升降變化。
en: inflected Chromatically altered from the typical version.

title: 詞彙表
text: 整數記譜法（integer notation）用整數命名音高類的系統：C為0、C♯為1、D為2，依此類推。
en: integer notation A system of naming pitch classes that treats C as 0, C♯ as 1, D as 2, etc.

title: 詞彙表
text: 內部擴展在樂句已開始、但尚未到達終止式之間加以延長，使樂句比預期更長。
en: internal expansion Making a phrase last longer than we expect by lengthening it after it begins, but before it cadences.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音程兩音之間的距離。
en: interval The distance between two notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音程類（interval class，IC）無序音高類音程，也就是兩個音高類之間可能的最短半音距離。因此，小二度與大七度都是IC1；大二度、小七度及增六度都是IC2；小三度、大六度及增二度都是IC3，依此類推。最大音程類為6個半音：不考慮順序並取最短路徑時，三全音就是最大距離。
en: interval class (IC) Unordered pitch-class intervals; that is, the smallest possible distance in semitones between two pitch classes. Thus, mi2 and ma7 are both IC 1; ma2, mi7, +6 are IC 2; mi3, ma6, +2 are IC 3, etc. The largest interval class is six semitones, because if order is disregarded, the tritone is the largest possible interval.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音程度數構成音程跨度的字母音名數，或譜線與譜間數；以阿拉伯數字表示，例如2、3、4。
en: interval size The number of letters (or lines and spaces) that make up the span of an interval. Interval size is written with Arabic numbers (2, 3, 4, etc.).

title: 詞彙表
text: 音程細分在對位中，一種協和弱拍型態：把相鄰兩個強拍之間較大的協和跳進，分成兩個較小的跳進。
en: interval subdivision In counterpoint, a type of consonant weak beat that divides a larger consonant leap (from downbeat to downbeat) into two smaller leaps.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音程轉位將兩音的上下位置對調。例如C在E下方，與E在C下方互為轉位。
en: intervallic inversion Occurs when two notes are flipped: for instance, C below E is an inversion of E below C.

title: 詞彙表
text: 導奏（古典曲式）出現在第一個核心樂段開始之前的樂段。
en: introduction (classical form) A section of music that occurs before the start of the first core section.

title: 詞彙表
text: 前奏（introduction，歌曲曲式）由歌曲開始前、沒有拍節的寂靜，過渡到第一個核心段落的音樂活動。前奏通常較短、沒有歌詞，也就是器樂段，並常預先呈現後續核心段落的材料。
en: introduction (song form) Introduction sections transition from the unmetered silence that precedes the song to the musical activity of the first core section. They tend to be short and untexted (i.e., instrumental) and tend to present musical material from one or more core sections to come.

title: 詞彙表
text: 不變性（invariance）在序列音樂中，指音列經過不同變換後，某個特徵仍保持相同。例如，音列逆行並適當移位後，若能回到相同的有序音高類排列，便稱為逆行不變性。
en: invariance In serial music, invariance refers to keeping a property of a row the same through different transformations. For example, when a retrograde version of a row contains the same ordered pitch classes as a prime version of the row, we would call it "retrograde invariant" to mean that the order of pitch classes doesn't change when the row is reversed and transposed

title: 詞彙表
text: 伊奧尼安調式依全—全—半—全—全—全—半排列的自然音調式，等同大音階。
en: ionian A diatonic mode that follows the pattern W–W–H–W–W–W–H. This is equivalent to a major scale.

title: 詞彙表
text: issimo（非常）義大利文後綴，意為「非常」。
en: issimo Italian suffix that means "very."

title: 詞彙表
text: 爵士藍調（jazz blues）在十二小節藍調中加入變化，融合藍調與爵士和聲。第8小節不再停留主和弦，而用一組副ii–V導向第9小節的ii；第三句把基本藍調的V–IV–I，改成爵士樂更常見的ii–V–I。
en: jazz blues The jazz blues incorporates several alterations to the 12-bar blues to blend together blues harmony and jazz harmony. In the eighth bar, instead of remaining on tonic, there is an applied ii–V that leads to the ii chord in bar 9. In the third phrase, the V–IV–I of the standard blues is replaced with a ii–V–I more common to jazz.

title: 詞彙表
text: 調號記譜時寫在每行五線譜開頭、緊接譜號之後的一組升記號或降記號，表示某些音一律升高或降低。
en: key signature In music notation, a collection of sharps or flats written at the beginning of each line (immediately after the clef) to signal that certain notes are always sharp/flat.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大鼓（kick drum）大型圓筒鼓，直徑通常18至24英吋，橫置，鼓殼多為木製，兩側繃鼓皮；其中一面有時移除，或開出圓孔。腳踏板透過凸輪與鏈條，帶動毛氈、木或塑膠製的大鼓槌頭。它是鼓組中音高最低的鼓，源於改製的音樂會大鼓；有些保留轟鳴聲，另一些是低沉短促的撞擊，或透過合適揚聲器能讓身體感受的極低頻效果。
en: Kick drum A large cylindrical drum, usually 18–24” in diameter, set on its side, typically with a wooden shell and two tensioned heads (the back one is sometimes removed or “ported,” meaning a circle is cut out), played with a foot pedal comprising a beater (a large mallet of felt, wood, or plastic) mounted to a cam and chain. The lowest-pitched drum in the kit, it is played with a foot pedal. It is originally based on a modified concert bass drum, and some still sound with the same booming quality. Other kick-drum sounds have a dull thud, or a sub-bass effect that (over the right speakers) is felt in the body as much as it is heard.

title: 詞彙表
text: 透過動覺地與身體各部位的動作有關。
en: kinesthetically Relating to movement of parts of the body.

title: 詞彙表
text: 哀嘆低音進行（古典音樂）為從主音逐級下行至屬音的低音線條配置和聲的一組進行。最簡單的自然音版本使用do–te–le–sol低音，配置i–v⁶–iv⁶–V和聲；半音化的替代版本也很常見。
en: lament bass progression (classical) A variety of harmonic progressions that harmonize a stepwise descending bass line from tonic to dominant. The simplest diatonic version uses the bass notes do–te–le–sol and is harmonized by the progression i–v⁶–iv⁶–V. Chromatic alternatives are common.

title: 詞彙表
text: 哀嘆圖式（lament schema，流行音樂）為低音中從主音經第七、第六級下行至第五級的四音列（1̂–7̂–6̂–5̂）配上和聲。
en: lament schema (pop) A harmonization of a descending upper tetrachord (1̂–7̂–6̂–5̂) in the bass.

title: 詞彙表
text: 旋律和弦譜（lead sheet）一種爵士或流行音樂樂譜，通常只記下旋律，以及寫在五線譜上方的和弦代號。
en: lead sheet A type of jazz/pop score that typically notates only the melody and the chord symbols (written above the staff).

title: 詞彙表
text: 導音（leading tone）在主音下方半音的第七級。大調中的導音屬於調內音；小調則需要用臨時記號，將自然小音階的第七級升高。
en: leading tone Scale degree 7 that is one half step below the tonic. The leading tone is diatonic in major keys, but requires an accidental in minor keys.

title: 詞彙表
text: 導音和弦建立在ti（7̂）上的三和弦或七和弦。
en: leading-tone chord The triad or seventh chord built on ti (7̂).

title: 詞彙表
text: 導音交換變換（L）一種新黎曼變換：保留三和弦中的小三度，讓剩餘的一音移動半音，例如 C 大三和弦與 E 小三和弦之間的轉換。
en: Leading-Tone Exchange (L) A Neo-Riemannian transformation that preserves the minor third in the triad, and moves the remaining note by semitone (e.g., relating C major and E minor).

title: 詞彙表
text: 跳進三度以上的旋律音程。有些人把三度稱為「小跳」（skip），而不稱為leap。
en: leap A melodic interval of a third or greater. Note that some refer to thirds as "skips" rather than leaps.

title: 詞彙表
text: 加線寫在五線譜上方或下方的短線，用來擴大譜表可記錄的音域。
en: ledger lines Small lines written above or below a staff to extend the staff's range of notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: legato（圓滑奏）平順、相連地演奏。
en: legato Performed smoothly or connected.

title: 詞彙表
text: 德語藝術歌曲（Lied）以德語演唱的藝術歌曲。
en: Lied A German-language art song.

title: 詞彙表
text: 連接段（賦格）賦格中，任何聲部都沒有陳述主題的樂段。
en: link (fugue) A passage of a fugue that does not contain a subject statement in any voice.

title: 詞彙表
text: 洛克利安調式依半—全—全—半—全—全—全排列的自然音調式，類似自然小音階，但第二級與第五級音降低。從B開始彈奏鋼琴白鍵，也能得到這個音階。
en: locrian A diatonic mode that follows the pattern H–W–W–H–W–W–W. This is like the natural minor scale, but with a lowered scale degree 2 and lowered scale degree 5. This scale can also be found by playing the white notes of the piano starting on B.

title: 詞彙表
text: 鬆散的非慣常樂句結構、不穩定和聲、多樣動機素材等因素所造成的一種音樂特質。具有過渡功能的樂段，常採用鬆散的組織方式。
en: loose-knit A perceived characteristic of music that is created by unconventional phrase structures, unstable harmonies, diverse motivic material, and so on. Loose organization is common in passages with transitional function.

title: 詞彙表
text: 利底安（lydian）全音、半音依序為全—全—全—半—全—全—半的自然音調式。它相當於大音階升高第四級，也可由鋼琴白鍵從F開始排列得到。
en: lydian A diatonic mode that follows the pattern W–W–W–H–W–W–H. This is like the major scale, but with a raised scale degree 4. This scale can also be found by playing the white notes of the piano starting on F.

title: 詞彙表
text: 利底安往返（lydian shuttle）I–II♯，以C為主音時為C–D，暗示利底安調式。它容易與大調IV–V或混合利底安♭VII–I混淆，因此分析時要仔細確認主音。
en: lydian shuttle I–II♯, or C–D in C major. This progression can easily be confused with IV–V in major or ♭VII–I in mixolydian, so one should be careful when referencing this progression. It implies the lydian mode.

title: 詞彙表
text: 歌詞固定型（lyric-invariant）段落或樂句每次出現時，大部分歌詞相同。常見於曲式收束位置，例如歌節末尾的尾端疊句，或主歌—副歌循環末尾的副歌。
en: lyric-invariant A module or phrase is lyric-invariant if each time it appears it brings (mostly) the same lyrics. Lyric invariance tends to come at points of formal closure (tail refrains at the ends of strophes, choruses at the end of a verse-chorus song’s formal cycle).

title: 詞彙表
text: 歌詞變動型（lyric-variant）段落或樂句每次出現時，大部分歌詞不同。
en: lyric-variant A module or phrase is lyric-variant if each time it appears it brings (mostly) different lyrics.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主要段落（main section）呈現作品主要音樂想法的段落，通常也是作品的第一個核心段落。例子包括主題、輪旋曲式的主要主題、呈示部、副歌或歌節。
en: main section A section that presents the work's primary musical ideas. Usually, the main section is the first core section of the work. Examples include primary themes, refrains, expositions, choruses, or strophes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大調五聲音集（major pentatonic collection）由五個音組成，唱名為do、re、mi、sol、la，再回到高八度do。
en: major pentatonic collection A five-note pentatonic collection with the solfège do, re, mi, sol, la, do.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大調五聲音階（major pentatonic scale）音程依序為大二度－大二度－小三度－大二度－小三度。例如C大調五聲音階為C–D–E–G–A，最後再回到高八度C。
en: major pentatonic scale A scale that proceeds ma2–ma2–mi3–ma2–mi3. For example, starting on C, the C major pentatonic scale is C–D–E–G–A.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大音階由半音（H）與全音（W）依序排列的音集合，上行順序為全—全—半—全—全—全—半。
en: major scale An ordered collection of half steps (H) and whole steps (W) as follows (ascending): W–W–H–W–W–W–H.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大七和弦（major seventh chord）由大三和弦加上根音上方的大七度音組成的七和弦。
en: major seventh chord A seventh chord with a major triad and a major seventh.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大三和弦（major triad）根音上方的三度為大三度、五度為完全五度的三和弦。
en: major triad A triad whose third is major and fifth is perfect.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大大七和弦由大三和弦加上根音上方大七度音構成的七和弦，也稱大七和弦。
en: major-major seventh chord A seventh chord with a major triad and a major seventh. Also known as a major seventh chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: 大小七和弦由大三和弦加上根音上方小七度音構成的七和弦，也稱屬七和弦。
en: major-minor seventh chord A seventh chord with a major triad and a minor seventh. Also known as a dominant seventh chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: marcato（加強重音）以更有力的重音或強調方式演奏。
en: marcato To play with a more forceful accent or emphasis.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小節由小節線劃分的單位，相當於一組拍。
en: measure Created by bar lines, a measure (or bar) is equivalent to one beat grouping.

title: 詞彙表
text: 中間停頓（medial caesura）在奏鳴曲式中，作為過渡部目標、並標示過渡部與副主題分界的終止式。通常是本調、屬調或副主題調中的半終止；有時是副主題調的正格終止，極少數情況也可能是本調的正格終止。
en: medial caesura In sonata form, the cadence that is the goal of the transition and marks the boundary between the transition and the secondary theme. Usually a HC, in I, V, or the secondary key; sometimes an authentic cadence in the secondary key; rarely, it could be an AC in the tonic key.

title: 詞彙表
text: 中音／中音關係（mediant）這個詞有數種意思，以下由最具體到最廣義排列：1. 音階第三級（mi，3̂），以及／或建立在其上的三和弦（iii／III）。2. 根音位於主和弦上方或下方三度的和弦：大調中的iii與vi，小調中的III與VI。3. 任意兩個根音相距三度的和弦之間的關係。
en: mediant This term has multiple meanings, given here from most to least specific: 1. The third scale degree (mi, 3̂) and/or the triad built upon it (iii/III). 2. The chords a third above or below the root (iii and vi in major keys; III and VI in minor keys). 3. The relationship between two chords whose roots are related by third.

title: 詞彙表
text: 旋律音程兩音先後、分別發聲的音程。
en: melodic interval An interval whose notes are sounded separately (one note after another).

title: 詞彙表
text: 旋律倒影（melodic inversion）將音高材料上下鏡映，使下行變上行、上行變下行。倒影常保留音程內容。
en: melodic inversion The act of mirroring pitch content vertically, so that motion down becomes up and up becomes down. Inversion often preserves intervallic content.

title: 詞彙表
text: 旋律層（melodic layer）流行歌曲織體中的功能層，通常由人聲及其他旋律樂器演奏。特色是音色變化靈活，且相較周圍織體，所用樂器的音色較明亮。
en: melodic layer A functional layer within a pop song texture that is typically performed by the voice and other melodic instruments. The melodic layer is notable for involving high timbral flexibility, as well as instruments that are bright relative to the surrounding texture.

title: 詞彙表
text: 旋律小音階由半音（H）與全音（W）依序排列的音集合：上行順序為全—半—全—全—全—全—半；下行順序為全—全—半—全—全—半—全。
en: melodic minor An ordered collection of half steps (H) and whole steps (W) with the ascending succession W–H–W–W–W–W–H and the descending succession W–W–H–W–W–H–W.

title: 詞彙表
text: 法語藝術歌曲（mélodie）以法語演唱的藝術歌曲。
en: mélodie A French-language art song.

title: 詞彙表
text: 旋律加伴奏主調織度的一種，可以明確區分旋律聲部與支撐聲部，兩者通常使用不同節奏。
en: melody-and-accompaniment A type of homophony in which one can clearly distinguish between melodic and supporting voices, usually with differing rhythms between them.

title: 詞彙表
text: 拍節在時間中反覆出現的重音型態，樂譜以拍號表示。
en: meter A recurring pattern of accents that occur over time. Meters are indicated in music notation with a time signature.

title: 詞彙表
text: 節奏轉調（metric modulation）在原速度中引入某種細分或拍的組合，使其時值對應新速度中的音值，讓原本突兀的速度轉換變得平順。
en: metric modulation A means of smoothing out abrupt tempo changes by introducing subdivisions or groups of beats in the first tempo that match durations in the new tempo.

title: 詞彙表
text: 節拍器速度標示以每分鐘拍數（BPM）表示速度的記號。
en: metronome marking An indication of tempo in beats per minute (BPM).

title: 詞彙表
text: mezzo（中等地）適中地。
en: mezzo Moderately.

title: 詞彙表
text: 女中音譜號作為C譜號，女中音譜號以五線譜中線為中心，表示中線的音是C₄。
en: mezzo-soprano clef As a "C" clef, the mezzo-soprano clef shows that C₄ is the middle line of the staff by centering on it.

title: 詞彙表
text: 微分音（microtone）不在十二平均律音階上的音高，例如四分音。
en: microtone A tone that exists outside of the twelve-tone equal-tempered scale (for example, quarter tones).

title: 詞彙表
text: 中頻（mid-range）為描述旋律樂器而劃出的頻率範圍，本書約指500至5000赫茲。
en: mid-range A band of frequencies meant to capture melodic instruments; about 500–5000 Hz.

title: 詞彙表
text: 歌曲中段導奏功能類似導奏，但出現在歌曲中間；通常引入曲式循環的第一個樂段。
en: mid-song introduction Mid-song intros function similarly to introductions, but in the middle of the song. They usually introduce the first section in the formal cycle.

title: 詞彙表
text: 中央CC₄，即鋼琴鍵盤接近中央的C，記在高音譜表下加一線，或低音譜表上加一線。
en: middle C C₄; the C near the middle of the piano keyboard, written on the first ledger line below the treble clef staff or the first ledger line above the bass clef staff.

title: 詞彙表
text: 環境背景實體環境、社會環境，或兩者兼有。
en: milieu A physical and/or social setting.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小調藍調（minor blues）十二小節藍調的變體：i與iv使用小七和弦，並把V–IV–I的終止模式改為ii–V–i。
en: minor blues The minor blues differs from the standard 12-bar blues by having minor seventh chords on the i and iv chords, and replacing the V–IV–I cadence with a ii–V–I cadence.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小iv圖式（minor iv schema）在大調中使用小iv和弦，使降第六級音到第五級音形成半音下行。常先使用大IV再接小iv，形成第六級、降第六級、第五級的下行線。
en: minor iv schema Use of a minor iv chord in a major key. This creates a semitone descent between scale degrees ↓6̂ and 5̂. It is common to precede iv with IV (major), creating a descent 6̂–↓6̂–5̂.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小調五聲音集（minor pentatonic collection）由五個音組成，唱名為do、me、fa、sol、te，再回到高八度do。
en: minor pentatonic collection A five-note pentatonic collection with the solfège do, me, fa, sol, te, do.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小調五聲音階（minor pentatonic scale）音程依序為小三度－大二度－大二度－小三度－大二度。例如從A開始為A–C–D–E–G，再回到高八度A。小調五聲音階可以由大調五聲音階旋轉得到。
en: minor pentatonic scale A pentatonic scale with the intervals mi3–ma2–ma2–mi3–ma2. For example, starting on A, the minor pentatonic would be A–C–D–E–G. The minor pentatonic is a rotation of the major pentatonic.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小七和弦（minor seventh chord）由小三和弦加上根音上方的小七度音組成的七和弦。
en: minor seventh chord A seventh chord with a minor triad and a minor seventh.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小三和弦三音與根音形成小三度、五音與根音形成完全五度的三和弦。
en: minor triad A triad whose third is minor and fifth is perfect.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小小七和弦由小三和弦加上根音上方小七度音構成的七和弦，也稱小七和弦。
en: minor-minor seventh chord A seventh chord with a minor triad and a minor seventh. Also known as a minor seventh chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: 混合利底安（mixolydian）一種自然音調式，音程依序為全、全、半、全、全、半、全，如同把大音階第七級降低半音。從G開始彈鋼琴白鍵，也能得到這個音階。
en: mixolydian A diatonic mode that follows the pattern W–W–H–W–W–H–W. This is like the major scale, but with a lowered scale degree 7. This scale can also be found by playing the white notes of the piano starting on G.

title: 詞彙表
text: 記憶輔助法用來協助記憶的技巧。
en: mnemonic device A technique used to aid memorization.

title: 詞彙表
text: 模12（mod 12）modulo 12的縮寫；數字到12便繞回起點。十二小時制鐘面就是常見類比：12點之後又到1點。在本書音高類記法中，12對應0。
en: mod 12 Short for modulo 12, where numbers wrap around upon reaching 12. Arithmetic in mod 12 is most commonly encountered in clock time: after 12 o’clock, the time becomes 1 o’clock again.

title: 詞彙表
text: 調式明亮度「明亮」指較接近大調的聲響，「暗」指較接近小調的聲響。
en: modal brightness "Bright" refers to a more major sound, while "dark" refers to a more minor sound.

title: 詞彙表
text: 調式混合（mode mixture）在同一作品中，混用第三、第六及／或第七音級的大調與小調版本。
en: mode mixture The intermixing of major and minor versions of 3̂, 6̂, and/or 7̂ within a composition.

title: 詞彙表
text: 轉調調性的改變。
en: modulation A change of key.

title: 詞彙表
text: 單音織度（monophony）只有一條沒有伴奏的旋律線之音樂織度。
en: monophony A musical texture with a single, unaccompanied melodic line.

title: 詞彙表
text: 單一調性作品具有一個統攝全曲的主調，亦即開始與結束在同一調，且有一個主音讓人感覺它所屬的調是作品的主要調性。
en: monotonality A piece that has one overarching tonic, that is, it starts and ends in the same key and contains a single tonic that gives the impression of being the primary key of the work.

title: 詞彙表
text: 動機（motive）經常反覆出現、比樂思更短的音樂單位，通常在作品中經過各種變化。「動機」常指音高材料，但也可以是節奏或輪廓等其他材料。
en: motive A regularly recurring unit of music that's smaller than an idea, and which is typically transformed across a work. The word "motive" usually refers to pitch material, but other kinds of motives such as rhythmic or contour also exist.

title: 詞彙表
text: 動機時值擴大使動機的時值比原來長。
en: motivic enlargement Making the durations of a motive last longer than the original.

title: 詞彙表
text: 動力節奏持續使用快速音值，尤其是十六分音符；常見於巴洛克音樂。
en: motor rhythm Persistent rapid note values, especially sixteenth notes. Common in Baroque music.

title: 詞彙表
text: 首調唱名法以音階第一級為do的唱名系統；相對地，固定唱名法的do一律是音高類C。
en: movable do A system of solfège in which do is the first scale degree in a scale; this is in contrast to fixed do, where do is always the pitch class C.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音樂固定型（music-invariant）段落或樂句每次出現時，大部分音樂材料相同。
en: music-invariant A module or phrase is music-invariant if each time it appears it brings (mostly) the same music.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音樂變動型（music-variant）段落或樂句每次出現時，大部分音樂材料不同。
en: music-variant A module or phrase is music-variant if each time it appears it brings (mostly) different music.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音樂學者研究音樂的學者。
en: musicologists Music scholars.

title: 詞彙表
text: 本位音既不升高也不降低的音。
en: natural Neither sharp nor flat.

title: 詞彙表
text: 自然小音階（natural minor）半音與全音依上行順序排列為全—半—全—全—半—全—全的音階。
en: natural minor An ordered collection of half steps (H) and whole steps (W) with the ascending succession W–H–W–W–H–W–W.

title: 詞彙表
text: 拿坡里六和弦♭II⁶和弦。
en: Neapolitan sixth A ♭II⁶ chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: 鄰接關係變換（N，Nebenverwandt）一種新黎曼變換：將三和弦中構成小三度的兩音各移動半音，改變和弦的大小性質，例如 C 大三和弦與 F 小三和弦之間的轉換。
en: Nebenverwandt transformation (N) A Neo-Riemannian transformation that moves both members of the minor third in a triad by semitone, and again changes the mode (e.g., relating C major and F minor).

title: 詞彙表
text: 鄰音（neighbor tones，NTs）以級進進入，再以反方向級進離開的裝飾音。
en: neighbor tones (NTs) Embellishing tones that are approached by step and left by step in the opposite direction.

title: 詞彙表
text: 鄰音式運動（neighboring）和弦音先級進到另一音，再回到原和弦音的運動。例如C大三和弦上方的C–D–C，就是鄰音式運動，其中D是鄰音。若兩個和弦之間的聲部連接只包含鄰音運動與共同音保持，也可以說整個和聲以鄰音式方式裝飾另一和聲，例如共同音減七和弦。
en: neighboring A type of motion where a chord tone moves by step to another tone, then moves back to the original chord tone. For example, C–D–C above a C major chord would be an example of neighboring motion, in which D can be described as a neighbor tone. Entire harmonies may be said to be neighboring when embellishing another harmony, when the voice-leading between the two chords involves only neighboring and common-tone motion (as in the common-tone diminished seventh chord).

title: 詞彙表
text: 鄰音四六和弦以鄰音進行裝飾和聲的一種四六和弦。通常用數字標示，例如一個聲部為5–6–5，另一聲部為3–4–3。
en: neighboring 6/4 A kind of 6/4 chord that embellishes a harmony with neighbor motion. This is usually labeled with figures, e.g., with 5-6-5 in one voice and 3-4-3 in another.

title: 詞彙表
text: 打擊樂譜號用於無固定音高的打擊樂器。使用此譜號時，譜線與譜間代表不同樂器，而非不同字母音名。
en: neutral clef A neutral clef is used for percussion instruments of indefinite pitch. The lines and spaces on a staff with a neutral clef indicate different instruments instead of different letter names.

title: 詞彙表
text: 常規律動（normal feel）相對於倍速或半速律動，常規律動的反拍與四拍子第2、4拍對齊，符合通常預期的位置。
en: normal feel In contrast to a double-time or half-time feel, a normal feel occurs when the backbeat is aligns with beats two and four of a quadruple measure (that is, the expected timing of the backbeat).

title: 詞彙表
text: 標準排序（normal order）將一組音高類排列得最緊密的方式。
en: normal order The most compressed way to write a given collection of pitch classes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 換音（nota cambiata）類別對位中的五音裝飾型態，有兩種形式。1）下行級進、下行三度、上行級進、上行級進。2）上行級進、上行三度、下行級進、下行級進。
en: nota cambiata A five-note species counterpoint embellishment that may occur in one of two different forms: 1) Down by step, down by third, up by step, up by step 2) Up by step, up by third, down by step, down by step

title: 詞彙表
text: 音／音符兼有音高與節奏成分的音樂聲音；其記譜符號可包含符桿、符槓或符尾。
en: note A musical sound that has both a pitch and a rhythmic component; the symbol may include a stem, beam, and/or flag.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音符時值音符的相對長度。
en: note value The relative duration of a note.

title: 詞彙表
text: 符頭（notehead）音符的橢圓部分，可以是實心黑色，也可以是空心。
en: notehead The elliptical part of the note. Can be either filled in (black) or outlined (white).

title: 詞彙表
text: 新奇層（novelty layer）流行歌曲織體中的功能層，透過呼應或插入式音型，與旋律層形成對照。常使用音色特徵不易與其他合奏樂器融合的樂器。
en: novelty layer A functional layer within a pop song texture that works in opposition with the melodic layer through call-and-response gestures or interjections. This layer often uses instruments whose timbral features resist blending with the rest of the ensemble.

title: 詞彙表
text: 斜向進行一個聲部的旋律移動，另一聲部則保持同一音高。
en: oblique motion When one voice moves melodically while another voice remains on the same pitch.

title: 詞彙表
text: 八音音集（octatonic collection）由全音與半音交替構成，共有八個不同音高類。例如 C–C♯–D♯–E–F♯–G–A–B♭。爵士樂手也稱它為減音階。
en: octatonic collection The octatonic collection is built with an alternation of whole steps and half steps, leading to a total of eight distinct pitches. One example is C–C♯–D♯–E–F♯–G–A–B♭. Jazz musicians refer to this as the diminished scale.

title: 詞彙表
text: 八度兩個字母音名相同的音之間，相距十二個半音的音程。兩音的頻率比為2:1，縮寫為8ve。
en: octave An interval of twelve half steps between two notes with the same letter name. The frequencies of two notes related by octave form a 2:1 ratio. Abbreviated “8ve.”

title: 詞彙表
text: 八度等價（octave equivalence）音名拼寫相同，但相隔一個或多個八度的音高之間的等價關係。
en: octave equivalence A relationship between pitches that share a letter name but are separated by one or more octaves.

title: 詞彙表
text: 八度移位高音譜號G譜號的一種，以捲曲部分環繞五線譜由下往上第二線，指定該線為G。其實際音高比一般高音譜號低八度或高八度，分別以寫在高音譜號下方或上方的8表示。
en: octave treble clef As a "G" clef, the octave treble clef designates the second-lowest line of a staff as G by curling around it. An octave treble clef sounds one octave below or above a treble clef. This is designated with an "8" below or above the treble clef.

title: 詞彙表
text: 非拍點（off-beat）不落在第1、2、3拍等拍點上的節奏位置或音符。
en: off-beat A rhythmic or note value that does not fall on a beat (1, 2, 3, etc.).

title: 詞彙表
text: 以非主和聲起始（off-tonic）樂句或段落以主和聲以外的和弦開始。
en: off-tonic A phrase or module is off-tonic when it begins on a harmony other than tonic.

title: 詞彙表
text: 以主和聲起始（on-tonic）樂句或段落由主和聲，也就是原位I和弦開始。
en: on-tonic A phrase or module is on-tonic when it begins with tonic harmony (I in root position).

title: 詞彙表
text: 再來一次（one-more-time）樂句內部擴展的一種技巧，由Janet Schmalfeldt命名，包含三個步驟：一、音樂試圖形成終止式；二、該次終止被迴避；三、音樂再次嘗試終止。
en: one-more-time A technique of internal phrase expansion. Coined by Janet Schmalfeldt, the technique involves three steps: (1) the music tries to cadence, (2) the attempted cadence is evaded, and (3) the music retries the cadence.

title: 詞彙表
text: 開放排列和弦各音的間距，超出它們所能採用的最密集位置。
en: open spacing Notes of a chord are spaced out beyond their closest possible position.

title: 詞彙表
text: 運算（集合論）在集合論中，「運算」指移位與倒影。
en: operations (set theory) In set theory, "operations" refers to transposition and inversion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 有序音高音程（ordered pitch interval）以半音數衡量兩個音高的距離，並用正號表示上行、負號表示下行。例如C₄到E₅的有序音高音程為＋16。
en: ordered pitch interval The distance between two pitches measured in semitones, with a plus or minus symbol to indicate ascending or descending, respectively. For example: C₄ to E₅ would be an ordered pitch interval of +16.

title: 詞彙表
text: 有序音高類音程（ordered pitch-class interval）從起點音高類向上計算到終點音高類的半音距離；在音高類鐘面上，一律順時針計算。
en: ordered pitch-class interval The distance between pitch classes from lowest to highest. In other words, pitch class intervals are measured on the clock face, always going clockwise.

title: 詞彙表
text: 有序集合（ordered set）依指定順序出現的一組事物。例如有序音高集合，在作品中以固定次序出現；相較之下，無序音高類集合中的音，可依任意順序出現。
en: ordered set A group of things that appear in a specified sequence. An ordered pitch set, for example, appears in a consistent order within a piece of music. Compare against a pitch class set, where the pitches are unordered, meaning they can appear in any order in the piece of music.

title: 詞彙表
text: 固定音型（ostinato）持續反覆的節奏或音高動機，周圍的音樂脈絡則未必以相同方式反覆。
en: ostinato A rhythmic/pitch motive that repeats within a context that is not similarly repeating.

title: 詞彙表
text: 收尾段（outro）把歌曲帶回寂靜、使能量降低的段落。在錄音室中，常以淡出完成。
en: outro Outros function as a transition from song back to silence, and thus decrease energy. Often this is accomplished in the recording studio by way of a fadeout.

title: 詞彙表
text: 泛自然音寫作（pandiatonic）使用自然音音集中的音，但不建立音高中心感的寫作方式。
en: pandiatonic Pandiatonicism uses the notes of a diatonic collection without imparting a sense of pitch center.

title: 詞彙表
text: 平行進行兩個聲部朝同一方向、以相同度數作旋律移動，例如兩部都上行二度。音程性質可以不同，仍算平行進行。依此定義，兩聲部之間也維持相同度數的和聲音程。
en: parallel motion When two voices move melodically in the same direction and by the same interval—for example, both voices move upward by a melodic second. (Note: the quality of the interval may vary, and it still counts as parallel motion.) By definition, two voices moving in parallel motion will also maintain the same harmonic interval between them.

title: 詞彙表
text: 同主音關係（parallel relationship）兩個調或音階共享同一主音，例如C大調與C小調。
en: parallel relationship When two keys/scales share the same tonic, such as C major and C minor.

title: 詞彙表
text: 同主音變換（P）一種新黎曼變換：保留三和弦中的完全五度，讓剩餘的一音移動半音，例如 C 大三和弦與 C 小三和弦之間的轉換。
en: Parallel transformation (P) A Neo-Riemannian transformation that preserves the perfect fifth in the triad, and moves the remaining note by semitone (e.g., relating C major and C minor).

title: 詞彙表
text: 分音（partial）複合音中，組成其頻譜的某一個頻率成分。
en: partial A component frequency within a complex tone's set of overtones.

title: 詞彙表
text: 經過式運動（passing）和弦音先級進到另一音，再以相同方向級進解決的運動。例如C大三和弦上方的C–D–E，就是經過式運動，D為經過音。若兩個和弦之間的聲部連接主要運用經過音，也能把整個和聲看作裝飾另一和聲的經過和聲，例如經過六四和弦。
en: passing A type of motion where a chord tone moves by step to another tone, then resolves by step in the same direction. For example, C–D–E above a C major chord would be an example of neighboring motion, in which D can be described as a passing tone. Entire harmonies may be said to be passing when embellishing another harmony, when the voice-leading between the two chords involves mainly passing tones (as in the passing 6/4 chord).

title: 詞彙表
text: 經過四六和弦建立在低音經過音上的四六和弦，最常用來延長主和聲或前屬和聲。經過四六和弦前後兩側的和弦，功能一律相同。
en: passing 6/4 A 6/4 chord built on a passing tone in the bass, most commonly found prolonging tonic or predominant harmonies. Importantly, the chords on both sides of the passing 6/4 are always the same function.

title: 詞彙表
text: 持續音常見於低音聲部，由一串維持不變的音構成；其上方的和弦發生變化，其中有些和弦並不包含這個低音。
en: pedal tones Pedal tones are often found in the bass. They consist of a series of static notes over top of which chord changes occur that do not include the bass.

title: 詞彙表
text: 五聲音集（pentatonic collection）以大二度、大二度、小三度、大二度、小三度的音程模式構成。也可以只取大音階的第1、2、3、5、6級，得到這個音集。
en: pentatonic collection A pitch collection built with the interval pattern ma2–ma2–mi3–ma2–mi3. This collection can also be generated by using scale degrees 1̂, 2̂, 3̂, 5̂, and 6̂ only of the major scale.

title: 詞彙表
text: 倒數第二的倒數第二。
en: penultimate Second-to-last.

title: 詞彙表
text: 打擊樂譜號（percussion clef）用於無固定音高打擊樂器的譜號，譜上的每條線或每個間，代表不同聲音。記號：𝄥。
en: percussion clef A clef used by non-pitched percussion instruments, where each line or space is dedicated to a different sound. Notation: 𝄥

title: 詞彙表
text: 完全正格終止（PAC）旋律以do（1̂）結束的V–I終止式，兩個和弦都必須是原位。
en: perfect authentic cadence (PAC) A V–I cadence that ends with do (1̂) in the melody. Both harmonies must be in root position.

title: 詞彙表
text: 完全協和音程完全八度（十二個半音）、完全同度（零個半音）與完全五度（七個半音）。完全四度（五個半音）有時被視為完全協和，有時被視為不協和，取決於語境。
en: perfect consonance Perfect octaves (twelve semitones), perfect unisons (zero semitones), and perfect fifths (seven semitones). Perfect fourths (five semitones) are sometimes considered a perfect consonance, sometimes a dissonance; this depends on the context.

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂段由前句與後句兩個樂句構成的樂句層次曲式。
en: period A phrase-level form that consists of two phrases: an antecedent and a consequent.

title: 詞彙表
text: 週期性（periodicity）某事物重複發生的頻率。
en: periodicity The rate at which something repeats.

title: 詞彙表
text: 分期將時間劃分為不同時期。
en: periodize To divide time into different periods.

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂句相對完整、呈現朝向某個目標推進軌跡的樂思；目標常為終止式。
en: phrase A relatively complete musical thought that exhibits trajectory toward a goal (often a cadence).

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂句重疊兩個樂句相互重疊，一處同時作為前句的結束與下一句的開始。
en: phrase elision The overlapping of two phrases, functioning as the ending of one phrase and the simultaneous beginning of the next.

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂句擴展透過內部或外部延長，使樂句超出預期長度。
en: phrase expansion The lengthening of a phrase, whether internally or externally, beyond its expected duration.

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂句模型表示樂句中和聲功能的典型順序與流向：主—前屬—屬（—主）。
en: phrase model Indicates the typical order and flow of harmonic functions in a phrase: tonic–predominant–dominant(–tonic).

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂句層次曲式指樂句由次樂句、樂念與動機構成的各種方式，例如樂句型、樂段、重複樂句與混合形式。
en: phrase-level form Refers to the various ways in which a phrase may be constructed of subphrases, ideas, and motives. Examples of phrase-level forms include sentences, periods, repeated phrases, and hybrid forms.

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂句處理演出時塑造樂段的方式，例如在哪裡推進或放緩速度，以及何處、如何改變力度。
en: phrasing The way a passage might be shaped in performance (where to push and pull the tempo, where and how to change dynamic levels, etc.).

title: 詞彙表
text: 弗里吉安（phrygian）全音、半音依序為半—全—全—全—半—全—全的自然音調式。它相當於自然小音階降低第二級，也可由鋼琴白鍵從E開始排列得到。
en: phrygian A diatonic mode that follows the pattern H–W–W–W–H–W–W. This is like the natural minor scale, but with a lowered scale degree 2. This scale can also be found by playing the white notes of the piano starting on E.

title: 詞彙表
text: 弗里吉安半終止弗里吉安半終止（PHC）是一種特殊的樂句終止型結束，只出現在小調，使用iv⁶–V進行。低音le（↓6̂）移至sol（5̂）形成半音，聲響類似弗里吉安調式中的ra（↓2̂）移至do（1̂），因此得名。
en: phrygian half cadence The phrygian half cadence (PHC) is a special kind of cadential phrase ending that occurs only in minor and involves the progression iv6–V. It's called “phrygian” because of the half step that occurs when le (↓6̂) moves to sol (5̂) in the bass, a sound that’s similar to when ra (↓2̂) moves to do (1̂) in the phrygian mode.

title: 詞彙表
text: piano（弱）弱奏。
en: piano Quiet.

title: 詞彙表
text: 皮卡第三度（picardy third）以大主和弦I取代小主和弦i，例如整體在C小調的作品，改用C大和弦。
en: picardy third Substituting a major I chord for a minor I chord (for example, using C major instead of C minor in a piece that is in C minor overall).

title: 詞彙表
text: 音高（pitch）具有特定頻率位置的個別音。
en: pitch A discrete tone with an individual frequency.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音高類（pitch class）透過八度等價與同音異名等價，歸為同一群的音高。
en: pitch class A group of pitches that are octave equivalent and enharmonically equivalent.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音高音程（pitch interval）以半音數測量的音程。例如音高音程2是兩個半音，音高音程7是七個半音。
en: pitch interval A type of interval that is measured in semitones. For example, the pitch interval 2 is two semitones; the pitch interval 7 is seven semitones.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音高類集合（pitch-class set）一組音高類。
en: pitch-class set A group of pitch classes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 樞紐和弦用來在兩調之間轉調，且同時屬於兩調自然音和聲的和弦。
en: pivot chord A chord used to modulate between two keys that is diatonic in both.

title: 詞彙表
text: 變格（plagal）音域由主音下方四度延伸至上方五度的調式；在教會調式的語境下，這個參照音更適合稱為終止音。
en: plagal A mode with a range of a fifth above and fourth below its tonic.

title: 詞彙表
text: 變格終止（plagal cadence）使用IV–I和聲的終止。
en: plagal cadence A plagal cadence uses the harmonies IV–I.

title: 詞彙表
text: 變格進行（plagal motion）IV或IV⁶進行到I或I⁶。
en: plagal motion Occurs when IV (or IV⁶) moves to I (or I⁶).

title: 詞彙表
text: 多重拍子（polymeter）同時記出兩種以上拍子。
en: polymeter When two or more meters are notated simultaneously.

title: 詞彙表
text: 複調織度（polyphony）具有多條獨立旋律聲部的音樂織度，各聲部透過不同節奏或音程輪廓彼此區分，也稱對位。複調可出現在許多風格中，但常與賦格、卡農等對位體裁相聯繫。
en: polyphony A musical texture with multiple independent melodic voices, distinguished from one another through different rhythms and/or intervallic profiles. Also known as counterpoint. Polyphony may occur in many styles but is commonly associated with contrapuntal genres like fugues and canons.

title: 詞彙表
text: 終止後延伸（p.c.e.）後綴，也就是外部擴展的一種類型。通常較短，常出現在樂段內部某個樂句的結尾，一般會延長終止式的最後和弦，或重述形成終止式的兩個和弦。
en: post-cadential extension (p.c.e.) A type of suffix (external expansion). Post-cadential extensions are usually short, they often occur at the ends of phrases within a section, and they typically prolong the final chord of the cadence or re-state the two chords that created the cadence.

title: 詞彙表
text: 後副歌（postchorus）接在副歌後的短段落，只用來結束當前循環，不負責引入或過渡到下一輪循環的開頭。
en: postchorus A short section that follows a chorus and serves only to close the cycle—does not introduce or transition to the beginning of the next cycle.

title: 詞彙表
text: 前副歌（prechorus）最明顯的功能是累積能量。前副歌常使用動機片段化、和聲節奏加快、離開主和聲，以及和聲開放等手法。
en: prechorus Prechorus function is most significantly typified in energy gain. Prechorus sections often use motivic fragmentation, acceleration of harmonic rhythm, movement away from tonic harmony, and harmonic openness.

title: 詞彙表
text: 前屬功能（predominant function）具有前屬功能的和弦，負責從主功能過渡到屬功能。
en: predominant function Predominant function chords are those that transition away from tonic function toward dominant function.

title: 詞彙表
text: 前綴出現在樂句開始之前的外部擴展，通常是導奏。可以很短，例如藝術歌曲的伴奏在歌者之前先開始；也可以很長，例如交響曲以慢速導奏開頭。
en: prefix An external expansion that occurs before the beginning of a phrase. Prefixes are usually introductions, and they may be small, as when the accompaniment for a lied begins before the singer, or they may be large, as when a symphony begins with a slow introduction.

title: 詞彙表
text: 呈示部（樂句型）由基本樂念及其重複構成的次樂句，通常不以終止式結束。
en: presentation A subphrase consisting of a basic idea and its repetition. Presentations don't usually end with cadences.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主要主題（P主題）奏鳴曲式作品中位於本調的主要樂段，通常具有穩定性。
en: primary theme (P theme) The main section of a sonata-form work, in the tonic key. P themes are usually stable.

title: 詞彙表
text: 原型（prime form）集合類的名稱：選取該類最緊密的代表形式，並移位至0起始。
en: prime form A name for a set class. The prime form is the version of the set class that is most compact to the left and transposed to begin on 0.

title: 詞彙表
text: 變化撇號（′）樂句與曲式分析中使用的符號（′），表示重複素材與最初陳述相比，某些方面有所改變。
en: prime symbol A symbol (′) that is used in the analysis of phrases and forms to indicate that some repeated material has changed, in some way, from its initial statement.

title: 詞彙表
text: 漸進調性作品以不同主音開始與結束。可與單一調性比較；後者是十七、十八、十九世紀大多數調性作品的通常和聲規劃。
en: progressive tonality A piece that starts and ends with different tonics. Compare with monotonality, which is the default harmonic plan in most tonal works from the 17th, 18th, and 19th centuries.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和聲延長（prolongation）某個和聲的影響持續超過單一和弦的時值。通常透過該和弦與其他較次要和弦交替，維持被延長和聲的作用。
en: prolongation When a given harmony’s influence lasts longer than a single chord. Usually this is accomplished by alternating the prolonged chord with other, less important chords.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聽寫草記法省去複雜元素，只聚焦於拍節、節奏與音階級數等基本要素的記譜系統。
en: protonotation A system of musical notation stripped of complicating elements, focusing only on basic elements of meter, rhythm, and scale degree.

title: 詞彙表
text: 四拍子（quadruple meter）每小節有四拍的拍子。
en: quadruple meter A meter with four beats per measure.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和弦性質（quality）概括和弦根音上方三度、五度，以及七度（若有）之性質的名稱。常見和弦性質有大、小、減、半減、屬與增。
en: quality (chord) A term that summarizes the quality of the third, fifth, and seventh (if applicable) above the root of the chord. Common chord qualities are major, minor, diminished, half-diminished, dominant, and augmented.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音程性質（quality）指出音程中兩音之間精確半音距離的名稱；相較之下，音程度數只計算跨越的字母音名數。常見性質為大、小、完全、增、減。
en: quality (interval) A term that indicates the exact number of half steps between two pitches in an interval (compare with interval size, which indicates only the number of letters between two pitches). Common interval qualities are major, minor, perfect, augmented, and diminished.

title: 詞彙表
text: 四分音符時值為二分音符的一半，或等於兩個八分音符的音符。
en: quarter note A note value that lasts half the duration of a half note, or the duration of two eighth notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 四分休止符時值為二分休止符的一半，或等於兩個八分休止符的休止符。
en: quarter rest A type of rest that lasts half the duration of a half rest, or the duration of two eighth rests.

title: 詞彙表
text: 四行詩節（quatrain）由四行歌詞組成的一組。
en: quatrain A group of lyrics that is four lines long.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音域人聲或樂器能發出音高的範圍。
en: range The span of notes a voice or instrument can produce.

title: 詞彙表
text: 真實答題將賦格主題移高或移低四度、五度，由第二聲部陳述，以回應第一聲部的主題陳述。
en: real answer A fugue subject transposed by fourth/fifth, stated in a second voice in response to the first voice's subject statement.

title: 詞彙表
text: 實現（數字低音）將數字低音符號轉化為和弦的過程。
en: realizing The process of turning figured bass symbols into chords.

title: 詞彙表
text: 再現部（recapitulation）奏鳴曲式中再次帶回呈示部主題，並解決呈示部所建立衝突的段落。
en: recapitulation A section of a sonata-form work that brings back themes from the exposition and resolves the conflict established in the exposition.

title: 詞彙表
text: 反覆主題（輪旋曲式）輪旋曲式作品的主要主題，通常出現在開頭、每個對比插部之後，以及最後一段；其後仍可能接尾聲。
en: refrain (rondo form) The primary theme of a rondo-form work, typically stated at the beginning, after each contrasting episode, and as the last section (though a coda may follow).

title: 詞彙表
text: 疊句（refrain，歌曲曲式）在其餘部分屬於歌詞變動型的段落中，一小段歌詞固定型材料。疊句太短，無法自成段落，通常只有一個樂句或更短。
en: refrain (song form) A lyric-invariant passage within a section that is otherwise lyric-variant. A refrain is too short to form its own section—typically a phrase or less.

title: 詞彙表
text: 相對（relative）以另一套系統為參照來理解。例如，若兩個調式的音階共用全部音高，就可稱為關係調式，如C大調與A小調。
en: relative Considered in relation to some other system. For example, modes are said to be relative if their scales share all the same notes (like C major and A minor).

title: 詞彙表
text: 關係調關係（relative relationship）兩個調或音階使用相同的一組音高。
en: relative relationship When two keys/scales share the same pitches.

title: 詞彙表
text: 關係變換（R）一種新黎曼變換：保留三和弦中的大三度，讓剩餘的一音移動全音，例如 C 大三和弦與 A 小三和弦之間的轉換。
en: Relative transformation (R) A Neo-Riemannian transformation that preserves the major third in the triad and moves the remaining note by whole tone (e.g., relating C major and A minor).

title: 詞彙表
text: 釋放聲音訊號包絡線的最後階段，由發聲轉為無聲。
en: release In a sound signal's envelope, the release is the final phase, and transitions from sound to silence.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小節反覆記號表示重複前一小節或前兩小節。
en: repeat sign Indicates one should repeat either the previous measure, or the previous two measures.

title: 詞彙表
text: 段落反覆記號表示某段音樂需要反覆的符號：𝄆與𝄇。
en: repeat signs Symbols (𝄆 and 𝄇) indicating that a section of music is repeated.

title: 詞彙表
text: 重複樂句由兩個樂句構成，第二句重複第一句。重複內容一定完整寫出；僅有反覆記號不表示這種「重複樂句」形式。第二句通常是最初陳述的變奏。
en: repeated phrase Two phrases where the second one is a repetition of the first. The repetition is always written out (repeat signs don't signify a repeated phrase), and usually the repetition is a variation on the initial statement.

title: 詞彙表
text: 重複樂句內部擴展的一種技巧。作曲家有時重複素材來增加樂句長度；重複可以完全相同，也可以有所變化。
en: repetition A technique of internal phrase expansion. Sometimes a composer repeats material to create extra length in a phrase. Such repetitions may be exact or varied.

title: 詞彙表
text: 反覆段作品中帶有反覆記號的樂段，例如二段式的任一部分。
en: reprise A section of a work that bears repeat signs, like either of the parts of a binary form.

title: 詞彙表
text: 改道替代路徑的一種類型，使樂句通往終止式的軌跡永久改變；由轉離原路徑的動作開始。
en: reroute A type of alternative path that involves a permanent change of a phrase's trajectory toward the cadence. Reroutes are initiated by a diversion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 休止音樂中具有確定時值的無聲部分。
en: rest A measured silence in a piece of music.

title: 詞彙表
text: 上行掛留由前一個不動的音延續而來、再向上級進離開的裝飾音，出現在拍中較強的位置。
en: retardation An embellishing tone that is approached by static note and left by step up. The retardation is on a stronger part of the beat.

title: 詞彙表
text: 再過渡部與過渡部十分相似，但再過渡部導回本調的主要樂段，過渡部則離開主調。再過渡部可以有明確的半終止結尾，其後也可能接後綴；也可以讓結尾與下一樂段的起始重疊。
en: retransition A retransition is very similar to a transition, but retransitions lead to a return to the main section in the tonic key, while transitions move away from tonic. Retransitions may have a clear half-cadential ending (possibly followed by a suffix), or they may have an elided ending that coincides with the initiation of the following section.

title: 詞彙表
text: 逆行主題、音列形式或動機，相對於最初或原始陳述，以倒序演奏。
en: retrograde Describes when a theme, row form, or motive is played backward in comparison to an initial (or original) statement.

title: 詞彙表
text: 節奏音樂聲音與休止在時間中的長度。
en: rhythm The duration of musical sounds and rests in time.

title: 詞彙表
text: 附點將音符或休止符的時值增加原值的一半。
en: rhythm dot Increases a note or rest value by half.

title: 詞彙表
text: 節奏組在爵士樂中，指鋼琴、吉他、貝斯與打擊樂器。
en: rhythm section In jazz, the piano, guitar, bass, and percussion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 節奏唱讀系統將節奏時值與特定音節配對的系統。
en: rhythmic solmization A system that pairs rhythmic values with particular syllables.

title: 詞彙表
text: Ride鈸（叮叮鈸）大型懸掛鈸，直徑通常20至24英吋。較薄的Ride鈸常見於爵士，可發出溫暖而綿延的聲響；金屬樂常見的厚鈸，可能產生尖銳、高頻且有顆粒感的聲音。敲擊中央隆起的鈸鐘，可得到高而清亮的鈴聲。
en: Ride cymbal A large suspended cymbal, usually 20–24” in diameter. Depending on the thickness of the cymbal, the ride may sound like a warm wash of sound (thinner rides, common in jazz) or a sharp, high-pitched crunch (thicker rides, common in metal music). High, pure ringing sounds can be produced by playing the “bell” of the ride, located in the middle of the cymbal.

title: 詞彙表
text: ritardando（漸慢）速度逐漸放慢。
en: ritardando A gradual decrease in speed (tempo).

title: 詞彙表
text: 羅馬數字分析以羅馬數字，有時加上數字低音數字，標示和弦。
en: Roman numeral analysis Labeling chords with Roman numerals (and sometimes figured bass figures).

title: 詞彙表
text: 羅馬數字I、II、III、IV、V、VI、VII分別代表1至7。和聲分析中，羅馬數字表示建立在相應音階級數上的三和弦，例如V是建立在5̂上的三和弦。
en: Roman numerals Numerals I, II, III, IV, V, VI, and VII for 1–7, respectively. In the analysis of harmony, Roman numerals represent triads built on the corresponding scale degree (for example, a V chord is a triad built on 5̂).

title: 詞彙表
text: 根音（root）將三和弦或七和弦排列成三度疊置時，位於最下方的音。
en: root The lowest note of a triad or seventh chord when the chord is stacked in thirds.

title: 詞彙表
text: 根音進行（root motion）相鄰和弦根音之間的距離。例如「根音級進」表示兩和弦的根音只相距一步，如I與ii、IV與V等。根音不一定在最低聲部，因此根音進行與低音進行是不同概念。
en: root motion The distance between roots of adjacent chords. For example, "root motion by step" refers to the distance between two chords that are only one step apart, such as I and ii, IV and V, etc. Note that the root is not always in the bass, so this is a separate concept from bass motion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 原位（root position）將和弦音排列成三度堆疊，並把根音放在最下方。
en: root position Ordering the notes of a chord so that it is entirely stacked in thirds. The root of the chord is on the bottom.

title: 詞彙表
text: 輪換起點（rotation，流行圖式）從和聲圖式中的另一個和弦開始，但仍以原來的和弦順序前進。
en: rotation (pop schemas) Beginning a harmonic schema on a different chord within the schema, but proceeding through the harmonies in the same order.

title: 詞彙表
text: 再現二段式（rounded binary form）二段式的一種：第一反覆段開頭的材料，在第二反覆段接近中間的位置重現。這段材料兩次出現時，通常都在主調。
en: rounded binary form A type of binary form where the material at the start of reprise 1 returns somewhere near the middle of reprise 2. Both appearances of that repeated music are expected to be in the home key.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音列（row）序列作品中依順序排列的要素，也稱series（序列）。這些要素通常是音高，但也可能是時值、力度等。
en: row The ordered elements in a serial composition, also referred to as a series. These elements are often pitches, but could be other things such as durations or dynamics.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音列類（row class）某音列所有形式的集合。大多數音列類包含48個不同版本，但有些因形式重複而較少；例如某原形版本可能與某逆行版本相同。
en: row class A collection of all forms of a given row. Most row classes contain 48 versions of a row, but some contain fewer due to duplications of row forms. For example, a prime version of a row may be equivalent to a retrograde version of the row.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音列形式（row form）序列音樂中某音列的一個特定版本，例如原形、移位、倒影或逆行形式。
en: row form A particular version of a row in serial music; that is, prime, transposed, inverted, or retrograded.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音列矩陣（row matrix）用12×12方格整理一個音列類的48個形式位置；具有對稱的音列可能出現相同形式的重複。
en: row matrix A 12-by-12 grid that sets out all 48 forms of a row class.

title: 詞彙表
text: SATB四部織度由女高音（S）、女低音（A）、男高音（T）與男低音（B）構成的音樂織度。
en: SATB A musical texture with soprano (S), alto (A), tenor (T), and bass (B) parts.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音階依序排列半音與全音的音集合。
en: scale An ordered collection of half steps and whole steps.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音階級數一個音在自然音音階中的相對位置，以1至7的數字表示其相對於該音階主音的位置。
en: scale degree The relative position of a note within a diatonic scale. Indicated with a number, 1–7, that indicates this position relative to the tonic of that scale.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音階各級名稱依音在音階中的功能命名、可隨主音移動的一套名稱，例如主音（do，第一級）與屬音（sol，第五級）。
en: scale-degree names A movable system of names for scale degrees based on their function within the scale, such as tonic (do, scale degree 1) and dominant (sol, scale degree 5).

title: 詞彙表
text: 圖式（schema）具有代表性的和弦進行或曲式結構。
en: schema A prototypical chord progression or formal structure.

title: 詞彙表
text: 第二轉位以五音為低音的三和弦和聲。
en: second inversion A triadic harmony with the fifth in the bass.

title: 詞彙表
text: 副屬和弦（secondary dominant）含半音變化的和弦，藉由在另一個調性中扮演屬功能，暫時主音化原主調以外的和弦或調。
en: secondary dominant A chromatic chord that temporarily tonicizes another key besides the tonic key, by taking on a dominant function in that new key.

title: 詞彙表
text: 次要調性整體屬於另一調的作品中，暫時出現的調。例如A大調作品可能暫時轉至E大調，E大調就是其中的次要調性。
en: secondary key A temporary key within a piece that is overall in a different key. For example, a piece in A major may temporarily modulate to E major; E major is a secondary key within A major.

title: 詞彙表
text: 副導音和弦（secondary leading-tone）使非主和弦暫時聽起來像主和弦的導音和弦。副導音和弦通常是全減七和弦，偶爾也用半減七和弦。
en: secondary leading-tone A leading-tone chord that makes a non-tonic chord temporarily sound like tonic. Most often, secondary leading-tone chords are fully diminished, though occasionally they are half-diminished.

title: 詞彙表
text: 副主題（S主題）奏鳴曲式作品中的對比樂段。S主題在對比調性中開始與結束，大調奏鳴曲通常使用V，小調奏鳴曲通常使用III或v。副主題通常具有穩定性。
en: secondary theme (S theme) The contrasting section of a sonata-form work. The S theme begins and ends in a contrasting key (usually V in major-mode sonatas and either III or v in minor-mode sonatas). S themes are usually stable.

title: 詞彙表
text: 段落（section）作品整體曲式中最高層次的分段，例如奏鳴曲式的呈示部、二段式的第一段，或流行歌曲的副歌。
en: section The highest-level division of the overall form of the piece. Examples include the exposition in sonata form, the first part of a binary form, or the chorus of a pop song.

title: 詞彙表
