text: 片段（segment）較大分組中的一部分。在序列分析中，音列片段可以包含任意數量的要素；例如十二音音列常以三音或四音片段來觀察。
en: segment A portion of a larger grouping. In serial analysis, segments of a row can be any number of elements (for example, in a twelve-tone row, it's common to look at three- or four-note segments).

title: 詞彙表
text: 分析分段（segmentation）將一段音樂或整首作品，劃分為構成部分的過程。
en: segmentation The process of dividing a passage or piece of music into its component parts.

title: 詞彙表
text: 樂句型（sentence）由呈示部與延續部構成的一種特殊樂句。
en: sentence A special kind of phrase consisting of a presentation and a continuation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 類樂句型的與典型樂句型有明顯差異，但仍呈現某些樂句型結構特徵的樂句。
en: sentential A phrase that differs substantially from the archetypal sentence while still exhibiting some traits of a sentence-structure phrase.

title: 詞彙表
text: 模進以某個固定音程移位、重複一個型態。模進可以出現在旋律、和聲，或兩者之中。
en: sequence A pattern that is repeated and transposed by some consistent interval. A sequence may occur in the melody, the harmony, or both.

title: 詞彙表
text: 模進複本模進中，將模型素材重複並移位的片段。
en: sequence copy The segment of a sequence that repeats and transposes the material from the model.

title: 詞彙表
text: 模進模型為模進確立型態的音樂片段，也就是在模進中被複製的片段。
en: sequence model The segment of music that establishes the pattern for a sequence; in other words, the segment that gets copied in a sequence.

title: 詞彙表
text: 序列技法（serialism）將音樂要素，例如音高、時值或力度，依特定順序組織的策略。
en: serialism A strategy of putting elements of music (pitch, duration, dynamics, etc.) in a particular order.

title: 詞彙表
text: 序列（series）序列作品中依順序排列的要素。通常是音高，但也可能是時值、力度等其他要素。
en: series Refers to the ordered elements in a serial composition. These elements are often pitches, but could be other things such as durations or dynamics.

title: 詞彙表
text: 集合（set）集合論中，把成員放在一起的一組事物；成員不一定具有特定的相互關係。
en: set In set theory, a group whose members are not necessarily related.

title: 詞彙表
text: 集合類（set class）一群透過移位或倒影相互關聯的音高類集合。集合類以原型命名，例如(012)。
en: set class A group of pitch-class sets related by transposition or inversion. Set classes are named by their prime forms; for example, (012) is a set class.

title: 詞彙表
text: 集合論（set theory）分析無調性音樂中音高組織的方法。音高類以0至11的整數命名，例如C為0、C♯為1。將一組音高一起視為「集合」，不同集合可以透過倒影或移位相互關聯。
en: set theory A methodology for analyzing pitch in atonal music. Pitch classes are given an integer name (0–11, where C is 0, C♯ is 1, etc.). Groups of pitches are considered together as "sets." Sets may be related by inversion or transposition.

title: 詞彙表
text: 七和弦在三和弦五音上方再疊加一個三度，使最高音與低音相距七度，共有四個音。
en: seventh chord A triad with an additional third above the fifth, creating a seventh between that top note and the bass and totaling four notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 升記號將音升高半音。
en: sharp Raises a note by a half step.

title: 詞彙表
text: 節奏視讀看到節奏就直接數拍，也就是此前從未看過或聽過該節奏。
en: sight counting Counting at "sight" (that is, never having seen or heard the rhythm before).

title: 詞彙表
text: 視唱看到樂譜就直接唱出，也就是此前從未看過或聽過該音樂。
en: sight singing Singing music at "sight" (that is, never having seen or heard it before).

title: 詞彙表
text: 同向進行兩個聲部的旋律朝相同方向移動，也就是同時上行或同時下行。
en: similar motion When two voices move melodically in the same direction (either upward or downward).

title: 詞彙表
text: 單純二段式沒有再現二段式那種主題回歸的二段式。第二反覆段可能一直延續A素材，從未離開，因此也沒有「回歸」；也可能全段使用相對較新的素材。
en: simple binary form A type of binary form that does not contain the thematic return of a rounded binary. Instead, the second reprise continues with A material without ever having departed from it (thus there is no “return”), or it contains relatively new material throughout.

title: 詞彙表
text: 單二拍子每小節有兩拍、每拍分成二等分的拍節。拍號上方數字一律為2，最常見的是2/4與2/2（二二拍，又稱alla breve）。
en: simple duple A meter with two beats, each of which divides into two. The top number of a simple duple meter will always be "2". 2/4 and 2/2 (cut time) are the most common simple duple meters.

title: 詞彙表
text: 單音程八度或小於八度的音程。
en: simple intervals An octave or smaller.

title: 詞彙表
text: 單拍子每拍分成二等分的拍節。
en: simple meter A meter that divides the beat into two parts.

title: 詞彙表
text: 單四拍子（simple quadruple）每小節四拍，每拍分成兩個分割單位。傳統單四拍子拍號的上方數字為4；4/4，也稱common time，是最常見的單四拍子。
en: simple quadruple A meter with four beats, each of which divides into two. The top number of a simple quadruple meter will always be "4". 4/4 (common time) is the most common compound quadruple meter.

title: 詞彙表
text: 單三段式每個樂段由一個以上樂句構成，但不各自形成完整曲式的三段式。「單」也可用來明確指出某一樂段不包含完整曲式。可與複三段式比較。
en: simple ternary form A ternary form whose sections are each made up of one or more phrases but not complete forms. The term "simple" can also be used to clarify that a single section does not contain a complete form. Compare with compound ternary form.

title: 詞彙表
text: 單三拍子（simple triple）每小節三拍，每拍分成兩個分割單位。傳統單三拍子拍號的上方數字為3；最常見的是3/4。
en: simple triple A meter with three beats, each of which divides into two. The top number of a simple triple meter will always be "3". 3/4 is the most common compound triple meter.

title: 詞彙表
text: 同時性兩個以上聲音事件同時發生的泛稱。
en: simultaneity A general term for two or more sound events occurring at the same time.

title: 詞彙表
text: 創作歌手圖式（singer/songwriter schema）大調中的I–V–vi–IV，或小調中的III–VII–i–VI，例如C–G–Ami–F。這個進行常在流行歌曲中持續循環，而且常從vi／i開始，而不是從I／III開始。
en: singer/songwriter schema I–V–vi–IV in major, or III–VII–i–VI in minor (C–G–Ami–F, for example). This chord progression often loops throughout a pop song. Frequently, this progression begins on the vi/i chord instead of the I/III chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: 十六分音符時值為八分音符一半的音符。
en: sixteenth note A note value that lasts half the duration of an eighth note.

title: 詞彙表
text: 十六分休止符時值為八分休止符一半的休止符。
en: sixteenth rest A type of rest that lasts half the duration of an eighth rest.

title: 詞彙表
text: 三度小跳（skip）旋律以三度音程移動。
en: skip Melodic movement by third.

title: 詞彙表
text: 跳進經過音在對位中，一種協和弱拍進行：以三度小跳進入，再朝同方向級進離開。
en: skipped passing tone In counterpoint, a type of consonant weak-beat motion that is approached by skip (third) and left by step in the same direction.

title: 詞彙表
text: 斜線記法一種簡化的節奏記譜法：以短劃表示起音、橫線表示持續音、圓圈表示休止。
en: slash notation An abbreviated form of musical rhythmic notation, that involves dashes to indicate articulations, horizontal lines to indicate a sustained note, and circles to indicate rests.

title: 詞彙表
text: 滑移變換（S，Slide）一種新黎曼變換：將三和弦中構成完全五度的兩音各移動半音，改變和弦的大小性質，例如 C 大三和弦與 C♯ 小三和弦之間的轉換。
en: Slide transformation (S) A Neo-Riemannian transformation that moves the two pitches that form the perfect fifth in a triad by semitone and changes the mode of the triad (e.g., relating C major and C♯ minor).

title: 詞彙表
text: 圓滑線畫在音符上方的弧線，表示應連續演奏或演唱，各音之間不分開。
en: slur A curved line placed over notes to indicate that they should be played or sung without separation.

title: 詞彙表
text: 小鼓（snare drum）圓筒形鼓，直徑通常14英吋，鼓殼以木或金屬製成，上下繃鼓皮。底部鼓皮下方裝有響弦，產生特有的沙響與爆裂音色。強奏可像木頭爆裂或雷響，輕奏則可呈現喀聲、點擊與帶響弦聲的滾奏。
en: snare drum A cylindrical drum, typically 14” in diameter, made of wood or metal with tensioned heads (or skins) on the top and bottom and a set of snare wires stretched below the bottom head to create the drum’s characteristic buzzing and cracking sounds. Played with force, it sounds like wood cracking or like a thunderclap. Played softly, it offers a range of effects from clicks and taps to buzzing rolls.

title: 詞彙表
text: 唱名將do、re、mi、fa、sol等唱讀音節應用於音階級數。
en: solfège The application of solmization syllables (do, re, mi, fa, sol, etc.) to scale degrees.

title: 詞彙表
text: 旋律唱讀系統將音階中的每個音與特定音節配對的系統。
en: solmization A system that pairs each note of a scale with a particular syllable.

title: 詞彙表
text: 奏鳴曲式（sonata form）一種複雜的大型曲式，可理解為加入平衡二段式特徵、進一步擴充的再現二段式。大段名稱依序為呈示部（約相當於A）、發展部（約相當於B）與再現部（約相當於A′）。一般而言，呈示部包含主題部與副題部兩個主要段落，中間由過渡連接。副題在呈示部以非主調出現，關鍵在於再現部會改以主調重述。呈示部與再現部往往都以較大的後綴——結束部——收尾。
en: sonata form A complex large-scale musical form that can be understood as an elaborate version of rounded binary form with a balanced component. The larger level names are as follows: Exposition (≈A), Development (≈B), and Recapitulation (≈A′). In general terms, the exposition contains two main sections (primary and secondary) separated by a transition. The secondary theme is presented in a non-tonic key in the exposition, and crucially, it is restated in the recapitulation in the tonic key. The exposition and recapitulation often end with a large suffix (closing section).

title: 詞彙表
text: 女高音SATB四部和聲中最高的聲部，寫在高音譜表上，符桿朝上；一般接受的音域為C₄–G₅。
en: soprano The highest part in SATB style, written in the treble clef staff with an up-stem; its generally accepted range is C₄–G₅.

title: 詞彙表
text: 女高音譜號作為C譜號，女高音譜號以五線譜中線為中心，表示中線的音是C₄。
en: soprano clef As a "C" clef, the soprano clef shows that C₄ is the middle line of the staff by centering on it.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聲音訊號泛指任何音訊資料的廣義術語。聲音訊號不一定是數位資料，也可以指人所感知的聲音。
en: sound signal A broad, generic term for any audio data. A sound signal does not need to be digital; this term can also refer to a perceived sound.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聲波被感知為聲音的聲學波動，也就是能量的振動。
en: sound wave An acoustic wave (energy vibration) that is perceived as sound.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聲部間距各聲部之間的音程。在嚴格SATB和弦寫作中，相鄰上方聲部——女高音與女低音、女低音與男高音——之間不應超過八度；男高音與男低音之間不應超過十二度。
en: spacing The intervals between voices. For chords in strict SATB style, there should be no more than an octave between upper voices (soprano and alto, alto and tenor), and no more than a twelfth between the tenor and bass.

title: 詞彙表
text: 類別對位傳統作曲教學的一種方法，以對位訓練同時從橫向旋律與縱向和聲思考音樂的能力。共分五「類」，每類聚焦於一項作曲元素。
en: species counterpoint A traditional approach to composition pedagogy focused on counterpoint as a way of learning to think of music horizontally (melodically) and vertically (harmonically) simultaneously. Consists of five “species,” each of which focuses on a single compositional element.

title: 詞彙表
text: 揚揚格（spondee）由連續兩個重讀音節構成的詩歌音步。
en: spondee A poetic foot consisting of two stressed syllables in a row.

title: 詞彙表
text: srdc流行音樂中的四部分樂句組織：陳述、重述、轉離與結束。srdc與古典樂句型有許多共同特徵。
en: srdc A four-part phrase structure in popular music: statement, restatement, departure, and conclusion. An srdc structure shares many features with the Classical sentence.

title: 詞彙表
text: 穩定性透過主和聲擴展、規律的超小節拍節、不轉調、自然音旋律與自然音和聲等因素，所產生的一種聽覺特質。
en: stability A perceived quality created in music through tonic expansions, regular hypermeter, absence of modulations, diatonic melodies, and diatonic harmonies, among other things.

title: 詞彙表
text: staccato（斷奏）演奏或演唱時將各音更加分開，在音與音之間留出空隙。
en: staccato Played or sung with more separation, leaving space between notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 五線譜（staff）五條等距水平線，用來記寫音符。
en: staff Five evenly spaced horizontal lines on which notes are placed.

title: 詞彙表
text: 詩節／歌詞段（stanza）歌詞中，由多行組成的一節。原文也用此詞指記譜中同時演奏的一組譜表。
en: stanza In lyrics, a stanza is a group of lines of lyrics. In music notation, a stanza is a group of staves that are played simultaneously.

title: 詞彙表
text: 符桿從符頭延伸出的垂直線，用來表示節奏與聲部分配。
en: stem A vertical line that originates at the notehead, used to indicate rhythm and voicing.

title: 詞彙表
text: 分軌混音檔（stem，音樂製作）音樂製作術語，指把單一樂器音軌或一組音軌混合成一個數位檔案。Stem位於各個樂器音軌與最終完整混音之間，是中間層次的混音素材。
en: stem (music production) A music production term for a single instrumental track or group of tracks that are mixed together into a single digital file. A stem is an intermediate level of mixing, between each individual instrument's track and the final composite mix.

title: 詞彙表
text: 符桿方向以大譜表記寫SATB時，女高音與男高音符桿朝上，女低音與男低音符桿朝下。
en: stem direction On a grand staff in SATB style, the soprano and tenor are up-stemmed, while the alto and bass are down-stemmed.

title: 詞彙表
text: 均分八分音符（straight eighth notes）時值相等的八分音符，與時值不相等的搖擺八分音符相對。
en: straight eighth notes Eighth notes that are equal, as opposed to swing eighths (which are unequal).

title: 詞彙表
text: 等值移位切分（straight syncopation）把一串等時值音符的第一個音縮短為一半，並把其餘音的起點都提早這半個時值。
en: straight syncopation Taking a series of notes of equal durations, cutting the duration of the first note in half, and shifting the rest early by that half duration.

title: 詞彙表
text: 拉長樂句內部擴展的一種技巧。作曲家增加和聲或旋律的時值，使其延續得比預期更久；包含該和聲或旋律的單位，便稱為受到拉長。
en: stretching A technique of internal phrase expansion. It occurs when a composer lengthens a harmony or melody by increasing its duration so that it lasts longer than expected. When that happens, we say that the unit that contains the harmony or melody has been stretched.

title: 詞彙表
text: 弦樂器透過一條以上弦的振動發聲的樂器。
en: string instrument An instrument that produces sound via one or more vibrating strings.

title: 詞彙表
text: 歌節（strophe）由多個樂句組成的基本單位。在流行音樂中，歌節是分節歌形式與AABA曲式的主要段落。
en: strophe A basic multi-phrase unit. In pop music, a strophe is a focal module within strophic-form and AABA-form songs.

title: 詞彙表
text: 分節歌形式（strophic form）全曲反覆使用同一個包含多樂句的基本單位，即AAA。這個被重複的基本單位稱為歌節。相較1970年代及以後，分節歌形式更常見於1950至1960年代的早期搖滾樂。
en: strophic form A large-scale song structure, in which the same basic multi-phrase unit is repeated throughout (AAA). The basic unit that is repeated is called a strophe. Strophic form is more common in early rock-and-roll (1950s–1960s) than in the 1970s and beyond.

title: 詞彙表
text: 結構特徵與樂段劃分及曲式相關的音樂特徵。
en: structural features Musical features that pertain to section divisions and form.

title: 詞彙表
text: 下屬功能（subdominant）一種和聲功能，可以導向屬功能和弦，也可以回到主功能和弦。最常與第四級和弦IV，也就是下屬和弦，以及第二級和弦，也就是上主和弦相聯繫。
en: subdominant A harmonic function that may either lead toward a dominant-function chord or back to a tonic-function chord. Subdominant function is most typically associated with the IV chord, otherwise known as the subdominant chord, and the II chord, otherwise known as the supertonic chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主題（賦格）形成賦格旋律基礎、並在全曲反覆出現的短旋律。
en: subject A short melody that forms the melodic basis of a fugue and recurs throughout.

title: 詞彙表
text: 次樂句某些樂句層次曲式中的單位，比樂句小一層、比樂念大一層。
en: subphrase A unit in some phrase-level forms that is one level smaller than a phrase, but one level larger than an idea.

title: 詞彙表
text: 子集（subset）所有元素都包含在另一個較大集合中的集合。
en: subset A set that is entirely contained within another larger set.

title: 詞彙表
text: 替代進行（對位）在對位中，一種協和弱拍型態：四度跳進之後，朝反方向級進。名稱表示這種進行取代了較常見的經過音進行。
en: substitution (counterpoint) In counterpoint, a type of consonant weak beat that involves a leap of a fourth followed by a step in the opposite direction. The name implies that this motion substitutes for a more common passing-tone motion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 下主音（subtonic）小調中尚未升高的第七級音te，或建立在該級上的三和弦VII。
en: subtonic The unraised seventh scale degree in minor keys (te, 7̂), or the triad built upon that scale degree (VII).

title: 詞彙表
text: 下主音往返（subtonic shuttle）♭VII–I，以C為主音時為B♭–C。主和弦為大和弦時可暗示混合利底安，為小和弦時則可暗示愛奧利安。在這種往返中，♭VII具有屬功能。
en: subtonic shuttle ♭VII–I, or B♭–C in C major. This shuttle can imply mixolydian if the tonic chord is major, or aeolian if it is minor. In this shuttle, the ♭VII chord has dominant function.

title: 詞彙表
text: 終止式的否定原本可能構成終止式的地方，被後續素材否定。常見方式是先寫出暗示終止的音樂，接著在樂句中「退回」，再次嘗試終止。也可參閱樂句擴展章的「再來一次」技巧。
en: subversion of a cadence Occurs when a potential cadence point is declined by the material that follows it. A common strategy is for a composer to write music that proposes a cadence, but then to "back up" in the phrase and try the cadence again. See also the "one-more-time" technique in the chapter on phrase expansion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 後綴出現在樂句結束之後的一種外部擴展。常見的三個名稱依規模由小至大為：終止後延伸、小尾聲、尾聲。
en: suffix A type of external expansion that occurs after the end of a phrase. There are three terms commonly used to describe suffixes, ranging in size from smaller to larger: post-cadential extension, codetta, and coda.

title: 詞彙表
text: 上標（superscript）排版中高於一般文字基線的字元，如數學指數。和弦代號C⁷中的7，就是上標。
en: superscript In typesetting, superscript characters appear higher on the page than the regular characters—like an exponent in math. For example, in the chord symbol C⁷, the 7 is superscript.

title: 詞彙表
text: 超集（superset）包含其他較小集合的更大集合。例如，大、小三和弦所屬的(037)集合類，可以包含在自然音音集(013568T)所代表的類別中。
en: superset A larger set that contains other smaller sets. For example, a superset of (037) is the diatonic collection, (013568t).

title: 詞彙表
text: 掛留音由前一個不動的音延續而來，再向下級進離開的裝飾音，出現在拍中較強的位置。
en: suspension An embellishing tone that is approached via static note and left by step down. The suspension is on a strong part of the beat.

title: 詞彙表
text: 持續聲音訊號包絡線的第三階段，音量在一段時間內維持相對穩定。
en: sustain In a sound signal's envelope, the sustain is the third phase. The sustain is a (relatively) constant loudness level that is held for some duration.

title: 詞彙表
text: 搖擺八分音符（swing eighths）一種演奏慣例：把譜上兩個八分音符奏成不等長，比例約為2:1。
en: swing eighths A performance practice in which two notated eighth notes are performed unequally, in about a 2:1 proportion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 切分（syncopation）表面節奏與底層拍節的層級相抵觸時產生的節奏現象，通常透過重音、較長時值，或兩者共同形成。
en: syncopation A rhythmic phenomenon in which the hierarchy of the underlying meter is contradicted through surface rhythms. Syncopation is usually created through accents and/or longer durations.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音樂句法將音樂元素組合成有意義、且符合風格之序列的規範或原則。
en: syntax The norms or principles according to which musical elements are combined into meaningful and stylistically appropriate successions.

title: 詞彙表
text: tacet（休止不奏）演出時保持無聲，不演奏或演唱。
en: tacet To remain silent (to not play or sing) during a performance.

title: 詞彙表
text: 基本拍感（tactus）感知上的拍：聽者會跟著踏腳或點頭的脈動。基本拍感是聽覺經驗，不是直接寫在譜上的記號。
en: tactus The perceptual equivalent of a "beat"—the pulse that you might tap your foot or bob your head along to. A tactus is felt, not notated.

title: 詞彙表
text: 尾端疊句（tail refrain）出現在段落歌詞最後一行左右的疊句。
en: tail refrain A refrain that is the last line or so of a section's text.

title: 詞彙表
text: 速度（tempo）樂曲演奏的快慢。許多速度術語使用義大利文或其他非英語語言。
en: tempo How fast or slow a work is performed; many tempo markings are in Italian or another non-English language.

title: 詞彙表
text: 時間性的與時間有關的。
en: temporal Relating to time.

title: 詞彙表
text: 吟誦音（tenor，教會調式）與tenuto一詞相關，指使用某調式的聖歌旋律中，經常持續吟唱的音。
en: tenor (church modes) Related to the word "tenuto," the tenor of a mode is the pitch frequently sustained in a chant melody using that mode.

title: 詞彙表
text: 男高音SATB四部和聲中第二低的聲部，寫在低音譜表上，符桿朝上；一般接受的音域為C₃–G₄。
en: tenor (voice) The second lowest part in SATB style, written in the bass clef staff with up-stems; its generally accepted range is C₃–G₄.

title: 詞彙表
text: 次中音譜號C譜號的一種，以五線譜由上往下第二線為中心，表示該線的音是C₄。
en: tenor clef As a "C" clef, the tenor clef shows that the second-highest line of the staff is C₄ by centering on that line.

title: 詞彙表
text: tenuto（保持奏）用來表示平順、相連演奏的一種奏法記號，以音符上方或下方的短橫線標示。
en: tenuto A type of articulation marking used to indicate smooth, connected playing, indicated by small horizontal lines above or below the notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 三段式由三個明確樂段構成，採ABA而非ABC結構的曲式。B段通常在新調中呈現對比素材；各段兩側加反覆記號的情形很常見。
en: ternary form A musical form consisting of three distinct sections, in an ABA (not ABC) formal structure. The B section typically contains contrasting material in a new key. Repeat signs around each section are common.

title: 詞彙表
text: 四音組（tetrachord）由四個音組成的音集。
en: tetrachord A four-note collection.

title: 詞彙表
text: 織度作品中聲部的密度與聲部之間的互動。
en: texture The density of and interaction between voices in a work.

title: 詞彙表
text: 第三轉位以和弦七音為低音的三度結構和聲。
en: third inversion A triadic harmony with the chordal seventh in the bass.

title: 詞彙表
text: 通作的曲式中沒有任何樂段回歸的一種特性。不同樂段可能使用相似動機，但各段仍被視為彼此不同的部分。
en: through-composed An attribute of a musical form where no sections of music return. Similar motivic material may be present in different sections, but the sections would each be considered distinct.

title: 詞彙表
text: 延音線連接兩個以上相同音高的音符；第一個音之後的音不重新起音。
en: tie Connects two or more notes of the same pitch; notes after the initial one are not rearticulated.

title: 詞彙表
text: 緊密的由慣常主題類型、和聲穩定性、對稱分組與一致動機素材形成的一種音樂特質。
en: tight-knit A perceived characteristic of music that is created by conventional theme types, harmonic stability, symmetrical groupings, and consistent motivic material.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音色使不同聲音來源可被區分的聲音面向。例如長笛與吉他即使以相同音量演奏相同音高，仍有不同聲響。音色源於聲音訊號的聲學特徵，但也深受人類感知影響，因此具有主觀性。
en: timbre The aspect of sound that distinguishes sound sources from one another; for example, what makes a flute sound different from a guitar, even if they are playing the same pitch at the same loudness. Timbre arises from acoustic aspects of a sound signal but is also strongly influenced by human perception and thus subjective.

title: 詞彙表
text: 拍號西方記譜法中表示拍節的記號，通常由上下排列的兩個數字構成。
en: time signature An indication of meter in Western music notation, often made up of two numbers stacked vertically.

title: 詞彙表
text: 時間軸記譜（timeline notation）以秒數衡量時間、取代傳統小節線與拍節的當代記譜技法。
en: timeline notation A contemporary metric technique that uses seconds as the measure of time, rather than traditional bar lines and meters.

title: 詞彙表
text: 通鼓（toms）尺寸多樣、直徑最常見10至16英吋的鼓，外形近似小鼓，但鼓身較深，沒有響弦。基頻較集中，音高比大鼓高。鼓組常有低、中、高三個通鼓；音高在其整體聲響中，可以較明顯，也可以較不突出。
en: Toms Drums of various sizes (diameters of 10–16” are most common), similar to the snare drum but with deeper bodies and lacking the snares. They have a more focused pitch fundamental than the snare and are higher-pitched than the kick. There are often three toms on a drum kit, with pitches that are low, middle, and high. The pitch can be a more or less prominent feature of the toms’ sound.

title: 詞彙表
text: 調性的（tonal）在本書此處，用來形容遵循西方功能和聲系統的音樂。
en: tonal An adjective used to describe music that adheres to the Western system of functional harmony.

title: 詞彙表
text: 調性歧義（tonal ambiguity）某些和弦進行具有的特性：單靠該進行本身，並不會暗示唯一的一個主和弦。
en: tonal ambiguity A property of certain chord progressions, where the progression does not inherently imply a single chord as the tonic chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: 調性答題對主題作模仿性重複，但不完全照原音程移位，也就是不同於真實答題；而是調整音程，以配合原主題所在的同一調。常見的修改是將主題中的完全五度do–sol（1̂–5̂），改為答題中的完全四度sol–do（5̂–1̂）。「調性答題」表示它保留do與sol等音之間的調性關係，而非保留原有音程關係。
en: tonal answer An imitative repetition of a subject that is not an exact transposition of the subject (that is, a real answer) but modifies the intervals to fit within the same key as the original subject. A common modification is to change a perfect fifth do–sol (1̂–5̂) in the subject to a perfect fourth sol–do (5̂–1̂) in the answer. The term "tonal answer" refers to the fact that this preserves the tonal relationships (e.g., between do and sol) instead of preserving intervallic relationships.

title: 詞彙表
text: 音簇（tone cluster）完全以大二度或小二度疊置構成的和弦，並非以三度或更大的音程堆疊。
en: tone cluster A chord composed entirely of seconds (major or minor), rather than thirds or any larger interval.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主音／主和弦（tonic）音階中作為歸屬中心的音或和弦，或具有這種中心功能的音。
en: tonic The home note or home chord of a scale, or something with the function of that home note.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主功能（tonic function）聽起來穩定、帶來歸屬或中心感的一類和弦。I是典型主功能和弦，但vi與iii有時也能具有主功能。
en: tonic function A category of chords that sound stable, providing a sense of home or center. The I chord is the paradigmatic tonic-function chord, but vi and iii occasionally have tonic function.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主音化（tonicization）使非主和弦的三和弦，暫時聽起來像主和弦的過程；會運用副屬和弦或副導音和弦。
en: tonicization The process by which a non-tonic triad is made to sound like a temporary tonic. It involves the use of secondary dominant or leading-tone chords.

title: 詞彙表
text: 過渡部用來連接兩個主題樂段的部分，尤其指後續樂段並非大型再現的起點時。
en: transition A section of music that functions to connect two thematic sections, especially where the upcoming section is not the initiation of a large-scale return.

title: 詞彙表
text: 移位（transposition）將音高材料整體移動某個音程的操作。
en: transposition The act of moving pitch content by a certain interval.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和弦七音的處理在嚴格四聲部寫作中：1）以級進或共同音進入和弦七音。2）將和弦七音向下級進解決。提醒：和弦七音與導音不同。
en: treatment of the chordal seventh In strict four-voice writing: 1) Approach the chordal seventh by step or common tone 2) Resolve the chordal seventh down by step Reminder: the chordal seventh is different from the leading tone.

title: 詞彙表
text: 高音譜號G譜號的一種，以捲曲部分環繞五線譜由下往上第二線，指定該線的音為G₄。
en: treble clef As a "G" clef, the treble clef designates the second-lowest line of a staff as G₄ by curling around it.

title: 詞彙表
text: Tresillo（三三二節奏）把一拍、兩拍或一小節等節奏單位，分為3+3+2的三組近似等長分組。例如，把二分音符分成兩個附點八分音符與一個八分音符。
en: tresillo A division of a rhythmic unit (one beat, two beats, one measure, etc.) into three almost-equal groups, in a 3+3+2 pattern: for example, dividing a half note into two dotted eighth notes and an eighth note.

title: 詞彙表
text: 三和弦三個音構成的和弦，其音高類可排列為三度堆疊。
en: triad A three-note chord whose pitch classes can be arranged as thirds.

title: 詞彙表
text: 三音組（trichord）由三個音組成的音集。
en: trichord A collection of three notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 三拍子每小節有三拍的拍節。
en: triple meter A meter with three beats per measure.

title: 詞彙表
text: 三連音將單拍子的一拍分成三等分的連音組。
en: triplet A tuplet that involves dividing a beat in simple meter into three parts.

title: 詞彙表
text: 三全音（tritone）增四度或減五度。名稱表示兩音相距三個全音。
en: tritone An augmented fourth or diminished fifth. The name reflects that the two notes of a tritone are three (tri-) whole steps (tones) apart.

title: 詞彙表
text: 連音組把拍細分成不同於拍號通常暗示之等分數的節奏。
en: tuplet A rhythm that involves dividing the beat into a different number of subdivisions from that usually implied by the time signature.

title: 詞彙表
text: 迴音以先上鄰音、再下鄰音的順序裝飾某個音；相反順序稱為逆迴音。例如C上的迴音可演奏為C–D–C–B–C，是雙鄰音的一種特定形式。
en: turn An embellishment that indicates to decorate a note with its upper and lower neighbor, in that order. (The opposite order would be an "inverted" turn.) For example, a turn on C would be performed C–D–C–B–C. This embellishment is a specific kind of double neighbor.

title: 詞彙表
text: 回轉進行（turnaround）在和聲已收束的段落末尾，使用非主和弦，通常是屬和弦，銜接到下一個以主和弦開始的段落。在爵士樂中，turnaround常指vi–ii–V–I進行。這些和弦的確切性質有許多變化，也可能把其中一個或數個和弦，換成與它相關的其他和弦。
en: turnaround The use of a non-tonic chord (usually dominant) at the end of a harmonically closed unit to transition into the beginning of the following on-tonic unit. In jazz, the term "turnaround" often refers to the progression vi–ii–V–I. The exact qualities of these chords are highly variable, and one or more of the chords may be substituted with a different, related chord.

title: 詞彙表
text: 典型四部和聲寫作步驟1．先寫完整的低音聲部。2．再寫完整的女高音聲部，形成流暢、與低音配合良好的旋律。屬功能和弦上方的女高音應選擇傾向音；記得不一定要從左到右依序寫。3．填寫內聲部時，問自己：「已有什麼音？還缺什麼音？考量聲部間距與解決方向，音要放在哪裡才能形成最流暢的進行？」
en: typical four-part writing procedure 1. Write the entire bass 2. Write the entire soprano to make a smooth melody that interacts well with the bass. Choose active notes for the soprano above dominant-function chords, and remember you do not always need to write left to right. 3. Write the inner voices by asking, "What notes do I already have? What notes do I still need? Considering spacing and resolution, what note placement would give me the smoothest motion?"

title: 詞彙表
text: 單位表現當下較高層次分組功能的音樂片段。例如某單位位於延續部中，就表現延續功能。「單位」一詞常用於不易歸類為基本樂念、對比樂念或終止樂念的樂念。
en: unit A segment of music that expresses whatever the prevailing higher-level grouping expresses. For example, if a unit is contained within a continuation, it expresses continuation function. We often apply the term "unit" to ideas that aren't easily categorized using terms such as basic idea, contrasting idea, or cadential idea.

title: 詞彙表
text: 無序音高音程（unordered pitch interval）以半音數衡量兩個音高的距離，不表示方向。例如C₄到E₅的無序音高音程為16。
en: unordered pitch intervals The distance between two pitches, measured in semitones. For example, C₄ to E₅ would be an unordered pitch interval of 16.

title: 詞彙表
text: 無固定音高打擊樂器（unpitched percussion）不產生明確音高的打擊樂器，例如小鼓、大鼓、鈸、沙鈴等。雖然仍可「調音」，也能形容聲音高或低，這類樂器在聲學上含有較多噪音成分，不形成容易辨認基音的離散頻帶。可與定音鼓、木琴或甘美朗中的有固定音高打擊樂器比較。
en: unpitched percussion Percussion instruments that do not produce a definite pitch; for example, snare drum, bass drum, cymbals, maracas, and so on. While unpitched percussion can still be "tuned" and can be described as having a higher or lower sound, unpitched percussion is acoustically noisy, and does not create discrete frequency bands that allow for easy perception of a fundamental pitch. Compare them against pitched percussion, such as timpani, xylophone, or gamelan.

title: 詞彙表
text: 未作聲部配置（unvoiced）在單一譜表上，把和弦寫成三度堆疊或密集排列，通常用於抽象概念或理論說明，尚未依演奏需求安排聲部。
en: unvoiced Spelling chords stacked in thirds or in closed position, within a single staff, usually for abstract or theoretical purposes, rather than for performance.

title: 詞彙表
text: 上拍小節的最後一拍，以向上的指揮動作表示。
en: upbeat The last beat of a measure which is conducted with an upward motion.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主歌（verse）歌詞每次出現時會變動的段落，常藉歌詞推進敘事。
en: verse Sections that are lyric-variant and often contain lyrics that advance the narrative.

title: 詞彙表
text: 主歌—副歌曲式（verse-chorus form）當今流行歌曲最常見的曲式，由歌詞變動的主歌，以及歌詞和音樂大致固定的副歌組成，傳達歌曲主要的敘事材料。
en: verse-chorus form The most common form of pop songs today, consisting of lyric-variant verses and lyric- and music-invariant choruses that deliver the primary narrative material of the song.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聲部（voice，音樂線條）樂曲中獨立的單音線條，可以由樂器或人聲演奏。每個聲部可交給不同樂器，也可由同一樂器同時演奏多個聲部，鍵盤與吉他等複音樂器尤其常見。
en: voice (musical line) An independent, monophonic part within a piece of music (instrumental or vocal). Each voice may be played by a different instrument, or multiple voices may be played by one instrument (especially in polyphonic instruments like keyboard or guitar).

title: 詞彙表
text: 聲部交叉較高聲部移到較低聲部下方。在嚴格SATB中，聲部音域不應交叉：女高音必須始終高於女低音，女低音高於男高音，男高音高於男低音。
en: voice crossing When a higher voice part moves below a lower voice part. In strict SATB style, the ranges of voices should not cross; the soprano must always be higher than the alto, the alto must always be higher than the tenor, and the tenor must be higher than the bass.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聲部交換（voice exchange）兩個聲部互相「交換音」。例如，女高音從 C 移到 E，同時低音從 E 移到 C，就形成女高音與低音之間的聲部交換。
en: voice exchange When two voices "switch notes," exchanging with one another. For example, a soprano singing C moves to E, while a bass singing E moves to C would be considered a voice exchange between the soprano and bass.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聲部連接（voice leading）和聲改變時，較大織體中的某個聲部如何移動。例如在女高音、女低音、男高音、男低音四部合唱中，可以討論全體由I進行到V時，男高音聲部如何連接。
en: voice leading The way a specific voice within a larger texture moves when the harmonies change. For example, in a choir with four parts, soprano/alto/tenor/bass, one might discuss the voice leading in the tenor part as the entire choir moves from I to V.

title: 詞彙表
text: 聲部超越多聲部織度中，某聲部跳過另一聲部前一個音所處的位置。
en: voice overlap In a multi-voice texture, when one voice leaps beyond the previous note in another voice.

title: 詞彙表
text: 和弦配置（voicing）把和弦中的音分配到符合演奏習慣的音域。
en: voicing Distribution of notes in a chord into idiomatic registers for performance.

title: 詞彙表
text: 波長聲波兩個波峰之間的距離。
en: wavelength The distance between two peaks of a sound wave.

title: 詞彙表
text: 西方（Western）與歐洲或美洲文化有關。
en: Western Related to European or American culture.

title: 詞彙表
text: 全音符時值等於兩個二分音符的音符。
en: whole note A note value that lasts the duration of two half notes.

title: 詞彙表
text: 全休止符時值等於兩個二分休止符的休止符。
en: whole rest A type of rest that lasts the duration of two half rests.

title: 詞彙表
text: 全音等於兩個半音的音程。
en: whole step An interval equal to two half steps

title: 詞彙表
text: 全音音集（whole-tone collection）完全由全音相接構成的音集。一個八度內有六個全音，只可能形成兩種不同音集：C–D–E–F♯–G♯–A♯，或C♯–D♯–F–G–A–B。
en: whole-tone collection A pitch collection composed entirely of whole steps. There are six whole steps in a whole tone collection, and there are only two possible whole tone scales: C–D–E–F♯–G♯–A♯, or C♯–D♯–F–G–A–B.

text: 轉錄者說明關於本電子書：本電子書以紐約Dover Publications, Inc.於1964年出版的重印本製作；該重印本又以巴黎俄羅斯音樂出版社（Édition Russe de Musique）於1922年出版的兩卷本英譯為底本。第一卷收錄本書正文；第二卷收錄第一卷所引用的譜例。在本電子書中，兩卷各置於一份獨立的HTML文件。第一卷對編號譜例的引用，均以超連結通往第二卷。關於譜例與方框排練號，請參閱編者在這則註腳中的說明。星號的用法則解釋於編者序的第XII頁。明顯的印刷錯誤已直接更正，不另註明。其他疑似錯誤以紅色底線標示，並附可浮現的轉錄者註。關於音樂：所有譜例均提供MIDI或MP3檔案，單音譜例、樂器音域表與和弦表除外。按下［Listen］連結即可聆聽。對於第二卷較長的譜例，也可按［PDF］連結查看放大的原譜圖，或按［XML］連結查看或下載MusicXML樂譜。所有MP3檔案均由轉錄者以Finale及Garritan Personal Orchestra製作；後者除獨唱人聲外，採用真實樂器的聲音取樣。MusicXML檔案由Finale自動產生，之後未再編修；它們主要反映音樂的聲響，而非原譜的外觀。為處理Finale與Garritan中影響聲音的小限制與錯誤，採取了一些變通做法，例如在樂曲開頭或結尾加入空白小節，以免聲音突然截斷；改變力度；將共用譜表上重複配置的樂器拆成不同譜表；替換樂器等。明顯的印刷錯誤已直接更正，不另註明；其他存疑之處則註記於MusicXML檔案中。第二卷的每個譜例，都附有返回第一卷引用該例之頁面的連結。第二卷省略了頁碼，但可在PDF檔案中找到。
en: Transcriber’s Notes About this eBook: This eBook was prepared from a 1964 reprint published by Dover Publications, Inc., New York, which in turn was prepared from the two-volume 1922 English translation published by Édition Russe de Musique, Paris. Volume I contains the text of the work; Volume II contains the musical examples referred to in Volume I. In this eBook, each volume is in a separate HTML document. References in Volume I to the numbered musical examples are hyperlinked to Volume II. See this footnote for the editor's explanation of the musical examples and the boxed rehearsal numbers. The use of asterisks is explained on page XII of the Editor's Preface. Obvious printer errors have been corrected without note. Other apparent errors are underlined in red with a popup Transcriber's Note. About the music: Midi or MP3 files have been provided for all music examples (except for single-note examples, and tables of instrument ranges and chords). Click on the [Listen] link to hear the music. For the extended music examples in Volume II, you can also click on the [PDF] link to view an enlarged version of the original music images; and on the [XML] link to view or download the notation in MusicXML. All MP3 files were created by the Transcriber using Finale with Garritan Personal Orchestra, which employs sound samples of actual musical instruments, except for vocal solos. The MusicXML files were created automatically in Finale and have not been edited further. They reflect primarily the sound of the music, not its appearance. Some workarounds were employed to address minor limitations and bugs in Finale and Garritan that affected the sound (e.g., empty measures at the beginning and/or end of a piece to avoid abrupt cut-offs; changes in dynamics; expansion of shared staves where instruments are doubled; instrument substitutions; etc.). Obvious printer errors have been corrected without note; other questionable items are noted in the MusicXML file. For each music example in Volume II, a link has been provided back to the page in Volume I on which the example is referenced. Page numbers have been omitted from Volume II, but are available in the PDF files.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 林姆斯基－高沙可夫長年投入配器法專著的構想。我們手中保存著一本厚實筆記，約二百頁，以細密字跡寫成，年代可追溯至1873至1874年。其中包含一篇聲學論述、管樂器分類，以及各類長笛、雙簧管、豎笛與法國號構造、指法的詳細說明。[1]
en: Rimsky-Korsakov had long been engrossed in his treatise on orchestration. We have in our possession a thick note book of some 200 pages in fine hand writing, dating from the years 1873-1874, containing a monograph on the question of acoustics, a classification of wind instruments and a detailed description of the construction and fingering of the different kinds of flute, the oboe, clarinet and horn.[1]

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 他的《我的音樂生活回憶錄》第1版120頁，有以下一段：「我曾打算把全部精力用來編寫一部完整的配器法論著。為此，我寫了幾份草稿，隨手記下說明各種樂器技術的筆記。我想向世人呈現的，是這個領域的一切。1873與1874年，我大部分時間都花在這部論著——更確切地說，是它的草稿——上。讀過廷德爾與赫姆霍茲的著作後，我擬出一篇導論，試著闡明聲學定律如何運用於樂器構造的基本原則。這本手冊原本要先詳細列出各種樂器，分類製表，說明當時使用的各種系統；至於討論樂器組合的第二部分，我還沒有開始構想。但我很快發現，自己走得太遠了。尤其管樂器，各種系統多得數不清，每家製造商都有自己偏好的理論。製作者只要加上一個音鍵，就能讓樂器多奏一種顫音，-VIII-或讓某些困難樂段比在另一種樂器上更容易演奏。
en: In his "Memoirs of my musical life" (1st edition, p. 120) the following passage occurs: "I had planned to devote all my energies to the compilation of a full treatise on orchestration. To this end I made several rough copies, jotting down explanatory notes detailing the technique of different instruments. What I intended to present to the world on this subject, was to include everything. The writing of this treatise, or, to be more exact, the sketch for it took up most of my time in the years 1873 and 1874. After reading the works of Tyndall and Helmholtz, I framed an introduction to my work, in which I endeavoured to expound the laws of acoustics as applied to the principles governing the construction of musical instruments. My manual was to begin with a detailed list of instruments, classified in groups and tabulated, including a description of the various systems in use at the present day. I had not yet thought of the second part of the book which was to be devoted to instruments in combination. But I soon realised that I had gone too far. With wind instruments in particular, the different systems were innumerable, and each manufacturer favoured his own pet theory. By the addition of a certain key the maker endowed his instrument with the possibility of a new trill, and-VIII- made some difficult passages more playable than on an instrument of another kind.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 「這些複雜細節沒有盡頭。在銅管樂器中，我看到三個、四個、五個活塞的樂器，機構也因製造商而異。顯然，我不可能涵蓋如此龐大的範圍；而且，這樣的論著對學生有什麼價值？各種系統及其優缺點的繁瑣描述，只會把急於學習的讀者弄糊塗。他自然想知道該用哪件樂器、它能做到什麼；若得不到滿意答案，就會把我這部巨著丟到一旁。因為這些緣故，我對這本書的興趣逐漸消退，最後放棄了。」
en: "There was no end to such complications. In the brass, I found instruments with three, four, and five valves, the mechanism varying according to the make. Obviously, I could not hope to cover so large a field; besides, of what value would such a treatise be to the student? Such a mass of detailed description of the various systems, their advantages and drawbacks, could not but fail to confuse the reader only too eager to learn. Naturally he would wish to know what instrument to employ, the extent of its capabilities etc., and getting no satisfactory information he would throw my massive work aside. For these reasons my interest in the book gradually waned, and finally I gave up the task."

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 到了1891年，林姆斯基－高沙可夫已是地位穩固的藝術家，寫出了《雪孃》（Snegourotchka）、《姆拉達》（Mlada）與《天方夜譚》（Shéhérazade），也已把自己精通的管弦樂技法教了二十年。他重新回到配器手冊的工作。看來他曾在1891至1893年間，分次寫下筆記；這段期間，《姆拉達》首演後，他曾暫停作曲。這些偶爾在《回憶錄》中提到的筆記，寫在三冊五線譜紙上，其中包括尚未完成的1891年序言，文字清晰、思考深刻，本書予以重刊。[2]
en: In 1891 Rimsky-Korsakov, now an artist of standing, the composer of Snegourotchka, Mlada, and Shéhérazade, a master of the orchestral technique he had been teaching for twenty years, returned to his handbook on instrumentation. He would seem to have made notes at different times from 1891 to 1893, during which period, after the first performance of Mlada, he gave up composition for a while. These notes, occasionally referred to in his Memoirs, are in three volumes of manuscript-paper. They contain the unfinished preface of 1891, a paragraph full of clear, thoughtful writing, and reprinted in this book.[2]

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 作者在《回憶錄》297頁提到，當時一些令人困擾的事件，妨礙了寫作進度。他不滿意草稿，毀掉其中大部分，再度放下這項工作。
en: As the author tells us in his Memoirs (p. 297), the progress of his work was hampered by certain troublesome events which were happening at the time. Dissatisfied with his rough draft, he destroyed the greater part of it, and once more abandoned his task.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 1894年，他寫作《聖誕夜》，展開了創作最豐盛的時期。他全心投入作曲，一部歌劇剛完成，就計畫下一部。直到1905年，創作產出因非他所能左右的因素暫告停頓，他才再度想到配器法論著。現存草稿證明，自1891年以來，全書規畫已徹底改變。他不再打算從樂器的技術-IX-角度一一描述，而更希望探討各種音色的價值及其組合。
en: In 1894 he composed The Christmas Night; this was the beginning of his most fertile period. He became entirely engrossed in composition, making plans for a fresh opera as soon as the one in hand was completed. It was not until 1905 that his thoughts returned to the treatise on orchestration, his musical output remaining in abeyance through no fault of his own. Since 1891 the plan of the work had been entirely remodelled, as proved by the rough drafts still extant. The author had given up the idea of describing different instruments from their technical-IX- standpoint, and was more anxious to dwell upon the value of tone qualities and their various combinations.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在作者遺稿中，找到這本書的數種方案，細節彼此差異很大。1905年夏天，林姆斯基－高沙可夫終於把構想整理成形，擬出六章綱要，成為本書的基礎。然而，工作又遭中斷，草稿再度擱置。他在《回憶錄》中，將此歸因於興趣不足與普遍的疲倦感：「論著仍然擱著。首先，書的形式不理想；我也在等待《基捷日城》（Kitesh）上演，以便從中選取一些例子。」（360頁）
en: Among the author's papers several forms of the book have been found, each widely differing in detail from the other. At last, in the summer of 1905 Rimsky-Korsakov brought his plans to a head, and outlined the six chapters which form the foundation of the present volume. But the work suffered a further interruption, and the sketches were once more laid aside. In his Memoirs, Rimsky-Korsakov explains the fact by lack of interest in the work and a general feeling of weariness: "The treatise remained in abeyance. To start with, the form of the book was not a success, and I awaited the production of Kitesh, in order to give some examples from that work" (p. 360).

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 接著到了1906年秋天，作曲家又湧現一股創作精力。《金雞》進展迅速，佔據了他整個冬天及次年夏天。1907年秋天作品完成後，他又回到配器法論著，但進展有限。他懷疑既定規畫是否妥當，儘管學生與朋友一再懇請，仍無法著手寫書的後半部分。1907年底，他時常生病，精力大受影響，大部分時間用來閱讀舊筆記、分類譜例。約5月20日，他前往柳別恩斯克的夏季住所；剛從第三次嚴重肺部發炎中恢復，就開始把本書第一章寫成目前的最後定稿。6月7／20日下午約四點，這一章完成；當夜第四次發病，終至不治。
en: Then came the autumn of 1906. The composer experienced another rush of creative energy; his opera, The Golden Cockerel made rapid strides, and kept him busy all that winter and the following summer. When it was finished, in the autumn of 1907, his thoughts reverted to the treatise on orchestration. But the work made little progress. The author had his doubts as to the adequacy of the plan he had adopted, and, in spite of the entreaties of his pupils and friends, he could not bring himself to broach the latter part of the book. Towards the end of 1907 Rimsky-Korsakov was constantly ailing in health, and this materially affected his energy. He spent the greater part of his time reading old notes and classifying examples. About the 20th of May he set out for his summer residence in Lioubensk, and having just recovered from a third severe attack of inflammation of the lungs, began to work on the first chapter of the treatise in its present, final form. This chapter was finished on June 7/20, about 4 o'clock in the afternoon; the same night, the composer was seized with a fourth attack which proved fatal.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 為林姆斯基－高沙可夫這部最後著作整理出版的榮幸，落在我身上。如今《配器法原理》已印行，我認為有必要說明本書的主要特色，以及我擔任編者時所做的工作。
en: The honour fell on me to prepare this last work of Rimsky-Korsakov for publication. Now that Principles of Orchestration has appeared in print I think it necessary to devote a few words to the essential features of the book, and to the labour imposed upon me in my capacity as editor.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 關於本書特色，只需略說幾句。讀者從目錄就能看出，它與其他著作不同，不只在於-X-譜例，更在材料的系統安排：並非依管弦樂器組別分類，像吉華特採取的方式，而是分別考察音樂整體中的各個構成要素。旋律與和聲要素的配器，在第二、三章特別著重；一般配器問題則見第四章。最後兩章討論歌劇，其中第六章具有補充性質，與前面的材料沒有直接承接關係。
en: On the first point I will say but little. The reader will observe from the Contents that the work differs from others, not merely by-X- reason of its musical examples, but more especially in the systematic arrangement of material, not according to orchestral division in groups (the method adopted by Gevaert for instance), but according to each constituent of the musical whole, considered separately. The orchestration of melodic and harmonic elements (Chapters II and III) receives special attention, as does the question of orchestration in general (Chapter IV). The last two chapters are devoted to operatic music, and the sixth takes a supplementary form, having no direct bearing on the previous matter.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 林姆斯基－高沙可夫曾多次更改書名，始終未作最後決定。我選的這個名稱，似乎最符合內容：它真正討論的是「原理」。有些人可能期待，書中揭露這位配器大師的「祕密」；但如他在序言中提醒我們的：「配器就是創造，而這是無法傳授的。」
en: Rimsky-Korsakov altered the title of his book several times, and his final choice was never made. The title I have selected seems to me to be the one most suitable to the contents of the work, "principles" in the truest sense of the word. Some may expect to find the "secrets" of the great orchestrator disclosed; but, as he himself reminds us in his preface, "to orchestrate is to create, and this is something which cannot be taught."

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 不過，在所有藝術中，創意都與技術密切相連，因此這本書仍能讓配器學生獲益良多。林姆斯基－高沙可夫常重申一條原則：好的配器，就是妥善處理各聲部。音色及其組合的基本運用，也可以教授，但技術教學的範圍到此為止。從這些角度看，本書幾乎能提供學生所需的一切。作者逝世，使幾個問題來不及討論，包括完整複音織體的配器，以及旋律、和聲音型的配置。不過，第二、三章的原則已能部分解決這些問題；我不願用額外材料塞滿初版，若將來證明有需要，再補充即可。我的首要工作，是整理並擴充作者1905年的草稿；這些草稿貫穿六章，形成連貫概要。第一章由作者完成，除少數無關緊要的文字修飾外，照原稿出版。其餘五章，我盡可能依循原稿，只稍改次序，並作一兩項不可或缺的補充。1891至1893年的筆記太零散，派不上太多用場；不過，-XI-它們實際上與全書最後形式相當接近。
en: Yet, as invention, in all art, is closely allied to technique, this book may reveal much to the student of instrumentation. Rimsky-Korsakov has often repeated the axiom that good orchestration means proper handling of parts. The simple use of tone-colours and their combinations may also be taught, but there the science of instruction ends. From these standpoints the present book will furnish the pupil with nearly everything he requires. The author's death prevented him from discussing a few questions, amongst which I would include full polyphonic orchestration and the scoring of melodic and harmonic designs. But these questions can be partly solved by the principles laid down in Chapters II and III, and I have no wish to overcrowd the first edition of this book with extra matter which can be added later, if it is found to be necessary. I had first of all to prepare and amplify the sketches made by Rimsky-Korsakov in 1905; these form a connected summary throughout the whole six chapters. Chapter I was completed by the author; it is published as it stands, save for a few unimportant alterations in style. As regards the other five chapters, I have tried to keep to the original drafts as far as possible, and have only made a few changes in the order, and one or two indispensable additions. The sketches made between 1891 and 1893 were too disconnected to be of much use, but, in point-XI- of fact, they corresponded very closely to the final form of the work.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 譜例的處理更為重要。1891年手稿的原始規畫，是先從葛令卡與柴可夫斯基作品取例，之後再加入鮑羅定與葛拉祖諾夫。只用自己作品作例子的想法，是逐漸形成的。未完成的1905年序言已部分解釋理由，還可以再補充一些。如果從上述四位作曲家的作品取例，他就必須交代各人鮮明、甚至強烈的風格特徵，這會是艱難的工作。而且，又如何說明排除西歐作曲家的理由？例如華格納，正是他極為欣賞的配器家。另一方面，他也不難意識到，自己的作品已足以示範各種配器方式，這些例子都出自一個宏大的共同原則。此處不打算評論這個方法；林姆斯基－高沙可夫的「學派」就在眼前，讀者可以自行檢視。俄國作曲家燦爛多彩的配器，以及年輕法國作曲家的配器，多由他的手法發展而來；他自己則視葛令卡為精神上的父親。
en: The musical examples are of greater importance. According to the original scheme, as noted on the 1891 MS., they were to be drawn from the works of Glinka and Tschaikovsky; those of Borodin and Glazounov were to be added later. The idea of choosing examples solely from his own works only came to Rimsky-Korsakov by degrees. The reasons for this decision are partly explained in the unfinished preface of 1905, but other motives may be mentioned. If Rimsky-Korsakov had chosen his examples from the works of these four composers, he would have had to give some account of their individual, and often strongly marked peculiarities of style. This would have been a difficult undertaking, and then, how to justify the exclusion of West-European composers, Richard Wagner, for example, whose orchestration Rimsky-Korsakov so greatly admired? Besides, the latter could hardly fail to realise that his own compositions afforded sufficient material to illustrate every conceivable manner of scoring, examples emanating from one great general principle. This is not the place to criticise his method; Rimsky-Korsakov's "school" is here displayed, each may examine it for himself. The brilliant, highly-coloured orchestration of Russian composers, and the scoring of the younger French musicians are largely developments of the methods of Rimsky-Korsakov, who, in turn, looked upon Glinka as his spiritual father.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 遺稿中的譜例表遠未完成：有些部分說明不清，有些完全沒有說明。作者未指出哪些引例要印在第二卷，哪些只需指引讀者研讀完整總譜，也沒有規定節錄長度。因此，這些都由編者決定。我在反覆猶疑後才選定譜例；要只用作者指定的例子並不容易，因為大師作品的每一頁，幾乎都有適合說明某種配器方法的材料。
en: The table of examples found among the author's papers was far from complete; some portions were badly explained, others, not at all. The composer had not mentioned which musical quotations were to be printed in the second volume, and which examples were to indicate the study of the full score; further, no limit was fixed to the length of quotation. All this was therefore left to the editor's discretion. I selected the examples only after much doubt and hesitation, finding it difficult to keep to those stipulated by the composer, as every page of the master's works abounds in appropriate instances of this or that method of scoring.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 我依循以下幾點考量，這也符合作者本人的意見：第一，譜例應盡可能簡單，以免-XII-分散學生對當前問題的注意力；第二，一個譜例應能說明書中數個部分；第三，大多數引例應是作者曾提到的。這類例子在第二卷有214個，其餘98個由我補入。我盡可能從他的戲劇音樂取例，因為歌劇總譜比交響作品總譜不易取得。[3]
en: I was guided by the following considerations which agreed with the opinions of the author himself: in the first place the examples should be as simple as possible, so as not to distract-XII- the student's attention from the point under discussion; secondly, it was necessary that one example should serve to illustrate several sections of the book, and lastly, the majority of quotations should be those mentioned by the author. These amount to 214, in the second volume; the remaining 98 were added by me. They are drawn, as far as possible, from Rimsky-Korsakov's dramatic music, since operatic full-scores are less accessible than those of symphonic works.[3]

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在第二卷末尾，我加了三張表，呈現完整和弦的不同配器方式；凡我補入正文的內容，都以星號標明。我認為，仔細研讀第二卷的譜例，對學生很有幫助，卻不能取代閱讀其他作曲家總譜的需要。大體而言，本書應與廣泛閱讀總譜並行。
en: At the end of Vol. II I have added three tables showing different ways of scoring full chords; all my additions to the text are marked with asterisks. I consider that the careful study of the examples contained in the second volume will be of the greatest use to the student without replacing the need for the study of other composers' scores. Broadly speaking, the present work should be studied together with the reading of full scores in general.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 還有幾句話，要說明作者在最後版本序言中提到，想指出自己管弦樂作品不妥之處的打算。他常說，這樣的檢討有教學價值，但最終未能完成。我不宜代他挑選例子，只提兩處他親自指出的問題：第一，《薩爾坦王的故事》排練記號220的第7小節，銅管主題不夠突出，因為長號休止；這是容易修正的失誤。第二，《金雞》排練記號233的第10至14小節，如果銅管照表情標記演奏，中提琴與大提琴、加上木管重複的對旋律，幾乎就聽不到。也可提到例75，正文第63頁的註針對它有所說明。我只限於舉出這些例子。
en: A few words remain to be said regarding Rimsky-Korsakov's intention to point out the faulty passages in his orchestral works, an intention expressed in his preface to the last edition. The composer often referred to the instructional value of such examinations. His purpose however was never achieved. It is not for me to select these examples, and I shall only mention two which were pointed out by the composer himself: 1. The Legend of Tsar Saltan 220, 7th bar—the theme in the brass is not sufficiently prominent the trombones being tacet (a mistake easily rectified); 2. The Golden Cockerel 233, bars 10-14, if the marks of expression are observed in the brass, the counter-melody on the violas and violoncellos doubled by the wood-wind will hardly be heard. Example 75 may also be mentioned, to which the note on page 63, in the text, refers. I will confine myself to these examples.

title: 編者序
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 最後，我要深深感謝林姆斯基－高沙可夫夫人，將本書編輯工作託付給我，讓我有機會履行一項神聖的責任，紀念這位我無比敬重的大師。
en: In conclusion I desire to express my deep gratitude to Madame Rimsky-Korsakov for having entrusted me with the task of editing this work, thereby providing me with the opportunity of performing a duty sacred to the memory of a master, held so deeply in reverence.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 作者序言節錄（1891）
en: Extract from the Author’s Preface (1891).

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 我們所處的後華格納時代，是管弦樂音色燦爛而富於想像的時代。白遼士、葛令卡、李斯特、華格納，法國近代作曲家德利伯、比才等人，以及俄國新樂派的鮑羅定、巴拉基列夫、葛拉祖諾夫與柴可夫斯基，已把音樂藝術的這一面推向高峰。論音色運用，他們超越了前輩韋伯、梅耶貝爾與孟德爾頌；儘管如此，他們自己的進步仍受惠於前人的才華。我寫這本書，主要是希望從燦爛音色與想像力的角度，向已有相當知識的讀者介紹近代配器的基本原理，因此用了不少篇幅研究聲響共鳴與管弦樂組合。
en: Our epoch, the post-Wagnerian age, is the age of brilliance and imaginative quality in orchestral tone colouring. Berlioz, Glinka, Liszt, Wagner, modern French composers—Delibes, Bizet and others; those of the new Russian school—Borodin, Balakirev, Glazounov and Tschaikovsky—have brought this side of musical art to its zenith; they have eclipsed, as colourists, their predecessors, Weber, Meyerbeer and Mendelssohn, to whose genius, nevertheless, they are indebted for their own progress. In writing this book my chief aim has been to provide the well-informed reader with the fundamental principles of modern orchestration from the standpoint of brilliance and imagination, and I have devoted considerable space to the study of tonal resonance and orchestral combination.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 我試著告訴學生，如何取得某種音色、統一織體，以及達到所需的聲響強度；也說明各件樂器或樂器組特有的旋律音型與線條，將問題簡明扼要地歸納成一般原則。總之，我盡可能提供經過細密研究的素材與材料。但我不聲稱能教他如何把這些知識用於藝術，也不聲稱能替這些例子確定其在音樂詩性語言中的恰當位置。和聲、對位或曲式手冊，可以提供和聲、複音材料、構造原則、形式安排與可靠技術，卻不能賦予學生作曲才能。同樣地，配器論著可以示範如何寫出某種音色、分配均衡而悅耳的-2-和弦，如何讓旋律從和聲背景中突出，如何正確連接聲部，並解決諸如此類的問題；卻永遠無法教授詩性的配器藝術。配器就是創造，而這是無法傳授的。
en: I have tried to show the student how to obtain a certain quality of tone, how to acquire uniformity of structure and requisite power. I have specified the character of certain melodic figures and designs peculiar to each instrument or orchestral group, and reduced these questions briefly and clearly to general principles; in short I have endeavoured to furnish the pupil with matter and material as carefully and minutely studied as possible. Nevertheless I do not claim to instruct him as to how such information should be put to artistic use, nor to establish my examples in their rightful place in the poetic language of music. For, just as a handbook of harmony, counterpoint, or form presents the student with harmonic or polyphonic matter, principles of construction, formal arrangement, and sound technical methods, but will never endow him with the talent for composition, so a treatise on orchestration can demonstrate how to produce a well-sounding chord-2- of certain tone-quality, uniformly distributed, how to detach a melody from its harmonic setting, correct progression of parts, and solve all such problems, but will never be able to teach the art of poetic orchestration. To orchestrate is to create, and this is something which cannot be taught.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 說「這位作曲家配器很好」或「這首作品配器很好」，其實是一大錯誤，因為配器是作品靈魂的一部分。作品本來就是以管弦樂的方式構思；在創作者心中，某些音色與它不可分離，從誕生之初就屬於它。華格納音樂的本質，能與配器分開嗎？那就像說一幅畫是用色彩畫得很好一樣。
en: It is a great mistake to say: this composer scores well, or, that composition is well orchestrated, for orchestration is part of the very soul of the work. A work is thought out in terms of the orchestra, certain tone-colours being inseparable from it in the mind of its creator and native to it from the hour of its birth. Could the essence of Wagner's music be divorced from its orchestration? One might as well say that a picture is well drawn in colours.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 不只一位古典或近代作曲家，缺乏以想像力與力量配器的能力；音色的祕訣不在他的創作天賦範圍內。這是否表示他們不知道如何配器？其中許多人對配器的知識，甚至比只擅長音色的人更深。布拉姆斯不懂配器嗎？然而，他的作品中，卻找不到燦爛音色或如畫想像的證據。事實是，他的思考並不朝向音色，他的心智並不要求這些。
en: More than one classical and modern composer has lacked the capacity to orchestrate with imagination and power; the secret of colour has remained outside the range of his creative faculty. Does it follow that these composers do not know how to orchestrate? Many among them have had greater knowledge of the subject than the mere colourist. Was Brahms ignorant of orchestration? And yet, nowhere in his works do we find evidence of brilliant tone or picturesque fancy. The truth is that his thoughts did not turn towards colour; his mind did not exact it.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 細膩配器的能力，是無法傳遞的祕密。擁有它的作曲家應珍惜這項能力，絕不要把它貶為一堆背得滾瓜爛熟的公式。
en: The power of subtle orchestration is a secret impossible to transmit, and the composer who possesses this secret should value it highly, and never debase it to the level of a mere collection of formulæ learned by heart.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 這裡也可以談到，由他人依作曲家粗略指示完成配器的作品。承擔這種工作的人，應盡可能深入作曲家的精神，理解其意圖，並在所有重要面向加以發展。
en: Here I may mention the case of works scored by others from the composer's rough directions. He who undertakes such work should enter as deeply as he may into the spirit of the composer, try to realise his intentions, and develop them in all their essential features.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 即使必須讓自己的個性服從另一個人，這樣的配器仍是創作工作。但另一方面，把一首從未打算交給管弦樂團的作品改編成管弦樂，則是不值得鼓勵的做法。許多音樂家犯了這個錯誤，至今仍如此。[4]無論如何，這是配-3-器最初等的形式，近似彩色攝影；當然，過程仍有好壞之分。
en: Though one's own personality be subordinate to that of another, such orchestration is nevertheless creative work. But on the other hand, to score a composition never intended for the orchestra, is an undesirable practice. Many musicians have made this mistake and persist in it.[4] In any case this is the lowest form of in-3-strumentation, akin to colour photography, though of course the process may be well or badly done.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在配器方面，我有幸出自一流學派，也累積了極多樣的經驗。首先，我有機會聽到自己所有作品，由聖彼得堡歌劇院優秀的樂團演出。其次，我曾傾向不同創作方向，因此為各種規模的樂團配器，從簡單組合，到最進步的編制；例如歌劇《五月之夜》，就是為自然法國號與自然小號而寫。第三，我曾指揮海軍軍樂隊數年，因此得以研究管樂器。最後，我組成一個年輕學生樂團，成功教他們頗為熟練地演奏貝多芬、孟德爾頌、葛令卡等人的作品。這一切，使我能把這部長年經驗的成果呈現給公眾。
en: As regards orchestration it has been my good fortune to belong to a first-rate school, and I have acquired the most varied experience. In the first place I have had the opportunity of hearing all my works performed by the excellent orchestra of the St. Petersburgh Opera. Secondly, having experienced leanings towards different directions, I have scored for orchestras of different sizes, beginning with simple combinations (my opera The May Night is written for natural horns and trumpets), and ending with the most advanced. In the third place, I conducted the choir of the Military Marine for several years and was therefore able to study wind-instruments. Finally I formed an orchestra of very young pupils, and succeeded in teaching them to play, quite competently, the works of Beethoven, Mendelssohn, Glinka, etc. All this has enabled me to present this work to the public as the result of long experience.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 作為出發點，我提出以下基本原則：
en: As a starting-point I lay down the following fundamental axioms:

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 一、管弦樂團中，沒有本質上醜陋的音色。
en: I. In the orchestra there is no such thing as ugly quality of tone.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 二、管弦樂寫作應容易演奏；各聲部寫得妥當，作曲家的作品才最有機會獲得理想呈現。[5]
en: II. Orchestral writing should be easy to play; a composer's work stands the best chance when the parts are well written.[5]

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 三、作品應依實際將演奏它的樂團編制而寫，而不是依想像中的團體。許多作曲家仍堅持後者，使用罕見調性的銅管樂器，結果實際使用的樂器並非他設想的調性，音樂也就難以照原構想演奏。
en: III. A work should be written for the size of orchestra that is to perform it, not for some imaginary body, as many composers persist in doing, introducing brass instruments in unusual keys upon which the music is impracticable because it is not played in the key the composer intends.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 沒有教師指導，要設計一套自學配器的方法相當困難。一般而言，最好循序漸進，從最簡單的配置學到最複雜的配置。
en: It is difficult to devise any method of learning orchestration without a master. As a general rule it is best to advance by degrees from the simplest scoring to the most complicated.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 學生可能經過以下階段：一、最初完全信賴打擊樂-4-器，以為美麗聲響全出自樂團的這一部分；二、熱衷豎琴，每個可能的和弦都要用上它；三、崇尚木管與法國號，把法國號悶塞音和加弱音器或撥奏的弦樂組合起來；四、較進步的階段，終於認識到弦樂組最豐富、最有表情。自學者必須盡量避開前三階段的陷阱。最好的方法，是研讀總譜，並拿著總譜聽樂團演奏。但應讀什麼、聽什麼，並不容易決定。當然，各時代的音樂都應接觸，但主要應是相當近代的作品。近代音樂能教學生配器；古典音樂對他反而可能有負面價值。韋伯、孟德爾頌、梅耶貝爾《先知》、白遼士、葛令卡、華格納、李斯特，以及近代法國、俄國作曲家，會是最好的引導者。白遼士或吉華特引用葛路克作品作例子，並沒有用；那種音樂語言太過時，對現代耳朵也陌生，今天已沒有教學用途。莫札特與被稱為現代配器之父的海頓，也可以作同樣看法。
en: The student will probably pass through the following phases: 1. the phase during which he puts his entire faith in percussion instru-4-ments, believing that beauty of sound emanates entirely from this branch of the orchestra—this is the earliest stage; 2. the period when he acquires a passion for the harp, using it in every possible chord; 3. the stage during which he adores the wood-wind and horns, using stopped notes in conjunction with strings, muted or pizzicato; 4. the more advanced period, when he has come to recognise that the string group is the richest and most expressive of all. When the student works alone he must try to avoid the pitfalls of the first three phases. The best plan is to study full-scores, and listen to an orchestra, score in hand. But it is difficult to decide what music should be studied and heard. Music of all ages, certainly, but, principally, that which is fairly modern. Fairly modern music will teach the student how to score—classical music will prove of negative value to him. Weber, Mendelssohn, Meyerbeer (The Prophet), Berlioz, Glinka, Wagner, Liszt, and modern French and Russian composers—these will prove his best guides. It is useless for a Berlioz or a Gevaert to quote examples from the works of Gluck. The musical idiom is too old-fashioned and strange to modern ears; such examples are of no further use today. The same may be said of Mozart and of Haydn (the father of modern orchestration).

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 貝多芬這位巨人則自成一格。他的音樂中，有數不清、如雄獅躍起般的管弦樂想像力；但細看技術，仍遠不及他巨大的構思。他讓小號突出於全團之上，給法國號困難而不理想的音程，弦樂聲部的特殊寫法，以及時常極富色彩的木管運用——這些特徵交織，使研讀貝多芬的學生遇到無數互相矛盾之處。
en: The gigantic figure of Beethoven stands apart. His music abounds in countless leonine leaps of orchestral imagination, but his technique, viewed in detail, remains much inferior to his titanic conception. His use of the trumpets, standing out above the rest of the orchestra, the difficult and unhappy intervals he gives to the horns, the distinctive features of the string parts and his often highly-coloured employment of the wood-wind,—these features will combine causing the student of Beethoven to stumble upon a thousand and one points in contradiction.

title: 作者序言節錄（1891）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 以為初學者無法在華格納等近代作曲家作品中，找到簡單而有啟發性的例子，是一種誤解。恰恰相反，近代作曲家作品中，比起所謂古典曲目，更能找到清楚、合適的例子。
en: It is a mistake to think that the beginner will light upon no simple and instructive examples in modern music, in that of Wagner and others. On the contrary, clearer, and better examples are to be found amongst modern composers than in what is called the range of classical music.

title: 最後版本序言節錄
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 我寫這本書，希望以稍不同於慣常的角度，闡明近代配器原理。我一直依這些原則替自己的作品配器；為了把一些想法傳給年輕作曲家，便引用自己的作品，或提供參照位置，盡力坦誠地說明哪些成功、哪些不成功。創作某部作品時，支配自己的目的與動機，只有作者本人能知道。解說者盛行替作曲家說明意圖，即使態度恭敬、措辭審慎，我仍覺得很不理想。他們常替平常簡單的事，賦予過於縝密的哲學意味，或過分詩化的解釋。有時，大作曲家的名望使人把不佳的例子當作佳例；有些疏忽或不熟悉技術造成的問題，本來用當時技法的限制就容易解釋，卻引出整頁費力的辯護，甚至對缺失樂段的讚美。
en: My aim in undertaking this work is to reveal the principles of modern orchestration in a somewhat different light than that usually brought to bear upon the subject. I have followed these principles in orchestrating my own works, and, wishing to impart some of my ideas to young composers, I have quoted examples from my own compositions, or given references to them, endeavouring to show, in all sincerity, what is successful and what is not. No one can know except the author himself the purpose and motives which governed him during the composition of a certain work, and the practice of explaining the intentions of a composer, so prevalent amongst annotators, however reverent and discreet, appears to me far from satisfactory. They will attribute a too closely philosophic, or excessively poetic meaning to a plain and simple fact. Sometimes the respect which great composers' names command will cause inferior examples to be quoted as good; cases of carelessness or ignorance, easily explained by the imperfections of current technique, give rise to whole pages of laborious exposition, in defence, or even in admiration of a faulty passage.

title: 最後版本序言節錄
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 本書是為已讀過吉華特優秀的配器論著，或其他著名手冊，並對若干管弦樂總譜有所認識的人而寫。
en: This book is written for those who have already studied instrumentation from Gevaert's excellent treatise, or any other well-known manual, and who have some knowledge of a number of orchestral scores.

title: 最後版本序言節錄
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 因此，指法、音域、發聲等技術問題，我只作簡略討論。[6]
en: I shall therefore only just touch on such technical questions as fingering, range, emission of sound etc.[6]

title: 最後版本序言節錄
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 本書討論各樂器組內部，以及整個樂團中的樂器組合；取得聲響強度與織體統一的不同方法；聲部分配；配器音色與表情的變化。整體主要從戲劇音樂的角度出發。
en: The present work deals with the combination of instruments in separate groups and in the entire orchestral scheme; the different means of producing strength of tone and unity of structure; the sub-division of parts; variety of colour and expression in scoring,—the whole, principally from the standpoint of dramatic music.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 更大的樂團，第一小提琴可達20人，甚至24人，其餘弦樂按比例增加。但如此大量的弦樂，會壓過通常的木管編制，因此後者也必須增強。有時樂團第一小提琴少於8人；作者認為這是錯誤，因為弦樂與管樂的平衡會完全被破壞。為樂團寫作，宜以中型弦樂編制為依據：較大樂團演奏時，作品會呈現得更好；較小樂團演奏時，損失也能減到最少。-7-
en: In larger orchestras, the number of first violins may amount to 20 and even 24, the other strings being increased proportionately. But such a great quantity of strings overpowers the customary wood-wind section, and entails re-inforcing the latter. Sometimes orchestras contain less than 8 first violins; this is a mistake, as the balance between strings and wind is completely destroyed. In writing for the orchestra it is advisable to rely on a medium-sized body of strings. Played by a larger orchestra a work will be heard to greater advantage; played by a smaller one, the harm done will be minimised.-7-

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 若弦樂要寫成超過五個聲部，先不計雙音與和弦，就可以把原聲部分成二、三、四部，甚至更多，這稱為分部（divisi）。通常拆分一個或多個主要聲部，例如第一或第二小提琴、中提琴或大提琴。可以依譜架分配，第1、3、5號等奏上聲部，第2、4、6號等奏下聲部；也可以每個譜架右側樂手奏上聲部、左側樂手奏下聲部。分成三部較不容易，因為各組人數未必能被三整除，不易取得適當平衡。不過，有些情況下，作曲家仍應毫不猶豫地採用，讓指揮設法平衡音量。最好在總譜標明分配方式，例如Vns I，1、2、3 desks，指第一小提琴的第1、2、3譜架；6 ’Cellos div. à 3，指六位大提琴分成三部，等等。分成四部以上較少見，但可用於弱奏段落，因為它會大幅減弱弦樂組每一聲部的聲響。
en: Whenever a group of strings is written for more than five parts—without taking double notes or chords into consideration—these parts may be increased by dividing each one into two, three and four sections, or even more (divisi). Generally, one or more of the principal parts is split up, the first or second violins, violas or violoncellos. The players are then divided by desks, numbers 1, 3, 5 etc. playing the upper part, and 2, 4, 6 etc., the lower; or else the musician on the right-hand of each desk plays the top line, the one on the left the bottom line. Dividing by threes is less easy, as the number of players in one group is not always divisible by three, and hence the difficulty of obtaining proper balance. Nevertheless there are cases where the composer should not hesitate to employ this method of dividing the strings, leaving it to the conductor to ensure equality of tone. It is always as well to mark how the passage is to be divided in the score; Vns I, 1, 2, 3 desks, 6 'Cellos div. à 3, and so on. Division into four and more parts is rare, but may be used in piano passages, as it greatly reduces volume of tone in the group of strings.

title: A. 弦樂器

text: 弦樂器的發聲方式，比其他管弦樂組更多；也更善於在不同表情層次之間轉換，變化幾乎無窮。連奏（legato）、分弓、斷奏（staccato）、跳弓（spiccato）、滑音（portamento）、錘擊式弓法（martellato）、輕斷奏、連續彈跳弓（saltando），在弓根或弓尖起音，下弓與上弓，以及各種力度：極強（fortissimo）、極弱（pianissimo）、漸強（crescendo）、漸弱（diminuendo）、突強（sforzando）、逐漸消逝（morendo）——都屬於弦樂組自然擅長的範圍。
en: Stringed instruments possess more ways of producing sound than any other orchestral group. They can pass, better than other instruments from one shade of expression to another, the varieties being of an infinite number. Species of bowing such as legato, detached, staccato, spiccato, portamento, martellato, light staccato, saltando, attack at the nut and at the point, and (down bow and up bow), in every degree of tone, fortissimo, pianissimo, crescendo, diminuendo, sforzando, morendo—all this belongs to the natural realm of the string quartet.

en: A limit should be set to the use of a high note on any one of the three lower strings on violins, violas and 'cellos. This note should be the one in the fourth position, either the octave note or the ninth of the open string.-9-

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 高貴、溫暖，以及從低到高音色均勻，是所有弦樂器共有的特質，作者認為這使它們本質上優於其他組別。各條弦又有自己的特色，難以言語盡述。小提琴最高的E弦燦爛明亮；中提琴最高的A弦較銳利，稍帶鼻音；大提琴最高的A弦明亮，具有「胸聲」般的音色。小提琴A、D弦，以及中提琴與大提琴D弦，比其他弦稍柔甜、較弱。小提琴的G纏弦，以及中提琴、大提琴的G、C纏弦，較粗獷。大體而言，低音提琴各音域共鳴相當均勻，較低的E、A弦稍暗，較高的D、G弦較有穿透力。
en: Nobility, warmth, and equality of tone from one end of the scale to the other are qualities common to all stringed instruments, and render them essentially superior to instruments of other groups. Further, each string has a distinctive character of its own, difficult to define in words. The top string on the violin (E) is brilliant in character, that of the viola (A) is more biting in quality and slightly nasal; the highest string on the 'cello (A) is bright and possesses a "chest-voice" timbre. The A and D strings on the violin and the D string on the violas and 'cellos are somewhat sweeter and weaker in tone than the others. Covered strings (G), on the violin (G and C), on the viola and 'cello are rather harsh. Speaking generally, the double bass is equally resonant throughout, slightly duller on the two lower strings (E and A), and more penetrating on the upper ones (D and G).

text: 註：除持續低音外，低音提琴很少奏獨立聲部，通常與大提琴以八度或同度同行，或重複低音管。因此，低音提琴音色較少單獨被聽到，各弦之間的性格差異也不那麼顯著。
en: Note. Except in the case of pedal notes, the double bass rarely plays an independent part, usually moving in octaves or in unison with the 'cellos, or else doubling the bassoons. The quality of the double bass tone is therefore seldom heard by itself and the character of its different strings is not so noticeable.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 若把弦樂器音域與人聲比較，可以這樣對應：小提琴涵蓋女高音、-10-女低音，並向上延伸很多；中提琴涵蓋女低音、男高音，並有更高音域；大提琴涵蓋男高音、男低音，並向上延伸；低音提琴則涵蓋男低音，並向下延伸。
en: Comparing the range of each stringed instrument with that of the human voice, we may assign: to the violin, the soprano and-10- contralto voice plus a much higher range; to the viola, the contralto and tenor voice plus a much higher register; to the 'cello, the tenor and bass voices plus a higher register; to the double bass, the bass voice plus a lower range.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 泛音、弱音器與某些特殊弓法，能大幅改變所有這些樂器的共鳴與音色。
en: The use of harmonics, the mute, and some special devices in bowing produce great difference in the resonance and tone quality of all these instruments.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 本書時代已常使用泛音，它會明顯改變弦樂音色：弱奏時冷冽透明，強奏時冷冽明亮，但表情餘地較少。作者因此認為，泛音不屬於管弦樂寫作的基礎要素，主要用於裝飾。由於共鳴力量不足，應節制使用，也不可被其他樂器蓋過。一般用於持續音、顫弓，或偶爾營造燦爛效果，很少用於極簡單的旋律。泛音與長笛音色有某種相似，可說是弦樂與木管之間的連接。
en: Harmonics, frequently used today, alter the timbre of a stringed instrument to a very appreciable extent. Cold and transparent in soft passages, cold and brilliant in loud ones, and offering but little chance for expression, they form no fundamental part of orchestral writing, and are used simply for ornament. Owing to their lack of resonant power they should be used sparingly, and, when employed, should never be overpowered by other instruments. As a rule harmonics are employed on sustained notes, tremolando, or here and there for brilliant effects; they are rarely used in extremely simple melodies. Owing to a certain tonal affinity with the flute they may be said to form a kind of link between string and wood-wind instruments.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 弱音器也能造成根本變化。加上弱音器後，弦樂清晰、如歌的聲音，弱奏時變得暗淡，強奏時略帶嘶聲或哨音，音量也大幅減少。
en: Another radical change is effected by the use of mutes. When muted, the clear, singing tone of the strings becomes dull in soft passages, turns to a slight hiss or whistle in loud ones, and the volume of tone is always greatly reduced.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 弓在弦上的接觸位置，也會影響共鳴。靠近琴橋拉奏（sul ponticello），主要用於顫弓，會產生金屬感；在指板上方拉奏（sul tasto、flautando），則帶來較暗、朦朧的效果。
en: The position of the bow on the string will affect the resonance of an instrument. Playing with the bow close to the bridge (sul ponticello), chiefly used tremolando, produces a metallic sound; playing on the finger-board (sul tasto, flautando) creates a dull, veiled effect.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 註：用弓背或弓木奏弦（col legno），又會產生全然不同的聲音，近似木琴或空洞的撥奏聲。本書在「持續能力較弱的樂器」部分討論它。
en: Note. Another absolutely different sound results from playing with the back or wood of the bow (col legno). This produces a sound like a xylophone or a hollow pizzicato. It is discussed under the heading of instruments of little sustaining power.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 依上表人數配置的五個弦樂聲部，能得到相當均衡的聲響。若某一方稍強，應是第一小提琴，因為它在和聲配置中的角色重要，必須清楚可聞。此外，樂團通常會多編一個譜架的第一小提琴；-12-一般而言，第一小提琴也比第二小提琴更有力。第二小提琴與中提琴通常擔任次要角色，較不突出；大提琴與低音提琴則較明顯，多半以八度形成低音。
en: The five sets of strings with number of players given above produce a fairly even balance of tone. If there is any surplus of strength it must be on the side of the first violins, as they must be heard distinctly on account of the important part they play in the harmonic scheme. Besides this, an extra desk of first violins is usual in all orchestras, and as a general-12- rule they possess a more powerful tone than second violins. The latter, with the violas, play a secondary part, and do not stand out so prominently. The 'cellos and double basses are heard more distinctly, and in the majority of cases form the bass in octaves.

title: A. 弦樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 總而言之，弦樂組作為旋律要素，能演奏各種樂段、快速或斷續樂句，不論自然音或半音性質。它能輕易維持長音，演奏三音、四音和弦，適應無窮的表情變化，也容易拆成多個聲部。因此，管弦樂團中的弦樂組，也是一個手段極豐富的和聲要素。
en: In conclusion it may be said that the group of strings, as a melodic element, is able to perform all manner of passages, rapid and interrupted phrases of every description, diatonic or chromatic in character. Capable of sustaining notes without difficulty, of playing chords of three and four notes; adapted to the infinite variety of shades of expression, and easily divisible into numerous sundry parts, the string group in an orchestra may be considered as an harmonic element particularly rich in resource.

title: B. 管樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: B. 管樂器
en: B. Wind instruments.

title: 木管樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 木管樂器
en: Wood-wind.

title: 木管樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 除了樂手人數可以增減，弦樂組的五個構成聲部保持不變，足以符合各種管弦樂總譜的需求。木管組則不同：聲部數與所能提供的音量都會變動，作曲家可以自由選擇。大致可分成三類：雙管、三管與四管編制（見原書第13頁的表）。
en: Apart from the varying number of players, the formation of the string group, with its five constituent parts remains constant, satisfying the demands of any orchestral full score. On the other hand the group of wood-wind instruments varies both as regards number of parts and the volume of tone at its command, and here the composer may choose at will. The group may be divided into three general classes: wood-wind instruments in pair's, in three's and in four's, (see table on page 13).

title: 木管樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 表中阿拉伯數字表示各樂器的樂手人數；羅馬數字表示第1、第2等聲部。整項放在括號內的樂器，不另加樂手，而由既有樂手放下平常的樂器，改奏這一件。通常第一長笛、第一雙簧管、第一豎笛與第一低音管不更換樂器；他們的聲部重要，不宜來回適應不同吹口。因此，短笛、中音長笛、英國管、高音豎笛、低音豎笛與倍低音管，多交由各組第二、第三樂手兼奏，他們比較習慣使用這些特殊樂器。-13-
en: Arabic numerals denote the number of players on each instrument; roman figures, the parts (1st, 2nd etc.). Instruments which do not require additional players, but are taken over by one or the other executant in place of his usual instrument, are enclosed in brackets. As a rule the first flute, first oboe, first clarinet and first bassoon never change instruments; considering the importance of their parts it is not advisable for them to turn from one mouth-piece to another. The parts written for piccolo, bass flute, English horn, small clarinet, bass clarinet and double bassoon are taken by the second and third players in each group, who are more accustomed to using these instruments of a special nature.-13-
