text: 4. 以四聲部為本質的和聲基礎，絕不是只能由木管承擔。其中一個聲部常交給弦樂弓奏或撥奏。更常見的情形，是把低音聲部獨立處理，讓木管演奏上方三聲部較長時值的和弦。如果再把最高聲部交給一組弦樂，木管便只留下中間兩聲部的持續和聲。前一種情況中，木管的三聲部和聲應自行構成完整整體，不依賴低音的協助，藉此避免空洞的四度、五度。後一種情況中，中間聲部宜具有適度飽滿的音色，音程只選用二度、七度、三度或六度。
en: 4. The formation of the harmonic basis, which is essentially in four parts, does not by any means devolve upon the wood-wind alone. One of the parts is often devoted to the strings, arco or pizz. More frequently the bass part is treated separately, the chords of greater value in the three upper parts being allotted to the wood-wind. Then, if the upper part is assigned to a group of strings, there remains nothing for the wind except the sustained harmony in the two middle parts. In the first case the three-part harmony in the wood-wind should form an independent whole, receiving no assistance from the bass; in this manner intervals of open fourths and fifths will be obviated. In the second case it is desirable to provide the intermediate parts with a moderately full tone, choosing no other intervals except seconds, sevenths, thirds or sixths.

title: 補充說明
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 前面關於以木管形成和聲，以及分配單一、混合音色的各項說明，-80-同樣適用於持續和弦，也適用於與斷奏和弦快速交替的和聲進行。短促和弦之間若隔著較明顯的休止，聽覺就不那麼容易察覺音色的排列與分配，對聲部進行的注意也較少。逐一考察無數的音色組合，以及和弦各種重複、配置方式，不但沒有必要，也不可能做到。我的目的是指出工作的基本原則，以及應遵循的一般規則。學生掌握這些原則之後，只要花些時間研究總譜，並聆聽管弦樂團的實際演奏，很快就能學會何時採用某些方法、何時改用其他方法。總的來說，建議學生按正常次序安排木管；留意每個和弦的聲部應全部加倍或全部不加倍，因聲部進行而產生的少數例外除外；充分理解之後再採用音色的交叉、包夾配置；最後，把注意力集中在密集聲部寫作。
en: All that has been said with regard to the use of wood-wind in the formation of harmony, and the division of simple and mixed-80- timbres applies with equal force to sustained chords, or harmonic progressions interchanging rapidly with staccato chords. In short chords, separated by rests of some importance, the arrangement and division of timbres is not so perceptible to the ear, and progression of parts attracts less attention. It would be useless, nay, impossible to examine the countless combinations of tone colour, all the varieties of duplication and distribution of chords. It has been my aim to denote the fundamental principles upon which to work, and to indicate the general rules to be followed. Once having mastered these, if the student devote a little time to the study of full scores, and listen to them on the orchestra, he will soon learn when certain methods should be used and when to adopt others. The pupil is advised, generally, to write for wood-wind in its normal order of distribution, to take heed that each particular chord is composed entirely either of duplicated or non-duplicated parts, (except in certain cases resulting from progression), to use the methods of crossing and enclosure of timbres with full knowledge of what he is doing, and finally to concentrate his attention on close part-writing.

title: 銅管的四聲部寫作
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 若必須把低音加上八度重複，通常很少採用共鳴過強的長號與低音號，而交給低音管，後文會再說明。三支長號加低音號的四重奏，很少直接用於密集排列的四聲部和聲；第三長號與低音號通常以八度形成低音。上方三個聲部則由另外兩支長號，加上一支小號或兩支同度齊奏的法國號來擔任，使音色達到完美的平衡：
en: When it is found necessary to double the bass in octaves, the too resonant trombone and tuba are seldom used, the duplication being effected by the bassoon, as explained further on. The quartet of trombones and tuba is not often employed in close four-part harmony; the third trombone and the tuba usually form the bass in octaves, and the three upper parts are generally allotted to the two remaining trombones reinforced by a trumpet or two horns in unison, so as to obtain a perfect balance of tone:

text: 前面已說過，低音管與法國號是最能調和木管組、銅管組的兩種樂器。把四聲部和聲交給2支低音管、2支法國號，尤其在弱奏樂段中，能得到非常均衡的音色，近似四支法國號的效果，卻稍微更透明。在強奏樂段，法國號會蓋過低音管，此時只用四支法國號較妥。前述弱奏配置宜採聲部交叉以融合音色，把協和音程交給法國號，不協和音程交給低音管：
en: It has already been stated that the bassoon and horn are the two instruments best capable of reconciling the groups of wood-wind and brass. Four-part harmony given to two bassoons and two horns, especially in soft passages, yields a finely-balanced tone recalling the effect of a quartet of horns, but possessing slightly greater transparence. In forte passages the horns overwhelm the bassoons, and it is wiser to employ four horns alone. In the former case crossing of parts is to be recommended for the purposes of blend, the concords being given to the horns, the discords to the bassoons:

title: 木管與銅管的結合
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 一般觀察。為全體木管配器時，不一定總能確保適當的平衡。例如，一連串和弦中若旋律位置不斷改變，樂器分配便須以正確的聲部進行為優先。不過，實際演奏時，下列聲學現象可以抵銷一些音色的不均衡：每個和弦中，相隔八度的聲部會彼此加強，最低音域的泛音與最高音域的聲音重合，並予以支持。即使如此，盡可能取得最佳音色平衡，仍完全是配器者的責任；遇到困難時，可以審慎區分力度，讓木管比銅管高一級力度，以取得平衡。
en: General observations. It is not always possible to secure proper balance in scoring for full wood-wind. For instance, in a succession of chords where the melodic position is constantly changing, distribution is subordinate to correct progression of parts. In practice, however, any inequality of tone may be counterbalanced by the following acoustic phenomenon: in every chord the parts in octaves strengthen one another, the harmonic sounds in the lowest register coinciding with and supporting those in the highest. In spite of this fact it rests entirely with the orchestrator to obtain the best possible balance of tone; in difficult cases this may be secured by judicious dynamic grading, marking the wood-wind one degree louder than the brass.

title: 同一段音樂的不同配器方式
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 有時，一個段落或管弦樂作品中某個時刻的整體音響、性格與氣氛，只容許一種特定的配器方式。以下簡單例子可說明這一點：設想一個短句，在震音伴奏上奏出華彩音型或號角式呼喚，和聲可以變動，也可以不變。毫無疑問，任何配器者都會把震音交給弦樂，把號角音型交給小號，絕不反過來。但即使這點已確定，作曲者或配器者仍可能猶豫：號角音型適合小號的音域嗎？應由兩支、三支小號同度齊奏，還是以其他樂器重複？這些方法是否都能不損及音樂意義？以下我將試著回答這些問題。
en: There are times when the general tone, character and atmosphere of a passage, or a given moment in an orchestral work point to one, and only one particular manner of scoring. The following simple example will serve for explanation. Take a short phrase where a flourish or fanfare call is given out above a tremolando accompaniment, with or without change in harmony. There is no doubt that any orchestrator would assign the tremolo to the strings and the fanfare to a trumpet, never vice versa. But taking this for granted, the composer or orchestrator may still be left in doubt. Is the fanfare flourish suitable to the range of a trumpet? Should it be written for two or three trumpets in unison, or doubled by other instruments? Can any of these methods be employed without damaging the musical meaning? These are questions which I shall endeavour to answer.

title: 同一段音樂的不同配器方式
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 若樂句音域對小號而言太低，應交給與小號相近的法國號；若太高，可以交給雙簧管與豎笛同度齊奏，因為這個組合的性格與音量最接近小號。一支還是兩支小號，應依該段需要的音量決定。若要宏大響亮的效果，可以加倍、增加為三支，甚至四支；反之，一件銅管獨奏，或兩件木管（1支雙簧管＋1支豎笛）就夠了。弦樂震音是否應由木管持續和聲支援，-98-取決於預定目的。作曲者事先明白自己的意圖，別人替他的音樂配器時，則只能推測。若作曲者希望和聲基礎與旋律輪廓形成鮮明差別，最好不加木管和聲，而透過審慎安排pp甚弱、p弱、f強、ff甚強等力度記號，取得音色平衡。反過來，若希望和聲基礎飽滿圓潤，和聲聲部少些耀眼光澤，便宜採用木管和聲。木管和弦的配器可遵循以下原則：和聲基礎不僅在聲音的飽滿度、強度上要與旋律有別，音色也應不同。若號角音型交給銅管（小號或法國號），和聲應交給木管；若樂句交給木管（雙簧管與豎笛），和聲則應交給法國號。要妥善解決這些問題，作曲者必須充分理解自己的目的，替他配器的人也必須深入領會他的意圖。於是又有一個問題：這些意圖究竟應該是什麼？這是更困難的課題。
en: If the phrase is too low in register for the trumpets it should be given to the horns (instruments allied to the trumpet); if the phrase is too high it may be entrusted to the oboes and clarinets in unison, this combination possessing the closest resemblance to the trumpet tone both in character and power. The question whether one trumpet or two should be employed must be decided by the degree of power to be vested in the given passage. If a big sonorous effect is required the instruments may be doubled, tripled, or even multiplied by four; in the opposite case one solo brass instrument, or two of the wood-wind will suffice (1 Ob. + 1 Cl.). The question whether the tremolo in the strings should be supported-98- by sustained harmony in the wood-wind depends upon the purpose in view. A composer realises his intentions beforehand, others who orchestrate his music can only proceed by conjecture. Should the composer desire to establish a strongly-marked difference between the harmonic basis and the melodic outline it is better not to employ wood-wind harmony, but to obtain proper balance of tone by carefully distributing his dynamic marks of expression, pp, p, f and ff. If, on the contrary, the composer desires a full round tone as harmonic basis and less show of brilliance in the harmonic parts, the use of harmony in the wood-wind is to be recommended. The following may serve as a guide to the scoring of wood-wind chords: the harmonic basis should differ from the melody not only in fullness and intensity of tone, but also in colour. If the fanfare figure is allotted to the brass (trumpets or horns) the harmony should be given to the wood-wind; if the phrase is given to the wood-wind (oboes and clarinets) the harmony should be entrusted to the horns. To solve all these questions successfully a composer must have full knowledge of the purpose he has in view, and those who orchestrate his work should be permeated with his intentions. Here the question arises, what should those intentions be? This is a more difficult subject.

title: 同一段音樂的不同配器方式
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 作曲者的目的與作品曲式密切相連，也與每一時刻、每一樂句自身的美學意義，以及它和全曲的關係相連。配器方案取決於音樂素材，以及前後段落的色彩。必須判斷某個段落與前後文是相輔還是對比，是高潮，還是音樂思想整體推進中的一個步驟。這些關係不可能一一列舉，本書每個摘錄段落的作用也無法逐一討論。因此，讀者不宜只關注所列譜例，而應回到完整總譜中的實際位置，研究它們與前後文的關聯。不過，下文仍會略談其中一些問題。年輕而缺乏經驗的作曲者，往往還不清楚自己想做什麼；只要盡可能專注，透過研讀-99-優秀總譜與反覆聆聽樂團演奏，就能在這方面進步。尋求大膽而出格的配器效果，與任性胡來是兩回事；光有實現效果的意願還不夠，有些效果本來就不應追求。
en: The aim of a composer is closely allied to the form of his work, to the aesthetic meaning of its every moment and phrase considered apart, and in relation to the composition as a whole. The choice of an orchestral scheme depends on the musical matter, the colouring of preceding and subsequent passages. It is important to determine whether a given passage is a complement to or a contrast with what goes before and comes after, whether it forms a climax or merely a step in the general march of musical thought. It would be impossible to examine all such possible types of relationship, or to consider the rôle played by each passage quoted in the present work. The reader is therefore advised not to pay too much attention to the examples given, but to study them and their bearing on the context in their proper place in the full scores. Nevertheless I shall touch upon a few of these points in the course of the following outline. To begin with, young and inexperienced composers do not always possess a clear idea of what they wish to do. They can improve in this direction by reading-99- good scores and by repeatedly listening to an orchestra, provided they concentrate the mind to the fullest possible extent. The search after extravagant and daring effects in orchestration is quite a different thing from mere caprice; the will to achieve is not sufficient; there are certain things which should not be achieved.

title: 同一段音樂的不同配器方式
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 最簡單的音樂構想，例如同度、八度或跨越數個八度重複的旋律樂句，以及各聲部都沒有獨立旋律意義的和弦，都可以依音域、力度效果、想要的表情或音色，以多種方式配器。很多時候，同一構想每次再現，都會採用不同配器。後文我會經常談到這個較複雜的問題。
en: The simplest musical ideas, melodic phrases in unison and octaves, or repeated throughout several octaves, chords, of which no single part has any melodic meaning are scored in various ways according to register, dynamic effect and the quality of expression or tone colour that may be desired. In many cases, one idea will be orchestrated in a different way every time it recurs. Later on I shall frequently touch upon this more complicated question.

The most complicated musical ideas sometimes admit of only one manner of scoring, with a few hardly noticeable variations in detail. text: 顯然，b）能產生令人滿意的音響。但第三、第四種配器方式就較難成功，再繼續變換，很快便會荒謬。例如，若把和弦交給銅管，整段會顯得沉重，低、中音域的女高音宣敘調也會被蓋過。若把低音提琴的F♯-100-交給大提琴與低音提琴一起弓奏，會顯得笨重；交給低音管，會帶來滑稽效果；交給銅管，又會粗糙刺耳，等等。
en: It is obvious that the method b) will produce satisfactory tone. But a 3rd and 4th way of scoring would be less successful, and a continuation of this process would soon lead to the ridiculous. For instance if the chords were given to the brass the whole passage would sound heavy, and the soprano recitative in the low and middle register would be overpowered. If the F sharp in the-100- double basses were played arco by 'cellos and basses together it would sound clumsy, if it were given to the bassoons a comic effect would be produced, and if played by the brass it would sound rough and coarse, etc.

title: 同一段音樂的不同配器方式
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 同一樂句採不同配器，是為了在音色或共鳴上取得變化。作曲者可以顛倒樂器通常的排列順序、重複聲部，或同時使用兩種方法。第一種不一定可行。本書前面已試著說明各樂器的特性，以及各樂器組在樂團中的作用。我也提過許多應避免的重複配置；有些樂器的特性差異太大，不適合結合。因此，在樂團的整體配置上，學生仍應遵循前面所述的一般原則。
en: The object of scoring the same musical phrase in different ways is to obtain variety either in tone colour or resonance. In each case the composer may resort to the inversion of the normal order of instruments, duplication of parts, or the two processes in combination. The first of these is not always feasible. In the preceding sections of the book I have tried to explain the characteristics of each instrument and the part which each group of instruments plays in the orchestra. Moreover many methods of doubling are to be avoided; these I have mentioned, while there are also some instruments which cannot be combined owing to the great difference in their peculiarities. Therefore, as regards the general composition of the orchestra, the student should be guided by the general principles laid down in the earlier stages of the present work.

title: 同一段音樂的不同配器方式
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 要以多種方式為同一音樂構想配器，最好的方法是調整音樂素材。可採取以下操作：a）全部或部分移到其他八度；b）以不同調性重複；c）在高、低聲部加上八度，擴大整體音域；d）改變細節（最常用的方法）；e）改變整體力度安排，例如把原先強奏的樂句改為弱奏再現。
en: The best means of orchestrating the same musical idea in various ways is by the adaptation of the musical matter. This can be done by the following operations: a) complete or partial transference into other octaves; b) repetition in a different key; c) extension of the whole range by the addition of octaves to the upper and lower parts; d) alteration of details (the most frequent method); e) variation of the general dynamic scheme, e.g. repeating a phrase piano, which has already been played forte.

book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 這些操作總能帶來管弦樂色彩的變化。
en: These operations are always successful in producing variety of orchestral colour.

en: The process of scoring the same or similar ideas in different ways is the source of numerous musical operations, crescendo, diminuendo, interchange of tone qualities, variation of tone colour etc., and incidentally throws new light upon the fundamental composition of the orchestra.

title: 完整全奏（Tutti）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: Tutti通常指所有樂器同時使用，但「所有」是相對的，不能因此認為每一件樂器都必須參與。為使下列說明簡明，我把它分成完整全奏與部分全奏兩類；這項區分不受樂團採二管、三管或更多管樂編制影響。我所謂完整全奏，是弦樂、木管、銅管所有旋律性樂器組的結合。部分全奏則指銅管組只有部分樂器參與：例如只用兩支法國號或兩支小號，或兩支法國號加一支、三支長號，而不用低音號、小號或其餘兩支法國號，等等：
en: The word tutti generally means the simultaneous use of all instruments, but the word "all" is used relatively, and it must not be inferred that every single instrument must necessarily be employed to form a tutti. In order to simplify the following illustrations I will divide the word into two classes, full tutti and partial tutti,—independently of whether the orchestra is constructed in pairs, in three's, or a larger number of instruments. I call full tutti the combination of all melodic groups, strings, wind, and brass. By partial tutti I mean passages in which the brass group only takes part, whether two horns or two trumpets participate alone, or whether two horns are combined with one or three trombones, without tuba, trumpets, or the two remaining horns, etc.:

book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: [4支法國號，2支法國號2支法國號 ]。. . . .或2支小號，或. . . . . .等等。. . . .. . . . . .3支長號
en: [ 4 Horns, 2 Horns 2 Horns ]. . . . . or 2 Trumpets, or . . . . . . etc. . . . . . . . . . . 3 Trombones

title: 完整全奏（Tutti）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 這兩類全奏都可以依段落的音域與音樂脈絡，決定是否使用全體木管。例如，極高音域可能必須加入短笛；低音域則不必用長笛，但仍可稱為全奏。是否加入定音鼓、豎琴、其他延音能力較弱的樂器，或一般打擊樂，不在這項分類的討論範圍。-102-
en: In both species of tutti full wood-wind may be employed or not, according to the register and musical context of the passage. For instance, in the extreme high register it may be essential to include the piccolo; in the low register flutes will be unnecessary, and yet the passage can still be called tutti. The inclusion of kettle-drums, harp, and other instruments of little sustaining power, as of the percussion in general, does not come under discussion.-102-

title: 完整全奏（Tutti）
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 參與全奏的樂器越多，可作的管弦樂處理就越多，多到不可能逐一討論所有組合。我只能舉一些完整與部分全奏的例子，讓讀者自行歸納。有些例子同時包含完整與部分全奏。也提醒學生，全奏主要用於強奏與甚強奏，較少出現在甚弱奏、弱奏樂段。
en: The variety of orchestral operations increases with the number of instruments forming a tutti, in fact, so great does it become that it is impossible to consider all combinations. I can only give a few examples of full and partial tutti, and leave the reader to draw his own conclusions. Some of these examples fall under the double heading of full and partial tutti, and the student is reminded that the tutti is used essentially in forte and fortissimo, rarely in pianissimo and piano passages.

text: 在許多場合，木管組與銅管組可以自行構成長短不一的全奏段落。有時僅由木管擔任，但更常有法國號支援；有時則只有法國號，而沒有木管；也可以從各組選取數量不等的樂器組成全奏。加入定音鼓與其他打擊樂的做法很常見，這便形成德語所稱的「Janitscharenmusik」，即土耳其禁衛軍音樂。木管全奏也常加入大提琴與低音提琴或多或少具有重要作用的撥奏音，其他弦樂與豎琴亦然；這種做法能讓木管的持續音更清楚。木管與法國號的全奏即使用強奏，力量也不會特別大；相對地，僅由銅管組構成的全奏卻能達到驚人的音量。以下譜例即使加入弦樂或木管的持續低音，也不改變全奏的整體性格：
en: In many cases the wood-wind and brass groups can form a tutti by themselves for periods of varying length. Sometimes this is effected by the wood-wind alone, but more frequently with the support of horns. At other times the horns are found alone without the wood-wind, and, lastly, a tutti may be comprised of instruments of each group in varying numbers. The addition of kettle-drums and the rest of the percussion is quite common and constitutes what the Germans call "Janitscharenmusik", or Turkish infantry music. Violoncellos and double basses playing more or less important pizz. notes are often added to wood-wind instruments (tutti), likewise the remainder of the strings and the harps; this process renders the sustained notes in the wood-wind more distinct. Tutti passages in wood-wind and horns do not produce any great amount of power in forte passages, but, on the other hand tutti in the brass groups alone may attain an extraordinary volume of tone. title: 弦樂獨奏
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 任何管弦樂作品中，都能找到許多交給單一管樂器獨奏的旋律與樂句，通常由木管或銅管各類樂器的首席擔任；相較之下，弦樂獨奏卻極少出現。小提琴首席與大提琴首席尚算經常以這種方式運用，中提琴獨奏則不多見，低音提琴獨奏更幾乎聞所未聞。需要特別鮮明、個人化表情-105-的樂句，會交給獨奏樂器；超出一般團員能力、要求特殊技巧的段落亦然。獨奏樂器的音量相對較弱，因此伴奏必須輕巧、透明。不宜寫入艱難的炫技獨奏，因為這會使聽眾過分注意某一件樂器。有時採用弦樂獨奏，並不是為了強烈的表情或靈活的技巧，而只是要取得單人演奏與多人同度演奏之間特有的音色差異。兩件獨奏樂器也可以成對使用，例如兩把小提琴獨奏；極少數情況下，還會採用由四位弦樂獨奏者構成的四重奏。
en: Although, in any orchestral piece, numerous instances are to be found of melodies and phrases entrusted to a solo wind instrument (generally the first of each group, wood-wind or brass), solos for stringed instruments, on the other hand, are extremely rare. Whilst the 1st violin and 1st 'cello are fairly frequently used in this manner, the solo viola is seldom found, and a solo on the double bass is practically unknown. Phrases demanding particular individuality-105- of expression are entrusted to solo instruments; likewise passages that require extraordinary technique, beyond the scope of the orchestral rank and file. The comparatively weak tone of the solo instrument necessitates light, transparent accompaniment. Difficult virtuoso solos should not be written, as they attract too much attention to a particular instrument. Solo stringed instruments are also used when vigourous expression and technical facility are not required, but simply in order to obtain that singular difference in colour which exists between a solo stringed instrument and strings in unison. Two solo instruments can be coupled together, e.g. 2 Violins soli, etc. and in very rare cases a quartet of solo strings may be employed.

title: 管弦樂音域的極限
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 管弦樂音域的極限。
en: Limits of orchestral range.

title: 管弦樂音域的極限
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 把整個管弦樂構想集中在樂團的高音域，即第5、6八度區，是不常見的做法；完全放在最低音域，即第1與−1八度區，更為罕見，因為低音域中過於接近的和聲音程會造成不良效果。前一種情況應使用長笛、短笛，以及小提琴獨奏或分部演奏的高音；後一種情況-107-則運用倍低音管，以及低音管、低音豎笛、法國號、長號、低音號的低音。前一種配置音色明亮，後一種則陰暗沉鬱；要得到相反的結果，根本不可能。
en: It is seldom that the entire orchestral conception is centred in the upper register of the orchestra (the 5th and 6th octaves), still more rarely is it focussed wholly in the lowest range (octaves 1 and -1) where the proximity of harmonic intervals creates a bad effect. In the first case the flutes and piccolo should be used along with the upper notes of the violins, soli or divisi; in the second-107- case the double bassoon and the low notes of the bassoons, bass clarinet, horns, trombones and tuba are brought into play. The first method gives brilliant colour, the second combination is dark and gloomy. The contrary would be fundamentally impossible.

text: 上下聲部相距很遠、卻不填入中間各八度區的寫法很少使用，因為這違背了合理配置和弦的基本原則。不過，這種不尋常的共鳴，可以用來產生奇異、怪誕的效果。以下第一個譜例中，短笛音型由豎琴與鐘琴閃亮的音色重複配置，與交給一把低音提琴及低音號的低音，相隔約四個八度。但位於第3八度區的兩支長笛，以增四度和減五度填補部分中間空間，縮小兩端聲部間的空隙，在兩者之間建立某種聯繫。整體效果富於幻想色彩。
en: The upper and lower parts of a passage can seldom be widely separated without the intermediate octaves being filled in, for this is contrary to the first principles of proper distribution of chords. Nevertheless the unusual resonance thus produced serves for strange and grotesque effects. In the first of the following examples the piccolo figure doubled by the harp and the sparkling notes of the glockenspiel is set about four octaves apart from the bass, which is assigned to a single Double bass and Tuba. But in the 3rd octave, the augmented fourths and diminished fifths in the two flutes help to fill up the intermediate space and lessen the distance between the two extreme parts, thus forming some sort of link between them. The general effect is fanciful.

text: 樂段與樂句的交接。
en: Transference of passages and phrases.

title: 樂段與樂句的交接
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 樂句或音型常會從一件樂器轉交給另一件。為了讓各樂器之間的樂句銜接-108-得最好，通常讓前一聲部的最後一個音，與接續聲部的第一個音重疊。當樂段音域太寬，無法由單一樂器演奏，或想把一句音樂分成兩種音色時，便可採用這種做法。
en: A phrase or a figure is often transferred from one instrument to another. In order to connect the phrases on each instrument in-108- the best possible way, the last note of each part is made to coincide with the first note of the following one. This method is used for passages the range of which is too wide to be performed on any one instrument, or when it is desired to divide a phrase into two different timbres.

When one instrument is on the point of completing its allotted part, another instrument takes up the passage, starting on one or two notes common to both parts, and so on. This division must be carried out to ensure the balance of the whole passage.

title: 交替使用不同音色的和弦
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 交替使用不同音色的和弦。
en: Chords of different tone quality used alternately.

title: 交替使用不同音色的和弦
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 1. 最常見的做法，是讓不同樂器組交替演奏和弦。處理不同音域的和弦時，要注意聲部進行雖然因樂器組的交替而中斷，仍應保持規律-109-，如同未曾在不同八度之間跳換一般。半音進行尤其應如此，以避免聲部間的半音對斜關係（false relation）。
en: 1. The most usual practice is to employ chords on different groups of instruments alternately. In dealing with chords in different registers care should be taken that the progression of parts, though broken in passing from one group to another, remains as regular-109- as if there were no leap from octave to octave; this applies specially to chromatic passages in order to avoid false relation.

Examples: * Shéhérazade, 8th bar from the beginning, (the chromatic progression at the 12th bar is undertaken by the same instruments, the 2nd cl. is therefore placed above the first in the opening)—cf. Ex. 109. * The Christmas Night, opening (cf. Ex. 106).

title: 交替使用不同音色的和弦
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 2. 另一種很好的方法，是把同一個和弦或其轉位從一個樂器組轉交給另一組。這種做法要求聲部進行與音域都取得妥善的平衡。第一組奏出短時值的和弦，另一組同時以相同的和弦位置與聲部配置接入，可以在同一八度，也可以在另一八度。兩組的力度層次不必相同。
en: 2. Another excellent method consists in transferring the same chord or its inversion from one orchestral group to another. This operation demands perfect balance in progression of parts as well as register. The first group strikes a chord of short value, the other group takes possession of it simultaneously in the same position and distribution, either in the same octave or in another. The dynamic gradations of tone need not necessarily be the same in both groups.

title: 音色的增添與撤除
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 音色的增添與撤除。
en: Amplification and elimination of tone qualities.

title: 音色的增添與撤除
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在持續音或和弦中，運用兩個不同樂器組的聲響對比（* 或同一樂器組內不同音色的對比），可以突然或逐步地把單一音色轉為複合音色。這種做法可用來建立漸強：第一組逐漸加強時，第二組以弱或甚弱進入，再以較快的速度漸強。音色隨之改變，也使整個過程更具張力。反過來，撤除其中一組，使複合音色轉回單一音色，則主要用於漸弱。-110-
en: The operation which consists in contrasting the resonance of two different groups (* or the different timbres of one and the same group), either in sustained notes or chords, transforms a simple into a complex timbre, suddenly, or by degrees. It is used in establishing a crescendo. While the first group effects the crescendo gradually, the second group enters piano or pianissimo, and attains its crescendo more rapidly. The whole process is thereby rendered more tense as the timbre changes. The converse operation—the transition from a complex to a simple timbre, by the suppression of one of the groups, belongs essentially to the diminuendo.-110-

title: 樂句的重複、模仿與回聲
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 樂句的重複、模仿與回聲。
en: Repetition of phrases, imitation, echo.

title: 樂句的重複、模仿與回聲
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 模仿樂句的音色選擇，應遵循音域的原則：在較高音域模仿樂句時，應交給音域較高的樂器，反之亦然。忽略這項原則會產生不自然的效果，例如讓豎笛的高音域回應雙簧管的低音域。內容雖然不同、性格卻相近的樂句，也應遵循同樣原則；如果重複樂句的性格有所改變，則應各自採用最合適的配器。
en: As regards choice of timbre, phrases in imitation are subject to the law of register. When a phrase is imitated in the upper register it should be given to an instrument of higher range and vice versa. If this rule is ignored an unnatural effect will be produced, as when the clarinet in its upper range replies to the oboe in the lower compass etc. The same rule must be followed in dealing with phrases, actually different, but similar in character; repeated phrases of different character should be scored in a manner most suitable to each.

title: 樂句的重複、模仿與回聲
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 回聲式樂句的模仿，不只是降低音量，還須營造距離感。因此，第二件樂器應比第一件弱，但兩者的音色仍須有某種親近性。銅管先不加弱音器演奏，再由加了弱音器的銅管重複同一句，便能產生這種遠處傳來的效果。加弱音器的小號尤其適合回應雙簧管的主題；長笛模仿豎笛或雙簧管，也能取得良好效果。由於音色相差太大，不能用木管來作弦樂的回聲，-111-也不能反過來用弦樂回應木管。相隔八度的模仿若同時減弱聲響，則會產生近似回聲的效果。
en: In echo phrases, that is to say imitation entailing not only decrease in volume of tone but also an effect of distance, the second instrument should be weaker than the first, but the two should possess some sort of affinity. An echo given to muted brass following the same phrase not muted produces this distant effect. Muted trumpets are eminently suited to echo a theme in the oboes; flutes also may imitate clarinets and oboes successfully. A wood-wind instrument cannot be used to echo the strings, or-111- vice versa, on account of the dissimilarity in timbre. Imitation in octaves (with a decrease in resonance) creates an effect resembling an echo.

en: Besides the natural dynamic process of obtaining these marks of expression, a process which depends upon the player, they may also be produced by artificial means of orchestration.

title: 突強後轉弱與弱奏後突強的和弦
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: a）木管開始以弱奏演奏和弦的同時，弦樂以突強奏出同一和弦，最好採多音和弦，弓奏或撥奏皆可。反過來，要做出弱奏後突強的效果，弦樂的sf就必須出現在木管和弦的結尾。第一種方法也可用於sf-dim.，即突強後漸弱；第二種則可用於cresc.-sf，即漸強後突強。
en: a) At the moment when the wood-wind begins a piano chord, the strings attack it sforzando, a compound chord for preference, either arco or pizz. In the opposite case the sf in the strings must occur at the end of the wood-wind chord. The first method is also employed for a sf-dim., and the second for a cresc.-sf effect.

title: 突強後轉弱與弱奏後突強的和弦

en: b) It is not so effective, and therefore less frequent to give the notes of sustained value to the strings, and the short chords to the wood-wind. In such cases the tenuto chord is played tremolando on the strings.

title: 強調特定音符與和弦的方法
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 為了加重或突出某個音符或和弦，除了使用表情記號與sf，還可以在原本演奏單音旋律的弦樂各聲部中，插入兩音、三音或四音和弦；也可以加入木管的短音，或在弦樂、木管中安排三、-112-四個音階式裝飾音。這些不受重音的先行音（anacrusis，弱起音）通常寫成小音符，形成一種向上滑入主要音符的效果，向下的做法則較少見。一般以圓滑線將它們接到主要音符。弦樂的這類裝飾音不應接向三音或四音和弦，因為運弓會很不順手。
en: In order to stress or emphasise a certain note or chord, besides the marks of expression and sf, chords of 2, 3, and 4 notes can be inserted into the melodic progression by the instruments of the string quartet, each playing a single note; short notes in the wood-wind may also be used as well as a chain of three or-112- four grace notes, in the form of a scale, either in strings or wood-wind. These unstressed notes (anacrusis), generally written very small, form a kind of upward glide, the downward direction being less common. As a rule they are connected to the main note by a slur. In the strings they should not lead up to chords of three or four notes, as this would be awkward for the bow.

title: 漸強與漸弱
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 短暫的漸強與漸弱通常直接靠演奏力度的變化來完成；較長的過程，則須把力度變化與其他配器手法結合。除了弦樂，銅管最擅長做出細緻的力度表情，能將漸強和弦推向最輝煌的突強高潮。豎笛尤其擅長漸弱，可以把聲音減弱到一絲氣息般，逐漸消逝（morendo）。長時間的管弦樂漸強，可依弦樂、木管、銅管的順序逐步加入樂器；漸弱則按相反順序，先撤去銅管，再木管，最後弦樂。本書篇幅不適合摘錄長大的漸強、漸弱段落，因此請讀者參考下列完整總譜：
en: Short crescendi and diminuendi are generally produced by natural dynamic means; when prolonged, they are obtained by this method combined with other orchestral devices. After the strings, the brass is the group most facile in producing dynamic shades of expression, glorifying crescendo chords into the most brilliant sforzando climaxes. Clarinets specialise in diminuendo effects and are capable of decreasing their tone to a breath (morendo). Prolonged orchestral crescendi are obtained by the gradual addition of other instruments in the following order: strings, wood-wind, brass. Diminuendo effects are accomplished by the elimination of the instruments in the reverse order (brass, wood-wind, strings). The scope of this work does not lend itself to the quotation of prolonged crescendo and diminuendo passages. The reader is referred, therefore, to the full scores:

title: 聲部的擴展與收攏
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 聲部的擴展與收攏。
en: Diverging and converging progressions.

title: 聲部的擴展與收攏
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在多數情況下，聲部向外擴展與向內收攏，只是各聲部間距逐步改變的過程。擴展時，上方三個聲部漸漸上升，低音則下降；起初低音與其餘聲部相距很近，之後逐漸拉開。反過來，收攏時，原本與低音相距很遠的上方三個聲部，會逐漸靠近低音。這類進行有時伴隨音量的增強或減弱。隨著間距擴大，可引入新的聲部填補中間的音程空間，使上方聲部形成二重或三重配置；收攏時則讓重複配置的樂器停止演奏，逐步簡化這些二重、三重聲部。此外，只要和聲允許，便應保留處於中間音域、位置不變的樂器組，或保留一個持續音，使整個過程保持統一。以下提供成對的例子。第一對是向外擴展的進行：第一例為弱奏，有聲樂參與；第二例是純管弦樂的漸強。第二對同樣都是向外擴展：第一例逐漸增強，第二例則減弱，管樂逐一停止演奏時，弦樂分得越來越細。譜例258伴隨姆拉達的幻影出現，譜例259則伴隨幻影消失，氣氛與音色奇異而富於幻想。第三對是向內收攏的進行：第一例（譜例260）由沃爾霍娃公主述說海中的奇觀；隨後海王在強烈的管弦樂漸強中出現（譜例261）。兩例都包含一個持續不動的減七和弦。處理這類進行，必須格外謹慎。
en: In the majority of cases, diverging and converging progressions simply consist in the gradual ascent of the three upper parts, with the bass descending. The distance separating the bass from the other parts is trifling at first, and grows by degrees. On the other hand, in converging progressions, the three upper parts, at first so far distant from the bass, gradually approach it. Sometimes these progressions involve an increase or a decrease in tone. The intermediate intervals are filled up by the introduction of fresh parts as the distance widens, so that the upper parts become doubled or trebled. In converging progressions the tripled and doubled parts are simplified, as the duplicating instruments cease to play. Moreover, if the harmony allows it, the group in the middle region which remains stationary is the group to be retained, or else the sustained note which guarantees unity in the operation. Below, the reader will find double examples of both descriptions. The first pair represents a diverging progression, 1. piano, in which the human voice takes part; 2. a purely orchestral crescendo. The second depicts two similar diverging progressions, firstly a gradual crescendo, secondly dim., during which the strings become more and more divided as the wind instruments cease to play. Ex. 258 accompanies the apparition of Mlada, Ex. 259, its disappearance. The atmosphere and colouring are weird and fanciful. The third pair of examples forms instances of converging progressions. In the first (Ex. 260) Princess Volkhova relates the wonders of the sea. Then in the middle of a powerful orchestral crescendo the Sea-King appears (Ex. 261). Both examples include a sustained stationary chord of the diminished seventh. The handling of such progressions requires the greatest care.

title: 和聲基礎
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 上例若將上聲部移低八度，倚音與基礎音相碰所產生的不協和感便會減輕；段落奏得越快，效果越不刺耳，反之亦然。但對這些音可以持續多久，不宜訂下僵硬的規則。和聲音，即與基礎音（E）相隔三度的音，會因為接近和聲外音而更加突出，這一點無庸置疑。若增加聲部數，例如讓旋律音型以三度、六度等音程進行，問題便更複雜，因為原有的和聲架構中又加入根音不同的和弦，產生聲部間的半音對斜關係。
en: If, in the above example, the upper part is transposed an octave lower, the discordant effect produced by the contact of appoggiaturas and fundamental notes will be diminished; the quicker the passage is played the less harsh the effect will be, and vice versa. But it would be ill-advised to lay down any hard and fast rule as to the permissible length of these notes. There is no doubt that the harmonic notes, the thirds of the fundamental one (E) are more prominent from their proximity with the notes extraneous to the harmony. If the number of parts is increased (for instance, if the melodic figure is in thirds, sixths etc.), the question becomes still more complicated, since, to the original harmonic scheme, chords with different root bases are added, producing false relation.

title: 和聲基礎
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 不過，配器提供了一個解決這類問題的重要因素：音色差異。和聲基礎與旋律音型的音色越不相似，和聲外音聽來就越不顯得-115-不協和。最好的例子是人聲與管弦樂之間的差異，其次是弦樂、木管、撥弦樂器與打擊樂器各組之間的音色差異。木管與銅管的差異較小，因此運用這兩組時，和聲基礎通常應與旋律音型相隔一個八度，而且力度應較弱。
en: Nevertheless, for the solution of such problems, orchestration provides an element of the greatest importance: difference of timbres. The greater the dissimilarity in timbre between the harmonic basis on the one hand and the melodic design on the other, the less discordant the notes extraneous to the harmony-115- will sound. The best example of this is to be found between the human voice and the orchestra, next comes the difference of timbres between the groups of strings, wood-wind, plucked strings and percussion instruments. Less important differences occur between wood-wind and brass; in these two groups, therefore, the harmonic basis generally remains an octave removed from the melodic design, and should be of inferior dynamic power.

text: 和聲外音的運用，哪些容許、哪些不容許，是整個作曲領域最困難的問題之一；這些音可持續多久，也完全沒有定論。若缺乏藝術感受，只依賴兩種音色的差異，作曲者往往會寫出極為刺耳的不協和音。近來後華格納音樂在這方面的革新，常常十分可疑：它們使耳朵疲乏、音樂感覺麻木，並導向一個不自然的結論——各自單獨聽來好的東西，結合起來就必然也好。
en: The whole question as to what is allowed and what forbidden in the employment of notes extraneous to the harmony is one of the most difficult in the whole range of composition; the permissible length of such notes is in no way established. In absence of artistic feeling, the composer who relies entirely on the difference between two timbres will often find himself using the most painful discords. Innovations in this direction in the latest post-Wagnerian music are often very questionable; they depress the ear and deaden the musical senses, leading to the unnatural conclusion that what is good, taken separately, must necessarily be good in combination.

title: 人為音響效果
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 我以這個名稱，指稱某些利用聽覺與感知能力缺陷的配器手法。我不打算列舉所有既有做法，也無意預言將來可能出現的發明；這裡只順帶提到幾種我曾在自己作品中用過的方法。豎琴的滑奏音階或琶音便屬此類：其音符未必與其他樂器同時演奏的音相符，卻仍可使用，因為長幅度滑奏比短幅度滑奏更有共鳴、也更輝煌。
en: I apply this name to some orchestral operations which are based on certain defects of hearing and faculty of perception. Having no wish to specify those that already exist or to foretell those which may yet be invented, I will mention, in passing, a few which have been used by me in my own works. To this class belong glissando scales or arpeggios in the harp, the notes of which do not correspond with those played simultaneously by other instruments, but which are used from the fact that long glissandi are more resonant and brilliant than short ones.

text: 打擊樂器在節奏與音色上的運用。
en: Use of percussion instruments for rhythm and colour.

title: 打擊樂器在節奏與音色上的運用
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 每當樂團的一部分演奏節奏音型時，都應同時運用打擊樂器。輕巧而嬉戲的節奏，適合三角鐵、鈴鼓、響板與小鼓；強勁而直截了當的節奏，則可交給大鼓、鈸與鑼。這些樂器的敲擊，幾乎總應對應小節強拍、重音強烈的切分音，或彼此分離的突強音。三角鐵、小鼓與鈴鼓能演奏多種節奏音型。有時，打擊樂也會獨立運用，不依附任何其他樂器組。
en: Whenever some portion of the orchestra executes a rhythmic figure, percussion instruments should always be employed concurrently. An insignificant and playful rhythm is suitable to the triangle, tambourine, castanets and side drum, a vigourous and straightforward rhythm may be given to the bass drum, cymbals and gong. The strokes on these instruments should almost invariably correspond to the strong beats of the bar, highly-accented syncopated notes or disconnected sforzandi. The triangle, side drum and tambourine are capable of various rhythmic figures. Sometimes the percussion is used separately, independently of any other group of instruments.

title: 打擊樂器在節奏與音色上的運用
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 從音色來看，銅管與木管是最能與打擊樂良好結合的兩組。三角鐵、小鼓與鈴鼓最適合高音域的和聲；鈸、大鼓與鑼則適合低音域的和聲。最常見的組合有：三角鐵與鈴鼓的滾奏，配合木管與小提琴的顫音；小鼓的滾奏，或以鼓棒敲奏的鈸，配合小號與法國號的持續和弦；大鼓或鑼的滾奏，配合長號和弦，或大提琴與低音提琴的低音持續音。不可忘記，大鼓、鈸、鑼及小鼓滾奏若以甚強演奏，足以壓過任何管弦樂全奏。
en: The brass and wood-wind are the two groups which combine the most satisfactorily with percussion from the standpoint of colour. The triangle, side drum, and tambourine go best with harmony in the upper register; cymbals, bass drum and gong with harmony in the lower. The following are the combinations most generally employed: tremolo on the triangle and tambourine with trills in wood-wind and violins; tremolo on the side drum, or cymbals struck with drum sticks, and sustained chords on trumpets and horns; tremolo on the bass drum or the gong with chords on trombones or low sustained notes on 'cellos and double basses. It must not be forgotten that the bass drum, cymbals, gong and a tremolo on the side drum, played fortissimo, is sufficient to overpower any orchestral tutti.

title: 管弦樂音色的節制運用
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 管弦樂音色的節制運用。
en: Economy in orchestral colour.

title: 管弦樂音色的節制運用
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 無論音樂感受還是耳朵本身，都無法長時間承受整個樂團的全部力量一起演奏。最常用的樂器組是弦樂，其次依序為木管、銅管、定音鼓、豎琴、撥奏效果，最後是其他打擊樂器；打擊樂內部的次序，則是三角鐵、鈸、大鼓、小鼓、鈴鼓、鑼。鋼片琴、鐘琴與木琴的使用更少；它們雖能演奏旋律，但音色過於鮮明，不宜太頻繁使用。鋼琴與響板也是如此。許多本書未介紹的民族樂器，也可加入樂團，例如吉他、多姆拉琴、齊特琴、曼陀林、東方鈴鼓、小型鈴鼓等。這些樂器偶爾使用，目的是描繪情景、營造特定美感。
en: Neither musical feeling nor the ear itself can stand, for long, the full resources of the orchestra combined together. The favourite group of instruments is the strings, then follow in order the wood-wind, brass, kettle-drums, harps, pizzicato effects, and lastly the percussion, also, in point of order, triangle, cymbals, big drum, side drum, tambourine, gong. Further removed stand the celesta, glockenspiel and xylophone, which instruments, though melodic, are too characteristic in timbre to be employed over frequently. The same may be said of the piano and castanets. A quantity of national instruments not included in the present work may be incorporated into the orchestra; such are the guitar, the domra, zither, mandoline, the oriental tambourine, small tambourine etc. These instruments are employed from time to time for descriptive-aesthetic purposes.

title: 管弦樂音色的節制運用
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 上述次序也大致反映這些樂器的使用頻率。某個樂器組沉默一段時間後，再度出現時，便會帶來新鮮感。長號、小號與低音號有時長時間休止；打擊樂器很少使用，幾乎從不全部一起演奏，而是單獨使用，或兩三種搭配。在民族舞曲或歌謠風格的音樂中，打擊樂則可以運用得更自由。
en: These instruments are most frequently used in the above-named order. A group of instruments which has been silent for some time gains fresh interest upon its reappearance. The trombones, trumpets and tuba are occasionally tacet for long periods, the percussion is seldom employed, and practically never all together, but in single instruments or in two's and three's. In national dances or music in ballad style, percussion instruments may be used more freely.

title: 管弦樂音色的節制運用
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 法國號、長號與低音號長時間休止後再進入時，應配合鮮明的力度，以pp，甚弱或ff，甚強為宜；以弱奏或強奏再進入，效果較差，若以中強或中弱重新引入，則會顯得平淡而尋常。這項意見也可推廣：基於相同理由，任何樂曲都不宜以mf，中強或mp，中弱開始或結束。本書譜例的篇幅，無法充分展示音色的節制運用，也無法以摘錄呈現樂器因長時間休止、再進入而格外突出的效果。讀者必須從完整總譜研讀這些問題。
en: After a long rest the re-entry of the horns, trombones and tuba should coincide with some characteristic intensity of tone, either pp or ff; piano and forte re-entries are less successful, while re-introducing these instruments mezzo-forte or mezzo-piano produces a colourless and common-place effect. This remark is capable of wider application. For the same reasons it is not good to commence or finish any piece of music either mf or mp. The scope of the musical examples in this work does not permit of illustrating by quotation the use of economy in orchestral colour, nor the re-entry of instruments thrown into prominence by prolonged rests. The reader must examine these questions in full scores.

title: 人聲伴奏的一般原則
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 一般原則。
en: General remarks.

title: 人聲伴奏的一般原則
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 為人聲伴奏時，配器應足夠輕盈，讓歌者能自由運用各種力度與表情層次，而不必使音色變得生硬。在抒情情感洋溢、需要充分發聲的時刻，管弦樂則應給予歌者有力支持。
en: In accompanying the voice orchestral scoring should be light enough for the singer to make free use of all the dynamic shades of expression without hardness of tone. In overflowing lyrical moments, where full voice is required, the singer should be well supported by the orchestra.

title: 人聲伴奏的一般原則
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 歌劇演唱大致可分為兩類：抒情歌唱，以及朗誦式歌唱或宣敘調。圓潤飽滿、連貫的詠嘆調，比繁複花腔或宣敘調更容易發聲；人聲聲部的活動與節奏細節越多，就越需要給歌者自由。這時，樂團不應重複人聲旋律，也不應替任何樂器寫出與人聲相對應的節奏音型。作曲者為人聲伴奏時，應先考慮這些問題，再選擇管弦樂音色。混亂而厚重的伴奏會蓋過歌者；過於簡單的伴奏缺乏趣味，過弱的伴奏則不足以支持人聲。
en: Opera singing may be divided into two general classes, lyric singing and declamation or recitative. The full, round, legato aria affords greater facility for tone production than florid music or recitative, and the more movement and rhythmic detail contained in the vocal part, the greater freedom and liberty must there be given to the voice. In such a case the latter should not be doubled by the orchestra, neither should rhythmical figures be written for any instrument corresponding with those in the vocal part. In accompanying the voice the composer should bear these points in mind before turning his attention to the choice of orchestral colour. A confused, heavy accompaniment will overpower the singer; an accompaniment which is too simple in character will lack interest, and one which is too weak will not sustain the voice sufficiently.

title: 人聲伴奏的一般原則
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 現代歌劇的管弦樂，很少只限於單純伴奏。主要的音樂構想往往存在於樂團中，而且常相當複雜。這時反而可以說，人聲成了伴奏，將音樂上的吸引力轉為文字上的吸引力。人聲-120-從屬於樂團，彷彿是事後才補上的額外聲部。但在這類情況下，配器顯然必須格外謹慎。樂團不能厚重或複雜到淹沒人聲、使歌詞聽不清楚，否則文字脈絡就會中斷，音樂所描繪的意象也失去解說。某些時刻需要極大的管弦樂音量，甚至連聲量非凡的歌者都無法被聽見。即使勉強聽得見，這種人聲與樂團之間不對等的爭鬥，也極不合乎藝術。作曲者應把樂團的爆發留在人聲休止之處，依歌詞意思，自由而自然地安排歌者的樂句與停頓。樂團若有長時間的強奏，可以配合舞台動作。僅為了讓人聲穿透，而違反段落真實情感、刻意壓低樂團音量的做法，應嚴格避免，因為它會奪走配器特有的光彩。同時也要記得，純管弦樂段落與人聲伴奏段落的音量差距過大，也會造成不自然的對比。因此，若樂團擴為三管或四管編制，並增添大量銅管，音量與音色的分配就必須處理得格外巧妙、謹慎。
en: In modern opera it is rare that orchestral writing is confined to accompaniment pure and simple. It frequently happens that the principal musical idea, often complex in character, is contained in the orchestra. The voice may then be said to form the accompaniment, exchanging musical for literary interest. It becomes-120- subordinate to the orchestra, as though it were an extra part, subsequently added as an after-thought. But it is evident that great care must be taken with orchestral writing in such cases. The scoring must not be so heavy or complicated as to drown the voice and prevent the words from being heard, thereby breaking the thread of the text, and leaving the musical imagery unexplained. Certain moments may require great volume of orchestral tone, so great that a voice of even phenomenal power is incapable of being heard. Even if the singer is audible, such unequal struggles between voice and orchestra are most inartistic, and the composer should reserve his orchestral outbursts for the intervals during which the voice is silent, distributing the singer's phrases and pauses in a free and natural manner, according to the sense of the words. If a prolonged forte passage occurs in the orchestra it may be used concurrently with action on the stage. All artificial reduction of tone contrary to the true feeling of a passage, the sole object being to allow the voice to come through, should be strictly avoided, as it deprives orchestral writing of its distinctive brilliance. It must also be remembered that too great a disparity in volume of tone between purely orchestral passages and those which accompany the voice create an inartistic comparison. Therefore, when the orchestra is strengthened by the use of wood-wind in three's or four's, and brass in large numbers, the division of tone and colour must be manipulated skillfully and with the greatest care.

title: 人聲伴奏的一般原則
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 前面各節已多次說明，樂團的組織與音樂本身密切相關。聲樂作品的配器尤其鮮明地證明了這一點；甚至可以說：只有寫得好的音樂，才可能配器得好。
en: In previous sections I have frequently stated that the structure of the orchestra is closely related to the music itself. The scoring of a vocal work proves this relationship in a striking manner, and, indeed, it may be stipulated that only that which is well written can be well orchestrated.

title: 伴奏的清晰度與和聲
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 伴奏的清晰度。和聲。
en: Transparence of accompaniment. Harmony.

title: 伴奏的清晰度與和聲
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 弦樂組的聲響最通透，也最不容易蓋過人聲。其次是木管，再來是銅管；銅管內部依序為法國號、長號、小號。弦樂撥奏與豎琴的結合，特別適合襯托人聲。一般而言，歌者更容易被長時間的持續音蓋過，而不是短促分離的音。木管-121-與銅管重複弦樂，或木管重複銅管的配置，都容易淹沒歌者。定音鼓及其他打擊樂器的滾奏更容易造成這種效果；它們即使單獨使用，也能蓋過其他任何樂器組。木管與法國號互相重複，以及用兩支豎笛、兩支雙簧管或兩支法國號同度演奏一個和聲聲部，也應避免，因為同樣會影響人聲。低音提琴頻繁使用長持續音，也對歌者不利；這些音與人聲結合時，會產生一種特殊的脈動感。
en: The group of strings is the most transparent medium and the one least likely to overpower the voice. Then come the wood-wind and the brass, the latter in the following order: horns, trombones, trumpets. A combination of strings, pizz., and the harp forms a setting eminently favourable for the voice. As a general rule a singer is more easily overpowered by long sustained notes than by short detached ones. Strings doubled in the wood-wind-121- and brass, and brass doubled by wood-wind are combinations liable to drown the singer. This may be done even more easily by tremolando in the kettle-drums and other percussion instruments, which, even by themselves are capable of overpowering any other orchestral group of instruments. Doubling of wood-wind and horns, and the use of two clarinets, two oboes or two horns in unison to form one harmonic part is likewise to be avoided, as such combinations will have a similar effect on the voice. The frequent use of long sustained notes in the double basses is another course unfavourable to the singer; these notes in combination with the human voice produce a peculiar throbbing effect.

title: 伴奏的清晰度與和聲
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 弦樂與木管並用，可能使連貫的抒情歌唱或朗誦式歌唱的伴奏過重；但若一組以持續音構成和聲，另一組演奏旋律音型，仍可採用。例如，由豎笛與低音管，或低音管與法國號維持和聲，小提琴或中提琴演奏旋律；也可以反過來，由中提琴與大提琴分部奏和聲，豎笛演奏旋律音型。
en: Juxtaposition of strings and wood-wind which overweights legato or declamatory singing may nevertheless be employed if one of the groups forms the harmony in sustained notes and the other executes a melodic design, when, for instance the sustaining instruments are clarinet, and bassoon, or bassoon and horn, and the melodic design is entrusted to violins or violas—or in the opposite case, when the harmony is given to violas and 'cellos divisi, and the harmonic figure to the clarinets.

title: 伴奏的清晰度與和聲
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在第二八度到第三八度中段的音域中，持續和聲不會蓋過女聲，因為女聲在這個範圍以外展開；對男聲也不會太厚重，因為男聲雖在這個範圍之內展開，卻像男高音那樣，聽來高出一個八度。一般而言，人聲與相同音域的和聲相遇時，女聲比男聲更容易受到影響。各樂器組若分別使用、並保持節制，都可以適合各類人聲。但兩組或三組結合時，就未必如此；除非各組各自演奏獨立聲部，而不是全力合在一起。應避免不間斷的四部和聲。逐步減少和聲聲部數，讓其中一些聲部維持持續音，並在和聲中安排必要停頓，便能取得良好效果；和聲可以限在一個八度內、分布於數個八度，或在較高音域重複配置。
en: Sustained harmony in the register of the second octave to the middle of the third does not overpower women's voices, as these develop outside this range; neither is it too heavy for men's voices, which although opening out within the range itself sound an octave higher, as in the case of the tenor voice. As a rule women's voices suffer more than men's when they come in contact with harmony in a register similar to their own. Taken separately, and used in moderation, each group of orchestral instruments may be considered favourable to each type of voice. But the combination of two or three groups cannot be so considered unless they each play an independent part and are not united together at full strength. Incessant four-part harmony is to be deprecated. Satisfactory results will be obtained when the number of harmonic parts is gradually decreased, with some of them sustaining pedal notes, and when the harmony, interspersed with necessary pauses is confined to the limits of one octave, distributed over several octaves, or duplicated in the higher register.

title: 伴奏的清晰度與和聲
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 這些處理能幫助歌者：當歌唱表情改變，從如歌的-122-唱法轉為朗誦式唱法，人聲音量減弱時，作曲者可以減少或移除過重的和聲；反過來，在寬廣樂句與高潮中，則以更飽滿的管弦樂音響支持人聲。
en: These manipulations allow the composer to come to the singer's aid; in voice-modulations, when the singer passes from the can-122-tabile to the declamatory style, the composer may reduce or eliminate some harmony which is found to be too heavy as the vocal tone diminishes, and conversely, support the voice by a fuller orchestral tone in broad phrases and climaxes.

title: 伴奏的清晰度與和聲

text: 裝飾性寫法與複音伴奏都不應過於繁複，以免動用不必要的大量樂器。某些複雜音型，適合部分交給弦樂撥奏與豎琴，因為這種組合不太會蓋過人聲。以下列舉一些詠嘆調伴奏的實例。
en: Ornamental writing and polyphonic accompaniment should never be too intricate in character, entailing the use of an unnecessary number of instruments. Some complicated figures are better partially entrusted to pizz. strings and harp, as this combination has little chance of overpowering the voice. Some examples of accompanying an aria are given below.

title: 管弦樂對人聲的重複配置
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 管弦樂器常以同度或八度重複人聲旋律，但應避免長時間不間斷地重複，只宜用在個別樂句。最自然的-123-女聲同度重複，是交給小提琴、中提琴、豎笛與雙簧管；男聲則交給中提琴、大提琴、低音管與法國號。八度重複通常放在較高音域。長號與小號會蓋過人聲，不適合這種用途。應避免連續或過於頻繁的重複，不僅因為它限制歌者充分表達的自由，也因為混合音色會取代人聲難得而獨特的質感。重複配置若只限於少數特定樂句，則能支持人聲，賦予美感與色彩。這種做法只適合依拍演唱；對自由處理速度的段落採同度或八度重複，既無效，也容易出問題。
en: Melodic doubling of voices by orchestral instruments (in unison or octaves) is of frequent occurrence, but incessant duplication for an extended period of time should be avoided; it is only permissible in isolated phrases. The most natural duplication in-123- unison of womens' voices is performed by violins, violas, clarinets and oboes; that of mens' voices by violas, 'cellos, bassoons and horns. Doubling in octaves is usually done in the upper register. Trombones and trumpets overpower the voice and cannot be used for this purpose. Uninterrupted or too frequent duplication should be avoided, not only because the operation deprives the singer of full freedom of expression, but also because it replaces by a mixed timbre the rare characteristic qualities of the human voice. Doubling, when limited to a few special phrases supports the voice and endows it with beauty and colour. It is only suitable in tempo; to apply it, in unison or octaves to a passage ad. lib. is both ineffective and dangerous.

text: 獨奏樂器為如歌的詠嘆調伴奏，能產生美妙效果，這是不容否認的。常用樂器包括小提琴、中提琴、大提琴，以及長笛、雙簧管、英國管、豎笛、低音豎笛、低音管、法國號與豎琴。伴奏往往採對位寫法，或由複音音型構成。獨奏樂器可以單獨演奏，也可以在合奏中擔任主要旋律聲部。獨奏樂器與人聲結合，或與舞台上的某種動作相聯繫，是塑造音樂性格的有力手段；這類實例很多。
en: The beautiful effect produced by a solo instrument accompanying a cantabile aria cannot be denied. In such cases the instruments used are generally the violin, viola, and 'cello, or the flute, oboe, Eng. horn, clar., bass clar., bassoon, horn and harp. The accompaniment is often contrapuntal or composed of polyphonic designs. The solo instrument either plays alone or as the leading melodic voice in the ensemble. In combination with the voice, or associated with some action on the stage, a solo instrument is a powerful expedient for musical characterisation. Instances of this description are numerous.

book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 宣敘調與朗誦式歌唱。
en: Recitative and declamation.

title: 宣敘調與朗誦式歌唱
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 宣敘調與帶旋律的朗誦式樂句，其伴奏應輕盈到讓歌者不必勉強用力，就能使聲音傳出、歌詞清楚。最方便的做法，是讓弦樂或木管使用持續和弦與顫奏，在人聲節奏上保留充分自由（a piacere，自由處理）。
en: The accompaniment of recitative and melodic declamatory phrases should be light enough to allow the voice to come through without strain, and the words to be heard distinctly. The most convenient method is to employ sustained chords and tremolo on the strings or wood-wind, giving free latitude to the voice from a rhythmic point of view (a piacere).

title: 宣敘調與朗誦式歌唱
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 另一種很好的方法，是讓弦樂奏短和弦，並以不同方式與木管搭配。持續和弦，以及需要改變位置的和弦，最好在人聲休止時出現，讓指揮與樂團更能留意歌者在自由處理的宣敘調中不規則的節奏伸縮。若伴奏較複雜，包含旋律、複音或裝飾性音型，宣敘調就必須依拍演唱。任何依詞意需要強調的樂句，都會轉向更如歌的性格，並須由管弦樂加強。今日的歌劇，不僅比過去更重視文字處理，也經常在朗誦與如歌的唱法之間轉換，或將兩者融合。樂團的織度更多樣，處理時更須注意它與歌詞-126-及舞台動作的關係。這類配器只能藉較長的實例研讀，因此請讀者參考歌劇完整總譜；這裡僅列一兩個短小例子：
en: Another excellent plan is to write short chords in the strings combined with wood-wind in different ways. Sustained chords and those entailing change of position should occur preferably when the voice is silent, thus permitting both conductor and orchestra to keep a closer watch over the singer's irregularities of rhythm in a piacere recitatives. If the accompaniment is more complex in character, melodic, polyphonic or ornamental in design, the recitative must be sung in tempo. Any phrase which it is necessary to emphasise in accordance with the sense of the words assumes a more cantabile character, and must be reinforced by the orchestra. Opera, today, besides demanding much greater care in the treatment of the text than in the past, abounds in constant transition from declamation to cantabile, or in the fusion of the two. The orchestra offers more variety of texture and must be-126- handled with greater regard to its relationship to the words, and the action on the stage. This class of orchestration can only be studied from lengthy examples. I refer the reader to operatic full scores and content myself with giving one or short instances:

en: Orchestral accompaniment of the chorus.

title: 合唱的管弦樂伴奏
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 合唱的整體凝聚力與力量，遠大於獨唱，因此伴奏不必像獨唱那樣小心處理。相反地，配器過度纖細，反而不利於合唱的共鳴。一般而言，合唱作品的配器遵循純器樂配器的原則。兩者的力度表情記號顯然必須相符；但只要符合音樂脈絡，便可以讓樂器組互相重複，也可以讓同類樂器同度演奏，例如兩支雙簧管、兩支豎笛、四支法國號、三支長號等。以樂器重複合唱聲部，通常是好方法。在如歌的段落中，這種-127-重複可以偏重旋律，而樂團的線條比合唱更富裝飾性。
en: The chorus, possessing much greater unity and power than the solo voice, does not demand such careful handling in the accompaniment. On the contrary, too great a refinement of orchestral treatment will prove harmful to the resonance of the chorus. As a general rule orchestration of choral works follows the rules laid down for purely instrumental scoring. It is obvious that dynamic marks of expression must correspond in both bodies, but doubling one orchestral group with another and coupling instruments of the same kind in unison (2 Ob., 2 Cl., 4 Horns, 3 Trombones etc.) are both possible operations, if performed according to the requirements of the musical context. Doubling choral parts by instruments is generally a good plan. In cantabile passages such-127- duplication may be melodic in character, and the design more ornamental in the orchestra than in the chorus.

title: 獨唱與合唱的結合
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 詠嘆調或宣敘調與合唱結合時，合唱的寫法必須格外謹慎。女聲獨唱能在男聲合唱前清楚突出；男聲獨唱對女聲合唱也是如此，因為兩者的音色不同。但獨唱-129-若與同音色的合唱或混聲合唱結合，就會有一些困難。這時，獨唱者應唱得比合唱音域高，獨唱者充分發聲，合唱則弱唱。獨唱者應盡可能靠近台口腳燈，合唱安排在舞台後方。配器應以獨唱者為準，而不是以合唱為準。
en: When an aria or recitative is coupled with the chorus great care must be taken in the choral writing. A woman's solo voice stands out well against a male voice chorus, likewise a solo male voice against a women's chorus, for in both cases, the timbre of the solo voice differs from the rest. But the combination of solo-129- voice and chorus, of the same timbre, or mixed chorus, creates a certain amount of difficulty. In such cases the soloist should sing in a higher register than the chorus, the former a piena voce, the latter piano. The soloist should stand as near to the footlights as possible; the chorus up-stage. The orchestration should be adapted to the soloist, not to the chorus.

text: 台上與幕後的樂器。
en: Instruments on the stage and in the wings.

title: 台上與幕後的樂器
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在台上或幕後使用樂器，已有悠久歷史，例如莫札特《唐喬望尼》第一幕終曲中的弦樂團。上個世紀中葉，銅管樂隊，或銅管與木管混合的樂隊，開始出現在舞台上；葛令卡、梅耶貝爾、古諾等人都曾採用。較近代的作曲家已放棄這種笨重的做法，因為它不僅不利於觀眾的觀感，也破壞了多數歌劇的中世紀或傳說背景。如今，台上只使用符合場景與故事環境的樂器。至於觀眾看不見的幕後樂器，問題較簡單；然而，今日音樂家選用這些樂器時，美學考量仍應比挑選軍樂隊樂器更重要。真正演奏的樂器放在幕後，台上可見的樂器只作裝飾。有時，舞台樂器可以仿製歌劇所描寫年代常見的樂器，例如《姆拉達》中的祭祀號角。管弦樂伴奏-130-的力量，必須依幕後樂器的特性調整。這裡不可能逐一示範下列所有樂器的用法與適合的伴奏，只能舉少數例子，再請讀者參考完整總譜中的相應段落。
en: The use of instruments on the stage or in the wings dates from distant times (Mozart, Don Giovanni, string orchestra in Act I, finale). In the middle of last century orchestras of brass instruments, or brass and wood-wind combined, made their appearance on the stage (Glinka, Meyerbeer, Gounod and others). More modern composers have abandoned this clumsy practice, not only unfortunate from the spectators' point of view, but also detrimental to the mediaeval or legendary setting of the majority of operas. Only those stage instruments are now used which suit the scene and surroundings in which the opera is laid. As regards instruments in the wings, invisible to the audience, the question is simple. Nevertheless, for the musician of today the choice of these instruments must be regulated by aesthetic considerations of greater importance than those governing the selection of a military band. The instruments are played in the wings, those visible on the stage are only for ornament. Sometimes stage-instruments may be replicas of those common to the period which the opera represents, (the sacred horns in Mlada, for example). The orchestral accompaniment-130- must vary in power according to the characteristics of the instruments played in the wings. It is impossible to illustrate the use of all the instruments mentioned below, and to outline suitable accompaniments. I can only give a few examples and refer the reader once again to the passages in the full scores.

title: 人聲分類術語
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 人聲分類術語。
en: Technical Terms.

title: 人聲分類術語
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 歌唱中用來表示人聲音域、音區與特性的術語相當紛雜，其中有四種可視為基本類型：女高音（soprano）、女低音（alto或contralto）、男高音（tenor）與男低音（bass）。這些名稱也用於表示合唱的組成；各類再細分為第一與第二聲部，以確定聲部如何分配，例如Sopr. I、Sopr. II等。樂器的音域由其構造明確決定；人聲的音域則取決於歌者的個別條件。因此，無法為每一類人聲劃定精確的音域界限。合唱團員分配到第一與第二聲部時，音域較高者歸入第一聲部，較低者則歸入第二聲部。
en: Among all the confused terms employed in singing to denote the compass, register and character of the human voice, there are four which may be said to represent elemental types: soprano, alto or contralto, tenor and bass. These names are used to denote the composition of the chorus with sub-divisions of firsts and seconds, to determine how the parts must be divided. (Sopr. I, Sopr. II etc.) While the range of an instrument is exactly governed by its construction, the compass of the voice, on the other hand, depends on the individuality of the singer. It is therefore impossible to define the exact limits of each of these vocal types. When it is a question of dividing choristers into 1st and 2nd parts, those with the higher voices are classed among the firsts and vice versa.

title: 人聲分類術語
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 除了上述主要名稱，還使用女中音（mezzo-soprano，介於女高音與女低音之間）與男中音（baritone，介於男高音與男低音之間）。
en: Besides the principal terms mentioned above, the names mezzo-soprano (between sop. and alto), and baritone (between tenor and bass) are also employed.

title: 人聲分類術語
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 註。在合唱中，依聲音的性質與音色，女中音歸入第二女高音或第一女低音；男中音歸入第二男高音或第一男低音。
en: Note. In the chorus mezzo-sopranos are classed with 2nd sopranos or 1st altos, baritones with 2nd tenors or first basses, according to quality and timbre of voice.

title: 人聲分類術語
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 除了代表六種主要獨唱聲部的上述名稱，還有許多用來表示音域、音色或技巧的名稱，例如輕型女高音、soprano giusto、抒情女高音、戲劇女高音、輕型男高音、tenorino-altino（高音域男高音）、baryton-martin（馬丁型男中音）、抒情男高音、戲劇男高音、basso cantante（「歌唱性男低音」）、basso profondo（深沉男低音）等。這份長長的名單-133-還須加上mezzo-carattere，指特性介於兩類之間的聲音，例如介於抒情與戲劇女高音之間。
en: Apart from these denominations which represent the six principal solo voices, a quantity of others are in use to denote either compass, timbre or technique, such as light soprano, soprano giusto, lyric soprano, dramatic soprano, light tenor, tenorino-altino, baryton-martin, lyric tenor, dramatic tenor, basso cantante ("singing bass"), basso profondo (deep bass) etc. To this lengthy list must-133- be added the term mezzo-carattere, of intermediate character (between lyric and dramatic soprano, for example).

title: 人聲分類術語
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 若試著探究這些名稱的實際意義，很快就會發現它們的命名依據很不一致。例如，「輕型女高音」指聲音的靈巧與敏捷；「戲劇男高音」指表達強烈戲劇情感的能力；basso profondo則表示低音區有很強的共鳴。
en: If we try to discover the real meaning of these designations it soon becomes apparent that they are derived from widely different sources—for instance, "light soprano" implies agility and mobility in the voice; "dramatic tenor", the power to express strong dramatic feeling; basso profondo signifies great resonance in the deep register.

title: 人聲分類術語
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 詳細研究各種起音與發聲方法，是聲樂教師的工作；在此逐一列舉，只會使學生困惑。各音區的位置與確切界限也是如此，例如女聲的胸聲、中聲區與頭聲，以及男聲的胸聲、混聲與假聲。聲樂教師的工作，是使整個音域的聲音均勻，讓所有母音由一個音區轉換到另一個音區時，都能不露痕跡。有些聲音天生均勻而靈活。聲樂教師必須矯正呼吸上的缺點，確定歌者的音域並建立適當的發聲位置，使音色均勻、增加靈活度，指導母音的發音及不同表情層次之間的轉換等。作曲者應能以靈活而均勻的人聲為前提寫作，不必為個別歌者的能力或缺點操心。在當今，聲部很少專為某一位藝術家而寫；作曲者與劇本作者也不認為必須將某個角色交給擅長花腔的歌者，另一角色則交給厚重的戲劇型嗓音。詩意與藝術上的考量，要求歌劇乃至一般聲樂創作運用更多樣的表現手段。
en: Minute examination of all the methods of attack and emission of sound lies within the province of the singing master and to enumerate them here would only perplex the student. The same applies to the position and exact limits of register (chest voice, middle and head voice in women; chest voice, mixed voice and falsetto in men). The work of a teacher of singing consists in equalising the voice throughout its whole compass, so that the transition from one register to another, on all the vowels, may be accomplished imperceptibly. Some voices are naturally even and flexible. The professor of singing must correct faults in breathing, determine the range of the voice and place it, equalise its tone, increase its flexibility, instruct as to the pronunciation of vowels, modulation from one grade of expression to another, etc. A composer should be able to rely upon flexible and equal voices without having to trouble himself as to the abilities or defects of individual singers. In these days a part is seldom written for a particular artist, and composers and librettists do not find it necessary to entrust a certain rôle to fioriture singers, another to heavy dramatic voices. Poetic and artistic considerations demand greater variety of resource in the study of opera or vocal music in general.

title: 獨唱的音域與音區
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 我建議作曲者參考表F，其中列出六種主要獨唱人聲的大致音域。音符下方的括線標示常用的八度範圍，也就是人聲通常使用的音區。作曲者可在這個範圍內自由寫作，不必擔心使聲音緊繃或疲勞。-134-這個常用八度也適用於朗誦式歌唱與宣敘調；超出其上的音屬於例外，應用於樂句的高點或高潮，其下方的音則用於旋律的下降或收束。長時間使用不尋常的音區，會使歌者與聽者都感到疲倦；但偶爾可短暫使用，以免把人聲過度限制在一個八度內。以下列出幾個例子，說明不同類型人聲的旋律。
en: I advise the composer to be guided by Table F. which gives the approximate range of the six principal solo voices. A bracket under the notes defines the normal octave, the register in which the voice is generally used. Within these limits the composer may write freely without fear of hardening or tiring the voice.-134- The normal octave applies also to declamatory singing and recitative; the notes above it are exceptional and should be used for the culminating points of a passage or for climaxes, the notes below, for the fall or decline of a melody. Employing voices in unusual registers for long periods of time will weary both singer and listener, but these registers may occasionally be used for brief intervals so as not to confine the voice too strictly to one octave. A few examples are added to illustrate melody in different types of voices.

title: 聲樂旋律與字音配置
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 好的聲樂旋律應至少包含三種不同時值的音符，例如二分音符、四分音符與八分音符，或四分音符、八分音符與十六分音符等。單調的節奏結構不適合聲樂旋律；即使在器樂中，也只適用於某些情況。如歌的旋律需要相當數量的長音，而詞語中音節的轉換，應安排在歌聲離開一個持續長音的時刻。短音一音一音地隨各個音節變換，會產生協調的效果。考量咬字的需要，作曲者對於在同一音節上圓滑唱出綿長旋律音型的寫法，必須謹慎；歌者演唱這類音型，需要更強的靈活度與技巧。能在適當位置換氣，是一切聲樂寫作的必要條件之一。詞語中間不能換氣，有時連一句歌詞或一個片語中間也不能換氣；因此，必須在聲樂聲部中適當插入休止。-135-
en: A good vocal melody should contain notes of at least three different values, minims, crotchets and quavers (or crotchets, quavers and semiquavers etc.). Monotony in rhythmic construction is unsuited to vocal melody; it is applicable to instrumental music, but only in certain cases. Cantabile melody requires a fair number of long notes, and a change of syllable in a word should occur at a moment when the voice quits a long sustained note. Short, single notes, changing with every syllable produce a harmonious effect. Owing to the requirements of diction, extended melodic figures sung legato on one syllable must be used with care on the part of the composer; to perform these the singer must possess greater command over flexibility and technique. The possibility of taking breath in the right place is one of the conditions essential to all vocal writing. Breath cannot be taken in the middle of a word, sometimes not even during the course of a sentence or phrase in the text; hence the voice part must be suitably interspersed with rests.-135-

text: 註。必須記住，有些詞語不適合讓歌聲停留，也不適合唱超過一、兩個音。這類詞可能是名詞、代名詞、數詞、介系詞、連接詞或其他詞類。例如，在「who」（誰）、「he」（他）等詞上寫一個持續長音，便是不可行而且可笑的。歌聲可以停留在某些可說是具有詩意色彩的詞語上。[18]
en: Note. It must be remembered that there are some words upon which the voice may not dwell, or sing more than one or two notes. These words may be nouns, pronouns, numerals, prepositions, conjunctions and other parts of speech. It would be impossible and ridiculous, for instance, to write a sustained note on such words as "who", "he" etc. The voice may dwell on certain words which, so to speak, possess some poetical colour.[18]

title: 母音
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在同一音節上演唱多音、持續長音或高音區旋律時，母音的選擇頗為重要。發開口母音a與閉口母音ou時，口腔與嘴唇的位置有何不同，人人都很清楚。若從開口音的角度排列，母音的順序是：a、i、o、e、u。女聲唱高音最容易使用的母音是a，男聲則是o。母音i可柔化男低音最高音的穿透性，母音a則有助於把音域延伸到更低處。綿長的花腔樂段常寫在感嘆詞ah上，或直接-137-用母音a演唱。由於文學與戲劇原則的限制，作曲者只能在有限的程度上遵循上述規則。
en: As regards vocalisation on one syllable, on long sustained notes and in the high register, the choice of vowels is a matter of some importance. The difference in the position of the mouth and lips in forming the open vowel a and the closed vowel ou is apparent to everyone. The series of vowels from the point of view of open sounds is: a, i, o, e, u. In women's voices the easiest vowel on high notes is a, for men it is o. The vowel i softens the penetrating quality of the top notes of a bass voice, and the vowel a adds to the extension of range in the very lowest compass. Lengthy florid passages are often written on the interjection ah, or simply-137- on the vowel a. Owing to the restrictions imposed by literary and dramatic laws, the composer can only follow the above rules to a limited extent.

title: 人聲的靈活度
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 靈活度。
en: Flexibility.

title: 人聲的靈活度
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 人聲在常用的八度範圍內最靈活。女聲比男聲柔韌，但在各類人聲中，較高的聲音都較敏捷：女聲以女高音最敏捷，男聲則以男高音最敏捷。雖然人聲能演唱花腔與複雜音型、各種分句方式，以及斷奏與圓滑奏之間的快速轉換，其靈活度仍遠遠不及樂器。在具有一定速度的樂段中，自然音階與以三度構成的琶音最容易演唱。快速接連跳進超過四度的音程，以及半音音階，都極為困難。從短音起跳的八度或更大跳進，應一律避免。極高的音應先作準備，或逐步向上導入，或以明確的四度、五度或八度跳進抵達；不過，人聲有時也能在未作適當準備的情況下直接唱出高音。
en: Voices possess the greatest amount of flexibility in their normal octave. Women's voices are more supple than men's, but in all types, the higher voice is the more agile, sopranos in women, the tenor voice in men. Although capable of performing florid and complicated figures, different varieties of phrasing and the rapid change from staccato to legato, the human voice is infinitely less flexible than a musical instrument. In passages of any rapidity, diatonic scales and arpeggios in thirds come easiest to the voice. Intervals bigger than fourths in quick succession and chromatic scales are extremely difficult. Skips of an octave or more starting from a short note should always be avoided. Preparation should precede any extremely high note either by leading up to it gradually, or by the clear leap of a fourth, fifth or octave; but sometimes the voice may attack a high note without any due preparation.

title: 人聲的音色與特性
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 人聲的音色與特性。
en: Colour and character of voices.

title: 人聲的音色與特性
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 人聲的色彩，不論明亮或暗淡、陰沉或響亮，都取決於個別歌者，作曲者不必為此費心。關鍵在於詮釋，而審慎選擇演唱者即可解決這個問題。-138-從靈活度與表現力來看，人聲可分為抒情型與戲劇型兩類。後者較有力量，音域也較廣；前者則較柔韌、有彈性，也較容易表現不同層次的情感。雖然罕見的兩者兼具，是作曲者的理想，但仍應以自己設定而力求實現的主要藝術目標為依歸。在複雜而重要的作品中，作曲者應記住所用各類人聲的特性；此外，若使用兩個同類聲音，例如兩位女高音或兩位男高音，應區分各自聲部的音域與音區，讓其中一部略高於另一部。兼具兩種類型部分特質的中間型聲音（mezzo-carattere）並不罕見。作曲者可將需要兩類特性的角色，尤其是次要角色，交給這類人聲。當今，除了適合戲劇型與抒情型聲音的角色，也常突出那些需要特殊條件的角色，例如特別柔和或有力、具備特定音域或靈活度的聲音；這些條件由所追求的藝術目的決定。為次要與小角色寫作時，建議作曲者採用中等音域，並降低技巧上的要求。
en: The colouring of the voice, whether it be brilliant or dull, sombre or sonorous depends upon the individual singer, and the composer has no need to consider it. The chief question is interpretation and may be solved by the judicious choice of artists. From the-138- point of view of flexibility and expression voices may be divided into two classes, lyric and dramatic. The latter is more powerful and of greater range, the former possesses more suppleness and elasticity and is more readily disposed to different shades of expression. Granted that the rare combination of the two classes is the composer's ideal, he should nevertheless be content to follow the main artistic purpose which he has set out the achieve. In complicated and important works the composer should bear in mind the characteristics of the various voices he employs; moreover, if he use two voices of the same calibre, e.g. 2 Sopranos or 2 Tenors, he should discriminate between the range and register of their respective parts, writing for one slightly higher than the other. It is no rare occurrence to meet with voices of an intermediate character (mezzo-carattere) combining the qualities of each type to a modified extent. To such voices the composer may assign rôles demanding the characteristics of each class, especially secondary rôles. At the present day, besides the rôles suitable to the dramatic and lyric type of voice, it is customary to give prominence to those demanding some special qualifications, voices of a certain tenderness or power, a specified range or degree of flexibility—attributes decided by the artistic object in view. In casting secondary and minor rôles the composer is advised to employ a medium range and less exacting demands on technique.

title: 人聲的音色與特性
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 註。梅耶貝爾首先為一種特殊的厚重女中音與男中音寫作；在他之後，理查・華格納創造了一種力量強大、音域寬廣的戲劇女高音，兼具女高音與女中音的音質與音域；也創造了相似的男高音類型，兼具男高音與男中音的特質與音域。要求人聲在高、低音區都同樣明亮而富有共鳴，要求歌者擁有超強的呼吸能力與異常的耐力，例如齊格飛、帕西法爾、崔斯坦、布倫希爾德、昆德麗與伊索德等角色，幾乎是在要求奇蹟。這樣的聲音確實存在；但也有些歌者，聲樂能力雖然優秀，卻非超凡，為了增加音域與音量而不斷追求華格納的角色，結果只是使聲音失去正確的音準、美麗的音色與一切細膩的表情層次。我相信，較不苛刻的要求、更清楚地掌握真正的需要、熟練而審慎地運用人聲的高低音區、正確理解如歌的寫法，再結合始終不蓋過聲樂聲部的配器，從藝術角度而言，會比理查・華格納那些更繁複的方法，對作曲者更有幫助。
en: Note. After Meyerbeer, who was the first to write for a special type of heavy mezzo-soprano and baritone, Richard Wagner created a type of powerful dramatic soprano, of extensive range, combining the quality and scope of the soprano and mezzo-soprano voices; likewise a similar type of tenor, possessing the attributes and compass of the tenor and baritone together. To demand that voices shall be equally brilliant and resonant in the high and low register, that singers shall be endowed with a super-powerful breathing apparatus and an extraordinary faculty for resistance to fatigue (Siegfried, Parsifal, Tristan, Brünhilda, Kundry, Isolda), is to exact something little short of the miraculous. Such voices are to be found, but there are some singers with excellent though not phenomenal vocal powers, who, by the constant pursuit of Wagnerian parts endeavour to increase their range and volume, and only succeed in depriving the voice of correct intonation, beauty of tone, and all subtlety of nuances. I believe that less exacting demands and greater perception of what is required, skilful and judicious use of the high and low registers of the voice, a proper understanding of cantabile writing combined with orchestration which never overpowers the vocal part will be of greater service to the composer, from an artistic point of view, than the more elaborate methods of Richard Wagner.

text: 人聲的組合。
en: Voices in combination.

title: 人聲的組合
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 在重唱中，以結合複音與和聲的方式處理各個獨唱聲部，是保留其個別特性的最佳方法。完全採取和聲式或完全採取複音式配置的情形並不多見。前者廣泛用於合唱寫作，卻會過度簡化聲部的進行，抹去其旋律特性；後者則使聽覺感到疲倦，甚至有些紛擾。
en: Treating solo voices in a polyphonico-harmonic manner is the best method of preserving their individual character in ensembles. A distribution which is wholly harmonic or entirely polyphonic is seldom found. The first plan, largely used in choral writing, simplifies the movement of the voices too greatly, eliminating their melodic character; the second method is wearisome and somewhat disturbing to the ear.

title: 人聲的組合
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 一般而言，各聲部應依照常用音區的規律排列。聲部交錯很少使用；只有當上行聲部越過音區相鄰的聲部，目的在於突出其旋律時，才應採用，例如男高音高於女低音、女中音高於女高音等。
en: As a general rule the voices are arranged according to the law of normal register. Crossing of parts is rare and should only be done with the intention of emphasising the melody in the ascending voices above those adjacent in register, e.g. the tenor part above contralto, the mezzo-soprano above the soprano, etc.

text: 若使用彼此接近的音程，效果不佳，因為這會把較低的聲音移到高音區，並把較高的聲音移到低音區。同度演唱已不可能，三度也應避免；建議使用六度、十度與十三度。兩聲部經常相距超過十二度，而且不能交錯。
en: intervals approaching one another do not create a good effect, for this transplants the deeper voice into the upper register and vice versa. Singing in unison is no longer possible, and thirds are to be avoided; the use of sixths, tenths and thirteenths is recommended. The voices will often be separated by more than a twelfth and crossing of parts is out of the question.

text: 一般而言，二聲部寫作要成功，聲部進行必須清楚；不協和音程應由共同音準備，或由兩聲部以適當間距運動而產生，並正確解決。在小節的強拍上，尤其是時值較長的音，應避免空洞的四度、完全五度、十一度與十二度。不過，若一部具有旋律性，另一部則以朗誦式風格構成和聲伴奏，便不一定要避免上述音程。
en: As a general rule, writing for two voices is only successful when the progression of parts is clear, when discords are prepared by a common note, or are the outcome of conveniently separated movement and correctly resolved. Empty intervals of fourths and perfect fifths, elevenths and twelfths should be avoided on the strong beats of a bar, especially on notes of some value. If, however, one of the voices assumes a melodic character, the other forming the harmonic accompaniment in declamatory style, it is not absolutely necessary to avoid the intervals mentioned above.

title: 二重唱
book: 配器法原理：繁體中文版
text: 註。更詳細地討論聲樂聲部的寫法，不在本書範圍內；這個問題應留給自由對位的教師處理。但仍須指出：即使由管弦樂伴奏，人聲總是被聽作獨立的、與伴奏有別而且自成一體的存在。因此，作曲者絕不能依賴樂團來填補人聲中的空缺，或修正聲部處理上的缺點。聲樂寫作必須遵守和聲與對位的一切規則，連最細微之處也不例外，不能依賴管弦樂伴奏而成立。
en: Note. It is not within the scope of the present work to consider the writing of vocal parts in closer detail. This question must be left to the professor of free counterpoint. It remains to be noted that the human voice accompanied by the orchestra is always heard independently as something apart, something complete in itself. For this reason a composer may never rely on the orchestra to fill up an empty space or correct a fault in the handling of voices. All the rules of harmony and counterpoint, down to the last detail, must be applied to vocal writing, which is never dependent upon orchestral accompaniment.

title: 三重唱、四重唱等

text: 前述關於二重唱聲部關係的說明，同樣適用於三個、四個、五個或更多人聲的組合。多聲部重唱很少完全採取複音寫法；通常有些聲部以複音方式進行，其餘則以三度、六度、十度與十三度進行。也可以讓某些聲部在構成和聲的音上作朗誦式歌唱。人聲各部同時採取不同的運動方式，反而讓聽覺較容易掌握整體效果；也容許將鮮明而適切的音型或音色分配給某些聲部，與同時進行的其他音型或音色並存。巧妙安排休止與重新進入的位置，有助於理解整體，也能適度凸顯細節。-142-
en: All that has been said regarding the relationship of voices in duet applies with equal force to the combination of three, four, five or more voices. An ensemble of several voices is seldom purely polyphonic; as a rule, although some parts move polyphonically, progression in thirds, sixths, tenths and thirteenths is used for the remainder. Declamation for some voices on notes forming the harmony is also possible. This variety of simultaneous movement of vocal parts renders the comprehension of the total effect less difficult for the ear, and sanctions the distribution of distinctive and suitable figures or tone colouring to certain voices with other figures or timbres which may be proceeding at the same time. The skilful arrangement of pauses and re-entries facilitates the understanding of the whole, and gives desirable prominence to detail.-142-
